diseases.definition: A myopathy that is characterized by childhood onset of progressive muscle weakness and atrophy primarily affecting the proximal muscles in males between 5 and 10 years old, has_material_basis_in mutation in the VMA21 gene on chromosome Xq28.

diseases.label: adenylosuccinase lyase deficiency
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that is characterized by microcephaly, aggressive behavior, cerebellar hypoplasia and seizures, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the ADSL gene resulting in adenylosuccinate lyase deficiency.

diseases.label: ARC syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by congenital joint contractures, renal tubular dysfunction, cholestasis, severe failure to thrive, ichthyosis and a defect in platelet alpha-granule biogenesis and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the VPS33B gene or homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the VIPAR gene on chromosome 14q24.3.

diseases.label: Armfield syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndromic X-linked intellectual disability characterized by intellectual disability, short stature, seizures, and small hands and feet and in some cases cleft palate or cataracts/glaucoma that has_material_basis_in variation in the chromosomal region Xq28.

diseases.label: neuroacanthocytosis
diseases.definition: A neurodegenerative disease that is characterized by characterized by misshapen, spiny red blood cells (acanthocytosis) and neurological abnormalities, especially movement disorders.

diseases.label: choreaacanthocytosis
diseases.definition: A neuroacanthocytosis characterized by progressive neurodegeneration and red cell acanthocytosis, with onset in the third to fifth decade of life and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the VPS13A gene, which encodes chorein, on chromosome 9q21.

diseases.label: midface dysplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that is characterized by hypertelorism, a wide nose, vertical midline cleft and encephalocele.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency nuclear type 1
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency that has_material_basis_in mutation in the ATPAF2 gene on chromosome 17p11.

diseases.label: N syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by intellectual disability, deafness, ocular abnormalities, T-cell leukemia, cryptorchidism, hypospadias and spasticity.

diseases.label: polycystic liver disease
diseases.definition: A liver disease that is characterized by the presence of multiple cysts located_in the liver.

diseases.label: pheochromocytoma
diseases.definition: An endocrine organ benign neoplasm that arises within the adrenal medulla, releasing epinephrines and norepinephrines hormones that cause either episodic or persistent high blood pressure.

diseases.label: spastic ataxia 1
diseases.definition: A spastic ataxia characterized by early-onset cerebellar ataxia, spasticity, pyramidal syndrome and peripheral neuropathy, has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of heterozygous mutation in the VAMP1 gene on chromosome 12p13.

diseases.label: paraganglioma
diseases.definition: A pheochromocytoma that arises in extraadrenal sympathetic ganglia.

diseases.label: rapadilino syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by radial ray defect, patellae hypoplasia, cleft palate, diarrhea, dislocated joints, limb malformations, long nose and normal intelligence, has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the DNA helicase gene RECQL4 on chromosome 8q24.

diseases.label: schneckenbecken dysplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that is characterized by hypoplastic iliac bones, hypoplastic vertebral bodies, short ribs and broad long bones, prenatally lethal, has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the SLC35D1 gene on chromosome 1p31.

diseases.label: non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability
diseases.definition: A non-syndromic intellectual disability characterized by a X-linked inheritance pattern.

diseases.label: Joubert syndrome
diseases.definition: A ciliopathy that is characterized by congenital malformation of the brainstem and agenesis or hypoplasia of the cerebellar vermis leading to an abnormal respiratory pattern, nystagmus, hypotonia, ataxia, and delay in achieving motor milestones.

diseases.label: Meckel syndrome
diseases.definition: A ciliopathy that is characterized by renal cystic dysplasia, occipital encephalocele, polydactyly (post axial), hepatic developmental defects, and pulmonary hypoplasia.

diseases.label: hydrolethalus syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by multiple fetal developmental defects including polydactyly and central nervous system malformations that results from a single amino acid mutation of D211G of the HYLS1 gene which plays a central role in cilia formation.

diseases.label: obsolete Opitz-GBBB syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by hypertelorism, hypospadias, and additional midline defects.

diseases.label: Ogden syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by postnatal growth failure, severely delayed psychomotor development, variable dysmorphic features, and hypotonia and has_material_basis_in X-linked recessive or X-linked dominant mutation in the NAA10 gene on chromosome Xq28.

diseases.label: Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by the development of a one or more tumors (gastrinoma) in the pancreas, duodenum, or both that secrete excessive levels of gastrin, a hormone that stimulates production of acid by the stomach.

diseases.label: secondary progressive multiple sclerosis
diseases.definition: A multiple sclerosis that is characterized by a worsening of disability, rather than by relapses followed by recovery, which progressively worsens until a steady progression of disability replaces the cycles of attacks.

diseases.label: primary progressive multiple sclerosis
diseases.definition: A multiple sclerosis that is characterized by steady worsening of neurologic functioning, without any distinct relapses or periods of remission. The rate of progression may vary over time, with occasional plateaus or temporary improvements, but the progression is continuous.

diseases.label: progressive relapsing multiple sclerosis
diseases.definition: A multiple sclerosis that is characterized by steadily worsening symptoms and attacks during periods of remission with disease progression from the onset.

diseases.label: iridogoniodysgenesis syndrome
diseases.definition: An iris disease that is characterized by the iris stroma being hypoplastic resulting from abnormalities in the differentiation of the anterior segment structures and increased values of intraocular pressure and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutations in the PITX2 gene.

diseases.label: juvenile polyposis syndrome
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system disease that is characterized by predisposition to hamartomatous benign polyps in the gastrointestinal tract, specifically in the stomach, small intestine, colon, and rectum.

diseases.label: proximal symphalangism
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by ankylosis of the proximal interphalangeal joints, carpal and tarsal bone fusion, and conductive deafness.

diseases.label: tarsal-carpal coalition syndrome
diseases.definition: A dysostosis that is characterized by fusion of the carpals, tarsals, and phalanges, short first metacarpals causing brachydactyly; and humeroradial fusion.

diseases.label: fibular hypoplasia and complex brachydactyly
diseases.definition: An acromesomelic dysplasia that is characterized by severe reduction or absence of the fibula and complex brachydactyly.

diseases.label: persistent Mullerian duct syndrome
diseases.definition: A pseudohermaphroditism that is characterized by the persistence of Mullerian duct derivatives (i.e. uterus, cervix, fallopian tubes and upper two thirds of vagina) in a phenotypically and karyotypically male.

diseases.label: multiple cutaneous and mucosal venous malformations
diseases.definition: A vein disease that is characterized by multiple bluish cutaneous or mucosal venous lesions that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the TEK gene on chromosome 9p21.

diseases.label: short QT syndrome
diseases.definition: A heart conduction disease that is characterized by heart arrhythmia defined as a short QT interval on an EKG (less than 300 ms) that does not significantly change with heart rate, tall and peaked T waves, and a structurally normal heart.

diseases.label: multiple synostoses syndrome
diseases.definition: A dysostosis that is characterized by characterized by multiple joint fusions, usually commencing in the hands, conductive deafness, and characteristic facial features, including a broad, tubular-shaped nose and a thin upper vermilion.

diseases.label: cone dystrophy
diseases.definition: A retinal disease that is characterized by the loss of cone cells, the photoreceptors responsible for both central and color vision.

diseases.label: achalasia microcephaly syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by microcephaly, intellectual deficit and early onset symptoms of achalasia (abnormal enlargement of the esophagus, impaired peristalsis, cardiospasm, recurrent vomiting and respiratory infections).

diseases.label: peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase deficiency
diseases.definition: A peroxisomal disease that is characterized by hypotonia and seizures in the neonatal period and neurological regression in early infancy that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the ACOX1 gene on chromosome 17q25.1.

diseases.label: cerebral creatine deficiency syndrome
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that is characterized by mental retardation, severe speech delay, behavioral abnormalities and seizures, has_material_basis_in mutation in the creatine transporter gene on chromosome Xq28.

diseases.label: guanidinoacetate methyltransferase deficiency
diseases.definition: A cerebral creatine deficiency syndrome that is characterized by severe intellectual disability, seizures, speech problems and involuntary movements, has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the GAMT gene on chromosome 19p13.

diseases.label: cerebral creatine deficiency syndrome 1
diseases.definition: A cerebral creatine deficiency syndrome that is characterized by mental retardation, severe speech delay, behavioral abnormalities and seizures, has_material_basis_in mutation in the SLC6A8 gene on chromosome Xq28.

diseases.label: androgenic alopecia
diseases.definition: An alopecia that is characterized by M-shaped hair line recession and thinning of hair at the crown of the head in males.

diseases.label: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome spondylodysplastic type 2
diseases.definition: An Ehlers-Danlos syndrome that is characterized by aged appearance, developmental delay, short stature, craniofacial disproportion, generalized osteopenia, defective wound healing, hypermobile joints, hypotonic muscles, and loose but elastic skin and has_material_basis_in compound heterozygous mutation in the B3GALT6 gene.

diseases.label: glioblastoma classical subtype
diseases.definition: A glioblastoma that is characterized by abnormally high levels of epidermal growth factor receptor and the absence of p53 mutations.

diseases.label: glioblastoma proneural subtype
diseases.definition: A glioblastoma that is characterized by IDH1 and p53 mutations and Platelet Derived Growth Factor A amplification.

diseases.label: glioblastoma mesenchymal subtype
diseases.definition: A glioblastoma that is characterized by the most frequent number of mutation of the Neurofibromin 1 gene.

diseases.label: glioblastoma neural subtype
diseases.definition: A glioblastoma that is characterized by the expression of several gene types that are also typical of the brain's normal, noncancerous nerve cells, or neurons.

diseases.label: Kahrizi syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by mental retardation, cataracts, coloboma, kyphosis, and coarse facial features and has_material_basis_in mutation in the SRD5A3 gene.

diseases.label: mucopolysaccharidosis IX
diseases.definition: A mucopolysaccharidosis characterized by a deficiency in hyaluronidase.

diseases.label: biotin deficiency
diseases.definition: A nutritional deficiency disease that is characterized by thinning of the hair (often with loss of hair color), and red scaly rash around the eyes, nose, and mouth.

diseases.label: congenital adrenal hyperplasia
diseases.definition: A steroid inherited metabolic disorder that is characterized by adrenal insufficiency and variable degrees of hyper or hypo androgyny manifestations resulting from steroidogenic enzyme deficiency.

diseases.label: spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia, Pakistani type
diseases.definition: A spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia that is characterized by short stature, short and bowed lower limbs, mild brachydactyly, kyphoscoliosis, abnormal gait, enlarged knee joints, precocious osteoarthropathy, and normal intelligence.

diseases.label: spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia with congenital joint dislocations
diseases.definition: A spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia that is characterized by short stature of prenatal onset, joint dislocations (knees, hips, radial heads), club feet, and limitation of range of motion that can involve all large joints.

diseases.label: temtamy preaxial brachydactyly syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by brachydactyly, hyperphalangism of digits, facial dysmorphism, dental anomalies, sensorineural hearing loss, delayed motor and mental development, and growth retardation and has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the CHSY1 gene.

diseases.label: obsolete eye adnexa disease
diseases.definition: An eye and adnexa disease that is located_in the adnexa of the eye.

diseases.label: urofacial syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by inverted facial expressions in association with a severe and early-onset form of dysfunctional urinary voiding.

diseases.label: Stargardt disease
diseases.definition: An age related macular degeneration that is characterized by progressive vision loss usually to the point of legal blindness.

diseases.label: transcobalamin II deficiency
diseases.definition: A vitamin B12 deficiency that is characterized by a lack of vitamin B12 intestinal absorption resulting from a deficiency in the B12 transport protein TCII.

diseases.label: obsolete Matthew-Wood syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by microphthalmia or anophthalmia, pulmonary agenesis, and diaphragmatic defect.

diseases.label: atrioventricular block
diseases.definition: A heart conduction disease that is characterized by the impairment of the conduction between the atria and ventricles of the heart.

diseases.label: first-degree atrioventricular block
diseases.definition: An atrioventricular block that is characterized by prolonged PR interval on electrocardiogram caused by delayed conduction from atria to ventricles through the atrioventricular node.

diseases.label: second-degree atrioventricular block
diseases.definition: An atrioventricular block that is characterized by progressive prolongation of the PR interval on consecutive beats followed by a blocked P wave on electrocardiogram or intermittently non-conducted P waves not preceded by PR changes on electrocardiogram caused by a conduction block between the atria and the ventricles through the atrioventricular node.

diseases.label: third-degree atrioventricular block
diseases.definition: An atrioventricular block that is characterized by bradycardia, hypotension, hemodynamic instability and complete dissociation between P waves and QRS complexes on electrocardiogram caused when conduction fails to propagate from atria to ventricles.

diseases.label: sinoatrial node disease
diseases.definition: A heart conduction disease that is characterized by dysfunction of the impulse-generating (pacemaker) tissue located in the right atrium of the heart which generates normal sinus rhythm.

diseases.label: endocardium disease
diseases.definition: A heart disease that is located_in the innermost layer of tissue that lines the chambers of the heart.

diseases.label: tricuspid valve disease
diseases.definition: A heart valve disease that is characterized by valvular insufficiency or valvular stenosis, located_in tricuspid valve between the right atrium and right ventricle.

diseases.label: rheumatic heart disease
diseases.definition: A heart valve disease that is characterized by repeated inflammation with fibrinous repair caused by an autoimmune reaction to Group A beta-hemolytic streptococci (GAS) that results in valvular damage. The cardinal anatomic changes of the valve include leaflet thickening, commissural fusion, and shortening and thickening of the tendinous cords.

diseases.label: artery disease
diseases.definition: A vascular disease that is located_in an artery.

diseases.label: pericardium disease
diseases.definition: A cardiovascular system disease that is located_in the fibrous sac surrounding the heart.

diseases.label: peripheral artery disease
diseases.definition: An artery disease that is characterized by build up of plaque in the arteries that carry blood to your head, organs, and limbs.

diseases.label: familial encephalopathy with neuroserpin inclusion bodies
diseases.definition: A neurodegenerative disease that is characterized by intraneuronal inclusions of mutant neuroserpin resulting in progressive encephalopathy, dementia and seizures and has_material_basis_in a mutation in the SERPINI1 gene inherited in an in autosomal dominant pattern.

diseases.label: pyrimidine metabolic disorder
diseases.definition: An inherited metabolic disorder involving dysfunction of pyrimidine metabolism.

diseases.label: orotic aciduria
diseases.definition: A pyrimidine metabolic disorder that is characterized by an excessive secretion of orotic acid in urine.

diseases.label: CHARGE syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by a pattern of congenital anomalies including choanal atresia and malformations of the heart, inner ear, and retina.

diseases.label: generalized dystonia
diseases.definition: A dystonia that affects most or all of the body.

diseases.label: focal dystonia
diseases.definition: A dystonia that is localized to a specific part of the body.

diseases.label: multifocal dystonia
diseases.definition: A dystonia that involves two or more unrelated body parts.

diseases.label: segmental dystonia
diseases.definition: A dystonia that affects two or more adjacent parts of the body.

diseases.label: anismus
diseases.definition: A focal dystonia that is characterized by the failure of the pelvic floor muscles to relax during defecation.

diseases.label: cervical dystonia
diseases.definition: A focal dystonia that is characterized by simultaneous contraction of the agonist and antagonist muscles that control the position of the head contracting during dystonic movement which causes the neck to involuntarily turn to the left, right, upwards, and/or downwards.

diseases.label: focal hand dystonia
diseases.definition: A focal dystonia that affects a single muscle or small group of muscles in the hand resulting from involuntary muscular contractions.

diseases.label: oculogyric crisis
diseases.definition: A focal dystonia that is characterized by a prolonged involuntary upward deviation of the eyes.

diseases.label: oromandibular dystonia
diseases.definition: A focal dystonia that is characterized by distortions of the mouth and tongue.

diseases.label: spasmodic dystonia
diseases.definition: A focal dystonia that involves the muscles that control the vocal cords, resulting in strained or breathy speech.

diseases.label: cranio-facial dystonia
diseases.definition: A focal dystonia that is characterized as dystonia that affects the muscles of the head, face, and neck.

diseases.label: hemidystonia
diseases.definition: A multifocal dystonia that involves the arm and leg on the same side of the body.

diseases.label: sleep apnea
diseases.definition: A sleep disorder characterized by repeated cessation and commencing of breathing that repeatedly disrupts sleep.

diseases.label: obstructive sleep apnea
diseases.definition: A sleep apnea that is characterized by repeated collapse and obstruction of the upper airway during sleep, which results in reduced airflow (hypopnea) or complete airflow cessation (apnea), oxygen desaturation, and arousals from sleep.

diseases.label: periampullary adenoma
diseases.definition: An ampulla of Vater neoplasm that is characterized by glandular dysplastic lesion having pre-malignant potential.

diseases.label: diabetic encephalopathy
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by functional impairment of cognition, cerebral signal conduction, neurotransmission and synaptic plasticity, and underlying structural pathology associated with diabetes.

diseases.label: glomerulosclerosis
diseases.definition: A glomerulonephritis that is characterized by hardening of the glomerulus in the kidney.

diseases.label: limb ischemia
diseases.definition: An ischemia that is characterized by low blood supply to tissues in the limb due to interruption in the arterial blood supply.

diseases.label: chronic venous insufficiency
diseases.definition: A venous insufficiency that is characterized by lower extremity swelling, hyperpigmentation, pruritus and venous ulceration caused by blood pooling in the veins.

diseases.label: Muckle-Wells syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by episodic skin rash, arthralgias, and fever associated with late-onset sensorineural deafness and renal amyloidosis that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the NLRP3 gene on chromosome 1q44.

diseases.label: renal fibrosis
diseases.definition: A kidney disease that is characterized by progressive detrimental connective tissue deposition of the kidney parenchyma leading to deterioration of renal function.

diseases.label: oppositional defiant disorder
diseases.definition: A specific developmental disorder that is characterized by a pattern of angry mood, defiant behavior and vindictiveness in children and adolescents.

diseases.label: Perrault syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by sensorineural hearing loss and ovarian failure.

diseases.label: Marshall-Smith syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by advanced bone age, failure to thrive, respiratory problems, dysmorphic facial features, and variable mental retardation.

diseases.label: hemorrhagic cystitis
diseases.definition: A cystitis that is characterized by dysuria, hematuria and hemorrhage located_in the lower urinary tract.

diseases.label: colorectal adenoma
diseases.definition: An intestinal benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue of glandular origin and is located_in colon and located_in rectum.

diseases.label: colorectal adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A colorectal carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: pyometritis
diseases.definition: A uterine disease that is characterized by inflammation of the uterus and is associated with pus in the uterine cavity.

diseases.label: arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy
diseases.definition: An anterior ischemic optic neuropathy that is characterized by near-complete vision loss caused by damage to the medium-sized blood vessels supplying the optic nerves following temporal arteritis.

diseases.label: non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy
diseases.definition: An anterior ischemic optic neuropathy that is characterized by near-complete vision loss caused by acute ischemic damage to the optic nerve due to non-inflammatory small vessel disease.

diseases.label: tongue squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A head and neck squamous cell carcinoma that is located_in the tongue.

diseases.label: oral squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: An oral cavity cancer that has_material_basis_in squamous cells.

diseases.label: obsolete Jensen syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by sensorineural hearing loss with onset in infancy, followed in adolescence by progressive optic nerve atrophy with loss of vision and in adulthood by progressive dementia.

diseases.label: hepatocellular adenoma
diseases.definition: A liver benign neoplasm that is located_in liver cells and that is composed_of epithelial tissue in which tumor cells form glands or glandlike structures.

diseases.label: villous adenoma
diseases.definition: An adenoma that is located_in the colon and other places in the gastrointestinal tract and sometimes in other parts of the body.

diseases.label: pulmonary adenocarcinoma in situ
diseases.definition: A lung carcinoma in situ that derives_from the distal bronchioles or alveoli that initially exhibit a specific non-invasive growth pattern.

diseases.label: fibroma
diseases.definition: A connective tissue benign neoplasm composed of fibrous or connective tissues that derives_from mesenchymal tissue.

diseases.label: large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
diseases.definition: A lung large cell carcinoma that derives_from neuroendocrine cells.

diseases.label: follicular lymphoma
diseases.definition: A B-cell lymphoma that is characterized as an indolent non-Hodgkin's lymphoma and has_material_basis_in follicle center B-cells (centrocytes and centroblasts).

diseases.label: obsolete small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the lung
Caroli disease
diseases.definition: A bile duct disease that is characterized by abnormal dilatation of the intrahepatic bile ducts.

diseases.label: pancreatic agenesis
diseases.definition: A pancreas disease that is characterized by the failure of the pancreas to develop prior to birth.

diseases.label: fragile X-associated tremor/ataxia syndrome
diseases.definition: A X-linked hereditary ataxia that is characterized by adult-onset progressive intention tremor and gait ataxia, has_material_basis_in expanded trinucleotide repeat of the FMR1 gene that results_in a toxic gain of function of FMR1 RNA.

diseases.label: Koolen de Vries syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by developmental delay, intellectual disability, muscle weakness (hypotonia), epilepsy, distinctive facial features and congenital malformations of the heart, urogenital tract and the central nervous system, and has_material_basis_in either a chromosome 17 (17q21.31) microdeletion or a mutation in the KANSL1-gene.

diseases.label: inclusion body myopathy with Paget disease of bone and frontotemporal dementia
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by progressive proximal muscle weakness, steolytic bone lesions consistent with Paget disease, and frontotemporal dementia and has_material_basis_in mutation in the valosin containing protein.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 5
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by the early-onset of cerebellar signs and eye movement abnormalities with a very slow disease progression, and has_material_basis_in mutation in the SPTBN2 gene.

diseases.label: infantile cerebellar-retinal degeneration
diseases.definition: A neurodegenerative disease that is characterized by onset between ages 2 and 6 months of truncal hypotonia, athetosis, seizures, and ophthalmologic abnormalities, particularly optic atrophy and retinal degeneration.

diseases.label: triosephosphate isomerase deficiency
diseases.definition: A glucose metabolism disorder that is characterized by chronic haemolytic anaemia, cardiomyopathy, susceptibility to infections and severe neurological dysfunction, and has_material_basis_in the triosephosphate isomerase enzyme (TPI1) gene inherited as an autosomal recessive trait.

diseases.label: IMAGe syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by intrauterine growth restriction, metaphyseal dysplasia, adrenal hypoplasia congenita, genital abnormalities and has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the CDKN1C gene.

diseases.label: Troyer syndrome
diseases.definition: A hereditary spastic paraplegia that is characterized by spasticity of the leg muscles, progressive muscle weakness, paraplegia, muscle wasting in the hands and feet (distal amyotrophy), small stature, developmental delay, learning disorders, speech difficulties (dysarthria), and mood swings, and has_material_basis_in a mutation of the SPG20 gene.

diseases.label: Townes-Brocks syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by imperforate anus, dysplastic ears often associated with sensorineural and/or conductive hearing impairment, and thumb malformations.

diseases.label: syndromic intellectual disability
diseases.definition: An intellectual disability that is characterized by the presence of associated medical and behavioral sign and symptoms.

diseases.label: non-syndromic intellectual disability
diseases.definition: An intellectual disability that is characterized by the absence of associated medical and behavioral signs and symptoms.

diseases.label: synucleinopathy
diseases.definition: A neurodegenerative disease that is characterized by the abnormal accumulation of aggregates of alpha-synuclein protein in neurons, nerve fibres or glial cells.

diseases.label: adrenal cortical adenoma
diseases.definition: An adrenal adenoma that is a benign tumor of the adrenal cortex.

diseases.label: adrenal gland pheochromocytoma
diseases.definition: A malignant pheochromocytoma that is characterized by overproduction of adrenaline.

diseases.label: gallbladder adenoma
diseases.definition: A gallbladder benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue of glandular origin located_in the gallbladder.

diseases.label: ameloblastoma
diseases.definition: A cell type benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in odontogenic epithelium.

diseases.label: bone ameloblastoma
diseases.definition: A bone benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in odontogenic epithelium and is located_in bone.

diseases.label: bone squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A bone carcinoma that derives_from squamous epithelial cells.

diseases.label: bone chondrosarcoma
diseases.definition: A chondrosarcoma that is located_in bone.

diseases.label: phalanx chondroma
diseases.definition: A bone benign neoplasm that is located_in the phalanx that has_material_basis_in cartilaginous cells.

diseases.label: brain stem medulloblastoma
diseases.definition: A brain stem cancer that begins in the lower part of the brain on the floor of the skull.

diseases.label: sacrum chordoma
diseases.definition: A spinal chordoma that is located_in the sacrum.

diseases.label: corpus callosum oligodendroglioma
diseases.definition: A brain oligodendroglioma located_in the corpus callosum.

diseases.label: medulloblastoma
diseases.definition: An infratentorial cancer that is located_in the lower part of the brain and is a type of primitive neuroectodermal tumor.

diseases.label: parietal lobe ependymoma
diseases.definition: A parietal lobe neoplasm that has_material_basis_in cells lining the ventricles of the brain.

diseases.label: salivary gland carcinoma
diseases.definition: A salivary gland cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

diseases.label: inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
diseases.definition: A mesenchymal cell neoplasm that has_material_basis_in myofibroblastic cells admixed with inflammatory cells.

diseases.label: conjunctival nevus
diseases.definition: A sensory organ benign neoplasm that is located in the eye conjunctiva.

diseases.label: mixed extragonadal germ cell cancer
diseases.definition: A mixed germ cell cancer that is located_in areas of the body other than the ovary or testicle.

diseases.label: myelodysplastic syndrome
diseases.definition: A bone marrow cancer that is characterized by under production of white blood cells, red blood cells and platelets.

diseases.label: extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue
diseases.definition: A marginal zone B-cell lymphoma that has_material_basis_in mucosal tissue involved in antibody production.

diseases.label: cecum adenoma
diseases.definition: A cecal benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue with glandular origin.

diseases.label: appendix carcinoid tumor
diseases.definition: An appendix cancer that has_material_basis_in neurodendocrine cells.

diseases.label: colon adenoma
diseases.definition: A colonic benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue with glandular origin.

diseases.label: large intestine adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A large intestine cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: large intestine adenoma
diseases.definition: An intestinal benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue with glandular origin and is located_in the large intestine.

diseases.label: rectal adenoma
diseases.definition: An rectal benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue with glandular origin.

diseases.label: bronchus mucoepidermoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in the bronchus.

diseases.label: lung combined type small cell adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A lung combined type small cell carcinoma that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue of glandular origin.

diseases.label: vaginal carcinoma
diseases.definition: A vaginal cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

diseases.label: trachea mucoepidermoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in the trachea.

diseases.label: tonsil squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A tonsil cancer that has_material_basis_in squamous cells.

diseases.label: pharynx squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A pharynx cancer that has_material_basis_in squamous cells.

diseases.label: gastrointestinal carcinoma
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

diseases.label: spindle epithelial tumor with thymus-like differentiation tumor
diseases.definition: A thyroid gland carcinoma that has_material_basis_in compact bundles of long spindle epithelial cells that merge with tubulopapillary structures and/or mucinous glands.

diseases.label: striated muscle rhabdoid tumor
diseases.definition: A muscle cancer that is located_in striated muscle and has_material_basis_in rhabdoid cells which are large cells with eccentrically located nuclei and abundant, eosinophilic cytoplasm.

diseases.label: small intestine carcinoid neuroendocrine tumor
diseases.definition: A neuroendocrine tumor that has_material_basis_in cells of the neuroendocrine system and that is located in the small intestine.

diseases.label: jejunal adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A jejunal cancer that is located_in the jejunum and has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue that has glandular origin.

diseases.label: duodenum adenoma
diseases.definition: A duodenal benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue with glandular origin.

diseases.label: ovarian melanoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian cancer that has_material_basis_in melanoctyes.

diseases.label: mucosal melanoma
diseases.definition: A melanoma that has_material_basis_in melanocytes located_in mucosal membranes lining the respiratory, gastrointestinal and urogenital tract.

diseases.label: sublingual gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A sublingual gland cancer that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests or cords of epithelial cells surround and/or infiltrate ducts or glandular structures within the affected organ.

diseases.label: parotid gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A parotid gland cancer that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests or cords of epithelial cells surround and/or infiltrate ducts or glandular structures within the affected organ.

diseases.label: lung mucoepidermoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A lung carcinoma that has_material_basis_in a combination of squamous cells, mucus secreting cells and intermediate cells.

diseases.label: ovarian serous carcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian carcinoma that has_material_basis_in the lining of the ovary and produces a serum-like fluid.

diseases.label: ovarian clear cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian carcinoma that has_material_basis_in cells with clear cytoplasm and glycogen secreting hob nail cells.

diseases.label: cervical neuroblastoma
diseases.definition: An extracranial neuroblastoma that has_material_basis_in immature nerve cells.

diseases.label: extra-adrenal pheochromocytoma
diseases.definition: A malignant pheochromocytoma that originate in the ganglia of the sympathetic nervous system and are named based upon the primary anatomical site of origin.

diseases.label: retroperitoneal neuroblastoma
diseases.definition: A retroperitoneal cancer that has_material_basis_in immature nerve cells.

diseases.label: breast lobular carcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast carcinoma that derives_from breast lobules (milk glands).

diseases.label: uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma
diseases.definition: A uterine corpus cancer that is derives_from the inner lining of the uterus.

diseases.label: endocervical adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An endocervical carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: spastic ataxia 2
diseases.definition: A spastic ataxia that is characterized by cerebellar ataxia, spasticity and peripheral neuropathy in the first two decades of life, has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the KIF1C gene on chromosome 17p13.

diseases.label: spastic ataxia 3
diseases.definition: A spastic ataxia that is characterized by cerebellar ataxia, spasticity, hyperreflexia, urinary urgency and dysarthria, has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous complex genomic rearrangements involving the MARS2 gene on chromosome 2q33.

diseases.label: spastic ataxia 4
diseases.definition: A spastic ataxia that is characterized by cerebellar ataxia, spasticity, dysarthria and optic atrophy, has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the MTPAP gene on chromosome 10p11.

diseases.label: spastic ataxia 5
diseases.definition: A spastic ataxia that is characterized by early onset of cerebellar ataxia, spasticity, oculomotor apraxia, dystonia and myoclonic epilepsy, has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the AFG3L2 gene on chromosome 18p11.

diseases.label: spastic ataxia 7
diseases.definition: A spastic ataxia that is characterized by poor visual acuity, cerebellar ataxia, dysarthria and pyramidal signs.

diseases.label: Charlevoix-Saguenay spastic ataxia
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by early onset of cerebellar ataxia, pyramidal tract signs and peripheral neuropathy, has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the gene encoding the sacsin protein on chromosome 13q12.

diseases.label: hereditary hypophosphatemic rickets with hypercalciuria
diseases.definition: A rickets that has_material_basis_in increased serum 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D levels and increased intestinal calcium absorption and is characterized by the presence of hypophosphatemia secondary to renal phosphate wasting, radiographic and/or histologic evidence of rickets, limb deformities, muscle weakness, and bone pain.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant hypophosphatemic rickets
diseases.definition: A rickets characterized by low levels of serum phosphate and elevated levels of ALP and phosphaturia and that has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive hypophosphatemic rickets
diseases.definition: A rickets that has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance mutation in the DMP1 gene and is characterized by hypophosphatemia, rickets and/or osteomalacia and slow growth.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia
diseases.definition: A cerebellar ataxia that has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance.

diseases.label: hereditary ataxia
diseases.definition: A neurodegenerative disease that is characterized by slowly progressive incoordination of gait and often associated with poor coordination of hands, speech, and eye movements.

diseases.label: spastic ataxia
diseases.definition: A hereditary ataxia that is characterized by early onset of cerebellar ataxia, pyramidal tract signs and peripheral neuropathy.

diseases.label: X-linked hereditary ataxia
diseases.definition: A hereditary ataxia that is characterized by X-linked inheritance.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 1
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by ataxia, dysarthria, dysphagia, dystonia and peripheral neuropathy that begins in early adulthood, has_material_basis_in the expanded (CAG)n trinucleotide repeat of ataxin-1 gene on chromosome 6p22.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 2
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by ataxia, bulbar palsy, peripheral neuropathy chorea and muscle atrophy, has_material_basis_in mutation in the ATXN2 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 6
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by progressive ataxia, has_material_basis_in mutation in the CACNA1A gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 4
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by progressive ataxia, dysarthria and peripheral neuropathy, has_material_basis_in mutation in the SCA4 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 7
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by ataxia, progressive vision loss, and failure to thrive, has_material_basis_in mutation in the ATXN7 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 8
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by slowly progressive dysarthria, bradykinesia, nystagmus and loss of coordination, has_material_basis_in mutation in the ATXN80S gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 10
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by gait ataxia, upper-limb ataxia, dysarthria and dysphagia, has_material_basis_in mutation in the ATXN10 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 11
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by ataxia, nystagmus, pyramidal abnormalities and peripheral neuropathy, has_material_basis_in mutation in the TTBK2 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 12
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by minor ataxia and intention tremor, has_material_basis_in CAG expansion of the PPP2R2B gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 13
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by developmental delay, ataxia, myoclinic jerks, dysarthria, dysphagia and seizure, and has_material_basis_in mutation in the KCNC3 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 14
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by progressive ataxia, dysarthria and dysphagia, has_material_basis_in mutation in the PRKCG gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 15
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by progressive ataxia, nystagmus, dysarthria and dysphagia, has_material_basis_in mutation in the ITPR1 gene.

diseases.label: obsolete spinocerebellar ataxia type 16
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by truncal and limb ataxia, dysarthria, nystagmus, peripheral neuropathy and limb spasticity, has_material_basis_in mutation in the STUB1 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 17
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by chorea, dementia, dystonia, spasiticity and seizure, has_material_basis_in CAG repeat expansion in the TBP gene.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia, deafness and narcolepsy
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by ataxia, sensorineal deafness, narcolepsy with cataplexy, and dementia, has_material_basis_in mutation in the DNMT1 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 18
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by cerebellar ataxia and sensory neuropathy, has_material_basis_in mutation on chromosome 7q22-q23.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 19/22
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by mild cerebellar ataxia, cognitive impairment, myoclonus and tremor.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 20
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by cerebellar dysarthria.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 21
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by progressive cerebellar ataxia, cognitive impairment, tremor, bradykinesia and rigidity.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 23
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominnant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by slowly progressive ataxia, dysarthria, slow saccades and hyperreflexia, has_material_basis_in mutation in the PDYN gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 25
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by ataxia and sensory neuropathy, has_material_basis_in repeat CAG expansion on chromosome 2p15-p21.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 26
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by slowly progressive ataxia and oculomotor abnormalities, has_material_basis_in mutation in the EEF2 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 27
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by slowly progressive ataxia, early-onset tremor and dyskinesia, and has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the FGF14 gene on chromosome 13q33. Some patients have heterozygous deletions of chromosome 13q33 affecting the FGF14 and ITGBL1 genes, which may thus be considered a contiguous gene deletion syndrome.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 28
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by progressive ataxia, dysarthria, hyperreflexia, ophthalmoparesis, nystagmus and ptosis, and has_material_basis_in mutation in the AFG3L2 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 29
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by progressive ataxia, intellectual disability, dysarthria and ophthalmoplegia, and has_material_basis_in mutation in the ITPR1 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 30
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by slowly progressive gait abnormalities and dysarthria, has_material_basis_in mutation in the ODZ3 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 31
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by late-onset ataxia, dysarthria and horizontal nystagmus, has_material_basis_in repeat expansion mutation in the BEAN1 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 34
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by papulosquamous, ichthyosiform plaques at birth and progressive ataxia, dysarthria, nystagmus and hyporeflexia, has_material_basis_in mutation in the ELOVL4 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 35
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by a slowly progressive ataxia, tremor, dysarthria and hyperreflexia, has_material_basis_in mutation in the TGM6 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 36
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by progressive ataxia, dysarthria, hyperreflexia, sensiorineural hearing loss and muscle atrophy, has_material_basis_in mutation in the NOP56 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 37
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by progressive ataxia and dysarthria, presenting in mid-adulthood, and has_material_basis_in mutation to the DAB1 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 38
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by slowly progressive ataxia and nystagmus, presenting in mid-adulthood, and has_material_basis_in mutation to the ELOVL5 gene.

diseases.label: spinocerebellar ataxia type 40
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by progressive gait abnormalities, dysarthria, tremor and hyporeflexia, has_material_basis_in mutation in the CCDC88C gene.

diseases.label: hypomyelinating leukoencephalopathy
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by nystagmus, spasticity, and a distinct pattern of MRI abnormalities.

diseases.label: GRID2-related spinocerebellar ataxia
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by cognitive delay, abnormal eye movements, and hearing loss.

diseases.label: episodic ataxia type 1
diseases.definition: An episodic ataxia that is characterized by periodic ataxia and frequent myokymic discharges, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation in the potassium channel gene KCNA1.

diseases.label: episodic ataxia type 2
diseases.definition: An episodic ataxia that is characterized by periodic ataxia and nystagmus, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation in the calcium channel gene CACNA1A.

diseases.label: episodic ataxia type 3
diseases.definition: An episodic ataxia that is characterized by periodic ataxia, myokymia, vertigo and tinnitus, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance.

diseases.label: episodic ataxia type 4
diseases.definition: An episodic ataxia that is characterized by vertigo and diplopia.

diseases.label: episodic ataxia type 5
diseases.definition: An episodic ataxia that is characterized by dysarthria and vertigo, develops in early childhood, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation in the CACNB4 gene.

diseases.label: episodic ataxia type 6
diseases.definition: An episodic ataxia that is characterized by nystagmus and dysarthria, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation in the SLC1A3 gene.

diseases.label: episodic ataxia type 7
diseases.definition: An episodic ataxia that is characterized by episodes of weakness and dysarthria, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance.

diseases.label: episodic ataxia type 8
diseases.definition: An episodic ataxia that is characterized by weakness, dysarthria and myokymia, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation in the UBR4 gene.

diseases.label: cerebellar ataxia, impaired intellectual development, and dysequilibrium syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by congenital onset of nonprogressive cerebellar ataxia, disturbed equilibrium, and mental retardation, associated with cerebellar hypoplasia.

diseases.label: nonprogressive cerebellar ataxia with mental retardation
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by early onset of nonprogressive cerebellar ataxia, developmental delay, intellectual impairment and cerebellar atrophy, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation in the CAMTA1 gene.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 10
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by ataxia, dysarthria, nystagmus and marked cerebellar atrophy, has_material_basis_in mutation in the ANO10 gene.

diseases.label: infective endocarditis
diseases.definition: An endocarditis that is characterized by inflammation of the endocardium caused by infectious agents.

diseases.label: withdrawal disorder
diseases.definition: A substance-related disorder that occurs upon the abrupt discontinuation/separation or a decrease in dosage of the intake of medications, recreational drugs, and alcohol.

diseases.label: C1 inhibitor deficiency
diseases.definition: A complement deficiency that is a functional deficiency in the complement component C1 inhibitor leading to hereditary angioedema (HAE) involving swelling due to leakage of fluid from blood vessels into connective tissue.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of central nervous system
diseases.definition: An autoimmune hypersensitivity disease located_in the central nervous system.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of endocrine system
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is the abnormal functioning of the immune system resulting in production of antibodies or T cells against cells and/or tissues in the endocrine system.

diseases.label: obsolete artemis deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that is caused when the DCLREI1, DNA cross-link repair 1C gene contains mutations resulting in the inability to repair DNA.

diseases.label: CD3zeta deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that affects the development and function of T cells.

diseases.label: janus kinase-3 deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that is characterized by severe cell-mediated and antibody-mediated immunodeficiency with recurrent bacterial, viral, and fungal infections, develops_from janus kinase-3 deficiency, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the JAK3 gene of chromosome 19p13.11, responsible for normal differentiation and maturation of B and T immune cells.

diseases.label: MHC class I deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that is characterized by recurrent bacterial, viral, and fungal infections, especially of the lung, and sterile necrotizing granulomas of the skin, develops_from deficiency or decreased surface expression of MHC Class I, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation affecting MHC Class I production or expression and frequently involves TAP1 and TAP2 subunits, and is typically asymptomatic in infancy.

diseases.label: Omenn syndrome
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that has_material_basis_in the RAG1 and RAG2 genes on chromosome 11p and the Artemis gene on chromosome 10p. It is characterized by erythroderma, desquamation, alopecia, chronic diarrhea, failure to thrive, lymphadenopathy, and hepatosplenomegaly.

diseases.label: recombinase activating gene 1 deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that is the result of a mutation on Chromosome 6 RAG1 gene involving genetic rearrangement of both the T- and B-lymphocyte receptor genes.

diseases.label: recombinase activating gene 2 deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that is the result of a mutation on Chromosome 6 RAG2 gene involving genetic rearrangement of both the T- and B-lymphocyte receptor genes.

diseases.label: X-linked severe combined immunodeficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that is a X-linked SCID that has_material_basis_in mutations in genes encoding common gamma chain proteins shared by the interleukin (IL-2,4,7,9,16 and21) receptors resulting in a non-functional gamma chain, defective interleukin signalling, minimal or ascent T- and NK cells and non-functional B-cells.

diseases.label: CD45 deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that is an autosomal recessive disease with T and B lymphocyte dysfunction, due to a large deletion at one allelle and a point mutation at the other. The point mutation resulted in the alteration of intervening sequence 13 donor splice site. The population of T lymphocytes is diminished and unresponsive to mitogen stimulation. The level of B lymphocyte numbers, serum immunoglobulin decreased with age.

diseases.label: obsolete interleukin-7 receptor alpha deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that results from defective IL7R expression causes T-B+NK+ SCID. Loss of IL-7R function leads to the loss of an antiapoptotic signal, resulting in a loss of T-cell selection in thymus.

diseases.label: CD3delta deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that is characterized by the absence of T cells but normal numbers of B cells. CD3D is essential for T cell development.

diseases.label: CD3epsilon deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive mutations in the gene coding for T-cell surface glycoprotein CD3epsilon chain precursors. Patients with CD3epsilon deficiency have a severe defect in the expression of the T-cell receptor CD3-complex.

diseases.label: CD3gamma deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive mutations in the gene coding for T-cell surface glycoprotein CD3gamma chain precursors. Patients with CD3gamma deficiency have a severe defect in the expression of the T-cell receptor CD3-complex. Affected patients have decreased T-cell numbers and function; B cells are variably affected.

diseases.label: coronin-1A deficiency
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that is an actin regulator when mutated results in SCID through inhibition of thymic egress of mature thymocytes into peripheral lymphoid organs.

diseases.label: reticular dysgenesis
diseases.definition: A severe combined immunodeficiency that is the most severe form of SCID and has_material_basis_in mutations in the gene encoding mitochondrial adenylate kinase 2. It is characterized by congenital agranulocytosis, lymphopenia, and lymphoid and thymic hypoplasia with absent cellular and humoral immunity functions.

diseases.label: DNA ligase IV deficiency
diseases.definition: A combined T cell and B cell immunodeficiency that has_material_basis_in a mutation in the LIG4 gene, a DNA ligase, encoding a protein essential for V(D)J recombination and DNA double-strand break (DSB) repair through nonhomologous end joining (NHEJ). Patients present with immunodeficiency and developmental and growth delay.

diseases.label: CD40 ligand deficiency
diseases.definition: A combined T cell and B cell immunodeficiency that is a X-linked immunodeficiency with hyperimmunoglobulin M (XHIM) affecting isotype switching and is caused by the absence of CD40 ligand which is normally expressed on activated CD4+ T cells. Individuals with this mutation are unable to switch from IgM to IgG, IgA and IgE.

diseases.label: immunodeficiency with hyper IgM type 3
diseases.definition: A hyper IgM syndrome that has_material_basis_in mutation in the TNFRSF5 gene, resulting in type 3 hyper-IgM immunodeficiency that is characterized by an inability of B cells to undergo isotype switching, an inability to mount an antibody-specific immune response, and a lack of germinal center formation.

diseases.label: lambda 5 deficiency
diseases.definition: A B cell deficiency that has_material_basis_in mutations in the IGLL1 gene. Lambda 5 mutations can cause a block in B cell development at the transition between the pro-B cell and the pre-B cell stage.

diseases.label: immunoglobulin alpha deficiency
diseases.definition: A B cell deficiency that is an autosomal recessive disorder that has_material_basis_in mutation in the IgA (CD79 alpha) antigen receptor.

diseases.label: immunoglobulin beta deficiency
diseases.definition: A B cell deficiency that is characterized by mucosal infections and autoimmune diseases due to lack of production of immunoglobulin A antibody, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance.

diseases.label: agammaglobulinemia 4
diseases.definition: An agammaglobulinemia that has_material_basis_in a mutation a homozygous mutation in the BLNK gene on chromosome 10q23.2.

diseases.label: Good syndrome
diseases.definition: A combined T cell and B cell immunodeficiency that is a condition where there is co-occurrence of deficient cell-mediated immunity and benign thymoma.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of exocrine system
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is the abnormal functioning of the immune system that causes your immune system to produce antibodies or T cells against cells and/or tissues in the exocrine system.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of eyes, ear, nose and throat
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease located_in eyes, located_in ears, located_in nose and located_in throat.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of gastrointestinal tract
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is the abnormal functioning of the immune system that causes your immune system to produce antibodies or T cells against cells and/or tissues in the gastrointestinal tract.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of musculoskeletal system
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is the abnormal functioning of the immune system that causes your immune system to produce antibodies or T cells against cells and/or tissues in the musculoskeletal system.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of peripheral nervous system
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease of the nervous system that is the abnormal functioning of the immune system that causes your immune system to produce antibodies or T cells against cells and/or tissues in the peripheral nervous system.

diseases.label: dropped head syndrome
diseases.definition: A spinal disease that is characterized by severe kyphotic deformity of the cervicothoracic spine and by severe weakness of the cervical paraspinal muscles that results in the passively correctable chin-on-chest deformity. This syndrome is defined by weakness of neck extensor muscles against gravity with or without weakness of neck flexor muscles.

diseases.label: obsolete medical disorder
diseases.definition: A disease that is present at birth due to a genetic abnormality, error with embryonic development, infection or compromised intrauterine environment.

diseases.label: intrinsic cardiomyopathy
diseases.definition: A cardiomyopathy that is characterized as weakness in the muscle of the heart that is not due to an identifiable external cause.

diseases.label: developmental disorder of mental health
diseases.definition: A disease of mental health that occur during a child's developmental period between birth and age 18 resulting in retarding of the child's psychological or physical development.

diseases.label: specific developmental disorder
diseases.definition: A developmental disorder of mental health that categorizes specific learning disabilities and developmental disorders affecting coordination.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of skin and connective tissue
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is the abnormal functioning of the immune system that causes your immune system to produce antibodies or T cells against cells and/or tissues in the skin and connective tissue.

diseases.label: pervasive developmental disorder
diseases.definition: A developmental disorder of mental health that refers to a group of five disorders characterized by impairments in socialization and communication, as well as restricted interests and repetitive behaviors.

diseases.label: autism spectrum disorder
diseases.definition: A pervasive developmental disorder that is a spectrum of psychological conditions. The disease has_symptom widespread abnormalities of social interactions and communication, has_symptom severely restricted interests and has_symptom highly repetitive behavior.

diseases.label: atypical autism
diseases.definition: An autism spectrum disorder that involves some autistic symptoms occurring after age 3 with an absence of all the traits necessary for a diagnosis of autism.

diseases.label: sexual health disorder
diseases.definition: A disease of mental health that involves the impairment in normal sexual functioning.

diseases.label: paraphilia disorder
diseases.definition: A sexual disorder that is characterized recurrent, intense sexually arousing fantasies, sexual urges or behaviors generally involving nonhuman objects.

diseases.label: Munchausen by proxy
diseases.definition: A factitious disorder that involves a care giver's deliberate exaggeration, fabrication, and/or induce physical, psychological, behavioral, and/or mental health problems in others.

diseases.label: aphasia
diseases.definition: A language disorder that involves an acquired impairment of any language modality such as producing or comprehending spoken or written language.

diseases.label: writing disorder
diseases.definition: A learning disability that involves impaired written language ability such as impairments in handwriting, spelling, organization of ideas, and composition.

diseases.label: nosophobia
diseases.definition: A specific phobia that involves an irrational fear of contracting a disease.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of urogenital tract
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is the abnormal functioning of the immune system that causes your immune system to produce antibodies or T cells against cells and/or tissues in the urogenital tract.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of blood
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is the abnormal functioning of the immune system that causes your immune system to produce antibodies or T cells against cells and/or tissues in the blood.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of cardiovascular system
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is the abnormal functioning of the immune system that causes your immune system to produce antibodies or T cells against cells and/or tissues in the cardiovascular system.

diseases.label: obsolete neurological disorder
diseases.definition: A physical disorder that is the result of structural, biochemical or electrical abnormalities in the brain or spinal cord, or in the nerves leading to or from them, can result in symptoms such as paralysis, muscle weakness, poor coordination, loss of sensation, seizures, confusion, pain and altered levels of consciousness.

diseases.label: obsolete peripheral neuropathy
diseases.definition: A neuropathy that is located_in nerves of the peripheral nervous system.

diseases.label: autonomic peripheral neuropathy
diseases.definition: A neuropathy that affects the autonomic nervous system and is characterized by urinary incontinence, gastrointestinal dysmotility, orthostatic hypotension, apneas, sweat disturbances and impotence.

diseases.label: popliteal pterygium syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by abnormal development of the face, skin and genitals. Clinical expressions of the disease include cleft lip, with or without cleft palate, contractures of the lower extremities, abnormal external genitalia, syndactyly of fingers and/or toes, and a pyramidal skin fold over the hallux nail. It has_material_basis_in mutations in the IRF6 gene on chromosome 1.

diseases.label: hypersensitivity reaction disease
diseases.definition: An immune system disease that has_material_basis_in abnormal immune responses.

diseases.label: gluten allergy
diseases.definition: A food allergy that develops from an immune reaction to eating gluten, a protein found in wheat, barley, rye and triticale and that is characterized by stomach cramping, diarrhea and gastrointestinal upset and is unrelated to the gluten intolerance.

diseases.label: lymphoma
diseases.definition: A hematologic cancer that affects lymphocytes that reside in the lymphatic system and in blood-forming organs.

diseases.label: non-Hodgkin lymphoma
diseases.definition: A lymphoma that is characterized as any kind of lymphoma except Hodgkin's lymphoma.

diseases.label: primary cutaneous T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
diseases.definition: A peripheral T-cell lymphoma that has_material_basis_in a mutation of T cells.

diseases.label: familial juvenile hyperuricemic nephropathy
diseases.definition: A kidney disease that is characterized by hyperuricemia with renal uric acid under-excretion, gout and chronic kidney disease.

diseases.label: sideroblastic anemia 1
diseases.definition: A sideoblastic anemia that is characterized by the presence of microcytic hypochromic anemia and iron overload, and has_material_basis_in X-linked inheritance of mutation in the ALAS2 gene that enocdes aminolevulinic acid synthase that catalyzes the first step in heme production.

diseases.label: obsolete sideroblastic anemia with spinocerebellar ataxia
diseases.definition: A sideoblastic anemia that is characterized by microcytic hypochromic anemia and ealy-onset, slowly progressive spinocerebellar ataxia, and has_material_basis_in X-linked inheritance of mutation in the ABCB7 gene that encodes a transporter protein that plays a role in heme production in the bone marrow and cerebellum.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive pyridoxine-refractory sideroblastic anemia 2
diseases.definition: A sideroblastic anemia that is characterized by microcytic hypochromic anemia and iron overload, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the SLC25A38 gene.

diseases.label: pyridoxine-responsive sideroblastic anemia
diseases.definition: A sideoblastic anemia that is characterized by the presence of microcytic hypochromic anemia and iron overload, and has_material_basis_in X-linked inheritance.

diseases.label: Pearson syndrome
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial metabolism disease that is characterized by sideroblastic anemia and exocrine pancreas dysfunction.

diseases.label: nonbacterial thrombotic endocarditis
diseases.definition: An endocarditis that results from the deposition of small sterile vegetations on valve leaflets.

diseases.label: pre-malignant neoplasm
diseases.definition: A disease of cellular proliferation that results in abnormal growths in the body, which do not invade or destroy the surrounding tissue but, given enough time, will transform into a cancer.

diseases.label: benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A disease of cellular proliferation that results in abnormal growths in the body which lack the ability to metastasize.

diseases.label: lymphatic system cancer
diseases.definition: An immune system cancer that is located_in the lymphatic system and is characterized by uncontrolled cellular proliferation of lymphoid tissue.

diseases.label: ductal carcinoma in situ
diseases.definition: A breast carcinoma in situ that is characterized by being non-invasive, not having spread outside of the duct into the surrounding breast tissue, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells, derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: estrogen-receptor positive breast cancer
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that is characterized by the presence of estrogen receptors.

diseases.label: estrogen-receptor negative breast cancer
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that is characterized by the absence of estrogen receptors.

diseases.label: progesterone-receptor positive breast cancer
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that is characterized by the presence of progesterone receptors.

diseases.label: progesterone-receptor negative breast cancer
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that is characterized by the absence of progesterone receptors.

diseases.label: Her2-receptor positive breast cancer
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that is characterized by the presence of Her2 receptors.

diseases.label: Her2-receptor negative breast cancer
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that is characterized by the absence of Her2 receptors.

diseases.label: triple-receptor negative breast cancer
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that is characterized by the absence of estrogen, progresterone and Her2 receptors.

diseases.label: breast benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A thoracic benign neoplasm that is characterized by lack of malignancy.

diseases.label: immune system cancer
diseases.definition: An organ system cancer located_in the immune system that is characterized by uncontrolled cellular proliferation in organs of the immune system.

diseases.label: cell type benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm that is classified by the type of cell or tissue from which it is derived.

diseases.label: organ system benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm that is classified by the organ system from which it is arising from.

diseases.label: female reproductive organ benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A reproductive organ benign neoplasm that is characterized by a lack of malignancy located_in the female reproductive system.

diseases.label: male reproductive organ benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A reproductive organ benign neoplasm that is characterized by a lack of malignancy located_in the male reproductive system.

diseases.label: vestibular gland benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ benign neoplasm that is located_in the vestibular gland.

diseases.label: endocrine organ benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: An organ system benign neoplasm that is located_in endocrine glands which secretes a type of hormone directly into the bloodstream to regulate the body.

diseases.label: central nervous system benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A nervous system benign neoplasm that is characterized by lack of malignancy.

diseases.label: cardiovascular organ benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: An organ system benign neoplasm disease located_in the blood, heart, blood vessels or the lymphatic system.

diseases.label: immune system organ benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: An organ system benign neoplasm located_in the immune system organs.

diseases.label: bone benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A connective tissue benign neoplasm that is located_in bone.

diseases.label: uterine benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ benign neoplasm that is located_in the uterus.

diseases.label: sensory organ benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A nervous system benign neoplasm that is located_in a sensory organ.

diseases.label: thoracic benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: An organ system benign neoplam that is located_in the thoracic cavity.

diseases.label: osteoblastoma
diseases.definition: A bone benign neoplasm of the bone that is characterized by clinical and histological similarity to osteoid osteomas.

diseases.label: musculoskeletal system benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: An organ system benign neoplasm that is located_in the muscular and skeletal organs.

diseases.label: musculoskeletal system cancer
diseases.definition: An organ system cancer located_in the muscular and skeletal organs and characterized by uncontrolled cellular proliferation of the musculoskeletal organs.

diseases.label: obsolete benign glioma
diseases.definition: A cell type benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in glial cells.

diseases.label: cartilage cancer
diseases.definition: A connective tissue tumor that can be a benign chondroma or a maligannt chondrosarcoma.

diseases.label: central nervous system embryonal tumor
diseases.definition: A central nervous system cancer of children and young adults that develops from neural crest cells located_in cerebrum, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from neuroectoderm.

diseases.label: cerebellar medulloblastoma
diseases.definition: A cerebellum cancer that begins in the lower part of the brain on the floor of the skull.

diseases.label: brain meningioma
diseases.definition: A brain cancer that is characterized by tumor of the meninges, that develops from the membranes that surround the brain and spinal cord, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from meningeal cells of embryonic ectoderm origin.

diseases.label: brain glioma
diseases.definition: A brain cancer that has_material_basis_in glial cells.

diseases.label: vulvar benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ benign neoplasm that is located_in the vulva.

diseases.label: cervical benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ benign neoplasm that is located_in the cervix.

diseases.label: fallopian tube benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ benign neoplasm that is located_in the fallopian tube.

diseases.label: ovarian benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ benign neoplasm that is located_in the ovary.

diseases.label: vaginal benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ benign neoplasm that is located_in the vagina.

diseases.label: nervous system benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: An organ system benign neoplasm that is located_in the central nervous system or located_in the peripheral nervous system.

diseases.label: sensory system cancer
diseases.definition: A nervous system cancer that is located in the sensory system.

diseases.label: peritoneal benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A thoracic benign neoplasm that is located_in the serous membrane lining the abdominal cavity or coelom.

diseases.label: thoracic disease
diseases.definition: A disease of anatomical entity that is located_in the thoracic cavity.

diseases.label: pharynx cancer
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system cancer that is located_in the pharynx.

diseases.label: integumentary system benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: An organ system benign neoplasm located_in the integumentary system organs.

diseases.label: integumentary system cancer
diseases.definition: An organ system cancer that is located_in the skin, hair and nails.

diseases.label: connective tissue benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A musculoskeletal system benign neoplasm that is located_in connective tissue.

diseases.label: heavy chain disease
diseases.definition: A hypersensitivity reaction type IV disease that results from a proliferation of cells producing immunoglobulin heavy chains.

diseases.label: alpha chain disease
diseases.definition: A heavy chain disease that results from an overproduction of alpha antibodies (IgA).

diseases.label: gamma heavy chain disease
diseases.definition: A heavy chain disease that results from an overproduction of gamma antibody (IgG).

diseases.label: mu chain disease
diseases.definition: A heavy chain disease that results from an overproduction of mu antibody (IgM).

diseases.label: delta chain disease
diseases.definition: A heavy chain disease that results from an overproduction of delta antibody (IgD).

diseases.label: akinetopsia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of motion perception.

diseases.label: alexithymia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a deficiency in understanding, processing, or describing emotions.

diseases.label: amusia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize musical notes, rhythms, and intervals.

diseases.label: anosognosia
