diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to gain feedback about one's own condition or impairments.

diseases.label: apperceptive agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to distinguish visual shapes.

diseases.label: apraxia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to map out physical actions in order to repeat them in functional activities.

diseases.label: associative agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize visual scenes or classes of objects but retain the ability to describe them.

diseases.label: auditory agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to distinguishing environmental and non-verbal auditory cues including difficulty distinguishing speech from non-speech sounds even though hearing is usually normal.

diseases.label: autotopagnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to orient parts of the body.

diseases.label: color agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize a color, while being able to perceive or distinguish it.

diseases.label: cortical deafness
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to perceive any auditory information but whose hearing is intact.

diseases.label: finger agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to distinguish the fingers on the hand.

diseases.label: form agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to perceive a whole object while perceiving only parts of details.

diseases.label: integrative agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to integrate these elements together into comprehensible perceptual wholes while recognizing elements of the whole.

diseases.label: mirror agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to acknowledge objects in the neglected field that are visible when a mirror reflects the object visible in the non-neglected field.

diseases.label: pain agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to perceive and process pain.

diseases.label: phonagnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize familiar voices.

diseases.label: semantic agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to visually recognise an object while maintaining the use of non-visual sensory systems such as feeling, tapping, smelling, rocking or flicking the object to recognise the object.

diseases.label: simultanagnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize a whole image or scene while retianing the ability to recognize objects or details in their visual field one at a time.

diseases.label: social emotional agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to perceive facial expression, body language and intonation, rendering them unable to non-verbally perceive people's emotions and limiting that aspect of social interaction.

diseases.label: astereognosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is the loss of the ability to recognize objects by touch based on its texture, size and weight.

diseases.label: tactile agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize or identify objects by touch alone.

diseases.label: time agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to comprehend the succession and duration of events.

diseases.label: topographical agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to rely on visual cues to guide them directionally due to the inability to recognise objects.

diseases.label: verbal auditory agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognising spoken words as semantically meaningful.

diseases.label: visual agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to visually recognize objects.

diseases.label: visual verbal agnosia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to comprehending the meaning of written words.

diseases.label: diffuse alopecia areata
diseases.definition: An alopecia areata that involves diffuse loss of hair over the whole scalp.

diseases.label: acquired metabolic disease
diseases.definition: A disease of metabolism that has_material_basis_in enzyme deficiency or accumulation of enzymes or toxins which interfere with normal function due to an endocrine organ disease, organ malfunction, inadequate intake, dietary deficiency, or malabsorption.

diseases.label: organic acidemia
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that disrupts normal amino acid metabolism causing a building up of branched-chain amino acids.

diseases.label: childhood spinal muscular atrophy
diseases.definition: A spinal muscular atrophy that is associated with the survival of motor neuron protein in childhood and that has_material_basis_in variation in the SMN gene.

diseases.label: Kennedy's disease
diseases.definition: A spinal muscular dystrophy that has_material_basis_in an X-linked recessive expansion of CAG triplet repeats (glutamine) in exon 1 of AR gene encoding the androgen receptor.

diseases.label: dentatorubral-pallidoluysian atrophy
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia that has_material_basis_in expansion of CAG triplet repeats (glutamine) encoding a polyglutamine tract in the atrophin-1 protein.

diseases.label: body dysmorphic disorder
diseases.definition: A somatoform disorder that involves an excessive concern about and preoccupation with a perceived defect in his or her physical features (body image).

diseases.label: pain disorder
diseases.definition: A somatoform disorder that involves chronic pain in one or more areas, and is thought to be caused by psychological stress.

diseases.label: Kleine-Levin syndrome
diseases.definition: A recurrent hypersomnia that is characterized by recurring periods of excessive amounts of sleep and altered behavior.

diseases.label: bipolar ll disorder
diseases.definition: A bipolar disorder that is characterized by at least one hypomanic episode and at least one major depressive episode; with this disorder, depressive episodes are more frequent and more intense than manic episodes.

diseases.label: seasonal affective disorder
diseases.definition: A mental depression that involves presentation of depressive symptoms only during a specific season of the year.

diseases.label: histidinemia
diseases.definition: A histidine metabolism disease characterized by a deficiency of the enzyme histidase.

diseases.label: benign familial infantile epilepsy
diseases.definition: An infancy electroclinical syndrome that is characterized by afebrile partial complex or generalized tonic-clonic seizures occurring between 3 and 12 months of age with a good response to medication and no neurologic sequelae.

diseases.label: generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus
diseases.definition: An idiopathic generalized epilepsy that is characterized by febrile seizures often with accessory afebrile generalized tonic-clonic seizures with childhood onset.

diseases.label: juvenile absence epilepsy
diseases.definition: An adolescence-adult electroclinical syndrome statring between the age of ten to 17 years characterized by the occurrence of typical absence seizures.

diseases.label: Timothy syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by cardiac, hand/foot, facial, and neurodevelopmental features that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the CACNA1C gene on chromosome 12p13.33. The two forms are type 1 (classic) and type 2, a rare form that has_material_basis_in mutations in a transcript variant of the CACNA1C gene.

diseases.label: GABA aminotransferase deficiency
diseases.definition: A gamma-amino butyric acid metabolism disorder that is characterized by a defect in the gene coding for gamma-aminobutyrate transaminase, which is responsible for catabolism of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), an important, mostly inhibitory neurotransmitter in the central nervous system, into succinic semialdehyde.

diseases.label: succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency
diseases.definition: A gamma-amino butyric acid metabolism disorder that is characterized by a deficiency of succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase resulting in elevated levels of gamma-hydroxybutyric acid.

diseases.label: gamma-amino butyric acid metabolism disorder
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder characterized by impairment of the GABA catabolic pathway.

diseases.label: homocarnosinosis
diseases.definition: A gamma-amino butyric acid metabolism disorder that is characterized by an excess of homocarnosine in the brain and has_material_basis_in a deficiency of serum carnosinase in its ability to hydrolyze homocarnosine.

diseases.label: familial hemiplegic migraine
diseases.definition: A migraine with aura that is characterized by temporary numbness or weakness, often affecting one side of the body (hemiparesis). Additional features of an aura can include difficulty with speech, confusion, and drowsiness.

diseases.label: Renpenning syndrome
diseases.definition: An intellectual disability that is characterized by small head size (microcephaly), long narrow face, short stature, small testes, and intellectual deficit which follows X-linked inheritance and presents most often in males.

diseases.label: colitis
diseases.definition: An inflammatory bowel disease that involves inflammation located_in colon.

diseases.label: ischemic colitis
diseases.definition: A colitis caused_by inadequate blood supply to the colon.

diseases.label: microscopic colitis
diseases.definition: A colitis that can only be diagnosed_by the examination of colon tissue under a microscope.

diseases.label: collagenous colitis
diseases.definition: A colitis characterized by a distinctive thickening of the subepithelial collagen table.

diseases.label: lymphocytic colitis
diseases.definition: A colitis characterized by an accumulation of lymphocytes in the colonic epithelium and connective tissue (lamina propria).

diseases.label: Clostridium difficile colitis
diseases.definition: A colitis characterized by an overgrowth of Clostridium difficile bacteria.

diseases.label: chemical colitis
diseases.definition: A colitis caused_by introduction of various chemicals.

diseases.label: diversion colitis
diseases.definition: A colitis caused_by diversion of the fecal stream due to complication of ileostomy or colostomy.

diseases.label: jejunoileitis
diseases.definition: An inflammatory bowel disease that is characterized by patchy areas of inflammation located_in jejunum, has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom cramps and has_symptom formation of fistulas.

diseases.label: ileitis
diseases.definition: An inflammatory bowel disease characterized by inflammation located_in ileum, has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom abdominal pain, often in the right lower quadrant, has_symptom weight loss.

diseases.label: ileocolitis
diseases.definition: An inflammatory bowel disease characterized by inflammation located_in colon and located_in ileum, has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom weight loss, has_symptom abdominal pain in middle or lower right part. The most common type of Crohn's disease.

diseases.label: gastroduodenal Crohn's disease
diseases.definition: An inflammatory bowel disease characterized by inflammation located_in stomach and located_in duodenum, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom weight loss and has_symptom loss of appetite.

diseases.label: Crohn's colitis
diseases.definition: An inflammatory bowel disease characterized by inflammation located_in colon only, has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom rectal bleeding, has_symptom skin lesions and has_symptom formation of ulcers, fistulas and abscesses around the anus.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 1
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the SOD1 gene on chromosome 21. The most common type of familial ALS.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 2
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the alsin gene on chromosome 2.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 3
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in loci on chromosome 18.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 4
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis with juvenile onset that has_material_basis_in mutation in the SETX gene on chromosome 9.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 5
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the SPG11 gene on chromosome 15q21.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 6
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the FUS gene on chromosome 16.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 7
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in SOD1 gene on chromosome 20.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 9
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the ANG gene on chromosome 14.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 10
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the TARDBP gene on chromosome 1.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 11
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the FIG4 gene on chromosome 6.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 12
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the OPTN gene on chromosome 10.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 13
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis where a mutation that has_material_basis_in the ATXN2 gene on chromosome 12 contributes to suscepitbility.

diseases.label: frontotemporal dementia and/or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis 6
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the VCP gene on chromosome 9p13.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 15
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the UBQLN2 gene on chromosome X.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 16
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the SIGMAR1 gene (SETX) on chromosome 9.

diseases.label: obsolete amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 17
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the CHMP2B gene on chromosome 3.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 18
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the PFN1 gene on chromosome 17.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 19
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the ERBB4 gene on chromosome 2.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 20
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis with juvenile onset that has_material_basis_in mutation in the HNRNPA1 gene on chromosome 12.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 21
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the MATR3 gene on chromosome 5.

diseases.label: frontotemporal dementia and/or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis 1
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the C9ORF72 gene on chromosome 9. It is characterized by adult onset of either frontotemporal dementia and/or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

diseases.label: frontotemporal dementia and/or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis 2
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the CHCHD10 gene on chromosome 22. It is characterized by adult onset of either frontotemporal dementia and/or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

diseases.label: Balo concentric sclerosis
diseases.definition: A multiple sclerosis that is characterized by concentric layers of demyelinated tissues, tumor-like lesions larger than two centimeters and symptoms similar to those of a brain tumor.

diseases.label: Cogan syndrome
diseases.definition: An eye disease characterized by nonsyphilitic interstitial keratitis located_in cornea, has_symptom fever, has_symptom fatigue.

diseases.label: Cogan-Reese syndrome
diseases.definition: An eye disease characterized by variable iris atrophy, pigmented and pedunculated nodules located_in iris and attachment of the iris to the cornea (peripheral anterior synechiae) and characterized_by glaucoma.

diseases.label: CREST syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by calcinosis, Raynaud's phenomeno, esophageal dysmotility, sclerodactyly and telangiectasia.

diseases.label: lymph node adenoid cystic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A lymph node carcinoma that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests or cords of epithelial cells surround and/or infiltrate ducts or glandular structures of the lymph nodes. These structures are typically filled with a mucous-like material or contain abnormal fibrous membranes.

diseases.label: physical urticaria
diseases.definition: An urticaria induced by external physical influences.

diseases.label: Maffucci syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by the presence of multiple enchondromas (benign growths of cartilage) associated with multiple hemangiomas.

diseases.label: Scheie syndrome
diseases.definition: A mucopolysaccharidosis characterized by corneal clouding, facial dysmorphism and normal lifespan.

diseases.label: agraphia
diseases.definition: An acquired writing disorder causing a loss in the ability to communicate through writing, either due to some motor dysfunction or the inability to spell.

diseases.label: atrial fibrillation
diseases.definition: A heart conduction disease that is characterized by uncoordinated electrical activity in the heart's upper chambers (the atria), which causes the heartbeat to become fast and irregular and has symptoms palpitations, weakness, fatigue, lightheadedness, dizziness, confusion, shortness of breath and chest pain.

diseases.label: 3MC syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by blepharophimosis, blepharoptosis, highly arched eyebrows hypertelorism, cleft lip and palate, postnatal growth deficiency, cognitive impairment, hearing loss and, in a smaller percentage of cases, craniosynostosis, radioulnar synostosis and genital and vesicorenal anomalies. It encompasses four disorders that were previously designated the Malpuech, Michels, Mingarelli and Carnevale syndromes.

diseases.label: acrofrontofacionasal dysostosis
diseases.definition: A dysostosis characterized by intellectual disability, short stature, hypertelorism, broad notched nasal tip, cleft lip palate, postaxial camptobrachypolysyndactyly, fibular hypoplasia and anomalies of foot structure.

diseases.label: Adams-Oliver syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by defects of the scalp (aplasia cutis congenita), abnormalities of the fingers, toes, arms and legs.

diseases.label: intracranial berry aneurysm
diseases.definition: An intracranial aneurysm with a characteristic rounded shape; the most common form of cerebral aneurysm.

diseases.label: Baraitser-Winter syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by distinctive facial features including hypertelorism, large eyelid openings, ptosis, high-arched eyebrows, a broad nasal bridge and tip of the nose, a long space between the nose and the upper lip, full cheeks and a pointed chin; structural abnormalities of the brain might also be present.

diseases.label: basal ganglia calcification
diseases.definition: A basal ganglia disease characterized by the presence of abnormal calcium deposits of unknown cause in the brain; has symptom dementia, psychosis, mood swings and loss of acquired motor skills.

diseases.label: Bruck syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by a combination of multiple joint contractures and osteogenesis imperfecta.

diseases.label: branchiootic syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by malformations of the outer, middle and inner ear and branchial and renal malformations. Mutations of the EYA1, SIX1 and SIX5 genes are associated with the syndrome.

diseases.label: cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome
diseases.definition: A RASopathy characterized by unusually sparse, brittle, curly hair, macrocephaly, a prominent forehead and bi-temporal narrowing, intellectual disability, failure to thrive, congenital heart defects, short stature and skin abnormalities, and has_material_basis_in mutation in the BRAF, MAP2K1, MAP2kK2 and KRAS genes.

diseases.label: Carpenter syndrome
diseases.definition: An acrocephalosyndactylia characterized by craniosynostosis, acrocephaly, obesity, syndactyly and polydactyly.

diseases.label: carnitine palmitoyltransferase II deficiency
diseases.definition: A lipid metabolism disorder characterized by an enzymatic defect that prevents long-chain fatty acids from being transported into the mitochondria.

diseases.label: xanthinuria
diseases.definition: A purine-pyrimidine metabolic disorder characterized by deficiency of xanthine oxidase, resulting in excretion of large amounts of xanthine in the urine and the formation of xanthine stones.

diseases.label: Warburg micro syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by severe intellectual disability, microcephaly, congenital cataract, microcornea, microphthalmia, agenesis or hypoplasia of the corpus callosum and hypogenitalism.

diseases.label: Van Maldergem syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by facial abnormalities such as telecanthus, epicanthus, broad flattened nose, large inverted W-shaped mouth and malformed ears, malformed extremities such as camptodactyly, clinodactyly, interdigital webbing and joint hyperlaxity and mental retardation.

diseases.label: Van der Woude syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by the combination of lower lip pits, cleft lip with or without cleft palate and cleft palate alone.

diseases.label: UV-sensitive syndrome
diseases.definition: A skin disease characterized by photosensitivity and liver spots (solar lentigines).

diseases.label: 3-M syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by dwarfism, facial dysmorphia and skeletal abnormalities.

diseases.label: synpolydactyly
diseases.definition: A syndactyly characterized by an increased number of digits; often a result of a mutation in the HOXD13 gene.

diseases.label: stuttering
diseases.definition: An articulation disorder characterized by involuntary sound repetition and disruption or blocking of speech.

diseases.label: specific language impairment
diseases.definition: A language disorder characterized by difficulty in language acquisition despite otherwise normal development and in the absence of any obvious explanatory factors.

diseases.label: Mast syndrome
diseases.definition: A hereditary spastic paraplegia associated with dementia.

diseases.label: MASA syndrome
diseases.definition: A hereditary spastic paraplegia that is characterized by hydrocephalus, spasticity of the lower limbs, adducted thumbs, aphasia, seizures, agenesis of the corpus callosum and intellectual disability in the mild to moderate range.

diseases.label: Smith-McCort dysplasia
diseases.definition: A Dyggve-Melchior-Clausen disease that is characterized by short limbs and a short trunk with a barrel-shaped chest.

diseases.label: Simpson-Golabi-Behmel syndrome type 1
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by pre- and postnatal overgrowth and craniofacial, skeletal, cardiac and renal abnormalities and has_material_basis_in mutation in the gene encoding glypican-3 (GPC3) on chromosome Xq26.

diseases.label: scoliosis
diseases.definition: A bone structure disease characterized by an appreciable lateral deviation in the normally straight vertical line of the spine.

diseases.label: idiopathic scoliosis
diseases.definition: A scoliosis with no known cause.

diseases.label: sclerosteosis
diseases.definition: A hyperostosis characterized by excessive bone formation most prominent in the skull, mandible, clavicle, ribs and diaphyses of long bones; bone formation occurs throughout life.

diseases.label: sclerocornea
diseases.definition: A corneal disease in which the cornea blends with sclera, resulting in clouding of the cornea.

diseases.label: scapuloperoneal myopathy
diseases.definition: A muscular dystrophy which begins at the lower legs and affects the shoulder region earlier and more severely than distal arm.

diseases.label: Robinow syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by mild to moderate short stature due to growth delays after birth, distinctive craniofacial abnormalities, skeletal malformations and genital abnormalities.

diseases.label: rippling muscle disease 2
diseases.definition: A muscle tissue disease characterized by mechanically triggered contractions of skeletal muscle and that has_material_basis_in mutation in the caveolin-3 gene (CAV3) on chromosome 3p25.

diseases.label: Dowling-Degos disease
diseases.definition: A pigmentation disease characterized by a reticulate pattern of abnormally dark skin coloring, particularly in the body's folds and creases.

diseases.label: dyschromatosis symmetrica hereditaria
diseases.definition: A pigmentation disease characterized by progressively pigmented and depigmented macules, often mixed in a reticulate pattern, concentrated on the dorsal extremities.

diseases.label: reticulate acropigmentation of Kitamura
diseases.definition: A pigmentation disease characterized by lesions that initially arise as letiginous, hyperpigmented macules in a reticular pattern on the dorsal aspect of the hands and feet. Over time, lesions may spread proximally and may darken; palmoplantar pitting and dermatoglyphic disruption may also be present.

diseases.label: renal-hepatic-pancreatic dysplasia
diseases.definition: A physical disorder characterized by pancreatic fibrosis, renal dysplasia and hepatic dysgenesis; it is usual fatal soon after birth.

diseases.label: ptosis
diseases.definition: An eye disease characterized by the drooping or falling of the upper or lower eyelid.

diseases.label: congenital ptosis
diseases.definition: A ptosis characterized by eyelid drop present at birth.

diseases.label: gallbladder disease
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system disease that is located_in the gallbladder.

diseases.label: porencephaly
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by encephalomalacia and cystic brain lesions.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia
diseases.definition: A neurodegenerative disease that is characterized by underdevelopment of the pons and cerebellum.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 1A
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by central and peripheral motor dysfunction, hypotonia, spasticity and failure to thrive, has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the VRK1 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 1B
diseases.definition: A severe pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by hypotonia, progressive microcephaly and developmental delay, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the EXOSC3 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2A
diseases.definition: A severe pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by progressive microcephaly, chorea, epilepsy and hyperreflexia, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the TSEN54 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2B
diseases.definition: A severe pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by progressive microcephaly, clonus, dysphagia and failure to thrive, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the TSEN2 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2C
diseases.definition: A severe pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by progressive microcephaly, extrapyramidal dyskinesia, seizure and failure to thrive, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the TSEN34 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2D
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by progressive microcephaly, profound intellectual disability, spasticity and seizure, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the SEPSECS gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2E
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by progressive microcephaly, profound intellectual disability, spasticity and seizure, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the VPS53 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 3
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by progressive microcephaly, hypotonia, dysmorphic features, profound intellectual disability and seizure, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the PCLO gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 4
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by progressive microcephaly, hypertonia, myoclonus, seizure and early lethality, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the TSEN54 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 5
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by severe olivopontocerebellar hypoplasia and degeneration leading to early lethality, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the TSEN54 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 6
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by olivopontocerebellar hypoplasia and developmental delay, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the RARS2 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 7
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by delayed psychomotor development, hypotonia, gonadal abnormalities and respiratory failure, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive mutation in the TOE1 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 8
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by delayed psychomotor development, chorea, hypotonia, spasticity and visual defects, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the CHMP1A gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 9
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by progressive microcephaly, spasticity, seizure and brain atrophy, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the AMPD2 gene.

diseases.label: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 10
diseases.definition: A pontocerebellar hypoplasia that is characterized by severe developmental delays, progressive microcephaly, spasticity and seizure, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the CLP1 gene.

diseases.label: primary pigmented nodular adrenocortical disease
diseases.definition: An adrenal cortex disease characterized by small to normal sized adrenal glands containing multiple small cortical pigmented nodules.

diseases.label: photosensitive epilepsy
diseases.definition: An epilepsy characterized by seizures triggered by visual stimuli that form patterns in space or time, such as flashing lights.

diseases.label: persistent hyperplastic primary vitreous
diseases.definition: A developmental vitreous disease that is characterized by leukocoria, strabismus and vision loss, caused by failure of primary vitreous and hyaloid vasculature to regress during embryological development.

diseases.label: peeling skin syndrome
diseases.definition: A skin disease that is characterized by the painless, continuous peeling of the top layer of skin.

diseases.label: paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria
diseases.definition: An acquired hemolytic anemia that is characterized by abdominal pain, hematuria, esophageal dysmotility and thrombosis, has_material_basis_in defect in the cell membrane glycosyl phosphatidylinositols that protect red blood cells from the innate complement immune system.

diseases.label: parietal foramina
diseases.definition: An inherited neural tube defect that is characterized by enlarged openings in the parietal bones of the skull, has_material_basis_in mutation in the ALX4 gene or MSX2 gene.

diseases.label: combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial metabolism disease that is characterized by growth retardation, microcephaly, hypertonia, encephalopathy, cardiomyopathy and liver dysfunction.

diseases.label: cornea plana
diseases.definition: A corneal disease that is characterized by a flat cornea where the radius of curvature is less than 43 D.

diseases.label: omodysplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that is characterized by severe limb shortening and facial dysmorphism.

diseases.label: Ohdo syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by blepharophimosis, ptosis, dental hypoplasia, hearing impairment and intellectual disability.

diseases.label: Ohdo syndrome,  SBBYS variant
diseases.definition: A Ohdo syndrome that is characterized by blepharophimosis, ptosis and intellectual disability and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the KAT6B gene on chromosome 10q22.

diseases.label: oculodentodigital dysplasia
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by craniofacial, neurologic, limb and ocular abnormalities.

diseases.label: X-linked chondrodysplasia punctata 1
diseases.definition: A chondrodysplasia punctata that is characterized by maxillary hypoplasia, stippled chondrodystrophy, flat nasal tip and short columella, and that has_material_basis_in a mutation in the ARSE gene on chromosome Xp22.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant chondrodysplasia punctata
diseases.definition: A chondrodysplasia punctata that is characterized by abnormal facies and stippling of the limbs, associated with vitamin K-related teratogenicity, has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance.

diseases.label: cold-induced sweating syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by profuse sweating induced by cold ambient temperature.

diseases.label: complement component 2 deficiency
diseases.definition: A complement deficiency that is characterized by recurrent bacterial infections, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the C2 gene.

diseases.label: congenital secretory chloride diarrhea 1
diseases.definition: A secretory diarrhea that has_material_basis_in mutation in the SLC26A3 gene.

diseases.label: complement component 4a deficiency
diseases.definition: A complement deficiency that is characterized by recurrent bacterial infections, caused by C4A deficiency.

diseases.label: complement component 4b deficiency
diseases.definition: A complement deficiency that is characterized by recurrent bacterial infections, caused by C4B deficiency.

diseases.label: complement component 6 deficiency
diseases.definition: A complement deficiency that is characterized by recurrent bacterial infections, has_material_basis_in mutation in the C6 gene.

diseases.label: complement component 7 deficiency
diseases.definition: A complement deficiency that is characterized by recurrent bacterial infections, has_material_basis_in mutation in the C7 gene.

diseases.label: type I complement component 8 deficiency
diseases.definition: A complement deficiency that is characterized by deficiency of the alpha subunit of complement protein 8, which causes increased susceptibility to recurrent bacterial infections, especially to Neisseria meningitidis, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the C8A gene, which produces the alpha subunit of complement component 8 important in forming membrane attack complexes.

diseases.label: type II complement component 8 deficiency
diseases.definition: A complement deficiency that is characterized by deficiency of the beta subunit of complement protein 8, which causes increased susceptibility to recurrent bacterial infections, especially to Neisseria meningitidis, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the C8B gene, which produces the beta subunit of complement component 8 important in forming membrane attack complexes.

diseases.label: complement component 9 deficiency
diseases.definition: A complement deficiency that is characterized by recurrent bacterial infections, has_material_basis_in mutation in the C9 gene.

diseases.label: dyschromatosis universalis hereditaria
diseases.definition: A pigmentation disease characterized by reticulate hyper- and hypo-pigmentated macules in a generalized distribution.

diseases.label: megalocornea
diseases.definition: A corneal disease that is characterized by a bilaterally enlarged corneal diameter without an increase in intraocular pressure and that has_material_basis_in mutation in the CHRDL1 gene.

diseases.label: Meier-Gorlin syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by bilateral underdevelopment of the external ear, short stature, absent or underdeveloped patellae and severe prenatal and postnatal growth retardation.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder
diseases.definition: A intellectual disability characterized by an autosomal dominant inheritance pattern.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder
diseases.definition: A intellectual disability characterized by an autosomal recessive inheritance pattern.

diseases.label: syndromic X-linked intellectual disability
diseases.definition: A syndromic intellectual disability characterized by an X-linked inheritance pattern.

diseases.label: uvulitis
diseases.definition: An upper respiratory tract disease characterized by the swelling of the uvula to 3-5 times its normal size.

diseases.label: adenoid hypertrophy
diseases.definition: An upper respiratory tract disease characterized by the unusual growth of the adenoid tonsil; has symptom snoring, has symptom hyponasality, has symptom otitis media with effusion, has symptom mouth breathing.

diseases.label: angular cheilitis
diseases.definition: A cheilitis characterized by inflammation of one or both of the corners of the mouth.

diseases.label: tracheomalacia
diseases.definition: A tracheal disease characterized by flaccidity of the tracheal support cartilage.

diseases.label: persistent generalized lymphadenopathy
diseases.definition: A lymph node disease characterized by enlarged, non-painful lymph nodes occurring for more than three to six months for which no other reason can be found.

diseases.label: oral hairy leukoplakia
diseases.definition: A mouth disease characterized by a white patch on the side of the tongue with a corrugated or hairy appearance; caused by Epstein-Barr virus.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome I
diseases.definition: An orofaciodigital syndrome that is characterized by malformations of the face, oral cavity, and digits, has_material_basis_in X-linked dominant inheritance of the OFD1 gene with lethality in males and is associated with polycystic kidney disease.

diseases.label: lung abscess
diseases.definition: A lung disease characterized by microbial infection which causes a type of liquefactive necrosis of the pulmonary tissue and formation of cavities containing necrotic debris or fluid.

diseases.label: acute promyelocytic leukemia
diseases.definition: An acute myeloid leukemia characterized by accumulation of promyelocytes in the bone marrow and by a translocation between chromosomes 15 and 17.

diseases.label: cardiac arrest
diseases.definition: A congestive heart failure characterized by a sudden stop in effective blood circulation due to the failure of the heart to contract effectively or at all.

diseases.label: inguinal hernia
diseases.definition: An intestinal disease characterized by a protrusion of abdominal cavity contests through the inguinal canal.

diseases.label: umbilical hernia
diseases.definition: A intestinal disease characterized by the protrusion by part of the intestine though an opening in the abdominal muscles.

diseases.label: mastoiditis
diseases.definition: A middle ear disease characterized by an inflammation of the mucosal lining of the mastoid antrum and the mastoid air cell system inside the mastoid process.

diseases.label: breast abscess
diseases.definition: A breast disease characterized by a collection of pus in the breast.

diseases.label: dental abscess
diseases.definition: A tooth disease characterized by a localized collection of pus associated with a tooth.

diseases.label: cervical polyp
diseases.definition: A cervix disease characterized by a benign polyp on the surface of the cervical canal.

diseases.label: myelomeningocele
diseases.definition: A spina bifida characterized by protrusion of the spinal cord through an opening, covered by meningeal membranes.

diseases.label: omphalocele
diseases.definition: A physical disorder characterized by a defect in the development of the abdominal wall muscles, resulting in the intestines, liver and other organs to remain outside of the abdomen in a sac.

diseases.label: anal fistula
diseases.definition: An anus disease characterized by is an abnormal connection between the epithelialised surface of the anal canal and the perianal skin.

diseases.label: ectopic pregnancy
diseases.definition: A female reproductive system disease characterized by the implantation of the embryo outside the uterine cavity.

diseases.label: Rapp-Hodgkin syndrome
diseases.definition: An ectodermal dysplasia characterized by abnormal development of ectodermal tissues including the skin, hair, nails, teeth and sweat glands and anhidrotic ectodermal dysplasia with cleft lip/palate.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency nuclear type 2
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency that has_material_basis_in mutation in the TMEM70 gene on chromosome 8q21.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency nuclear type 3
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency that has_material_basis_in mutation in the ATP5E gene on chromosome 20q13.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency nuclear type 4
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency that has_material_basis_in mutation in the ATP5F1A gene on chromosome 18q21.1.

diseases.label: transient neonatal diabetes mellitus
diseases.definition: A neonatal diabetes that is characterized by hyperglycemia during the neonatal period that remits during infancy but recurs in later life in most patients.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant sideroblastic anemia 4
diseases.definition: A sideroblastic anemia characterized by an autosomal dominant inheritance pattern.

diseases.label: 3-methylglutaconic aciduria
diseases.definition: An organic acidemia that is characterized by elevated levels of 3-methylglutaconic acid and 3-methylglutaric acid in the urine.

diseases.label: CEDNIK syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the SNAP29 gene and characterized by a unique constellation of clinical manifestations including microcephaly, severe neurologic impairment, psychomotor retardation, failure to thrive, facial dysmoprhism, palmoplantar keratoderma and late-onset ichthyosis.

diseases.label: parameningeal embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: An embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma located in the parameningeal region.

diseases.label: chronic atrial and intestinal dysrhythmia
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by a unique combination of cardiac arrhythmias and intestinal pseudo-obstruction. It has_material_basis_in the mutated SGOL1 protein. Distinctive clinical features include atrial dysrhythmias, sick sinus syndrome (SSS) and valve anomalies and chronic intestinal pseudo-obstruction (CIPO).

diseases.label: ciliopathy
diseases.definition: A syndrome associated with mutations encoding defective proteins, which result in either abnormal function formation or function of cilia.

diseases.label: agnathia-otocephaly complex
diseases.definition: A physical disorder characterized by mandibular hypoplasia or agnathia, ventromedial auricular malposition (melotia) and/or auricular fusion (synotia), and microstomia with oroglossal hypoplasia or aglossia. Holoprosencephaly is the most commonly identified association, but skeletal, genitourinary and cardiovascular anomalies and situs inversus have been reported.

diseases.label: acromelic frontonasal dysostosis
diseases.definition: A dysostosis characterized by cranium bifidum, severe hypertelorism, median cleft lip and palate, nasal bifurcation, brachycephaly, large fontanelle, tibial hemimelia, preaxial polydactyly of the feet and brain malformations.

diseases.label: glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis
diseases.definition: An osteoporosis caused by chronic glucocorticoid use. Glucocorticoids impair the replication, differentiation and function of osteoblasts and induce the apoptosis of mature osteoblasts and osteocytes; the also favor osteoclastogenesis leading to an increase in bone resorption.

diseases.label: acrodermatitis chronica atrophicans
diseases.definition: An acrodermatitis characterized by a chronically progressive course, leading to widespread atrophy of the skin. It is a clinical manifestation of Lyme borreliosis.

diseases.label: bacillary angiomatosis
diseases.definition: A bartonellosis that has_material_basis_in Bartonella henselae or has_material_basis_in Bartonella quintana. The disease is characterized by the proliferation of blood vessels, resulting in them forming tumour-like masses in the skin and other organs.

diseases.label: Native American myopathy
diseases.definition: A congenital myopathy that is characterized by congenital weakness, arthrogryposis, cleft palate, ptosis, myopathic facies, short stature, kykphoscoliosis, talipes deformities and susceptibility to malignant hyperthermia provoked by anesthesia and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the STAC3 gene on chromosome 12q13.

diseases.label: acrorenal syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by limb defects, usually bilateral, like cleft hands or feet and longitudinal defects involving radius or ulna, tibia or fibula and renal anomalies which include agenesis, hypoplasia and rarely polycystic kidneys. Additional malformations may involve the oro-mandibular region, the trachea and lungs, skin derivatives including sweat glands, mammary glands, the uterus, vas deferens, the nasal placodes and the eyes.

diseases.label: hypoparathyroidism-retardation-dysmorphism syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by permanent parathyroid hormone (PTH) deficiency, hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, facial anomalies, and psychomotor retardation that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the TBCE gene on chromosome 1q42.3.

diseases.label: microcephaly with or without chorioretinopathy, lymphedema, or mental retardation
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by variable expression of microcephaly, ocular disorders including chorioretinopathy, congenital lymphedema of the lower limbs, and mild to moderate intellectual disability.

diseases.label: adenine phosphoribosyltransferase deficiency
diseases.definition: A purine-pyrimidine metaobolic disorder characterized by the formation 2,8-dihydroxyadenine stones and renal failure secondary to intratubular crystalline precipitation and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the gene encoding adenine phosphoribosyltransferase (APRT) on chromosome 16q24.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 2
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial metabolism disease characterized by motor disability, with ataxia, apraxia, dystonia, and dysarthria, associated with necrotic lesions throughout the brain and has_material_basis_in mutation in the TTC19 gene on chromosome 17. It has an autosomal recessive inheritance pattern.

diseases.label: Kleefstra syndrome 1
diseases.definition: A Kleefstra syndrome that is characterized by severe mental retardation, hypotonia, microcephaly, epileptic seizures, flat face with hypertelorism, synophrys, anteverted nares, everted lower lip, carp mouth with macroglossia, and heart defects and that has_material_basis_in a microdeletion in the chromosome region 9q34.3 or by a point mutation in the EHMT1 gene located in that region.

diseases.label: acrofacial dysostosis Cincinnati type
diseases.definition: An acrofacial dysostosis characterized by a spectrum of mandibulofacial dysostosis phenotypes, such as cleft palate, micrognathia, malar flattening, microcephaly and, in some cases, extrafacial skeletal defects. It is that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the POLR1A gene on chromosome 2p11.

diseases.label: Stormorken syndrome
diseases.definition: A blood platelet disease characterized by thrombocytopathy, thrombocytopenia, mild anemia, asplenia, tubular aggregate myopathy, miosis, headache, and ichthyosis. It has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the STM1 gene on chromosome 11p15. It has an autosomal dominant inheritance pattern.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 22
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the TUBA4A gene on chromosome 2q35.

diseases.label: Vici syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by callosal agenesis, cataracts, cardiomyopathy, combined immunodeficiency and hypopigmentation. It has_material_basis_in mutation in the EPG5 gene on chromosome 18q12.3.

diseases.label: chylomicron retention disease
diseases.definition: A lipid metabolism disorder characterized by malnutrition, failure to thrive, growth failure, vitamin E deficiency and the absence of chylomicrons and apolipoprotein B48 post-prandially. It has an autosomal recessive inheritance pattern and has_material_basis_in mutations in the SAR1B gene on chromosome 5q31.1.

diseases.label: multiple acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency
diseases.definition: An inherited metabolic disorder characterized by the body's inability to break down proteins and fats to produce energy. It is a disorder of fatty acid, amino acid, and choline metabolism and has an autosomal recessive inheritance pattern. It has_material_basis_in mutations in the ETFA, ETFB and ETFDH genes. It presents three clinical phenotypes: a neonatal-onset form with congenital anomalies (type I), a neonatal-onset form without congenital anomalies (type II), and a late-onset form (type III). The neonatal-onset forms are usually fatal.

diseases.label: Sakati-Nyhan syndrome
diseases.definition: An acrocephalosyndactylia characterized by abnormalities in the bones of the legs, congenital heart defects and craniofacial defects and craniosynostosis. The patients suffer from cyanosis and other respiratory and breathing infections.

diseases.label: hereditary papulotranslucent acrokeratoderma
diseases.definition: A keratosis of the hands and feet characterized by persistent, asymptomatic, yellowish to white papules and plaques associated with fine-textured scalp hair and an atopic diathesis.

diseases.label: punctate palmoplantar keratoderma
diseases.definition: A palmoplantar keratosis characterized by keratoses with a raindrop pattern on the palmoplantar surface, skin lesions which may involve the whole of the palmoplantar surface, or may be more restricted in their distribution.

diseases.label: punctate palmoplantar keratoderma type III
diseases.definition: A punctate palmoplantar keratoderma that is characterized by hyperkeratinization of the palms and soles, has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation in the AAGAB gene.

diseases.label: glycerol kinase deficiency
diseases.definition: An inherited metabolic disorder characterized_by wide range of phenotypic variability; patients can have severe metabolic and CNS abnormalities, while others possess hyperglycerolemia and glyceroluria with no other apparent phenotype and that has_material_basis_in mutation in the GK gene on chromosome Xp21.

diseases.label: Galloway-Mowat syndrome 1
diseases.definition: A Galloway-Mowat syndrome that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the WDR73 gene on chromosome 15q25.

diseases.label: mandibulofacial dysostosis with alopecia
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by malar and mandibular hypoplasia, typically associated with abnormalities of the ears and eyelids, and with alopecia.

diseases.label: Hennekam syndrome
diseases.definition: A lymphatic system disease characterized by he presence of intestinal lymphangiectasia, mental retardation, and characteristic facial anomalies. It is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern. Most individuals with Hennekam syndrome have characteristic facial abnormalities, such as a flat face with accompanying puffy eyelids and hypertelorism; the nasal bridge is typically flat and the ears are typically small. Congenital extremity and genital lymphedema is present in most patients.

diseases.label: Parkinson's disease 1
diseases.definition: A late onset Parkinson's disease that has_material_basis_in mutation in the alpha-synuclein gene on chromosome 4q22.1.

diseases.label: Parkinson's disease 2
diseases.definition: An early-onset Parkinson's disease that has_material_basis_in mutation in the parkin gene on chromosome 6q25.2-q27.

diseases.label: Parkinson's disease 6
diseases.definition: An early-onset Parkinson's disease that has_material_basis_in mutations in the PINK1 gene on chromosome 1p36.12.

diseases.label: Parkinson's disease 7
diseases.definition: An early-onset Parkinson's disease that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the DJ1 gene on chromosome 1p36.

diseases.label: Parkinson's disease 8
diseases.definition: A late onset Parkinson's disease that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the dardarin encoding gene on chromosome 12q12.

diseases.label: Parkinson's disease 15
diseases.definition: An early-onset Parkinson's disease that has_material_basis_in mutation in the FBXO7 gene on chromosome 22q12.3.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome III
diseases.definition: An orofaciodigital syndrome that is characterized by dysmorphic facies and severe intellectual deficits, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome IV
diseases.definition: An orofaciodigital syndrome that is characterized by dysmorphic facies, the development of harmartomas of the tongue, polydactyly and limb dysplasia, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutations in the TCTN3 gene.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome V
diseases.definition: An orofaciodigital syndrome that is characterized by postaxial polydactyly and median cleft of the upper lip and has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the DDX59 gene on chromosome 1q32.

diseases.label: Joubert syndrome with orofaciodigital defect
diseases.definition: A Joubert syndrome that is characterized by orofaciodigital defect.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome VII
diseases.definition: An orofaciodigital syndrome that is characterized by oral, facial and digital abnormalities, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome VIII
diseases.definition: An orofaciodigital syndrome that is characterized by tongue lobulation, hypoplasia of the epiglottis, cleft lip, polydactyly, short stature and intellectual deficit, and has_material_basis_in X-linked recessive inheritance.

diseases.label: acrofacial dysostosis
diseases.definition: A hetergeneous dysostosis that is characterized by digital dysplasia, downslanted palpebral fissures, deafness and developmental delay, has_material_basis_in mutation to the SF3B4 gene.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome X
diseases.definition: An orofaciodigital syndrome that is characterized by facial, oral and digital deformities as well as radial shortening, fibular agenesis and coalescence of tarsal bones.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome XI
diseases.definition: An orofaciodigital syndrome that is characterized by blepharophimosis, bulbous nasal tip, broad nasal bridge, downslanting palpebral fissures, low set ears, skeletal malformations, intellectual deficits, deafness and congenital heart defects.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome IX
diseases.definition: An orofaciodigital syndrome that is characterized by highly arched palate with bifid tongue, harmartomatous tongue, hypertelorism, telecanthus, strabismus, bifid nasal tip, short stature, bifid halluces, forked metatarsal, polydactyly, mild intellectual deficit and specific retinal abnormalities, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance.

diseases.label: acrofacial dysostosis Rodriguez type
diseases.definition: An acrofacial dysostosis that is characterized by CNS malformations, lung anomalies, congenital heart defects, dysmorphic facies and limb reduction, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance.

diseases.label: acrofacial dysostosis, Catania type
diseases.definition: An acrofacial dysostosis that is characterized by intrauterine growth retardation, short stature, microcephaly, cleft palate, limb hypoplasia, simian creases and cryptorchidism/hypospadias.

diseases.label: acrofacial dysostosis, Patagonia type
diseases.definition: An acrofacial dysostosis that is characterized by oligodontia, short stature, pili torti, syndactyly, vertebral abnormalities and cleft lip, and has_material_basis_in X-linked dominant inheritance.

diseases.label: Chilblain lupus
diseases.definition: A cutaneous form of systemic lupus erythermatosus that is characterized by painful nodular skin lesions precipitated by variation in temperatures, has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation in the TREX1 gene.

diseases.label: chondrodysplasia Blomstrand type
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that is characterized by rapid endochondral bone maturation, short limbs, dwarfism and prenatal lethality, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the PTH1R gene.

diseases.label: chromosomal deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal disease that has_material_basis_in partial deletion of chromosomes.

diseases.label: chromosome 10q23 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that is characterized by dysmorphic facies, developmental delay and multiple congenital abnormalities and huvenile polyposis, has_material_basis_in recurrent deletions of chromosome 10q22.3-q23.2.

diseases.label: distal 10q deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that is characterized by developmental delay, intellectual disability, behavioral problems and facial facies caused by a missing copy of the long arm of chromosome 10.

diseases.label: chromosome 13q14 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that is characterized by low birth weight, dysmorphic facies, limb defects, genital malformations and psychomotor developmental delay, has_material_basis_in deletion of the long arm of chromosome 13.

diseases.label: chromosome 14q11-q22 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that is characterized by microcephaly, dysmorphic facies, psychomotor delay and failure to thrive, has_material_basis_in isolated cases of partial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 14.

diseases.label: chromosome 15q11.2 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that is characterized by intellectual disbaility, dysmorphic facies, psychiatric illness and autism spectrum disorder, has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of partial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 15.

diseases.label: chromosome 15q13.3 microdeletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that is characterized by intellectual dsability, developmental delay, autism spectrum disorder and seizure, has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of partial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 15.

diseases.label: chromosome 15q24 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that is characterized by dysmorphic facial features, intellectual disability and seizure, has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation in the SIN3A gene causing partial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 15.

diseases.label: chromosome 15q25 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that is characterized by intellectual disability and developmental delay, has_material_basis_in partial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 15.

diseases.label: chromosome 15q26-qter deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that is characterized by pre- and postnatal growth restriction, developmental delay, variable degrees of intellectual disability, brachy-clinodactyly, talipes equinovarus, nail hypoplasia, proximally placed digits and mild craniofacial dysmorphism including microcephaly, triangular face, broad nasal bridge and micrognathia.

diseases.label: chromosome 16p11.2 deletion syndrome, 220-kb
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that is characterized by developmental delay, mild intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder and that has_material_basis_in a partial deletion of the short arm of chromosome 16, specifically a deletion of a 220-kb region on chromosome 16p11.2 (chr16:28.73-28.95 Mb) encompassing approximately 9 genes, including the SH2B1 gene.

diseases.label: chromosome 16p12.1 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a 520 kb deletion on the short (p) arm of the chromosome at a location designated 16p12.1 and is characterized by developmental delay, craniofacial dysmorphology, and congenital heart defects.

diseases.label: chromosome 16p12.2-p11.2 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a chromosome 16p12.2-p11.2 deletion and that is characterized by dysmorphic facial features, feeding difficulties, recurrent ear infections, developmental delay, and cognitive impairment.

diseases.label: chromosome 16q22 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in an interstitial 16q22 deletion that is characterized by a failure to thrive in infancy, poor growth, delayed psychomotor development, hypotonia, and dysmorphic features, including large anterior fontanel, high forehead, diastasis of the cranial sutures, broad nasal bridge, hypertelorism, low-set abnormal ears, and short neck.

diseases.label: chromosome 17p13.1 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a chromosome 17p13.1 deletion and that is characterized by mild global developmental delay/intellectual disability with poor to absent speech, dysmorphic features (long midface, retrognathia with overbite, protruding ears), microcephaly, failure to thrive, wide-based gait and a body posture with knee and elbow flexion and hands held in a midline.

diseases.label: chromosome 17q11.2 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a contiguous gene deletion on 17q11.2 that includes the NF1 gene.

diseases.label: chromosome 17q12 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a chromosome 17q12 deletion and that is characterized by renal cystic disease, maturity onset diabetes of the young type 5, cognitive impairment, developmental delay (particularly of speech), autistic traits and autism spectrum disorder.

diseases.label: chromosome 17q23.1-q23.2 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a chromosome 17q23.1-q23.2 deletion and that is characterized by characterized by developmental delay, microcephaly, short stature, heart defects and limb abnormalities.

diseases.label: chromosome 18p deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in partial or complete deletion of the short arm of chromosome 18.

diseases.label: chromosome 18q deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a terminal deficiency or macrodeletion that is characterized by mental retardation and congenital malformations.

diseases.label: chromosome 19q13.11 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a chromosome 19q13.11 deletion and that is characterized by characterized by poor overall growth, slender habitus, microcephaly, delayed development, intellectual disability with poor or absent speech, and feeding difficulties.

diseases.label: NFIA-related disorder
diseases.definition: A syndrome that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the NFIA gene on chromosome 1p31 and that is characterized by macrocephaly, seizures, developmental delay, dysmorphic features, ventriculomegaly, and hypotonia.

diseases.label: chromosome 1p36 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in by deletion of the chromosome 1p36 region and is characterized by severe intellectual disability, a small head, deep-set eyes with straight eyebrows, midface hypoplasia, a broad, flat nose, a pointed chin and low-set ears.

diseases.label: chromosome 1q21.1 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a contiguous deletion of the 1q21.1 region on chromosome 1 and is characterized by an increases the risk of delayed development, intellectual disability, physical abnormalities, and neurological and psychiatric problems.

diseases.label: chromosome 1q41-q42 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 1q41-q42 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, distal
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 22q11.2 region, distinct from DiGeorge syndrome and velocardiofacial syndrome.

diseases.label: chromosome 2p12-p11.2 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 2p12-p11.2 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 2p16.1-p15 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 2p16.1-p15 region that is characterized by delayed psychomotor development, intellectual disability, and variable but distinctive dysmorphic features, including microcephaly, bitemporal narrowing, smooth and long philtrum, hypertelorism, downslanting palpebral fissures, broad nasal root, thin upper lip, and high palate.

diseases.label: chromosome 2q31.2 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 2q31.2 region.

diseases.label: 3p deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a contiguous gene deletion syndrome involving chromosome 3pter-p25 and is characterized by low birth weight, microcephaly, trigonocephaly, hypotonia, psychomotor and growth retardation, ptosis, telecanthus, downslanting palpebral fissures, and micrognathia.

diseases.label: chromosome 3q13.31 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 3q13.31 region and that is characterized by marked developmental delay, characteristic facies with a short philtrum and protruding lips, and abnormal male genitalia.

diseases.label: chromosome 3q29 microdeletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 3q29 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 4q21 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 4q21 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 5q12 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 5q12 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 6pter-p24 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 6pter-p24 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 6q11-q14 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 6q11-q14 region and that is characterize by hypotonia, short stature, skeletal/limb anomalies, umbilical hernia, and urinary tract anomalies, as well as characteristic facial features including upslanting palpebral fissures, low-set and/or dysplastic ears, and high-arched palate.

diseases.label: chromosome 6q24-q25 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 6q24-q25 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 8q21.11 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome 8q21.11 region and that is characterized by intellectual disability and common facial dysmorphic features.

diseases.label: chromosome 19p13.13 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in a chromosome 19p13.13 deletion and that is characterized by an unusually large head size, tall stature, and intellectual disability that is usually moderate in severity.

diseases.label: chromosome Xp21 deletion syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the chromosome Xp21 region.

diseases.label: SATB2-associated syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that has_material_basis_in genetic changes that affect the SATB2 gene and that is characterized by mild to severe intellectual disability, a delayed or absent ability to speak, severe speech anomalies, abnormalities of the palate, teeth anomalies, behavioral issues with or without bone or brain anomalies, and onset before age 2.

diseases.label: chromosomal duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal disease that has_material_basis_in extra copies of a chromosomal region.

diseases.label: chromosome 16p11.2 duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in duplication of the chromosome 16p11.2 region that is characterized by low weight, a small head size, and developmental delay, especially in speech and language.

diseases.label: chromosome 16p13.3 duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in duplication of the chromosome 16p13.3 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 17p13.3 duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in the PAFAH1B1 and/or the YWHAE  gene on chromosome 17p13.3.

diseases.label: chromosome 17q12 duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in duplication of the chromosome 17q12 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 17q21.31 duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in duplication of the chromosome 17q21.31 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 1q21.1 duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in duplication of the chromosome 1q21.1 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 22q11.2 microduplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in duplication of the chromosome 22q11.2 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 22q13 duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in heterozygous interstitial duplication in chromosome 22q13 involving the SHANK3 gene.

diseases.label: Cole-Carpenter syndrome
diseases.definition: An osteogenesis imperfecta characterized by craniosynostosis, communicating hydrocephalus, ocular proptosis, marked postnatal growth failure, and distinctive facial appearance.

diseases.label: lysinuric protein intolerance
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder characterized by the body's inability to effectively break down lysine, arginine and ornithine and by renal hyperdiaminoaciduria, especially lysinuria, and by impaired formation of urea with hyperammonemia after protein ingestion. It has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the amino acid transporter gene SLC7A7 on chromosome 14q11.

diseases.label: epithelial and subepithelial dystrophy
diseases.definition: A corneal dystrophy that primarily affects the corneal epithelium and its basement membrane.

diseases.label: epithelial-stromal TGFBI dystrophy
diseases.definition: A corneal dystrophy that is characterized by abnormal deposition of proteins in the cornea and is caused by mutations in TGFBI gene of chromosome 5q.

diseases.label: stromal dystrophy
diseases.definition: A corneal dystrophy that affects the corneal stroma.

diseases.label: corneal endothelial dystrophy
diseases.definition: A corneal dystrophy that affects the corneal endothelium and/or the descemet membrane.

diseases.label: granular corneal dystrophy 2
diseases.definition: An corneal granular dystrophy that is characterized by recurrent erosions and stellate or thorn-like opacification located_in the cornea, hyaline and amyloid deposits in the stroma, and progressive vision loss later in life, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation of transforming growth factor beta-induced gene on chromosome 5q31.1, which encodes keratoepithelin. Abnormalities lead to increased hyaline and amyloid protein deposition and disruption of the corneal surface.

diseases.label: congenital stromal corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: A stromal dystrophy that is characterized by the presence of bilateral corneal opacities that can be seen at or shortly after birth.

diseases.label: X-linked endothelial corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: A corneal endothelial dystrophy that is characterized by congenital ground glass corneal clouding or a diffuse corneal haze, and blurred vision in male patients.

diseases.label: epithelial basement membrane dystrophy
diseases.definition: An epithelial and subepithelial dystrophy that is characterized by sheet-like areas of basement membrane originating from the basal epithelial cells of the corneal epithelium and extending superficially into the epithelium.

diseases.label: Fleck corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: A stromal dystrophy that is characterized by numerous tiny, dot-like white flecks scattered in all layers of the corneal stroma and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the PIKFYVE gene on chromosome 2q34.

diseases.label: gelatinous drop-like corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: An epithelial and subepithelial dystrophy that is characterized by severe corneal amyloidosis leading to blindness and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the TACSTD2 gene which encodes the monoclonal antibody-defined, tumor-associated antigen GA733-1, on chromosome 1p32.

diseases.label: Lisch epithelial corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: An epithelial and subepithelial dystrophy that is characterized by bilateral or unilateral, gray, band-shaped, and feathery opacities that sometimes appeared in whorled patterns and that has_material_basis_in the MCOLN1 gene on Chr. 19.

diseases.label: Meesmann corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: An epithelial and subepithelial dystrophy that is characterized by the formation of tiny round cysts in the corneal epithelium.

diseases.label: posterior amorphous corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: A stromal dystrophy that is characterized by irregular sheetlike areas of opacification with involvement of the Descemet membrane and, in some instances, alterations of the normal endothelial mosaic and that has_material_basis_in a chromosome 12q21.33 contiguous gene deletion syndrome.

diseases.label: Reis-Bucklers corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: An epithelial-stromal TGFBI dystrophy that is characterized by recurrent erosions and irregular geographic opacification located_in the cornea, proteinaceous deposits in the anterior stroma and subepithelium, and progressive early vision loss, and has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation of transforming growth factor beta-induced gene located in chromosome 5q31.1, which encodes keratoepithelin. Abnormalities lead to increased protein deposition and disruption especially of Bowman's membrane of the cornea.

diseases.label: subepithelial mucinous corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: An epithelial and subepithelial dystrophy that is characterized by frequent, recurrent corneal erosions in the first decade of life.

diseases.label: Thiel-Behnke corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: An epithelial-stromal TGFBI dystrophy that is characterized by recurrent erosions and honeycomb-shaped opacification located_in the cornea, proteinaceous deposits in the anterior stroma and subepithelium, and progressive early vision loss, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of heterozygous mutation of transforming growth factor beta-induced gene located in chromosome 5q31.1, which encodes keratoepithelin. Abnormalities lead to increased protein deposition and disruption especially of Bowman's membrane of the cornea.

diseases.label: Schnyder corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: A stromal dystrophy that is characterized by abnormal deposition of cholesterol and phospholipids in the cornea and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the UBAID1 gene on chromosome 1p36.

diseases.label: posterior polymorphous corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: A corneal dystrophy that is characterized by changes in Descemet's membrane and endothelial layer.

diseases.label: chromosome 2q31.1 duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in duplication of the chromosome 2q31.1 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 3q29 microduplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in duplication of the chromosome 3q29 region.

diseases.label: chromosome 5p13 duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in duplication of the chromosome 5p13 region.

diseases.label: chromosome Xp11.23-p11.22 duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in duplication of the chromosome Xp11.23-p11.22 region.
