diseases.label: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 87
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness characterized by prelingual profound sensorineural hearing loss with inner ear anomalies, including cochlear maldevelopment, absence of the osseous spiral lamina, and/or an enlarged vestibular aqueduct that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the PI4KB gene on chromosome 1q21.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 90
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the MYO3A gene on chromosome 10p12.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 81
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the ELMOD3 gene on chromosome 2p11.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 83
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the MAP1B gene on chromosome 5q13.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 86
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness characterized by late-onset progressive hearing loss through p53-mediated hair cell apoptosis that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the THOC1 gene on chromosome 18p11.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 88
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness characterized by postlingual progressive severe sensorineural hearing loss with tinnitus that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the EPHA10 gene on chromosome 1p34.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 89
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the ATOH1 gene on chromosome 4q22.

diseases.label: familial renal glucosuria
diseases.definition: A renal glycosuria that has_material_basis_in homozygous, compound heterozygous, or heterozygous mutation in the SLC5A2 gene on chromosome 16p11.2.

diseases.label: chromosome 11 partial duplication syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal duplication syndrome that has_material_basis_in one or more extra copies of a region of chromosome 11.

diseases.label: autoinflammation, antibody deficiency, and immune dysregulation syndrome
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease characterized by recurrent blistering skin lesions with a dense inflammatory infiltrate and variable involvement of other tissues, including joints, the eye, and the gastrointestinal tract that has_material_basis in heterozygous mutation in PLCG2 on chromosome 16q23.

diseases.label: glycine encephalopathy 1
diseases.definition: A glycine encephalopathy that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the GLDC gene, a member of the mitochondrial glycine cleavage system that encodes the P protein, on chromosome 9p24.

diseases.label: rhabdoid tumor predisposition syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by a markedly increased risk for the development of rhabdoid tumors, rare and highly aggressive malignant tumors occurring in almost any anatomical location predominantly in infants and young children.

diseases.label: rhabdoid tumor predisposition syndrome 1
diseases.definition: A rhabdoid tumor predisposition syndrome that has_material_basis_in heterozygous germline mutation in the SMARCB1 gene on chromosome 22q11.

diseases.label: mitochondrial trifunctional protein deficiency 1
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial trifunctional protein deficiency that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the HADHA gene, the alpha subunit of the mitochondrial trifunctional protein, on chromosome 2p23.3.

diseases.label: muscular disease
diseases.definition: A musculoskeletal system disease that affects the muscles.

diseases.label: bone disease
diseases.definition: A connective tissue disease that affects the structure or development of bone or causes an impairment of normal bone function.

diseases.label: bone remodeling disease
diseases.definition: A bone disease that results_in formation or resorption abnormalities located_in bone.

diseases.label: bone development disease
diseases.definition: A bone disease that results_in abnormal growth and development located_in bone or located_in cartilage.

diseases.label: bone deterioration disease
diseases.definition: A bone structure disease that results_in change or damage of structure located_in bone.

diseases.label: ischemic bone disease
diseases.definition: A bone disease that results_in an interruption of blood supply located_in bone.

diseases.label: X-linked dominant disease
diseases.definition: A X-linked monogenic disease that has_material_basis_in dominant inheritance.

diseases.label: bone structure disease
diseases.definition: A bone disease that has_material_basis_in an abnormality in the location or function of the skeletal structure.

diseases.label: bone resorption disease
diseases.definition: A bone remodeling disease that results in an abnormal decrease of bone density or mass.

diseases.label: X-linked recessive disease
diseases.definition: A X-linked monogenic disease that has_material_basis_in recessive inheritance.

diseases.label: chromosomal disease
diseases.definition: A genetic disease that has_material_basis_in extra, missing, or re-arranged chromosomes.

diseases.label: physical disorder
diseases.definition: A disease that has_material_basis_in a genetic abnormality, error with embryonic development, infection or compromised intrauterine environment.

diseases.label: spina bifida
diseases.definition: A neural tube defect that is characterized by incomplete closing of the spine and membranes around the spinal cord during early development.

diseases.label: dysbaric osteonecrosis
diseases.definition: An ischemic bone disease the has_material_basis_in nitrogen embolization located_in bone.

diseases.label: metaphyseal dysplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that is characterized by abnormally broad ends of the arm and leg long bones resembling a boat oar or paddle due to enlargement of the spongy inner layer of bone.

diseases.label: Jansen's metaphyseal chondrodysplasia
diseases.definition: A metaphyseal dysplasia that has_material_basis_in mutation in PTH receptor which results_in short-limbed dwarfism.

diseases.label: Schmid metaphyseal chondrodysplasia
diseases.definition: A metaphyseal dysplasia that results_in dwarfism and bowed legs.

diseases.label: otospondylomegaepiphyseal dysplasia, autosomal recessive
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that results from mutations autosomal recessive inheritance of mutations in the COL11A2 gene which results_in enlargement of the located_in epiphysis in located_in hand and located_in foot, distinct facial features, platyspondyly and hearing loss.

diseases.label: spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that results_in abnormalities of bone growth located_in vertebral column, located_in epiphysis, located_in metaphysis.

diseases.label: spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia, Strudwick type
diseases.definition: A spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia that has_material_basis_in mutations in the COL2A1 gene which results_in short stature and multiple skeletal abnormalities (lordosis, scoliosis, flattened vertebrae, pectus carinatum, coxa vara, clubfoot, and abnormal epiphyses or metaphyses).

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 16
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by truncal and limb ataxia resulting in gait instability and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the STUB1 gene on chromosome 16p13.

diseases.label: spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia, Missouri type
diseases.definition: A spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia that has_material_basis_in mutations in the MMP13 gene which results_in a pear-shaped vertebrae, abnormal metaphyseal changes, and genu varum deformities.

diseases.label: fibrous dysplasia
diseases.definition: A bone remodeling disease that results_in the destruction of normal bone and replacing it with fibrous bone tissue.

diseases.label: craniodiaphyseal dysplasia
diseases.definition: An osteosclerosis that results_in increased calcium concentration located_in skull which decreases the size of cranium foramina and cervical spinal canal.

diseases.label: craniometaphyseal dysplasia
diseases.definition: An osteosclerosis that is characterized by hyperostosis and sclerosis of the craniofacial bones associated with abnormal modeling of the metaphyses.

diseases.label: obsolete endosteal hyperostosis
diseases.definition: A hyperostosis of endosteal bone.

diseases.label: SOST-related sclerosing bone dysplasia
diseases.definition: A hyperostosis that has_material_basis_in a mutation in the SOST gene which results_in overgrowth of endosteal bone producing dense and wide bones throughout the body especially located_in skull.

diseases.label: Worth syndrome
diseases.definition: A hyperostosis that has_material_basis_in a mutation in the LRP5 gene which results_in increased bone density and bony structures located_in palate.

diseases.label: pycnodysostosis
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that has_material_basis_in a mutation in the CTSK gene which results_in dwarfism, brittle bones, osteopetrosis, shortening of the distal phalanges.

diseases.label: axial osteomalacia
diseases.definition: An osteosclerosis that results_in coarsening located_in trabecular bone.

diseases.label: fibrogenesis imperfecta ossium
diseases.definition: A syndrome that involves abnormality of collagen synthesis in lamellar bones, with manifestations limited to the skeleton. The initial symptom is frequently spontaneous fractures.

diseases.label: hypochondroplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that has_material_basis_in mutation in the FGFR3 gene which affects ossification of cartilage and results_in short limb dwarfism.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 18
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by delayed psychomotor development, severely impaired gait due to cerebellar ataxia, ocular movement abnormalities, and intellectual disability and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the GRID2 gene on chromosome 4q22.

diseases.label: achondrogenesis
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that has_material_basis_in deficient endochondral ossification which results_in dwarfism, short-trunk, short-limbed, anascara, disproportionately large cranium, and a narrow chest which leads to death in utero or during early neonatal period.

diseases.label: hypochondrogenesis
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that has_material_basis_in a mutation in the COL2A1 gene which affects bone growth and results_in a small body, hydrops fetalis, and abnormal ossification located_in vertebral column or located_in pelvis. The disease has_symptom enlarged abdomen.

diseases.label: Kniest dysplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that has_material_basis_in a mutation in the COL2A1 gene which results_in dwarfism with a short trunk and limbs as well as vision and hearing problems. The disease has_symptom large joints, has_symptom wide set eyes, has_symptom round flat face.

diseases.label: Stickler syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by a distinctive facial appearance, eye abnormalities, hearing loss, and joint problems.

diseases.label: pseudoachondroplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that has_material_basis_in mutations in the COMP gene which results_in short limb dwarfism.

diseases.label: acromesomelic dysplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that is characterized by mesomelia and acromelia, which results_in short limb dwarfism.

diseases.label: acromesomelic dysplasia, Maroteaux type
diseases.definition: An acromesomelic dysplasia that has_material_basis_in mutation in NPR-B receptor which results_in severe dwarfism, abnormalities of the vertebral column and shortening of the limb middle and distal segments.

diseases.label: acromesomelic dysplasia, Hunter-Thompson type
diseases.definition: An acromesomelic dysplasia that has_material_basis_in mutation in AMDH gene which results_in normal axial skeleton but fused bones in the located_in hand or located_in foot.

diseases.label: acromesomelic dysplasia, Grebe type
diseases.definition: An acromesomelic dysplasia that has_material_basis_in mutation in CDMP-1 which results_in micromelia, absence of middle and proximal phalanges and some metacarpal and metatarsal bones.

diseases.label: Albright's hereditary osteodystrophy
diseases.definition: An pseudohypoparathyroidism that has_material_basis_in lack of responsiveness to parathyroid hormone which results in shortening and widening of long bones of the located in hand or located in foot along with short stature, obesity, and rounded face.

diseases.label: achondrogenesis type IA
diseases.definition: An achondrogenesis that results_in abnormal ossification of the located_in vertebral column or located_in spine.

diseases.label: achondrogenesis type IB
diseases.definition: An achondrogenesis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the SLC26A2 gene which results_in umbilical or inguinal hernia and a prominent rounded abdomen.

diseases.label: achondrogenesis type II
diseases.definition: An achondrogenesis that has_material_basis_in mutations in the COL2A1 gene which results_in underdeveloped lungs, hydrops fetalis, a prominent forehead and abnormal ossification of the located_in vertebral column or located_in pelvis.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 15
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the RUBCN gene on chromosome 3q29.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 14
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by delayed psychomotor development, severe early-onset gait ataxia, eye movement abnormalities, cerebellar atrophy on brain imaging, and intellectual disability and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the SPTBN2 gene on chromosome 11q13.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 7
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by onset of progressive gait difficulties, eye movement abnormalities, and dysarthria in the first or second decade of life and that has_material_basis_in compound heterozygous mutation in the TPP1 gene on chromosome 11p15.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 12
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by onset of generalized seizures in infancy, delayed psychomotor development with mental retardation, and cerebellar ataxia and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the WWOX gene on chromosome 16q23.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 2
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by juvenile onset of progressive cerebellar ataxia, axonal sensorimotor peripheral neuropathy, and increased serum alpha-fetoprotein, and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the senataxin gene on chromosome 9q34.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 13
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by delayed psychomotor development beginning in infancy and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the GRM1 gene on chromosome 6q24.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 11
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the SYT14 gene on chromosome 1q32.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 17
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the CWF19L1 gene on chromosome 10q24.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 19
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by postnatal onset of severe progressive sensorineural hearing loss and progressive cerebellar ataxia and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the SLC9A1 gene on chromosome 1p36.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 20
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by severely delayed psychomotor development with poor or absent speech, wide-based or absent gait, coarse facies, and cerebellar atrophy and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the SNX14 gene on chromosome 6q14.

diseases.label: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 5
diseases.definition: A Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease that is characterized by pyramidal features including extensor plantar responses, mild increase in tone, and preserved or increased reflexes but no spastic gait.

diseases.label: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 6
diseases.definition: A Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease that is characterized by early-onset optic atrophy resulting in progressive visual loss and peripheral axonal sensorimotor neuropathy with highly variable age at onset and severity.

diseases.label: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 7
diseases.definition: A Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease that is characterized by optic atrophy followed by retinitis pigmentosa.

diseases.label: mucolipidosis II alpha/beta
diseases.definition: A mucolipidosis that is characterized by short stature, skeletal abnormalities, cardiomegaly, and developmental delay, caused by a defect in proper lysosomal enzyme phosphorylation and localization, which results in accumulation of lysosomal substrates, and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the GNPTAB gene.

diseases.label: mucolipidosis III alpha/beta
diseases.definition: A mucolipidosis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the gene encoding the alpha/beta-subunits precursor gene of GLcNAc-phosphotransferase.

diseases.label: intestinal pseudo-obstruction
diseases.definition: A colonic disease that is characterized by bowel obstruction resulting from impairment of the muscle contractions that move food through the digestive tract.

diseases.label: spina bifida occulta
diseases.definition: A spina bifida that is characterized by minor splits in the vertebrae where the outer part of some of the vertebrae is not completely closed.

diseases.label: neural tube defect
diseases.definition: A physical disorder characterized by incomplete closure of the neural tube.

diseases.label: Neu-Laxova syndrome 2
diseases.definition: A serine deficiency that is characterized by multiple fatal malformations including ichthyosis, microcephaly, central nervous system abnormalities, limb deformities, intrauterine growth restriction, proptosis, anasarca, and micrognathia, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the PSAT1 gene on chromosome 9q21.1, causing issues producing the amino acid serine.

diseases.label: Neu-Laxova syndrome 1
diseases.definition: A serine deficiency that is characterized by multiple fatal malformations including ichthyosis, microcephaly, central nervous system abnormalities, limb deformities, intrauterine growth restriction, proptosis, anasarca, and micrognathia, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the PHGDH gene on chromosome 1p12, causing issues producing the amino acid serine.

diseases.label: hypophosphatemic nephrolithiasis/osteoporosis 1
diseases.definition: A hypophosphatemic nephrolithiasis/osteoporosis that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the SLC34A1 gene on chromosome 5q35.

diseases.label: hypophosphatemic nephrolithiasis/osteoporosis 2
diseases.definition: A hypophosphatemic nephrolithiasis/osteoporosis that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the SLC9A3R1 gene on chromosome 17q25.1.

diseases.label: nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 1
diseases.definition: A nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder that is characterized by excessive longitudinal striations and numerous superficial pits on the nails, which have a distinctive rough, sand paper-like appearance.

diseases.label: nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 2
diseases.definition: A nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder that is characterized by nails that are abnormally thin and concave from side to side, with turned up edges.

diseases.label: nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 3
diseases.definition: A nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder that is characterized by white discoloration of the nails.

diseases.label: nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 4
diseases.definition: A nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder that is characterized by complete absence or severe hypoplasia of all fingernails and toenails without significant bone anomalies, and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the R-spondin-4 gene on chromosome 20p13.

diseases.label: nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 5
diseases.definition: A nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder that is characterized by a decreased growth rate, thick and hard nails, and a straight or concave proximal edge of detachment.

diseases.label: nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 6
diseases.definition: A nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder that is characterized by partial absences of nails.

diseases.label: nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 7
diseases.definition: A nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder that is characterized by nails with longi- tudinal streaks, thinning of the nail plate, poorly developed or absent lunulae, along with variously disturbed formation of the nail plate leading to increased vulnerability of the free nail margins.

diseases.label: nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 8
diseases.definition: A nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder that is characterized by dystrophy of the toenails only.

diseases.label: nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 9
diseases.definition: A nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder that is characterized by normal nails at birth with dystrophic changes developing within the first decade of life, resulting in onycholysis of fingernails and anonychia of toenails.

diseases.label: tubular aggregate myopathy 1
diseases.definition: A myopathy that is characterized by the presence of tubular aggregates in myofibrils and has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the STIM1 gene on chromosome 11p15.

diseases.label: reducing body myopathy 1A
diseases.definition: A myopathy that is characterized by by the presence of intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies strongly stained by menadione-linked alpha-glycerophosphate dehydrogenase in the absence of substrate, alpha-glycerophosphate, with infantile or early childhood onset, and that has_material_basis_in mutation in the FHL1 gene on chromosome Xq26.

diseases.label: obsolete spheroid body myopathy
diseases.definition: A myofibrillar myopathy that is characterized by predominantly proximal muscle weakness associated with spheroid body inclusions and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the myotilin gene on chromosome 5q31.

diseases.label: myofibrillar myopathy 1
diseases.definition: A myofibrillar myopathy that has_material_basis_in heterozygous, homozygous, or compound heterozygous mutation in the desmin gene on chromosome 2q35.

diseases.label: myofibrillar myopathy 2
diseases.definition: A myofibrillar myopathy that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the alpha-B-crystallin gene on chromosome 11q23.

diseases.label: myofibrillar myopathy 3
diseases.definition: A myofibrillar myopathy that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the MYOT gene on chromosome 5q31.

diseases.label: myofibrillar myopathy 4
diseases.definition: A myofibrillar myopathy that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the ZASP gene on chromosome 10.

diseases.label: myofibrillar myopathy 5
diseases.definition: A myofibrillar myopathy that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the FLNC gene on chromosome 7q32.

diseases.label: myofibrillar myopathy 6
diseases.definition: A myofibrillar myopathy that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the BAG3 gene on chromosome 10q26.

diseases.label: myofibrillar myopathy 7
diseases.definition: A myofibrillar myopathy that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the KY gene on chromosome 3q22.

diseases.label: myopathy, lactic acidosis, and sideroblastic anemia
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial myopathy that is characterized by progressive exercise intolerance manifesting in childhood, onset of sideroblastic anaemia around adolescence, lactic acidaemia, and mitochondrial myopathy.

diseases.label: obsolete Batten Turner congenital myopathy
diseases.definition: A myopathy that is characterized by the lack of muscle tone or floppiness at birth.

diseases.label: Compton-North congenital myopathy
diseases.definition: A congenital myopathy that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the CNTN1 gene on chromosome 12q12 and that is characterized antenatally, by fetal akinesia, intrauterine growth restriction and polyhydramnios, and, following birth, by severe neonatal hypotonia, severe generalized skeletal, bulbar and respiratory muscle weakness, multiple flexion contractures, and normal creatine kinase serum levels.

diseases.label: congenital myopathy 4A
diseases.definition: A congenital myopathy that is characterized by skeletal muscle weakness, particularly in the muscles of the shoulders, upper arms, hips, and thighs.

diseases.label: cylindrical spirals myopathy
diseases.definition: A congenital myopathy that is characterized by global muscle weakness, hypotonia, myotonia and cramps in the presence of cylindrical, spiral-shaped inclusions.

diseases.label: microcephaly and chorioretinopathy 1
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by delayed psychomotor development and visual impairment, often accompanied by short stature and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the TUBGCP6 gene.

diseases.label: microcephaly and chorioretinopathy 2
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by delayed psychomotor development, visual impairment, and short stature and has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the PLK4 gene.

diseases.label: microcephaly and chorioretinopathy 3
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by congenital microcephaly and chorioretinal dysplasia associated with poor vision and nystagmus and has_material_basis_in compound heterozygous mutation in the TUBGCP4 gene.

diseases.label: myoglobinuria
diseases.definition: A myopathy that is characterized by an increased urinary excretion of myoglobin.

diseases.label: infantile myofibromatosis
diseases.definition: A connective tissue benign neoplasm that is characterized by the development of benign tumors in the skin, striated muscles, bones, and in exceptional cases, visceral organs.

diseases.label: contractures, pterygia, and spondylocarpotarsal fusion syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by permanently bent fingers, short stature, rocker-bottom or club feet, joints that are bent in a fixed position, union or webbing of the skin between the fingers, and/or webbing of the neck, inside bend of the elbows, back of the knees and armpits.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 1
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex III deficiency characterized by onset at birth of lactic acidosis, hypotonia, hypoglycemia, failure to thrive, encephalopathy, and delayed psychomotor development and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the nuclear-encoded BCS1L gene on chromosome 2q35.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 3
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex III deficiency that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the UQCRB gene on chromosome 8q22.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 4
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex III deficiency that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the UQCRQ gene on chromosome 5q31.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 5
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex III deficiency characterized by neonatal onset of severe metabolic acidosis associated with hyperammonemia and hypoglycemia and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the UQCRC2 gene on chromosome 16p12.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 6
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex III deficiency characterized by onset in early childhood of episodic acute lactic acidosis, ketoacidosis, and insulin-responsive hyperglycemia, usually associated with infection and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the CYC1 gene on chromosome 8q24.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 7
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex III deficiency that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the UQCC2 gene on chromosome 6p21.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 8
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex III deficiency characterized by childhood onset of progressive neurodegeneration that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the LYRM7 gene on chromosome 5q23.

diseases.label: mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 9
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial complex III deficiency that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the UQCC3 gene on chromosome 11q12.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 1
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by onset between the second and fifth decades of life of ptosis, progressive external ophthalmoplegia, gastrointestinal dysmotility, cachexia, diffuse leukoencephalopathy, peripheral neuropathy, and mitochondrial dysfunction, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the nuclear-encoded thymidine phosphorylase gene on chromosome 22q13.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 2
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by childhood onset of muscle weakness associated with depletion of mtDNA in skeletal muscle, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the mitochondrial thymidine kinase gene on chromosome 16q21.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 3
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by onset in infancy of progressive liver failure and neurologic abnormalities, hypoglycemia, and increased lactate in body fluids, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the deoxyguanosine kinase gene on chromosome 2p13.

diseases.label: Alpers-Huttenlocher syndrome
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by a clinical triad of psychomotor retardation, intractable epilepsy, and liver failure in infants and young children, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the nuclear gene encoding mitochondrial DNA polymerase gamma on chromosome 15q26.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 4b
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by chronic gastrointestinal dysmotility and pseudoobstruction, cachexia, progressive external ophthalmoplegia, axonal sensory ataxic neuropathy, and muscle weakness, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of compound heterozygous mutation in the mitochondrial DNA polymerase gamma gene on chromosome 15q26.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 5
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by infantile onset of hypotonia, progressive neurologic deterioration, a hyperkinetic-dystonic movement disorder, external ophthalmoplegia, deafness, and variable renal tubular dysfunction, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the beta subunit of the succinate-CoA ligase gene on chromosome 13q14.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 6
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by infantile onset of progressive liver failure, often leading to death in the first year of life, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the mitochondrial inner membrane protein MPV17 gene on chromosome 2p23.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 7
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by progressive ataxia, hypotonia, hyporeflexia, athetosis and sensory impairment and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the C10ORF2 gene, which encodes the twinkle and twinky proteins, on chromosome 10q24.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 8a
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by neonatal hypotonia, lactic acidosis, and neurologic deterioration, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the ribonucleotide reductase regulatory TP53 inducible subunit M2B gene on chromosome 8q22.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 9
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by infantile onset of hypotonia, lactic acidosis, severe psychomotor retardation, progressive neurologic deterioration, and excretion of methylmalonic acid, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the alpha subunit of the succinate-CoA ligase gene on chromosome 2p11.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 11
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by onset in childhood or adulthood of progressive external ophthalmoplegia (PEO), muscle weakness and atrophy, exercise intolerance, and respiratory insufficiency due to muscle weakness, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous mutation in the mitochondrial genome maintenance exonuclease 1 gene on chromosome 20p11.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 12a
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by severe hypotonia due to mitochondrial dysfunction apparent at birth and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of heterozygous mutation in the solute carrier family 25 member 4 gene on chromosome 4q35.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 13
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by early infantile onset of encephalopathy, hypotonia, lactic acidosis, and severe global developmental delay, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous mutation in the F-box and leucine-rich repeat protein 4 gene on chromosome 6q16.

diseases.label: Sengers syndrome
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome that is characterized by congenital cataracts, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, skeletal myopathy, exercise intolerance, and lactic acidosis, but normal mental development, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the acylglycerol kinase gene on chromosome 7q34.

diseases.label: multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome 1
diseases.definition: A multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome that is characterized by weakness, respiratory failure, lack of neurologic development, lactic acidosis, and early death, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the NFU1 iron-sulfur cluster scaffold gene on chromosome 2p13.

diseases.label: multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome 2
diseases.definition: A multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome that is characterized by increased serum glycine and lactate, developmental regression in infancy, an encephalopathic disease course with seizures, spasticity, loss of head control, and abnormal movement, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous mutation in the bolA family member 3 gene on chromosome 2p13.

diseases.label: multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome 3
diseases.definition: A multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome that is characterized by loss of previously acquired developmental milestones in the first months or years of life, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous mutation in the iron-sulfur cluster assembly factor IBA57 gene on chromosome 1q42.

diseases.label: multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome 4
diseases.definition: A multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome that is characterized by normal development for the first months of life, followed by progressive loss of motor and social skills with hypotonia, spasticity, and nystagmus, resulting in death in early childhood, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the iron-sulfur cluster assembly 2 gene on chromosome 14q24.

diseases.label: multiple endocrine neoplasia type 4
diseases.definition: A multiple endocrine neoplasia that is characterized by hyperparathyroidism and multiple endocrine tumors and that has_material_basis_in mutations in the CDKN1B gene on chromosome 12p13 resulting in a reduction in the amount of functional p27 tumor suppressor protein which allows cells to grow and divide unchecked.

diseases.label: multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 1
diseases.definition: A multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome that is characterized by neonatal hypotonia, lack of psychomotor development, seizures, dysmorphic features, and variable congenital anomalies involving the cardiac, urinary, and gastrointestinal systems and has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the PIGN gene on chromosome 18q21.

diseases.label: multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 2
diseases.definition: A multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome that is characterized by X-linked recessive inheritance of dysmorphic features, neonatal hypotonia, myoclonic seizures and variable abnormalities involving the central nervous, cardiac, and urinary systems that has_material_basis_in mutation in the PIGA gene on chromosome Xp22.

diseases.label: multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 3
diseases.definition: A multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome that is characterized by neonatal hypotonia, lack of psychomotor development, seizures, dysmorphic features, and variable congenital anomalies involving the cardiac, urinary, and gastrointestinal systems and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the PIGT gene on chromosome 20q13.

diseases.label: mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1
diseases.definition: A mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome that is characterized by slow growth before and after birth, shorter than average height, unusually small head size, and an increased risk of developing cancer in childhood, and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the BUB1B gene on chromosome 15q15.

diseases.label: mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 2
diseases.definition: A mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome that is characterized by slowly before and after birth and typically normal head size and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the CEP57 gene on chromosome 11q21.

diseases.label: congenital fibrosis of the extraocular muscles
diseases.definition: An ocular motility disease that is characterized by the inability to move the eyes in certain directions, droopy eyelids and eyes that are fixed in an abnormal position.

diseases.label: childhood acute lymphocytic leukemia
diseases.definition: An acute lymphocytic leukemia occurring during childhood.

diseases.label: childhood T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
diseases.definition: A childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia that has_material_basis_in T-cells.

diseases.label: childhood B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
diseases.definition: A childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia that has_material_basis_in B-cells.

diseases.label: lymphoblastic lymphoma
diseases.definition: A lymphoma that has_material_basis_in immature malignant lymphocytes (lymphoblasts) committed to the B-cell or T-cell lineage and located_in primarily lymph nodes or located_in extranodal sites.

diseases.label: T-cell childhood lymphoblastic lymphoma
diseases.definition: A lymphoblastic lymphoma that has_material_basis_in T-cells and that occurs during childhood.

diseases.label: adult acute monocytic leukemia
diseases.definition: An acute monocytic leukemia occurring in adults.

diseases.label: adrenocorticotropic hormone deficiency
diseases.definition: A hypopituitarrium that is characterized by a decreased or absent production of adrenocorticotropic hormone by the pituitary gland.

diseases.label: medium chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency
diseases.definition: A lipid metabolism disorder that is characterized by a deficiency of the enzyme medium chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase that results in the inability to convert medium chain fatty acids to energy, particularly during fasting.

diseases.label: short chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency
diseases.definition: A lipid metabolism disorder that is characterized by deficiency of the enzyme short chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase that results in the inability to convert short chain fatty acids.

diseases.label: very long chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency
diseases.definition: A lipid metabolism disorder that is characterized by deficiency of the enzyme very long chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase that results in the inability to convert very long chain fatty acids.

diseases.label: X-linked adrenal hypoplasia congenita
diseases.definition: An adrenal cortical hypofunction that is characterized by a reduction in adrenal gland function resulting from incomplete development of the adrenal cortex and has_material_basis_in the nuclear receptor NR0B1 (DAX1) gene.

diseases.label: herpes simplex virus keratitis
diseases.definition: A keratitis that has_material_basis_in herpes simplex type infection.

diseases.label: Cryptococcal meningitis
diseases.definition: A fungal meningitis that has_material_basis_in Crypococcus fungal infection.

diseases.label: Cytomegalovirus retinitis
diseases.definition: A retinitis that has_material_basis_in Cytomegalovirus.

diseases.label: cutaneous candidiasis
diseases.definition: A candidiasis that is characterized by Candida infection located_in the skin.

diseases.label: lupus nephritis
diseases.definition: A glomerulonephritis that is characterized by inflammation of the kidneys resulting from systemic lupus erythematosus.

diseases.label: otulipenia
diseases.definition: An immune system disease that is characterized by neonatal onset of recurrent fever, erythematous rash with painful nodules, painful joints, and lipodystrophy and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous loss-of-function mutations in the OTULIN gene encoding a deubiquitinase with linear linkage specificity on chromosome 5p15.

diseases.label: myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia and abnormalities of PDGFRA, PDGFRB, and FGFR1
diseases.definition: A myeloid neoplasm that is characterized by the formation of abnormal fusion genes that encode constitutively activated tyrosine kinases.

diseases.label: myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms associated with PDGFRA rearrangement
diseases.definition: A myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia and abnormalities of PDGFRA, PDGFRB, and FGFR1 that is characterized by the rearrangement of the PDGFRA gene, most often resulting in the formation of FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion transcripts.

diseases.label: myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms associated with PDGFRB rearrangement
diseases.definition: A myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia and abnormalities of PDGFRA, PDGFRB, and FGFR1 that is characterized by the rearrangement of the PDGFRB gene, most often resulting in the formation of ETV6-PDGFRB fusion transcripts.

diseases.label: myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms associated with FGFR1 abnormalities
diseases.definition: A myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia and abnormalities of PDGFRA, PDGFRB, and FGFR1 that is characterized by the rearrangement of the FGFR1 gene, resulting in translocations with an 8p11 breakpoint.

diseases.label: tricuspid atresia
diseases.definition: A tricuspid valve disease characterized by a missing or abnormally developed tricuspid heart value at birth.

diseases.label: normophosphatemic familial tumoral calcinosis
diseases.definition: A calcinosis that is characterized by massive periarticular, and seldom visceral, deposition of calcified tumors.

diseases.label: esophageal atresia/tracheoesophageal fistula
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system disease that is characterized by abnormal development of the esophagus and trachea where the upper esophagus does not connect (atresia) to the lower esophagus and stomach and may also include tracheoesophageal fistula where the esophagus and the trachea are abnormally connected which allows fluids from the esophagus to get into the airways and interfere with breathing.

diseases.label: poor metabolism of thiopurines
diseases.definition: An inherited metabolic disease that is characterized by significantly reduced activity of an enzyme that helps the body process drugs called thiopurines.

diseases.label: bladder exstrophy-epispadias-cloacal exstrophy complex
diseases.definition: A physical disorder that is characterized as a spectrum of anomalies involving the urinary tract, genital tract, musculoskeletal system and sometimes the intestinal tract.

diseases.label: bladder exstrophy
diseases.definition: A bladder exstrophy-epispadias-cloacal exstrophy complex that is characterized by an evaginated bladder plate, epispadias and an anterior defect of the pelvis, pelvic floor and abdominal wall. The rear portion of the bladder wall (posterior vesical wall) turns outward (exstrophy) through an opening in the abdominal wall and urine is excreted through this opening.

diseases.label: cloacal exstrophy
diseases.definition: A bladder exstrophy-epispadias-cloacal exstrophy complex that is characterized by a defect in the urethra, bladder and bowel.

diseases.label: meningococcal meningitis
diseases.definition: A bacterial meningitis that has_material_basis_in Neisseria meningitidis infection.

diseases.label: hepatic veno-occlusive disease
diseases.definition: A hepatic vascular disease that is characterized by obstruction of some of the small veins of the liver.

diseases.label: mucositis
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system disease that is characterized by painful inflammation and ulceration of the mucous membranes lining the digestive tract.

diseases.label: haemophilus meningitis
diseases.definition: A bacterial meningitis that has_material_basis_in Haemophilus influenzae infection.

diseases.label: Zika virus congenital syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized in neonates by microcephaly, craniofacial disproportion, spasticity, seizures, irritability and brainstem dysfunction including feeding difficulties, ocular abnormalities and findings on neuroimaging such as calcifications, cortical disorders and ventriculomegaly and has_material_basis_in the acquisition of Zika virus infection in utero.

diseases.label: PHARC syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by polyneuropathy, hearing loss, cerebellar ataxia, retinitis pigmentosa and early-onset cataract.

diseases.label: mixed fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma
diseases.definition: A fibrolamellar carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of both pure fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma and and conventional hepatocellular carcinoma components.

diseases.label: medullary colon carcinoma
diseases.definition: A colon carcinoma that is characterized by a solid growth pattern.

diseases.label: mixed mucinous and nonmucinous bronchioloalveolar adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A bronchiolo-alveolar adenocarcinoma that is characterized by a mixed array of different patterns (acinar, papillary, bronchioloalveolar, solid with mucin).

diseases.label: mucinous bronchioloalveolar adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A bronchiolo-alveolar adenocarcinoma that is characterized by a tumour cells containing abundant mucin in their cytoplasm and composed of tall columnar cells growing along alveolar walls without stromal invasion.

diseases.label: nonmucinous bronchioloalveolar adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A bronchiolo-alveolar adenocarcinoma that is characterized by cells with cuboidal or columnar morphology with eosinophilic or clear cytoplasm and shows Clara cell or type 2 pneumocyte differentiation.

diseases.label: chronic neutrophilic leukemia
diseases.definition: A chronic leukemia characterized by neutrophilic leukocytosis with no detectable Philadelphia chromosome or BCR/ABL fusion gene.

diseases.label: chronic myelomonocytic leukemia
diseases.definition: A chronic leukemia characterized by monocytosis, increased monocytes in the bone marrow, variable degrees of dysplasia, but an absence of immature granulocytes in the blood.

diseases.label: malignant hemangioma
diseases.definition: A cell type cancer of vascular origin that is characterized by the proliferation of endothelial cells in and about the vascular lumen.

diseases.label: malignant epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
diseases.definition: A malignant hemangioma characterized by the presence of epithelioid endothelial cells. The neoplastic cells are arranged in cords and nests, which are embedded in a myxoid to hyalinized stroma.

diseases.label: PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized as a spectrum of disorders (Cowden syndrome, Bannayan-Riley-Ruvalcaba syndrome, PTEN-related Proteus syndrome, and Proteus-like syndrome) caused by germline mutations of the PTEN gene.

diseases.label: relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
diseases.definition: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma characterized by less than 50 percent decrease in lesion size with induction therapy or the appearance of new lesions or the appearance of new lesions after attainment of complete remission.

diseases.label: superior semicircular canal dehiscence
diseases.definition: An inner ear disease characterized by dehiscence in the bone overlying the superior semicircular canal experience with symptoms of pressure or sound-induced vertigo, bone conduction hyperacusis, and pulsatile tinnitus.

diseases.label: Carey-Fineman-Ziter syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by hypotonia, Moebius sequence (bilateral congenital facial palsy with impairment of ocular abduction), Pierre Robin complex (micrognathia, glossoptosis, and high-arched or cleft palate), delayed motor milestones, and failure to thrive.

diseases.label: Marinesco-Sjogren syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by congenital cataracts, cerebellar ataxia, progressive muscle weakness due to myopathy, and delayed psychomotor development.

diseases.label: mandibulofacial dysostosis, Guion-Almeida type
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by progressive microcephaly, micrognathia, microtia, dysplastic ears, preauricular skin tags, speech delay, significant developmental delay, midface and malar hypoplasia.

diseases.label: congenital muscular dystrophy with cataracts and intellectual disability
diseases.definition: A congenital muscular dystrophy characterized by onset of progressive muscle weakness in early childhood with autosomal recessive inheritance that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the INPP5K gene (607875) on chromosome 17p13.

diseases.label: infantile histiocytoid cardiomyopathy
diseases.definition: An intrinsic cardiomyopathy characterized by the presence of characteristic pale granular foamy histiocyte-like cells within the myocardium and has_material_basis_in a mutation in the gene encoding mitochondrial cytochrome b.

diseases.label: colorectal carcinoma
diseases.definition: A colorectal cancer that arises from the colon or rectum and invades through the muscularis mucosa into the submucosa.

diseases.label: bilateral renal aplasia
diseases.definition: A renal agenesis that is characterized by the absence of both kidneys at birth.

diseases.label: Peters plus syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by anterior chamber eye anomalies, short limbs with broad distal extremities, characteristic facial features, cleft lip/palate, and variable developmental delay/intellectual disability.

diseases.label: adenoid cystic carcinoma
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that is characterized by bands or cylinders of hyalinized or mucinous stroma separating or surrounded by nests or cords of small epithelial cells.

diseases.label: renal hypoplasia
diseases.definition: A kidney disease that is characterized by abnormally small kidneys with normal morphology and reduced number of nephrons.

diseases.label: CAKUT
diseases.definition: A urinary system disease characterized by structural malformations in the kidney and/or urinary tract containing vesicoureteral reflux.

diseases.label: CAKUT1
diseases.definition: A CAKUT that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the DSTYK gene on chromosome 1q32.

diseases.label: CAKUT2
diseases.definition: A CAKUT that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the TBX18 gene on chromosome 6q14.

diseases.label: metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease
diseases.definition:
A steatotic liver disease characterized by at least one of five cardiometabolic risk factors (adjusted for age, sex and ethnicity), alcohol consumption below 140g/week (female) or 210g/week (male), and no other discernible cause. The five cardiometabolic risk factors are:
(1) Body mass index ≥ 25 kg/m2 (adult), 23 kg/m2 (adult Asian), or 85th percentile (pediatric); waist circumference > 94 cm (adult male), 80 cm (adult female), or 95th percentile (pediatric); or ethnicity adjusted equivalents.
(2) Fasting serum glucose ≥ 5.6 mmol/L, 2-hr post-load glucose levels ≥ 7.8 mmol/L, glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) ≥ 5.7% (39 mmol/L), type 2 diabetes, treatment for type 2 diabetes, previously diagnosed or treated type 2 diabetes (pediatric only), or serum glucose ≥ 11.1 mmol/L (pediatric only).
(3) Blood pressure ≥ lower of 130/85 mmHg or 95th percentile (age < 13 years), or 130/85 mmHg (age ≥ 13 years); or specific hypertensive drug treatment.
(4) Plasma triglycerides ≥ 1.15 mmol/L (age < 10 years) or 1.70 mmol/L (age ≥ 10 years); or lipid lowering treatment.
(5) Plasma high-density lipoprotein cholesterol ≤ 1.0 mmol/L (adult male, pediatric) or 1.3 mmol/L (adult female); or lipid lowering treatment.

diseases.label: sideroblastic anemia with B-cell immunodeficiency, periodic fevers, and developmental delay
diseases.definition: A sideroblastic anemia characterized by onset of severe sideroblastic anemia in the neonatal period or infancy, has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the TRNT1 gene on chromosome 3p26.

diseases.label: primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma
diseases.definition: A large B-cell lymphoma that is is characterized by a diffuse proliferation of medium to large B-cells associated with sclerosis.

diseases.label: nodal marginal zone lymphoma
diseases.definition: A marginal zone B-cell lymphoma which morphologically resembles lymph nodes involved by marginal zone lymphomas of extranodal or splenic types, but without evidence of extranodal or splenic disease.

diseases.label: polycystic kidney disease 4
diseases.definition: A autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease that has_material_basis_in mutation in the PKD4 gene.

diseases.label: punctate palmoplantar keratoderma type II
diseases.definition: A punctate palmoplantar keratoderma that is characterized by multiple, asymptomatic, 1 to 2 mm-long, firm, hyperkeratotic projections on the palms, soles and digits.

diseases.label: punctate palmoplantar keratoderma type I
diseases.definition: A punctate palmoplantar keratoderma that is characterized by multiple hyperkeratotic centrally indented papules that develop in early adolescence or later and are irregularly distributed on the palms and soles.

diseases.label: developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 8
diseases.definition: A developmental and epileptic encephalopathy characterized by seizures with onset before 2 years of age, severe developmental delay, and in some patients hyperekplexia that has_material_basis_in X-linked recessive inheritance of a mutation in the ARHGEF9 gene on chromosome Xq22.1.

diseases.label: duodenal atresia
diseases.definition: An intestinal atresia that is characterized by congenital absence or complete closure of a portion of the lumen of the duodenum.

diseases.label: lysosomal acid lipase deficiency
diseases.definition: A lipid storage disease characterized by dyslipidemia and accumulation of cholesteryl esters and triglycerides within various organs that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the LIPA gene on chromosome 10q23.31.

diseases.label: primary spontaneous pneumothorax
diseases.definition: A pneumothorax that is characterized by an abnormal accumulation of air in the space between the lungs and the chest cavity that can result in the partial or complete collapse of a lung.

diseases.label: dystransthyretinemic hyperthyroxinemia
diseases.definition: A hyperthyroxinemia that is characterized by an increased affinity for thyroxine (T4) by transthyretin in clinically euthyroid individuals and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the TTR gene on chromosome 18q12.

diseases.label: pseudohypoparathyroidism type IB
diseases.definition: A pseudohypoparathyroidism characterized by isolated renal parathyroid hormone (PTH) resistance resulting in hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia and elevated PTH levels that has_material_basis_in mutations that alter the methylation pattern of GNAS on 20q13.32.

diseases.label: epidermolytic palmoplantar keratoderma
diseases.definition: A palmoplantar keratosis that is characterized by marked hyperkeratosis on the surface of palms and soles.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa
diseases.definition: An epidermolysis bullosa dystrophica that is characterized by recurrent blistering at the level of the lamina densa secondary to minor trauma, limited to the nails, hands, feet, knees, and elbows, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of mutation in the COL7A1 gene, which encodes a protein that assists assembly of type VII collagen.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 23
diseases.definition: An amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the ANXA11 gene on chromosome 10q22.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 56
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that is characterized by global developmental delay, intellectual disability and in most cases hypotonia, delayed walking, poor fine motor skills, and poor or absent speech that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the CLTC gene on chromosome 17q23.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 55
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that is characterized by onset of myoclonic seizures in the first years of life, global developmental delay, intellectual disability, speech delay and ataxic gait that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the NUS1 gene on chromosome 6q22.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 53
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the CAMK2A gene on chromosome 5q32.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 54
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the CAMK2B gene on chromosome 7p13.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 52
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the ASH1L gene on chromosome 1q22.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 51
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the KMT5B gene on chromosome 11q13.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 50
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the NAA15 gene on chromosome 4q31.

diseases.label: Clark-Baraitser syndrome
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the TRIP12 gene on chromosome 2q36.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 48
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the RAC1 gene on chromosome 7p22.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 45
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the CIC gene on chromosome 19q13.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 46
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the KCNQ5 gene on chromosome 6q14.

diseases.label: autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 47
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the STAG1 gene on chromosome 3q22.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 61
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the RUN and SH3 domain containing 2 gene (RUSC2) on chromosome 9p13.

diseases.label: non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability 106
diseases.definition: A non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability that has_material_basis_in hemizygous mutation in OGT on chromosome Xq13.1.

diseases.label: syndromic X-linked mental retardation 35
diseases.definition: A syndromic X-linked intellectual disability that has_material_basis_in mutation in the RPL10 gene on chromosome Xq28.

diseases.label: syndromic X-linked mental retardation Hough type
diseases.definition: A syndromic X-linked intellectual disability that is characterized by delayed development, intellectual disability, speech and language delay, and early-onset seizures and that has_material_basis_in hemizygous or heterozygous mutation in the CNKSR2 gene on chromosome Xp22.

diseases.label: amelogenesis imperfecta type 3B
diseases.definition: An amelogenesis imperfecta type 3 that is characterized by enamel that is reduced in mineral density and is thin, chipped, and absent in places and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the amelotin gene.

diseases.label: Galloway-Mowat syndrome 2
diseases.definition: A Galloway-Mowat syndrome that has_material_basis_in hemizygous mutation in the LAGE3 gene on chromosome Xq28.

diseases.label: Galloway-Mowat syndrome 3
diseases.definition: A Galloway-Mowat syndrome that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the OSGEP gene on chromosome 14q11.

diseases.label: Galloway-Mowat syndrome 4
diseases.definition: A Galloway-Mowat syndrome that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the TP53RK gene on chromosome 20q13.

diseases.label: Galloway-Mowat syndrome 5
diseases.definition: A Galloway-Mowat syndrome that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the TPRKB gene on chromosome 2p13.

diseases.label: erythrokeratodermia variabilis et progressiva 2
diseases.definition: An erythrokeratodermia variabilis that is characterized by persistent plaque-like or generalized hyperkeratosis and transient red patches of variable size, shape, and location and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the gene encoding connexin-30.3 (GJB4) on chromosome 1p34.

diseases.label: erythrokeratodermia variabilis et progressiva 3
diseases.definition: An erythrokeratodermia variabilis that is characterized by normal skin at birth but develop hyperpigmentation and scaling at sites of friction in childhood, with progression to near-confluent corrugated hyperkeratosis, palmoplantar keratoderma, and transient figurate erythema and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the gene encoding connexin-43 (GJA1) on chromosome 6q22.

diseases.label: erythrokeratodermia variabilis et progressiva 4
diseases.definition: An erythrokeratodermia variabilis that is characterized by severe lesions of thick scaly skin on the face and genitals, as well as thickened, red, and scaly skin on the hands and feet and that has_material_basis_in compound heterozygous mutation in the KDSR gene on chromosome 18q21.

diseases.label: erythrokeratodermia variabilis et progressiva 5
diseases.definition: An erythrokeratodermia variabilis that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the KRT83 gene on chromosome 12q13.

diseases.label: spastic ataxia 8
diseases.definition: A spastic ataxia that is characterized by onset of primarily motor dysfunction within the first year of life and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the NKX6-2 gene on chromosome 8q21.

diseases.label: Meckel syndrome 13
diseases.definition: A Meckel syndrome that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the TMEM107 gene on chromosome 17p13 and that is characterized by occipital encephalocele, polydactyly, polycystic kidneys, micrognathia, contractures, and perinatal lethality.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome XVI
diseases.definition: An orofaciodigital syndrome that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the TMEM107 gene on chromosome 17p13.

diseases.label: Meier-Gorlin syndrome 8
diseases.definition: A Meier-Gorlin syndrome that has_material_basis_in compound heterozygous mutation in the MCM5 gene on chromosome 22q12.

diseases.label: Perrault syndrome 6

diseases.definition: A Meier-Gorlin syndrome that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the CDC6 gene on chromosome 17q21.

diseases.label: Meier-Gorlin syndrome 6
diseases.definition: A Meier-Gorlin syndrome that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the GMNN gene on chromosome 6p22.

diseases.label: Meier-Gorlin syndrome 7
diseases.definition: A Meier-Gorlin syndrome that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the CDC45 gene on chromosome 22q11.

diseases.label: PAPA syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by pyoderma gangrenosum, pyogenic arthritis, acne and suppurative hidradenitis and heterozygous mutation in the PSTPIP1 gene on chromosome 15q24.

diseases.label: Tn polyagglutination syndrome
diseases.definition: A hematopoietic system disease that is characterized by red blood cells that agglutinate upon exposure to almost all human sera, but not to autologous serum or the sera of newborns and has_material_basis_in somatic mutation in the C1GALT1C1 gene on chromosome Xq24.

diseases.label: lung non-squamous non-small cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A lung non-small cell carcinoma that is characterized by the lack of evidence of squamous differentiation.

diseases.label: anaplastic thyroid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A thyroid gland carcinoma that is composed of undifferentiated cells.

diseases.label: adult-onset leukoencephalopathy with axonal spheroids and pigmented glia
diseases.definition: A leukodystrophy that is characterized by progressive dementia, apraxia, apathy, impaired balance, parkinsonism, spasticity and epilepsy and has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the CSF1R gene on chromosome 5q32.

diseases.label: thyroid gland adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A thyroid gland carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: differentiated high-grade thyroid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A thyroid gland adenocarcinoma characterized by extensive evidence of follicular cell differentiation.

diseases.label: bronchiectasis 1
diseases.definition: A bronchiectasis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the gene encoding the beta subunit of the epithelial sodium channel on chromosome 16p12.

diseases.label: bronchiectasis 2
diseases.definition: A bronchiectasis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the gene encoding the alpha subunit of the epithelial sodium channel.

diseases.label: bronchiectasis 3
diseases.definition: A bronchiectasis that has_material_basis_in mutation in the gene encoding the gamma subunit of the epithelial sodium channel.

diseases.label: granular corneal dystrophy 1
diseases.definition: A granular corneal dystrophy that is characterized by recurrent erosions and gray crumb-like opacification located_in the cornea, proteinaceous rock candy-like deposits in the anterior stroma and subepithelium, and progressive vision loss later in life as deposits move into the central vision, and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of heterozygous mutation of transforming growth factor beta-induced gene located in chromosome 5q31.1, which encodes keratoepithelin. Abnormalities lead to increased protein deposition and disruption of the corneal surface.

diseases.label: dedifferentiated liposarcoma
diseases.definition: A liposarcoma that is characterized as a high-grade tumor that occurs when a lower-grade tumor changes and creates new high-grade cells.

diseases.label: Smarca4-deficient sarcoma of thorax
diseases.definition: A thoracic cancer that is characterized by poorly differentiated neoplasms with epithelioid/rhabdoid cells organized in a solid pattern and has_material_basis_in alterations in the switch/sucrose nonfermenting complex, also known in humans as BRG1-associated factors (BAF chromatin remodeling complex).

diseases.label: Carney-Stratakis syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by the presence of multicentric paragangliomas and multifocal gastrointestinal stromal sarcoma tumors.

diseases.label: myxofibrosarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma that arises from the soft tissue and is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped cells, cellular pleomorphism, thin-walled blood vessels, fibrous septa, and myxoid stroma.

diseases.label: hypermanganesemia with dystonia
diseases.definition: A metal metabolism disorder that is characterized by involuntary, sustained muscle contractions (dystonia) and other uncontrolled movements resulting from excessive accumulation of manganese.

diseases.label: hypermanganesemia with dystonia 1
diseases.definition: A hypermanganesemia with dystonia that is characterized by increased serum manganese, motor neurodegeneration with extrapyramidal features, polycythemia, and hepatic dysfunction and has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the SLC30A10 gene on chromosome 1q41.

diseases.label: hypermanganesemia with dystonia 2
diseases.definition: A hypermanganesemia with dystonia that is characterized predominantly by loss of motor milestones in the first years of life and has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the SLC39A14 gene on chromosome 8p21.

diseases.label: Sweeney-Cox syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by striking facial dysostosis, including hypertelorism, deficiencies of the eyelids and facial bones, cleft palate/velopharyngeal insufficiency, and low-set cupped ears and has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the TWIST1 gene on chromosome 7p21.

diseases.label: PEHO syndrome
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by extreme cerebellar atrophy due to almost total granule neuron loss.

diseases.label: galactosialidosis
diseases.definition: A lysosomal storage disease that is characterized by combined deficiency of beta-galactosidase and neuraminidase that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the CTSA gene on chromosome 20q13.

diseases.label: hyperprolinemia
diseases.definition: An amno acid metabolic disorder that is characterized by the excess of proline in the blood.

diseases.label: hyperprolinemia type 1
diseases.definition: A hyperprolinemia that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the proline dehydrogenase gene on chromosome 22q11.

diseases.label: hyperprolinemia type 2
diseases.definition: A hyperprolinemia that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the pyrroline-5-carboxylate dehydrogenase gene on chromosome 1p36.

diseases.label: hyper IgM syndrome
diseases.definition: A hyperimmunoglobin syndrome that is characterized by an immune system that fails to produce normal levels of the antibodies IgA, IgG and IgE but can produce normal or elevated levels of IgM.

diseases.label: hyper IgE syndrome
diseases.definition: A hyperimmunoglobulin syndrome that is characterized by eczema, distinct facial features, a tendency to experience bone fractures and recurrent bacterial infections of the skin and lungs.

diseases.label: non-alcoholic fatty liver
diseases.definition: A metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease characterized by the absence of inflammation and hepatocyte injury in the form of hepatocyte ballooning.

diseases.label: metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis
diseases.definition: A metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease characterized by the presence of inflammation with hepatocyte injury such as ballooning, with or without fibrosis.

diseases.label: Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines 1
diseases.definition: A Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the PTPN11 gene on chromosome 12q24.

diseases.label: Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines 2
diseases.definition: A Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the RAF1 gene on chromosome 3p25.

diseases.label: Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines 3
diseases.definition: A Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the BRAF gene on chromosome 7q34.

diseases.label: Naxos disease
diseases.definition: A nonepidermolytic palmoplantar keratoderma that is characterized by palmoplantar keratoderma, woolly hair and arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy and that has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the plakoglobin gene on chromosome 17q21.

diseases.label: congenital disorder of glycosylation Ia
diseases.definition: A congenital disorder of glycosylation I that is characterized by a severe encephalopathy with axial hypotonia, abnormal eye movement, pronounced psychomotor retardation, peripheral neuropathy, cerebellar hypoplasia, and retinitis pigmentosa and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the gene encoding phosphomannomutase-2 on chromosome 16p13.

diseases.label: congenital disorder of glycosylation Iaa
diseases.definition: A congenital disorder of glycosylation I that is characterized by fibroblasts with reduced dolichol profiles and enhanced accumulation of free cholesterol and has_material_basis_in homozygous mutation in the NUS1 gene on chromosome 6q22.

diseases.label: congenital disorder of glycosylation Ib
diseases.definition: A congenital disorder of glycosylation I that is characterized by protein-losing enteropathy, cyclic vomiting, profound hypoglycemia, failure to thrive, liver fibrosis, protein-losing enteropathy with hypoalbuminaemia, life-threatening intestinal bleeding of diffuse origin, protein C and S deficiency, low anti-thrombine III levels and has_material_basis_in compound heterozygous mutation in the gene encoding mannosephosphate isomerase on chromosome 15q24.

diseases.label: congenital disorder of glycosylation Ic
diseases.definition: A congenital disorder of glycosylation I that is characterized by psychomotor retardation with delayed walking and speech, hypotonia, seizures, and sometimes protein-losing enteropathy and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the ALG6 gene on chromosome 1p31.

diseases.label: congenital disorder of glycosylation Id
diseases.definition: A congenital disorder of glycosylation I that is characterized by severe neurologic involvement associated with dysmorphism and visual impairment and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the ALG3 gene on chromosome 3q27.

diseases.label: congenital disorder of glycosylation Ie
diseases.definition: A congenital disorder of glycosylation I that is characterized by psychomotor delay, seizures, hypotonia, facial dysmorphism and microcephaly and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the DPM1 gene on chromosome 20q13.

diseases.label: congenital disorder of glycosylation If
diseases.definition: A congenital disorder of glycosylation I that is characterized by psychomotor delay, seizures, failure to thrive, and cutaneous and ocular anomalies and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the MPDU1 gene on chromosome 17p13.

diseases.label: congenital disorder of glycosylation Ig
diseases.definition: A congenital disorder of glycosylation I that is characterized by facial dysmorphism (prominent forehead, large ears, thin upper lip), generalized hypotonia, feeding difficulties, moderate to severe developmental delay, progressive microcephaly, frequent upper respiratory tract infections due to impaired immunity with decreased immunoglobulin levels, and decreased coagulation factors and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the gene encoding dolichyl-P-mannose:Man-7-GlcNAc-2-PP-dolichyl-alpha-6-mannosyltransferase on chromosome 22q13.

diseases.label: congenital disorder of glycosylation Ih
