diseases.definition: A prolapse of female genital organ that is characterized by a decrease in muscle mass and tissue in the pelvic floor, vagina, vulva and urinary tract due to aging, menopause and its subsequent reduction of estrogen, or a combination of the two.

diseases.label: bronchopulmonary dysplasia
diseases.definition: A lung disease that is characterized by underdeveloped lungs in newborns that can be easily irritated or inflamed after birth resulting in damage to the alveoli of the lungs and bronchi. Most newborns who develop BPD are born more than 10 weeks before their due dates, weigh less than 2 pounds at birth, and have breathing problems.

diseases.label: cicatricial pemphigoid
diseases.definition: A pemphigoid that is characterized by skin lesions and scaring and located_in mucous membranes and located_in skin.

diseases.label: palindromic rheumatism
diseases.definition: An arthritis that involves sudden and rapidly developing attacks of arthritis with a remission period that results_in no joint damage or symptoms.

diseases.label: blue color blindness
diseases.definition: A color blindness that is characterized by a selective deficiency of blue vision, has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance of a mutation in the OPN1SW gene and is associated with a deficiency or absence of blue-sensitive cone photoreceptor function.

diseases.label: hypopigmentation of eyelid
diseases.definition: A pigmentation disease that is characterized by loss of pigmentation of the eyelid and has_symptom white or light macules or patches on the eyelid, and has_material_basis_in autoimmune conditions like vitiligo, chronic inflammation, malignancy, or exposure to destructive substances.

diseases.label: onchocerciasis
diseases.definition: A filariasis that involves parasitic infection caused by the nematode Onchocerca volvulus, which is transmitted to humans through the bite of a blackfly of the genus Simulium. The worms spread throughout the body and, when they die, cause intense itching and a strong immune system response that can destroy nearby tissue. The symptoms include pruritus, dermatitis, blindness, onchocercomata (subcutaneous nodules), and lymphadenopathy.

diseases.label: obsolete ocular onchocerciasis
diseases.definition: A onchocerciasis that involves parasitic infection of the eye by the larvae of Onchocerca volvulus. The microfilariae migrate to the surface of the cornea. Punctate keratitis occurs in the infected area. In severe infection, sclerosing keratitis occurs, making the affected area become opaque leading to blindness.

diseases.label: obsolete glaucoma associated with systemic syndromes
portal vein thrombosis
diseases.definition: A hepatic vascular disease that is characterized by a blood clot that forms within the hepatic portal vein.

diseases.label: obsolete intrathoracic lymph node tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A lymph node tuberculosis that is characterized by a peri-hilar or paratracheal lymph adenopathy after the primary infection. The diseased lymph nodes and associated inflammatory edema compress the airways resulting in partial or total airway obstruction. When a caseating lymph node erupts into an airway, aspiration of caseous material results in dense alveolar consolidation of the affected segment/lobe.

diseases.label: heart cancer
diseases.definition: A cardiovascular cancer located_in the heart.

diseases.label: selective IgA deficiency disease
diseases.definition: A selective immunoglobulin deficiency disease that is the result of a deficiency of immunoglobulin A (IgA), an antibody that protects against infections of the mucous membranes lining the mouth, airways, and digestive tract.

diseases.label: dysgammaglobulinemia
diseases.definition: A selective immunoglobulin deficiency disease that is caused by a reduction in some types of gamma globulins.

diseases.label: lipoatrophic diabetes mellitus
diseases.definition: A type 2 diabetes mellitus that is characterized by severe insulin resistance and lipodystrophy.

diseases.label: diabetic angiopathy
diseases.definition: A peripheral vascular disease that is characterized by narrowing of the arteries as a complication arising from chronic diabetes.

diseases.label: gestational diabetes
diseases.definition: A diabetes mellitus that manifests during pregnancy.

diseases.label: prediabetes syndrome
diseases.definition: A glucose metabolism disease that is characterized by blood glucose levels are high, but not high enough to be classified as type 2 diabetes.

diseases.label: neonatal diabetes
diseases.definition: A diabetes mellitus that is characterized by hyperglycemia occurring within the first 6 months of life.

diseases.label: antidepressant type abuse
diseases.definition: A substance abuse that involves the recurring use of antidepressant drugs despite negative consequences.

diseases.label: distal myopathy
diseases.definition: A muscular dystrophy that is characterized by predominant weakness and atrophy beginning in the feet and/or hands.

diseases.label: glycogen storage disease VII
diseases.definition: A glycogen storage disease that is characterized by exercise intolerance, muscle cramping, exertional myopathy, and compensated hemolysis and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the PFKM gene, which encodes muscle phosphofructokinase, on chromosome 12q13.

diseases.label: myotonic dystrophy type 1
diseases.definition: A myotonic disease that is characterized by progressive muscle wasting and weakness affecting the distal skeletal and smooth muscles of lower legs, hands, neck, and face along with myotonia and cataracts and has_material_basis_in the autosomal dominant inheritance of the DMPK gene containing an expansion of a CTG trinucleotide repeat in the non-coding region.

diseases.label: Duchenne muscular dystrophy
diseases.definition: A muscular dystrophy that has_material_basis_in X-linked mutations in the DMD gene found on the X chromosome. It is characterized by rapidly progressing muscle weakness and muscle atrophy initially involving the lower extremities and eventually affecting the whole body. It affects males whereas females can be carriers. The symptoms start before the age of six and may appear at infancy.

diseases.label: limb-girdle muscular dystrophy
diseases.definition: A muscular dystrophy that is characterized by weakening of the muscles of the hip and shoulders which comprise the limb girdle muscles.

diseases.label: Cornelia de Lange syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by slow growth before and after birth, intellectual disability that is usually severe to profound, skeletal abnormalities involving the arms and hands, and distinctive facial features.

diseases.label: Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy
diseases.definition: A muscular dystrophy that chiefly affects muscles used for movement (skeletal) and heart (cardiac) muscle.

diseases.label: Lyme disease
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Borrelia burgdorferi, which is transmitted_by blacklegged tick (Ixodes scapularis) or transmitted_by western blacklegged tick (Ixodes pacificus). The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom headache, has_symptom fatigue, and has_symptom skin rash called erythema migrans. If left untreated, infection can spread to joints, the heart, and the nervous system.

diseases.label: obsolete single manic episode in full remission
obsolete Chlamydophila pneumoniae pneumonia
diseases.definition: A Chlamydophila infectious disease that involves Chlamydophila pneumoniae infection, characterized by interstitial infiltrates and respiratory distress.

diseases.label: parametrium malignant neoplasm
diseases.definition: A uterine adnexa cancer that is located_in the parametrium.

diseases.label: uterine adnexa cancer
diseases.definition: A uterine cancer that is located_in the adnexa.

diseases.label: round ligament malignant neoplasm
diseases.definition: A uterine adnexa cancer that is located_in the round ligament.

diseases.label: Bordetella parapertussis whooping cough
diseases.definition: A pertussis that is a milder disease caused by the bacterium Bordetella parapertussis. The disease has_symptom coughing, has_symptom sneezing, or has_symptom runny nose.

diseases.label: obsolete biliary calculus with acute cholecystitis
siderosis of eye
diseases.definition: An eye degenerative disease that is characterized by intraocular iron toxicity typically due to a retained foreign body.

diseases.label: choledocholithiasis
diseases.definition: A common bile duct disease characterized by the presence of at least one gallstone in the common bile duct.

diseases.label: obsolete calculus of bile duct with acute cholecystitis
iron deficiency anemia
diseases.definition: A microcytic anemia that is characterized by pallor, fatigue, lightheadedness, and weakness and has_material_basis_in low total body iron causing impaired synthesis of red blood cells.

diseases.label: hypochromic anemia
diseases.definition: An anemia that is characterized by a decrease in the ratio of the weight of hemoglobin to the volume of the erythrocyte. As a result, the red cells have an area of central pallor which is increased in size. The leading cause is iron deficiency.

diseases.label: bronchial disease
diseases.definition: A lower respiratory tract disease that affects the airways leading into the lungs, which is caused due to inflammation of the bronchi and bronchioles, infection, or blockage.

diseases.label: Kohler's disease
diseases.definition: An osteochondrosis that results_in death and collapse located_in navicular bone of foot.

diseases.label: absolute glaucoma
diseases.definition: A glaucoma that is characterized by a total loss of vision, uncontrolled pressure in the eye, severe pain in the eye, absence of pupillary light reflex, absence of pupillary response, and the eye has a stony appearance.

diseases.label: astigmatism
diseases.definition: A refractive error characterized by the optics of the eye to focus a point object into a sharp focused image on the retina, has_symptom blurred vision.

diseases.label: chronic laryngitis
diseases.definition: A laryngitis in which symptoms last longer than three weeks. Gastroesophageal reflux, and lingering bronchitis can cause the disease.

diseases.label: pericardial effusion
diseases.definition: A pericardium disease that is characterized by an abnormal accumulation of fluid in the pericardial cavity.

diseases.label: protein-energy malnutrition
diseases.definition: A nutritional deficiency disease that is characterized by inadequate dietary protein and calories, which can have profound systemic effects including decreased metabolism, altered tissue distribution, compromised immunity, and impaired growth, and has_material_basis_in dietary deprivation.

diseases.label: obsolete metastatic neoplasm to the bladder
bladder sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma and malignant neoplasm of urinary bladder that is located_in the bladder.

diseases.label: ureter cancer
diseases.definition: A urinary system cancer that is located_in the ureter.

diseases.label: hepatorenal syndrome
diseases.definition: An acute kidney failure that is characterized by severe renal vasoconstriction.

diseases.label: multicentric reticulohistiocytosis
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by papulonodular skin lesions containing a proliferation of true macrophages associated with arthritis.

diseases.label: obsolete visual cortex disorder due to vascular disorder
obsolete nephrotic syndrome with lesion of membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis
myopia
diseases.definition: A refractive error characterized by the inability to see farther objects clearly.

diseases.label: clubfoot
diseases.definition: A bone development disease where one or both are inclined inwards, axially rotated outwards, and pointing downwards with concomitant soft tissue abnormalities.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant neoplasm of scapula and long bones of upper limb
penis sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma and malignant neoplasm of penis that is located_in the penis.

diseases.label: nephrotic syndrome
diseases.definition: A nephrosis characterized by marked increase in glomerular protein permeability resulting in marked elevation of urine protein levels, hypoalbuminemia, hyperlipidemia, and hypercoagulability.

diseases.label: obsolete degenerative changes of ciliary body
indeterminate leprosy
diseases.definition: A leprosy that is an early form of the disease which causes one to a few hypopigmented or erythematous macules.

diseases.label: obsolete monocular exotropia with A pattern
obsolete monocular exotropia with V pattern
Pick's disease
diseases.definition: A frontotemporal dementia that is characterized by a spectrum of neuropsychiatric symptoms ranging from those that affect the patient's personality to those that cause a decline in cognitive function.

diseases.label: mononeuropathy
diseases.definition: A neuropathy that is characterized by damage to a single nerve, which results in loss of movement, sensation, or other function of that nerve.

diseases.label: ureter leiomyoma
diseases.definition: An ureteral benign neoplasm that derives_from smooth muscle cells.

diseases.label: female breast nipple and areola cancer
diseases.definition: A female breast cancer that is located_in the nipple and areola.

diseases.label: obsolete Amoebozoa infectious disease
diseases.definition: A parasitic protozoa infectious disease that involves infection caused by amoeboid protozoa.

diseases.label: obsolete cutaneous amebiasis
diseases.definition: An amebiasis that involves infection of the skin caused by the parasite Entamoeba histolytica, resulting in lesions on the body.

diseases.label: obsolete Acanthamoeba keratitis
diseases.definition: A parasitic protozoa infectious disease that involves infection of the cornea of the eye with Acanthamoeba in people wearing contact lenses. The symptoms include eye pain, eye redness, blurred vision, sensitivity to light, excessive tearing and sensation of something in the eye.

diseases.label: obsolete Blastocystis hominis infectious disease
diseases.definition: A parasitic stramenopiles infectious disease that involves infection of the intestine with a pathogenic heterokont Blastocystis hominis. The symptoms include watery diarrhea, abdominal pain, perianal pruritus, and excessive flatulence.

diseases.label: vaginal cancer
diseases.definition: A female reproductive system cancer that is located_in the vagina.

diseases.label: obsolete cerebral amebiasis
diseases.definition: An amebiasis that involves infection of the brain caused by the parasite Entamoeba histolytica resulting in brain abscesses.

diseases.label: labium majus cancer
diseases.definition: A vulva cancer that is located_in the labium majus.

diseases.label: tinea cruris
diseases.definition: A dermatophytosis that results_in fungal skin infection located_in groin, located_in perineum, or located_in perianal region, has_material_basis_in Ascomycota fungi that belong to a group called dermatophytes and has_symptom itching in groin, thigh skin folds, or anus and results_in_formation_of rash which appears as raised red plaques (platelike areas) and scaly patches with sharply defined borders that may blister and ooze.

diseases.label: peripheral nervous system neoplasm
diseases.definition: A nervous system cancer that is located in the peripheral nervous system.

diseases.label: tracheal cancer
diseases.definition: A respiratory system cancer that is located_in the trachea.

diseases.label: head and neck cancer
diseases.definition: An organ system cancer that arises in the head or neck region. This region includes the nasal cavity, sinuses, lips, mouth, salivary glands, throat, or larynx.

diseases.label: obsolete schizo-affective type schizophrenia subchronic state
obsolete Trichomonas vaginitis
diseases.definition: A Trichomonas vaginalis trichomoniasis that involves inflammation of the vagina caused by Trichomonas vaginalis. The symptoms include foul vaginal odor, burning during urination, vaginal discharge and irritation of the genital area.

diseases.label: obsolete Trichomonas prostatitis
diseases.definition: A Trichomonas vaginalis trichomoniasis that involves inflammation of the prostate gland caused by Trichomonas vaginalis.

diseases.label: obsolete Trichomonas cystitis
diseases.definition: A Trichomonas vaginalis trichomoniasis that involves inflammation of the urinary bladder caused by Trichomonas vaginalis. The symptoms include pain during urination, foul urine odor and abnormal urine color.

diseases.label: obsolete recurrent major depression in complete remission
obsolete Congenital cardiovascular disorder complicating pregnancy, childbirth, or the puerperium
obsolete Congenital cardiovascular disorder of mother, with delivery
obsolete psychosexual dysfunction with inhibited sexual excitement
obsolete Histoplasma capsulatum retinitis
diseases.definition: An American histoplasmosis that results_in inflammation located_in retina, has_material_basis_in Histoplasma capsulatum var capsulatum, transmitted_by airborne spores and results_in_formation_of lesions.

diseases.label: postmenopausal atrophic vaginitis
diseases.definition: A vaginitis that occurs in postmenopausal women and is characterized by vaginal atrophy secondary to estrogen deficiency.

diseases.label: obsolete symptomatic menopausal or female climacteric state
synostosis
diseases.definition: A dysostosis that results_in abnormal fusing of adjacent bones.

diseases.label: botulism
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that involves intoxication caused by botulinum neurotoxins (BoNTA, B, E and F) located in neuromuscular junction resulting in descending muscle paralysis, has_material_basis_in Clostridium botulinum A, has_material_basis_in Clostridium botulinum B, has_material_basis_in Clostridium botulinum E and has_material_basis_in Clostridium botulinum F.

diseases.label: obsolete chronic pyelonephritis without lesion of renal medullary necrosis
Prader-Willi syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal disease that is characterized by weak muscle tone, feeding difficulties, poor growth, and delayed development. Beginning in childhood, affected individuals develop an insatiable appetite, which leads to chronic overeating and obesity.

diseases.label: hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
diseases.definition: An intrinsic cardiomyopathy that is characterized by abnormal thickening (hypertrophy) of the heart without any obvious cause.

diseases.label: ulceroglandular tularemia
diseases.definition: A tularemia that results_in painful regional lymphadenopathy and an ulcerated skin lesion.

diseases.label: osteopoikilosis
diseases.definition: An osteosclerosis that results_in numerous bone islands located_in skeleton.

diseases.label: female reproductive organ cancer
diseases.definition: A reproductive organ cancer that is manifested in the female genitals. This includes organs such as the ovaries, fallopian tubes, uterus, cervix, vagina and vulva.

diseases.label: obsolete secondary malignant neoplasm of trachea
trachea sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma and malignant tumor of trachea that is located_in the trachea.

diseases.label: trachea squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that is located_in the trachea.

diseases.label: obsolete group B streptococcal pneumonia
diseases.definition: A commensal streptococcal infectious disease that is caused by group B streptococci (Streptococcus agalactiae) usually infecting neonates and the elderly.

diseases.label: obsolete group A streptococcal pneumonia
diseases.definition: A commensal streptococcal infectious disease that is caused due to the infection by group A streptococci, of which Streptococcus pyogenes is the most important pathogen. The infection results in the development of empyema, pneumothorax, and cyst.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant neoplasm of corpus uteri, except isthmus
obsolete leukemic reticuloendotheliosis of intrathoracic lymph nodes
obsolete spontaneous abortion complicated by genital tract and pelvic infectious disease
Conn's syndrome
diseases.definition: An adrenal adenoma characterized by the over production of aldosterone.

diseases.label: sympathetic ophthalmia
diseases.definition: A panuveitis that is characterized by bilateral diffuse intraocular inflammation following penetrating trauma to an eye, has_symptom blurry vision, watering, pain, and photophobia.

diseases.label: panuveitis
diseases.definition: An uveitis that is characterized by inflammation of all layers of the uvea (middle layer) of the eye, which includes the iris, ciliary body, and choroid.

diseases.label: obsolete arthropathy due to hypersensitivity reaction
allergic disease
diseases.definition: An immune system disease that is an exaggerated immune response to allergens, such as insect venom, dust mites, pollen, pet dander, drugs or some foods.

diseases.label: obsolete cryptococcal meningitis
diseases.definition: A cryptococcosis that results_in inflammation located_in meninges, has_material_basis_in Cryptococcus neoformans and has_symptom headache, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom staggering gait, has_symptom dementia, has_symptom blurred vision and has_symptom confusion.

diseases.label: cryptococcosis
diseases.definition: An opportunistic mycosis that results_in fungal infection and has_material_basis_in Cryptococcus neoformans or Cryptococcus gattii.

diseases.label: obsolete Trypanosoma meningitis
diseases.definition: A trypanosomiasis that involves inflammation of the meninges caused due to Trypanosoma species.

diseases.label: obsolete meningitis with clear cerebrospinal fluid
obsolete Fetal-maternal hemorrhage affecting management of mother
Rett syndrome
diseases.definition: A pervasive developmental disease that is characterized by normal early growth and development followed by a slowing of development, loss of purposeful use of the hands, distinctive hand movements, slowed brain and head growth, problems with walking, seizures, and intellectual disability.

diseases.label: obsolete interstitial emphysema and related conditions of newborn
nutritional optic neuropathy
diseases.definition: An optic neuritis that is characterized by nutritional deficiency causing optic nerve dysfunction, has_symptom painless bilateral progressive decrease in visual acuity and color perception, and has_material_basis_in nuritional deficits, especially of folate and vitamin B, which can be associated with restrictive diets and alcohol abuse.

diseases.label: obsolete vitamin A deficiency with corneal xerosis
sodoku disease
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Spirillum minus, which is transmitted_by contact with urine or secretions from the mouth, eye, or nose of an infected animal or transmitted_by bite of an infected animal, especially rat. The infection has_symptom chills, has_symptom relapsing fever, has_symptom rash and has_symptom joint pain.

diseases.label: vaginal disease
diseases.definition: A female reproductive system disease that is located_in the vagina.

diseases.label: optic neuritis
diseases.definition: An optic nerve disease that results_in inflammation located_in optic nerve which may cause a complete or partial loss of vision.

diseases.label: obsolete vitamin A deficiency with corneal xerosis and ulcer
obsolete vitamin A deficiency with xerophthalmic corneal scar
obsolete streptococcal pharyngitis
diseases.definition: A commensal streptococcal infectious disease that involves infection of the pharynx and sometimes the larynx and tonsils. It is caused by Group A Streptococcus bacteria. The common symptoms include fever, sore throat, headache, stomach ache, nausea, or chills.

diseases.label: pulmonary alveolar microlithiasis
diseases.definition: A lung disease that is characterized the accumulation of tiny fragments of calcium phosphate gradually accumulate in the alveoli of the lungs.

diseases.label: pulmonary hemosiderosis
diseases.definition: A lung disease with an unknown etiology affecting the lungs which results in bleeding from tiny alveolar capillaries. Examination of sputum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid can disclose hemosiderin-laden alveolar macrophages (siderophages), and the lung biopsy shows numerous siderophages in the alveoli. Alveolar hemorrhage is characterized by hemoptysis, shortness of breath, alveolar infiltrates on chest radiograph, and various degrees of anaemia. Following a bleeding episode, the alveolar macrophages convert the hemoglobin's iron into hemosiderin within 36-72h.

diseases.label: hemosiderosis
diseases.definition: An iron metabolism disease that has_material_basis_in an accumulation of hemosiderin, an iron-storage complex, resulting in iron overload.

diseases.label: pulmonary alveolar proteinosis
diseases.definition: A lung disease that is characterized by abnormal accumulation of surfactant occurs within the alveoli, interfering with gas exchange.

diseases.label: episcleritis periodica fugax
diseases.definition: A scleral disease that is characterized by painful inflammation of the episcleral tissues that, importantly, spares the sclera itself and has_symptom pain, red eyes, photophobia, tearing, and blurry vision. Episcleritis periodica fugax is typically self-limited but may be related to vascular congestion within the superficial episcleral plexus and associated with autoimmune disease, connective tissue disease, malignancies, trauma, infection, and medications, especially topiramate and pamidronate.

diseases.label: pica disease
diseases.definition: An eating disorder that is characterized by an appetite for non-nutritive substances or food ingredients.

diseases.label: bulimia nervosa
diseases.definition: An eating disorder characterized by the restraining of food intake for a period of time followed by an over intake or binging period that results in feelings of guilt and low self-esteem.

diseases.label: obsolete Tympanosclerosis of tympanic membrane and ossicles
granulomatosis with polyangiitis
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is characterized by necrotizing granulomatous inflammation of the upper and lower respiratory tract, glomerulonephritis, vasculitis, and the presence of antineutrophil cytoplasmatic autoantibodies (ANCAs) in patient sera, and is located_in lung, located_in kidney, located_in skin resulting from an autoimmune attack by antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies against small and medium-size blood vessels.

diseases.label: obsolete Yersinia enterocolitica intestinal infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Yersinia infectious disease that involves infection of the intestine caused by Yersinia enterocolitica. The symptoms include fever, abdominal pain, and diarrhea (often bloody in children).

diseases.label: factor VIII deficiency
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that has_material_basis_in Factor VIII deficiency, which results in the formation of fibrin deficient clots which makes coagulation much more prolonged.

diseases.label: dysthymic disorder
diseases.definition: A mood disorder that involves the presence of a low mood almost daily over a span of at least two years.

diseases.label: Chagas disease
diseases.definition: A trypanosomiasis that is a tropical parasitic disease caused by the flagellate protozoan Trypanosoma cruzi, which is transmitted to humans and other mammals by an insect vector, the blood-sucking assassin bugs of the subfamily Triatominae (family Reduviidae), most commonly species belonging to the Triatoma, Rhodnius, and Panstrongylus genera. The symptoms include fever, fatigue, body aches, headache, rash, loss of appetite, diarrhea, vomiting, swelling of the eyelids and myocarditis.

diseases.label: obsolete adenovirus meningitis
diseases.definition: An adenovirus infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in meninges, has_material_basis_in Human adenovirus 3 or has_material_basis_in Human adenovirus 7 and has_symptom fever, has_symptom headache, has_symptom stiff neck, and has_symptom confusion.

diseases.label: alveolar echinococcosis
diseases.definition: An echinococcosis that is caused by the larvae of Echinococcus multilocularis affecting the liver as a slow growing, destructive tumor, with abdominal pain, biliary obstruction, and occasionally metastatic lesions into the lungs and brain.

diseases.label: obsolete Tympanosclerosis of tympanic membrane only
obsolete calculus of gallbladder with acute cholecystitis, with obstruction
lymphocytic choriomeningitis
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results in infection located in brain, or located in meninges, or located in brain and meninges, has_material_basis_in Mammarenavirus choriomeningitidis, which is transmitted by common house mouse, Mus musculus. The infection has symptom fever, has symptom lack of appetite, has symptom headache, has symptom muscle aches, has symptom malaise, has symptom nausea, and has symptom vomiting.

diseases.label: aseptic meningitis
diseases.definition: A meningitis that is characterized by meningeal inflammation not caused by an identifiable bacterial pathogen in the cerebrospinal fluid. A large majority of them are caused by enteroviruses.

diseases.label: carpal tunnel syndrome
diseases.definition: A nerve compression syndrome characterized by pressure on the median nerve at the wrist resulting in numbness, tingling, pain, and muscle weakness in the hand and forearm.

diseases.label: fascioloidiasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves parasitic infection of the liver of a variety of wild and domestic ruminants by Fascioloides magna.

diseases.label: goiter
diseases.definition: A thyroid gland disease that involves an abnormal enlargement of the thyroid gland.

diseases.label: common variable immunodeficiency
diseases.definition: An agammaglobulinemia that is characterized by low Ig levels with phenotypically normal B cells that can proliferate but do not develop into Ig-producing cells and that esults in insufficient production of antibodies needed to respond to exposure of pathogens.

diseases.label: tinea corporis
diseases.definition: A dermatophytosis that results_in fungal infection located_in skin, limited to the stratum corneum of the epidermis, has_material_basis_in Ascomycota fungi that belong to a group called dermatophytes and has_symptom itching, and has_symptom red colored skin rash. The border of the rash lesions look scaly.

diseases.label: echinostomiasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves parasitic infection of the intestine by Echinostoma species. The symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, fever and abdominal pain.

diseases.label: otosclerosis
diseases.definition: An otitis interna characterized by isolated endochondral bone sclerosis of the labyrinthine capsule.

diseases.label: obsolete metastatic tumor to the colon
dicrocoeliasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves parasitic infection of the bile ducts of the liver by Dicrocoelium dendriticum. The symptoms include cholecystitis, liver abscesses and upper abdominal pain.

diseases.label: obsolete abdominal cancer
diseases.definition: A cancer by anatomical entitiy that affects the organs in the abdominal cavity.

diseases.label: dengue disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results in infection, has_material_basis_in Dengue virus [NCBITaxon:12637] with four serotypes (Dengue virus 1, 2, 3 and 4), which are transmitted by Aedes mosquito bite. The infection has symptom fever, has symptom severe headache, has symptom severe pain behind the eyes, has symptom joint pain, has symptom muscle and bone pain, has symptom rash, and has symptom mild bleeding.

diseases.label: dengue hemorrhagic fever
diseases.definition: A dengue disease that occurs when a person experiences a second infection with a heterologous Dengue virus serotype, which is transmitted_by Aedes mosquito bite. The infection has_symptom hemorrhagic lesions of the skin, has_symptom thrombocytopenia, has_symptom reduction in the fluid part of the blood, and has_symptom high fever.

diseases.label: obsolete infiltrative lung tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A pulmonary tuberculosis that is characterized by filling of airspaces with fluid, inflammatory exudates (pus, proteins and immunological substances) or cells (malignant cells and red blood cells) in a region of the lung.

diseases.label: obsolete Wuchereria bancrofti filariasis
diseases.definition: A filarial elephantiasis that involves parasitic infection of the lymphatic system by a filarial worm Wuchereria bancrofti, which is transmitted by mosquitoes. The symptoms include lymphedema, fever, chills, skin infections, painful lymph nodes, orchitis and epididymitis.

diseases.label: filarial elephantiasis
diseases.definition: A filariasis that is characterized by the thickening of the skin and underlying tissues, especially in the legs, male genitals and female breasts, caused by thread-like parasitic worms Wuchereria bancrofti, Brugia malayi or Brugia timori, which inhabit the lymphatics. These nematodes are transmitted by mosquitoes. Acute symptoms include fever, lymphadenitis, lymphangitis, funiculitis, and epididymitis. Chronic symptoms include abscesses, hyperkeratosis, polyarthritis, hydroceles, lymphedema, and elephantiasis.

diseases.label: oligohydramnios
diseases.definition: A placenta disease that is characterized by a deficiency of amniotic fluid sometimes resulting in an embryonic defect through adherence between embryo and amnion.

diseases.label: Lewy body dementia
diseases.definition: A dementia that is characterized by the development of abnormal proteinaceous (alpha-synuclein) cytoplasmic inclusions, called Lewy bodies, throughout the brain that results in progressive decline in mental abilities that has_material_basis_in accumulation of alpha-synuclein, SCNA, (protein). The causal mutation might be in SCNA or SCNB or some other gene(s) but the end result is always accumulation of SCNA in Lewy bodies.

diseases.label: cartilage disease
diseases.definition: A connective tissue disease that is located_in cartilage.

diseases.label: obsolete Synovial, tendon or bursa disorder
specific bursitis often of occupational origin
obsolete calcium deposits in tendon and bursa
obsolete secondary malignant neoplasm of large intestine and rectum
primary biliary cholangitis
diseases.definition: A liver cirrhosis characterized by chronic and slow progressive destruction of intrahepatic bile ducts.

diseases.label: bile reflux
diseases.definition: A biliary tract disease characterized by the flow of bile up into the stomach and/or esophagus.

diseases.label: beta thalassemia
diseases.definition: A thalassemia characterized by the reduced or absent synthesis of the beta globin chains of hemoglobin.

diseases.label: obsolete histoplasmosis endocarditis
diseases.definition: A histoplasmosis endocarditis that results_in inflammation located_in endocardium, has_material_basis_in Histoplasma capsulatum var duboisii or has_material_basis_in Histoplasma capsulatum var capsulatum, transmitted_by airborne spores and has_symptom murmurs, has_symptom peripheral edema, has_symptom pulmonary rales, has_symptom petechia and has_symptom skin lesions.

diseases.label: obsolete Cushing's syndrome
diseases.definition: An adrenal gland hyperfunction that is caused by overactivity of the adrenal cortex caused by a tumor of the pituitary gland.

diseases.label: obsolete metastatic tumor to the testis
hemophilia B
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that has_material_basis_in Factor IX deficiency, which makes coagulation much more prolonged. The disease is inherited as an X-linked recessive trait.

diseases.label: obsolete Toxemia with convulsions complicating pregnancy, childbirth or the puerperium
coloboma
diseases.definition: An eye disease characterized by missing pieces of tissue in structures that form the eye, such as the iris, retina, choroid or optic disc.

diseases.label: aniridia
diseases.definition: An iris disease that is characterized by a complete or partial absence of the colored part of the eye.

diseases.label: cutaneous diphtheria
diseases.definition: A pyoderma that is a milder form of diphtheria restricted to the skin producing shallow skin ulcers is caused by direct physical contact of indivduals infected with Corynebacterium diphtheriae as the bacteria releases the diphtheria toxin.

diseases.label: obsolete paranoid type schizophrenia in remission
Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that is a hemorrhagic fever, has_material_basis_in Orthonairovirus haemorrhagiae, which is transmitted_by Hyalomma ticks. The infection has_symptom headache, has_symptom high fever, has_symptom back pain, has_symptom joint pain, has_symptom stomach pain, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom red eyes, has_symptom flushed face, has_symptom red throat, has_symptom petechiae (red spots) on the palate, has_symptom jaundice, has_symptom nosebleeds, and has_symptom blood in the feces and urine.

diseases.label: paranoid schizophrenia
diseases.definition: A schizophrenia characterized by delusions or auditory hallucinations of persecution or being plotted against without thought disorder, disorganized behavior, or affective flattening.

diseases.label: atypical depressive disorder
diseases.definition: A mood disorder that is characterized by mood reactivity and positivity, significant weight gain or increased appetite, excessive sleep or somnolence, a sensation of heaviness in limbs known as leaden paralysis, and significant social impairment as a consequence of hypersensitivity to perceived interpersonal rejection.

diseases.label: Vogt-Koyanagi-Harada disease
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is caused by T helper cell mediated autoimmune attack of melanocytes resulting in inflammation of the inside of the eye, whitening of hair, skin pigment loss, and meningitis.

diseases.label: obsolete diphtheritic membranous angina
diseases.definition: A diphtheria that involves a bluish white membrane formation on the faucial pillars, uvula, soft palate and tonsils.

diseases.label: vitiligo
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that causes depigmentation of patches of skin resulting from loss of function or death of melanoctyes.

diseases.label: Dubin-Johnson syndrome
diseases.definition: A bilirubin metabolic disorder that involves elevated levels of unconjugated bilirubin without elevation of liver alanine transaminase and aspartate transaminase enzymes as a result of the deficient ability of hepatocytes to secrete conjugated bilirubin into the bile.

diseases.label: granular corneal dystrophy
diseases.definition: An epithelial-stromal TGFBI dystrophy that is characterized by progressive accumulation of deposits within the layers of the cornea.

diseases.label: obsolete paranoid type schizophrenia subchronic state with acute exacerbation
cough variant asthma
diseases.definition: A chronic asthma that is characterized by chronic nonproductive cough without shortness of breath.

diseases.label: marasmus
diseases.definition: A protein-energy malnutrition that is characterized by severe caloric deprivation, has_symptom emaciation, decreased height and weight gain, and decreased metabolism with hypothermia, bradycardia, and constipation, and has_material_basis_in severe caloric deprivation.

diseases.label: gender incongruence
diseases.definition: A sexual health disorder that involves a conflict between a person's actual physical gender and the gender that person identifies himself or herself as.

diseases.label: retroperitoneal sarcoma
diseases.definition: A malignant retroperitoneal cancer and sarcoma that is located_in the retroperitoneal space.

diseases.label: osteogenesis imperfecta
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that has_material_basis_in a deficiency in type-I collagen which results_in brittle bones and defective connective tissue.

diseases.label: viral labyrinthitis
diseases.definition: A labyrinthitis which involves viral infection of the inner ear through the upper airway or the blood stream. The symptoms may include hearing loss and ringing in the ears. If the virus reaches the vestibular system, dizziness, severe vertigo with nausea and vomiting, and imbalance can occur.

diseases.label: patulous eustachian tube
diseases.definition: A eustachian tube disorder with a wider eustachian tube which allows a larger bolus of bacteria-laden material from the nasopharynx during an infection to enter the middle ear, causing a more fulminant infection.

diseases.label: Graves' disease
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease of endocrine system that involves production of excessive amount of thyroid hormones, located_in thyroid gland.

diseases.label: malaria
diseases.definition: A parasitic protozoa infectious disease characterized as a vector-borne infectious disease caused by the presence of protozoan parasites of the genus Plasmodium in the red blood cells, transmitted from an infected to an uninfected individual by the bite of anopheline mosquitoes, and characterized by periodic attacks of chills and fever that coincide with mass destruction of blood cells and the release of toxic substances by the parasite at the end of each reproductive cycle.

diseases.label: prolapse of urethra
diseases.definition: A prolapse of female genital organ that is characterized by the descent of the urethra from the normal anatomic location toward or through the vaginal opening.

diseases.label: bronchopneumonia
diseases.definition: A pneumonia involving inflammation of lungs that begins in the terminal bronchioles, which become clogged with thick mucus that forms consolidated patches in adjacent lobules. It is caused by bacteria and viruses.

diseases.label: juvenile spinal muscular atrophy
diseases.definition: A childhood spinal muscular atrophy that has age of onset after 18 months and is characterized by muscle weakness after early childhood and the ability to stand and walk and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the SMN1 gene on chromosome 5q13.

diseases.label: spinal muscular atrophy
diseases.definition: A motor neuron disease that is a degenerative neuromuscular disease characterized by lower motor neuron degeneration associated with progressive muscle weakness and atrophy.

diseases.label: obsolete mixed disorder as reaction to stress
obsolete acute erythremia and erythroleukemia in remission
dysentery
diseases.definition: An intestinal infectious disease that involves inflammation of the intestines, especially colon, due to chemical irritants, bacteria, protozoa, or parasitic worms, which results in severe diarrhea with passage of mucus and blood.

diseases.label: shigellosis
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that results_in infection located_in epithelium of colon, has_material_basis_in Shigella boydii, has_material_basis_in Shigella dysenteriae, has_material_basis_in Shigella flexneri, or has_material_basis_in Shigella sonnei, which produce toxins that can attack the lining of the large intestine, causing swelling, ulcers on the intestinal wall, and bloody diarrhea. The bacteria are transmitted_by ingestion of food and water contaminated with feces.

diseases.label: balantidiasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic protozoa infectious disease involving infection caused by Balantidium coli. The trophozoites are capable of attacking the intestinal epithelium, creating ulcers and causing bloody diarrhea. The infectiou has_symptom cramping, has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom nausea and has_symptom foul breath.

diseases.label: nephrogenic diabetes insipidus
diseases.definition: A diabetes insipidus that is characterized by a complete or partial resistance of the kidneys to vasopressin (ADH).

diseases.label: neurohypophyseal diabetes insipidus
diseases.definition: A central diabetes insipidus that is characterized by polyuria and polydipsia due to a deficiency in vasopressin synthesis and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the arginine vasopressin gene (AVP) on chromosome 20p13.

diseases.label: obsolete leukemic reticuloendotheliosis involving lymph nodes of head, face and neck
obsolete entropion and trichiasis of eyelid
pathological gambling
diseases.definition: An impulse control disorder that involves the uncontrollable impulse to gamble, irrespective of the interference the behaviour has on the individual's life.

diseases.label: leukemia
diseases.definition: A cancer that affects the blood or bone marrow characterized by an abnormal proliferation of blood cells.

diseases.label: kleptomania
diseases.definition: An impulse control disorder that involves the repeated impulse to steal for no great gain, when he or she has sufficient money to pay for the item and no need for what is stolen.

diseases.label: intermittent explosive disorder
diseases.definition: An impulse control disorder that involves the episodic inability to control violent impulses with a disproportionate degree of aggressiveness.

diseases.label: pyromania
diseases.definition: An impulse control disorder that involves the uncontrollable impulse to repeatedly set fires with no obvious motive.

diseases.label: tinea pedis
diseases.definition: A dermatophytosis that results_in fungal infection located_in skin of foot, especially between the toes, has_material_basis_in Trichophyton or has_material_basis_in Epidermophyton and has_symptom fissures, has_symptom scaling, has_symptom maceration, and eroded areas between the toes and on the plantar surface of the foot.

diseases.label: obsolete tinea
diseases.definition: A cutaneous mycosis that results_in fungal infection located_in skin, located_in hair, and located_in nail, has_material_basis_in Epidermophyton, has_material_basis_in Microsporum, or has_material_basis_in Trichophyton, which invade the dead keratin and has_symptom itchy patches, and has_symptom red rash on the skin.

diseases.label: globe disease
diseases.definition: An eye disease that involves the globe of the eye.

diseases.label: labia minora cancer
diseases.definition: A vulva cancer that is located_in the labium minora.

diseases.label: aplastic anemia
diseases.definition: A normocytic anemia that is characterized by a deficiency of red blood cells, white blood cells and platelets produced by bone marrow.

diseases.label: vulva cancer
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ cancer that is located_in the vulva.

diseases.label: pancytopenia
diseases.definition: An anemia that is characterized by a reduction in the number of red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets.

diseases.label: blood coagulation disease
diseases.definition: A hematopoietic system disease that is characterized by abnormal blood clotting or bleeding.

diseases.label: capillariasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves infection of the intestine, liver and lungs caused by Capillaria species.

diseases.label: obsolete Conjunctival vascular disorder and cysts
vagina leiomyoma
diseases.definition: A vaginal benign neoplasm that is a benign tumor of smooth muscle cells.

diseases.label: Bell's palsy
diseases.definition: A facial paralysis resulting from dysfunction in the cranial nerve VII (facial nerve).

diseases.label: obsolete simple type schizophrenia chronic state with acute exacerbation
tuberculous epididymitis
diseases.definition: An urogenital tuberculosis that is located_in epididymis, has_symptom pain and has_symptom scrotal swelling.

diseases.label: retinal ischemia
diseases.definition: An ischemia that is characterized by restriction in blood supply to the retina.

diseases.label: trichuriasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves parasitic infection located_in intestine in humans, has_material_basis_in Trichuris trichiura, which is transmitted_by ingestion of food contaminated with egg-carrying soil. The infection has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom rectal prolapse and has_symptom growth retardation.

diseases.label: bagassosis
diseases.definition: An extrinsic allergic alveolitis that is an industrial disease characterized by cough, difficult breathing, chills, fever, and prolonged weakness caused by the inhalation of the dust of bagasse containing thermophilic actinomycetes.

diseases.label: obsolete Lateral cutaneous femoral nerve of thigh compression or syndrome
obsolete Enoplea infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Nematoda infectious disease that involves infection by parasitic worms of the class Enoplea, characterized by no body annules, no elaborate amphids, and five or more esophageal glands.

diseases.label: von Willebrand's disease
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that is a hereditary abnormality which slows the blood clotting process. It arises from a qualitative or quantitative deficiency of von Willebrand factor (vWF), a multimeric protein that is required for platelet adhesion.

diseases.label: trichostrongylosis
diseases.definition: A trichostrongyloidiasis that involves infection of the small intestine with Trichostrongylus colubriformis or Trichostrongylus axei, which results in abdominal pain, diarrhea, anorexia, headache, fatigue, anemia and eosinophilia.

diseases.label: obsolete catatonic type schizophrenia subchronic state
obsolete catatonic type schizophrenia subchronic state with acute exacerbation
obsolete catatonic type schizophrenia chronic state with acute exacerbation
hepatitis A
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in liver, has_material_basis_in Hepatitis A virus, which is transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food or water, or transmitted_by direct contact with an infected person. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom fatigue, has_symptom loss of appetite, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom clay-colored bowel movements, has_symptom joint pain, and has_symptom jaundice.

diseases.label: trichostrongyloidiasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves parasitic infection of animals and humans by nematodes of the superfamily Trichostrongyloidea.

diseases.label: hemolytic-uremic syndrome
diseases.definition: A kidney disease that is characterized by hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, and renal failure caused by platelet thrombi in the microcirculation of the kidney and other organs.

diseases.label: obsolete acute renal failure with lesion of renal cortical necrosis
acute kidney tubular necrosis
diseases.definition: An acute kidney failure that is characterized by necrosis of epithelial tubule cells.

diseases.label: idiopathic juvenile osteoporosis
diseases.definition: An osteoporosis with no known cause that is characterized by pain in the back and extremities, walking difficulties, multiple fractures, and radiological evidence of osteoporosis.

diseases.label: ulceration of vulva
diseases.definition: A vulvar disease that is characterized by the presence of ulcers.

diseases.label: dyscalculia
diseases.definition: A learning disability involving a math disability can cause such difficulties as learning math concepts (such as quantity, place value, and time), difficulty memorizing math facts, difficulty organizing numbers, and understanding how problems are organized on the page.

diseases.label: obsolete Chagas cardiomyopathy
diseases.definition: A Chagas disease that involves deterioration of the function of the myocardium caused due to Trypanosoma cruzi infection, which leads to heart rhythm abnormalities and may result in sudden death.

diseases.label: phacolytic glaucoma
diseases.definition: A phacogenic glaucoma that is characterized by acute onset of open-angle glaucoma secondary to a leaking mature or hypermature cataract and has_symptom chronic progressive vision loss with acute onset of pain, redness, and blurry vision. Phacolytic glaucomas are caused by direct obstruction of aqueous outflow pathways from leaking cataractous lens proteins.

diseases.label: phacogenic glaucoma
diseases.definition: A glaucoma characterized by glaucomatous optic atrophy secondary to a lens abnormality and has_symptom progressive decreased vision, especially decreased peripheral vision. Phacogenic glaucoma can be caused by cataracts, trauma to the eye, or age-related damage that obstructs aqueous outflow, leading to inappropriately increased intraocular pressure and eventual optic nerve atrophy with associated vision loss.

diseases.label: Cri-Du-Chat syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that has_material_basis_in deletion of the end of the chromosome 5 p arm and that is characterized by intellectual disability, delayed development, small head size, low birth weight, weak muscle tone widely set eyes, low-set ears, a small jaw, a rounded face and a high-pitched cry that sounds like that of a cat.

diseases.label: velocardiofacial syndrome
diseases.definition: A chromosomal deletion disease that has_material_basis_in da 1.5- to 3.0-Mb hemizygous deletion of chromosome 22q11.2 and that is characterized by variable developmental problems and schizoid features. Haploinsufficiency of the TBX1 gene in particular is responsible for most of the physical malformations.

diseases.label: obsolete Diabetes mellitus of mother, with delivery
Potter's syndrome
diseases.definition: A renal agenesis characterized by the typical physical appearance and associated pulmonary hypoplasia of a newborn as a direct result of kidney failure, oligohydramnios and compression while in the uterus.

diseases.label: acute leukemia
diseases.definition: A lymphoid leukemia that occurs when a hematopoietic stem cell undergoes malignant transformation into a primitive, undifferentiated cell with abnormal longevity producing large numbers of white blood cells to be produced and enter the blood stream.

diseases.label: obsolete secondary malignant neoplasm of suprarenal gland
obsolete staphylococcal pneumonia
diseases.definition: A staphylococcal infectious disease that is caused due to the infection by Gram-positive bacterium Staphylococcus aureus, which is an important cause of hospital-acquired infection that results in the formation of abscesses, empyema, pneumothorax, and cyst.

diseases.label: obsolete adrenal hemorrhage of fetus or newborn
obsolete gastrointestinal hemorrhage of fetus or newborn
obsolete cervicofacial actinomycosis
diseases.definition: An actinomycosis that involves invasion and infiltration located_in head and located_in neck, has_material_basis_in Actinomyces israelii. The infection results_in_formation_of abscesses following oral surgery or in patients with poor dental hygiene.

diseases.label: obsolete cerebral actinomycosis
diseases.definition: An actinomycosis that involves invasion and infiltration located_in brain, has_material_basis_in Actinomyces israelii. The infection results_in_formation_of brain abscess.

diseases.label: perineocele
diseases.definition: A prolapse of the female genital organ that is characterized by an isolated central defect and herniation of the posterior perineum in patients without diffuse vaginal prolapse.

diseases.label: hypertrophic pyloric stenosis
diseases.definition: A pyloric stenosis characterized by the enlargement of the muscle surrounding the pylorus, causing severe projectile non-bilious vomiting.

diseases.label: displacement of cardia through esophageal hiatus
obsolete Congenital or acquired abnormality of vulva, with delivery
obsolete genitourinary cancer
diseases.definition: An organ system cancer located_in the genitourinary system that is characterized by uncontrolled cellular proliferation in reproductive and urinary organs.

diseases.label: obsolete disorder of optic chiasm associated with inflammatory disorder
paracoccidioidomycosis
diseases.definition: A primary systemic mycosis that results_in systemic fungal infection located_in mucosa, located_in lymph nodes, located_in bone, located_in skin or located_in lungs, has_material_basis_in Paracoccidioides brasiliensis.

diseases.label: blastomycosis
diseases.definition: A primary systemic mycosis that results_in a systemic fungal infection, has_material_basis_in Blastomyces dermatitidis, transmitted_by airborne spores and has_symptom skin lesions, has_symptom lung lesions and has_symptom pleural thickening.

diseases.label: pseudobulbar palsy
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by damage to neurons of the corticobulbar tract, has_symptom dysarthria, has_symptom dysphagia, has_symptom spasticity located_in tongue, has_symptom gag reflex, and has_symptom emotional outbursts.

diseases.label: vestibular neuronitis
diseases.definition: A inner ear infectious disease caused by a viral infection which involves inflammation of the vestibular nerve. It usually results as a complication of an upper respiratory infection. This causes sudden and severe vertigo, nausea and vomiting. Auditory symptoms are usually absent.

diseases.label: mixed receptive-expressive language disorder
diseases.definition: A communication disorder that involves both the receptive and expressive areas of communication may be affected in any degree, from mild to severe.

diseases.label: obsolete hyperemesis gravidarum with metabolic disturbance
locked-in syndrome
diseases.definition: A nervous system disease that is characterized by complete paralysis of all voluntary muscles except for the ones that control the movements of the eyes.

diseases.label: gynecomastia
diseases.definition: A disorder of sexual development that is characterized by enlargement or swelling of male breast tissue resulting from elevated male estrogen levels or imbalanced estrogen and testosterone levels.

diseases.label: leiomyoma
diseases.definition: A cell type benign neoplasm that is a benign tumor of smooth muscle cells.

diseases.label: hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia
diseases.definition: A vascular disease characterized by the presence of multiple arteriovenous malformations that lack intervening capillaries and result in direct connections between arteries and veins.

diseases.label: hyperprolactinemia
diseases.definition: An acquired metabolic disease that has_material_basis_in the presence of abnormally-high levels of prolactin in the blood.

diseases.label: obsolete Rotator cuff shoulder syndrome and allied disorder
ataxia telangiectasia
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that is characterized by cerebellar ataxia, telangiectases, immune defects, and a predisposition to malignancy and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the ATM gene on chromosome 11q22.

diseases.label: capillary disease
diseases.definition: A vascular disease that is located_in the capillaries.

diseases.label: obsolete Histoplasma duboisii pneumonia
diseases.definition: An African histoplasmosis that results_in inflammation located_in lung, has_material_basis_in Histoplasma capsulatum var duboisii, transmitted_by airborne spores and has_symptom mediastinal lymphadenopathy, has_symptom cough and has_symptom chest pain.

diseases.label: black piedra
diseases.definition: A superficial mycosis that is a superficial fungal infection of the hair shaft caused by Piedraia hortae, an ascomycetous fungus forming hard black nodules on the shafts of the scalp, beard, moustache and pubic hair.

diseases.label: nephronophthisis
diseases.definition: A kidney disease that is characterized by a chronic tubulointerstitial nephritis that progress to terminal renal failure during the second decade (juvenile form) or before the age of 5 years (infantile form) resulting from dysfunction of ciliary proteins (ciliopathy).

diseases.label: Ellis-Van Creveld syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by short limbs, short ribs, postaxial polydactyly, dysplastic nails and teeth, and in many patients congenital cardiac defects that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in either the EVC or EVC2 gene on chromosome 4p16.2.

diseases.label: newborn respiratory distress syndrome
diseases.definition: A respiratory failure that is characterized by deficiency of the surfactant coating the inner surface of the lungs, by failure of the lungs to expand and contract properly during breathing with resulting collapse, and by the accumulation of a protein-containing film lining the alveoli and their ducts.

diseases.label: chronic gonococcal salpingitis
diseases.definition: A chronic salpingitis that is caused by gonorrhea.

diseases.label: multiple epiphyseal dysplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that has_material_basis_in defective cartilage mineralization into bone which results in irregular ossification centers of the located in hip or located in knee. The disease has symptom fatigue, has symptom joint pain.

diseases.label: obsolete lung carcinoma metastatic to the liver
obsolete breast arcinoma metastatic to the liver
respiratory syncytial virus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection located_in upper respiratory tract or located_in lower respiratory tract, has_material_basis_in Human respiratory syncytial virus, which is transmitted_by droplet spread of nasal secretions from an infected person while coughing or sneezing, or transmitted_by contaminated fomites. The infection has_symptom runny nose, has_symptom fever, has_symptom cough, has_symptom wheezing, and has_symptom respiratory distress.

diseases.label: hernia of ovary and fallopian tube
diseases.definition: A female reproductive system disease that is characterized by the protrusion of the ovary and fallopian tube through a defect inthe abdominal wall.

diseases.label: obsolete bronchial tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A pulmonary tuberculosis which involves inflammation of bronchi resulting in irregular circumferential bronchial wall thickening that leads to narrowed or even obstructed airways.

diseases.label: obsolete Pneumovirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Paramyxoviridae infectious disease that results_in infection in cattle and humans, has_material_basis_in Pneumovirus, which is transmitted_by contact with the respiratory secretions.

diseases.label: cyclosporiasis
diseases.definition: A coccidiosis that involves infection of the intestine with the parasitic protozoan Cyclospora cayetanensis, which is transmitted by contaminated food and water. The symptoms include watery diarrhea, anorexia, weight loss, abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting, myalgias, low-grade fever, and fatigue.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant neoplasm of eyeball, except conjunctiva, cornea, retina and choroid
obsolete classic Kaposi's sarcoma
diseases.definition: A Kaposi's sarcoma that located_in older men of Italian or Eastern European Jewish origin. Kaposi's sarcoma results_in slow-growing lesions on the legs and feet.

diseases.label: obsolete peritonsillar abscess
diseases.definition: A tonsillitis which involves collection of pus beside the tonsil (peritonsillar space). It is caused by both aerobic and anaerobic bacteria. Commonly involved species include streptococci, staphylococci and hemophilus. Progressively worsening unilateral sore throat and pain during swallowing usually are the earliest symptoms. As the abscess develops, persistent pain in the peritonsillar area, fever, malaise, headache and a distortion of vowels informally known as 'hot potato voice' may appear. Neck pain associated with tender, swollen lymph nodes, referred ear pain and halitosis are also common.

diseases.label: obsolete endemic African Kaposi's sarcoma
diseases.definition: A Kaposi's sarcoma that is located_in black Africans.

diseases.label: obsolete recurrent Kaposi's sarcoma
diseases.definition: A Kaposi's sarcoma that derives_from the tissue that lines the lymph vessels under the skin or in mucous membranes.

diseases.label: migraine without aura
diseases.definition: A migraine that is characterized by migraine headaches that are not accompanied by an aura.

diseases.label: obsolete diabetes mellitus insulin dependent type, not stated as uncontrolled, with neurological manifestations
hallucinogen abuse
diseases.definition: A substance abuse that involves the recurring use of hallucinogenic drugs despite negative consequences.

diseases.label: mucopolysaccharidosis
diseases.definition: A lysosomal storage disease that involves the accumulation of glycosaminoglycans in the tissues and their excretion in the urine.

diseases.label: mucopolysaccharidosis II
diseases.definition: A mucopolysaccharidosis characterized by a deficiency of the lysosomal enzyme iduronate sulfatase.

diseases.label: mucopolysaccharidosis VI
diseases.definition: A mucopolysaccharidosis characterized by a deficiency of the lysosomal enzyme N-acetylgalactosamine 4-sulfatase.

diseases.label: mucopolysaccharidosis III
diseases.definition: A mucopolysaccharidosis characterized by a deficiency of the lysosomal enzyme resulting in incomplete breakdown of the heparan sulfate sugar chain.

diseases.label: mucopolysaccharidosis I
diseases.definition: A mucopolysaccharidosis characterized by a deficiency of the lysosomal enzyme alpha-L-iduronidase.

diseases.label: Sly syndrome
diseases.definition: A mucopolysaccharidosis characterized by a deficiency of the lysosomal enzyme beta-glucuronidase resulting in the inability to degrade glucuronic acid-containing glycosaminoglycans.

diseases.label: mucopolysaccharidosis IV
diseases.definition: A mucopolysaccharidosis characterized by a deficiency of the lysosomal enzymes galactose 6-sulfate sulfatase (Type A) or beta-galactosidase (Type B) needed to break down the keratan sulfate sugar chain.

diseases.label: obsolete Clostridium difficile intestinal infectious disease
diseases.definition: A commensal bacterial infectious disease that involves infection of the intestine by the bacterium Clostridium difficile, which causes diarrhea, pseudomembranous colitis, toxic megacolon, intestinal perforation and sepsis. The symptoms include fever, loss of appetite, nausea and abdominal pain.

diseases.label: enterocele
diseases.definition: A prolapse of female genital organ that is characterized by the descent of a peritoneal sac containing small bowel into the rectovagnial space causing a bulge in the posterior vaginal wall.

diseases.label: obsolete thyrotoxicosis from ectopic thyroid nodule
prolapse of female genital organ
diseases.definition: A female reproductive system disease that is characterized by the descent of one or more of the pelvic structures (bladder, uterus, vagina) from the normal anatomic location toward or through the vaginal opening.

diseases.label: obsolete Ancylostoma ceylanicum ancylostomiasis
diseases.definition: An ancylostomiasis that involves parasitic infection of animals and humans by Ancylostoma ceylanicum larvae, which invade percutaneously and migrate to the intestine.

diseases.label: ancylostomiasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves infection of skin, eyes, and viscera in humans by the parasitic nematodes Ancylostoma braziliense, Ancylostoma ceylanicum, Ancylostoma duodenale or Ancylostoma caninum. The larvae cause lesions on the skin at the site of penetration. The infection has_symptom intestinal bleeding, has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom anemia, has_symptom severe diarrhea and has_symptom malnutrition.

diseases.label: Guillain-Barre syndrome
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease of peripheral nervous system that causes body's immune system to attack part of the peripheral nervous system.

diseases.label: autistic disorder
diseases.definition: An autism spectrum disorder that is characterized by symptoms across all three symptom domains (communication, social, restricted repetitive interests and behaviors), delayed language development, and symptom onset prior to age 3 years.

diseases.label: obsolete adhesions of drum head to incus
obsolete adhesions of drum head to promontorium
obsolete adhesions of drum head to stapes
Huntington's disease
diseases.definition: A neurodegenerative disease that has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant inheritance and is characterized by unwanted choreatic movements, behavioral and psychiatric disturbances and dementia and has_material_basis_in expansion of CAG triplet repeats (glutamine) resulting in neuron degeneration affecting muscle coordination, cognitive abilities.

diseases.label: choreatic disease
diseases.definition: A movement disease characterized by brief, semi-directed, irregular movements that not repetitive or rhythmic, but appear to flow from one muscle to the next.

diseases.label: cardiovascular system disease
diseases.definition: A disease of anatomical entity which occurs in the blood, heart, blood vessels or the lymphatic system that passes nutrients (such as amino acids and electrolytes), gases, hormones, blood cells or lymph to and from cells in the body to help fight diseases and help stabilize body temperature and pH to maintain homeostasis.

diseases.label: hypochondriasis
diseases.definition: A somatoform disorder that involves an excessive preoccupation or worry about having a serious illness.

diseases.label: obsolete Chlamydophila psittaci pneumonia
diseases.definition: An ornithosis involving Chlamydophila psittaci infection, contracted by inhaling dust from the feathers or the waste of infected birds. The symptoms include fever, chills, fatigue, and loss of appetite. A cough develops, which is initially dry but later brings up greenish sputum.

diseases.label: Miller Fisher syndrome
diseases.definition: A Guillain-Barre syndrome that manifests as a descending paralysis. It usually affects the eye muscles first and presents with the triad of ophthalmoplegia, ataxia, and areflexia.

diseases.label: neurodegenerative disease
diseases.definition: A central nervous system disease that results in the progressive deterioration of function or structure of neurons.

diseases.label: Sjogren's syndrome
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that involves attack of immune cells which destroy the exocrine glands that produce tears and saliva.

diseases.label: benign lymphoepithelial lesion of salivary gland
Mikulicz disease
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is characterized by chronic enlargement of the glands of the head and neck, has_symptom lumps of the face and neck, dry eyes, dry mouth, and intermittent fever, and is often associated with an underlying autoimmune disorder, hematologic malignancy, tuberculosis infection, or syphilis infection.

diseases.label: Plasmodium ovale malaria
diseases.definition: A malaria characterized as a relatively mild form caused by a parasite Plasmodium ovale, which is characterized by tertian chills and febrile paroxysms, and that ends spontaneously.

diseases.label: hypodermyiasis
diseases.definition: A myiasis that involves parasitic infestation of warble flies of the genus Hypoderma, on cattle and deer and Dermatobia hominis on humans. The larvae of human botfly, Dermatobia hominis, feed in a subdermal cavity causing cutaneous swellings on the body or scalp that may produce discharges and be painful.

diseases.label: screw worm infectious disease
diseases.definition: A myiasis that involves parasitic infestation of Cochliomyia hominivorax or Chrysomya bezziana larvae, which feed on the living tissues of warm-blooded animals. In Cochliomyia infestation, larvae migrate from the subdermis to other tissues in the body, causing extreme damage in the process. Chrysomya bezziana larvae feed and can cause permanent tissue damage.

diseases.label: endocardial fibroelastosis
diseases.definition: An endocardium disease that is characterized by a thickening of the inmost lining of the heart chambers due to an increase in the amount of supporting connective tissue and elastic fibers.

diseases.label: labia minora carcinoma
diseases.definition: A vulva carcinoma that is located_in the labia minora.

diseases.label: dilated cardiomyopathy
diseases.definition: An intrinsic cardiomyopathy that is characterized by an an enlarged heart and damage to the myocardium causing the heart to pump blood inefficiently.

diseases.label: vulva carcinoma
diseases.definition: A vulva cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: acrocephalosyndactylia
diseases.definition: A synostosis that results_in craniosynostosis and syndactyly.

diseases.label: Poland syndrome
diseases.definition: A physical disorder that is characterized by missing or underdeveloped muscles on one side of the body, resulting in abnormalities that can affect the chest, shoulder, arm, and hand.

diseases.label: subleukemic leukemia
diseases.definition: A leukemia that is characterized by the presence of abnormal white blood cells located_in peripheral blood, but in which the total number of white blood cells is normal.

diseases.label: central nervous system leukemia
diseases.definition: A leukemia located_in the central nervous system.

diseases.label: hereditary spherocytosis
diseases.definition: A congenital hemolytic anemia characterized by the production of red blood cells with a sphere shape, rather than the normal biconcave disk shape.

diseases.label: obsolete secondary malignant neoplasm of intrapelvic lymph node
Plasmodium vivax malaria
diseases.definition: A malaria that is caused by the protozoan parasite Plasmodium vivax, which induces paroxysms at 48-hour intervals.

diseases.label: obsolete transient disorder of initiating or maintaining sleep
obsolete functional disorder of polymorphonuclear neutrophils
agranulocytosis
diseases.definition: A leukopenia that is characterized by a severe lack of of granulocytes with a drop in granulocyte concentration below 200 cells/mm³ of blood.

diseases.label: conduct disorder
diseases.definition: A specific developmental disorder marked by a pattern of repetitive behavior wherein the rights of others or social norms are violated.

diseases.label: intra-abdominal lymph node mast cell malignancy
obsolete RNA virus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in RNA viruses, which have RNA as their genetic material.

diseases.label: obsolete cryptococcal gastroenteritis
diseases.definition: A cryptococcosis that results_in inflammation located_in stomach and located_in intestine, has_material_basis_in Filobasidiella neoformans and has_symptom gastointestinal bleeding, has_symptom diarrhea and has_symptom abdominal pain.

diseases.label: obsolete pulmonary cryptococcosis
diseases.definition: A cryptococcosis that results_in inflammation located_in lungs, has_material_basis_in Cryptococcus neoformans which results_in_formation_of nodular lesions and results_in_formation_of lobar consolidation in the lungs of the immunocompetent patient and has_symptom cough, has_symptom chest pain and has_symptom difficulty breathing.

diseases.label: obsolete AIDS-related cryptococcosis
diseases.definition: A cryptococcosis that is_a disease associated with AIDS has_material_basis_in Cryptococcus neoformans which results_in a systemic infection in individuals with HIV.

diseases.label: lobomycosis
diseases.definition: A dermatomycosis that results in infection located in skin or located in subcutaneous tissue, has_material_basis_in Lacazia loboi and has symptom crusty plaques, has symptom tumors and results in formation of nodular lesions.

diseases.label: transient global amnesia
diseases.definition: An amnestic disorder that is characterized by temporary but almost total disruption of short-term memory with a range of problems accessing older memories.

diseases.label: obsolete Trichomonas balanoposthitis
diseases.definition: A Trichomonas vaginalis trichomoniasis that involves inflammation of the foreskin and glans in uncircumcised males caused by Trichomonas vaginalis resulting in redness of foreskin or penis, rash on the head of penis, foul-smelling discharge, and painful penis and foreskin.

diseases.label: relapsing fever
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Borrelia, which is transmitted_by tick or transmitted_by body louse.

diseases.label: louse-borne relapsing fever
diseases.definition: A relapsing fever that is characterized by relapsing or recurring episodes of fever, has_material_basis_in Borrelia recurrentis, which is transmitted_by body louse (Pediculus humanus). The infection has_symptom tachypnea, has_symptom tachycardia, has_symptom hepatosplenomegaly and has_symptom lymphadenopathy.

diseases.label: tick-borne relapsing fever
diseases.definition: A relapsing fever that is characterized by relapsing or recurring episodes of fever, has_material_basis_in Borrelia hermsii, has_material_basis_in Borrelia parkeri or has_material_basis_in Borrelia duttoni, which are transmitted_by soft ticks (Ornithodoros parkeri and Ornithodoros hermsii). The infection has_symptom tachypnea, has_symptom tachycardia, has_symptom hepatosplenomegaly and has_symptom lymphadenopathy.

diseases.label: acute sphenoidal sinusitis
diseases.definition: A sphenoid sinusitis which lasts for less than 4 weeks.

diseases.label: obsolete Ancylostoma braziliense ancylostomiasis
diseases.definition: An ancylostomiasis that is characterized by skin manifestations (cutaneous larva migrans) occuring due to migrating larvae of Ancylostoma braziliense in the upper epidermis. It is marked by the presence of erythematous, serpiginous and pruritic cutaneous eruptions.

diseases.label: obsolete Ancylostoma duodenale ancylostomiasis
diseases.definition: An ancylostomiasis that involves parasitic infection of the small intestine in humans, cats and dogs by the nematode Ancylostoma duodenale. The symptoms include abdominal pain, loss of appetite, geophagy and anemia.

diseases.label: obsolete AIDS dementia complex
diseases.definition: A HIV encephalopathy that results_in infection in adults located_in brain, has_material_basis_in Human immunodeficiency virus 1 or has_material_basis_in Human immunodeficiency virus 2. The infection has_symptom cognitive impairment, has_symptom motor dysfunction, has_symptom behavioral change, and has_symptom speech problems.

diseases.label: corpus luteum cyst
diseases.definition: An ovarian cyst that arises from the accumulation of fluid in the follicle after an oocyte has been release.

diseases.label: obsolete HIV encephalopathy
diseases.definition: An acquired immunodeficiency syndrome that results_in infection located_in brain, has_material_basis_in Human immunodeficiency virus 1 or has_material_basis_in Human immunodeficiency virus 2. The infection has_symptom cognitive impairment, has_symptom motor dysfunction, and has_symptom behavioral change.

diseases.label: traumatic glaucoma
diseases.definition: A glaucoma characterized by elevated intraocular pressure secondary to ocular trauma, which leads to glaucomatous optic nerve atrophy and progressive vision loss and has_symptom progressive decreased vision, visual field defects, and decreased peripheral vision.
