diseases.definition: An exostosis that has_material_basis_in a mutation on the genes EXT1, EXT2 and EXT3 which results in multiple bony spurs throughout a child's growth.

diseases.label: vulvar nodular hidradenoma
diseases.definition: A vulvar benign neoplasm that is characterized by nodules with cystic foci high in dermis on gross examination and derives_from the sweat gland distal excretory duct. Histologically characterized by nests or lobules of cells resembling eccrine poroma with either clear cytoplasm or prominent squamous metaplasia and lumina lined by cuboidal ductal cells or columnar secretory cells.

diseases.label: obsolete vulvar tumor of skin appendage origin
vulvar syringoma
diseases.definition: A vulvar benign neoplasm that is characterized by the comma tadpole shaped tail of dilated, cystic eccrine ducts, derives_from the eccrine sweat gland and presents as multiple, small, soft, skin-colored-to-yellowish papules, and has_symptom vulvar discomfort and has_symptom itching.

diseases.label: vulvar angiokeratoma
diseases.definition: A vulvar benign neoplasm that is characterized by numerous ectatic blood vessels present in the superficial dermis.

diseases.label: vulvar squamous tumor
diseases.definition: A vulva cancer that has_material_basis_in squamous tissue.

diseases.label: minor vestibular glands adenoma
diseases.definition: A vestibular gland benign neoplasm that is located_in the minor vestibular glands and is composed_of epithelial tissue in which tumor cells form glands or glandlike structures.

diseases.label: vulvar glandular tumor
diseases.definition: A vulva cancer that has_material_basis_in glandular tissue.

diseases.label: vulvar trichoepithelioma
diseases.definition: A vulvar benign neoplasm that derives_from epithelial-mesenchymal origin cells. It is characterized by branching nests of basaloid cells, horn cysts, and abortive hair papillae. The tumors represent benign hamartomas of the pilosebaceous apparatus.

diseases.label: obsolete constipation
diseases.definition: A bowel dysfunction that is characterized by infrequent or difficult evacuation of feces.

diseases.label: vulvar melanoma
diseases.definition: A vulva cancer that has_material_basis_in melanocytes.

diseases.label: vulvar sarcoma
diseases.definition: A vulva cancer that has_material_basis_in connective tissue.

diseases.label: vulval Paget's disease
diseases.definition: A vulva adenocarcinoma that is characterized by distinctive large cells with prominent cytoplasm, referred to as Paget cells and is an intraepithelial neoplasm of epithelial origin expressing apocrine or eccrine glandular-like features.

diseases.label: vulva adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A vulva carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: heel spur
diseases.definition: An exostosis that results_in an abnormal growth located_in calcaneus.

diseases.label: vulva squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A vulva carcinoma and has_material_basis_in squamous cells and is located_in the epidermis of the vulvar tissue.

diseases.label: myotonia congenita
diseases.definition: A muscle tissue disease that is characterized by slow muscle relaxation associated with hyperexcitation of the muscle fibres.

diseases.label: obsolete transplant-related disease
diseases.definition: An immune system disease that is related to the transplantation of cells, tissues and/or whole organs from one individual to another.

diseases.label: cystoisosporiasis
diseases.definition: A coccidiosis that involves infection of the epithelial cells of the small intestine with Cystoisospora belli, which results in nonbloody diarrhea with crampy abdominal pain, malabsorption and weight loss.

diseases.label: coccidiosis
diseases.definition: A parasitic protozoa infectious disease that occurs in the intestinal tract of animals and humans caused by Coccidia protozoa. Immunocompromised persons are at greater risk of developing the infection.

diseases.label: B cell deficiency
diseases.definition: A primary immunnodeficiency disease that is caused by a lack of infection-fighting antibody producing B cells (immunoglobulins) or B cells that are not functioning properly.

diseases.label: focal dermal hypoplasia
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized at birth by streaks of very thin skin (dermal hypoplasia), cutis aplasia, and telangiectases, and has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the PORCN gene on chromosome Xp11.23.

diseases.label: ectodermal dysplasia
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by abnormal development in 2 or more ectodermal structures (hair, nails, teeth, and sweat glands) without other systemic findings.

diseases.label: pneumonic tularemia
diseases.definition: A tularemia that is located_in lungs. The bacteria are transmitted_by breathing dusts or aerosols containing the organisms. The infection has_symptom cough, has_symptom chest has_symptom pain, and has_symptom difficulty breathing.

diseases.label: tularemia
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that has_material_basis_in Francisella tularensis, which is transmitted by dog tick bite (Dermacentor variabilis), transmitted by deer flies (Chrysops sp) or transmitted by contact with infected animal tissues.

diseases.label: brain germinoma
diseases.definition: A brain cancer that is characterized by abnormally proliferating cells, derives_from germ cells.

diseases.label: atypical teratoid rhabdoid tumor
diseases.definition: A brain cancer that is usually located in the brain, but can occur anywhere in the central nervous system.

diseases.label: obsolete childhood malignant central nervous system neoplasm
brain sarcoma
diseases.definition: A brain cancer that is characterized by abnormally proliferating cells, derives_from embryonic mesoderm.

diseases.label: central nervous system sarcoma
diseases.definition: A central nervous system cancer develops from transformed cells of mesenchymal origin located_in brain and spine, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from mesoderm.

diseases.label: urethra leiomyoma
diseases.definition: An urethral benign neoplasm that derives_from smooth muscle cells.

diseases.label: ovarian malignant mesothelioma
diseases.definition: An ovarian cancer that derives_from mesothelial tissue.

diseases.label: malignant ovarian cyst
diseases.definition: An ovarian cancer that is characterized by cystic structure.

diseases.label: ovary sarcoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from embryonic mesoderm.

diseases.label: tuberculous oophoritis
diseases.definition: An urogenital tuberculosis that results_in inflammtion located_in ovary.

diseases.label: urogenital tuberculosis
diseases.definition: An extrapulmonary tuberculosis that is located_in urogenital system.

diseases.label: ovarian lymphoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian cancer that arises_from lymphocytes.

diseases.label: malignant ovarian surface epithelial-stromal neoplasm
diseases.definition: An ovary epithelial cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial and stromal tissue and arises from the surface epithelium of the ovary.

diseases.label: ovary epithelial cancer
diseases.definition: An ovarian cancer that is derives_from ovarian surface epithelium.

diseases.label: ovarian Wilms' cancer
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm of ovary and nephroblastoma that is located_in the ovaries.

diseases.label: nephroblastoma
diseases.definition: A kidney cancer that affects the kidneys and typically occuring in children.

diseases.label: ovarian germ cell cancer
diseases.definition: An ovarian cancer that originates in the germ (egg) cells of the ovary.

diseases.label: dental caries
diseases.definition: A teeth hard tissue disease that is characterized by damage to a tooth that can happen when decay-causing bacteria in your mouth make acids that attack the tooth’s surface, or enamel.

diseases.label: vaginitis
diseases.definition: A vaginal disease that is characterized by inflammation of the vagina.

diseases.label: ocular cancer
diseases.definition: A sensory system cancer located_in the eye that is characterized by uncontrolled cellular proliferation in the eye.

diseases.label: obsolete complications mainly related to pregnancy
obsolete diabetes mellitus insulin dependent type, uncontrolled, with ophthalmic manifestations
amelogenesis imperfecta
diseases.definition: A dental enamel hypoplasia characterized by abnormal enamel formation.

diseases.label: colon cancer
diseases.definition: A colorectal cancer that is located_in the colon.

diseases.label: acute perichondritis of pinna
diseases.definition: A perichondritis of auricle with a sudden onset and a short course.

diseases.label: factor XIII deficiency
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that is characterized by easy bleeding, has_symptom prolonged umbilical cord bleeding, epistaxis, bleeding of the gums, menorrhagia, recurrent miscarriages, abnormal scar formation and wound healing, and hemarthrosis, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation of the F13A1 or F13B gene, which encodes Factor XIII, formally known as fibrin stabilizing factor.

diseases.label: factor VII deficiency
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that is characterized by easy bleeding, has_symptom epistaxis, bleeding of the gums, menorrhagia, and occasionally hemarthrosis, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the F7 gene, which encodes coagulation factor VII, an important factor in the clotting cascade.

diseases.label: Bernard-Soulier syndrome
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease characterized by autosomal recessive inheritance of mucosal bleeding, purpuric skin bleeding, epistaxis, and menorrhagia with prolonged bleeding times, enlarged platelets and absence of platelet aggregation in response to von Willebrand factor that has_material_basis_in mutation in the GP1BA gene, the GP1BB gene, or the GP9 gene which are subunits of the platelet membrane von Willebrand factor receptor complex, glycoprotein Ib.

diseases.label: blood platelet disease
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that is characterized by an abnormal increase or decrease in platelets or platelet dysfunction.

diseases.label: Glanzmann's thrombasthenia
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease characterized by autosomal recessive inheritance of failure of platelet aggregation and absent or diminished clot retraction that has_material_basis_in mutation in the ITGA2B or ITGB3 genes on chromosome 17q21.32.

diseases.label: perichondritis of auricle
diseases.definition: An otitis externa involving infection of the tissue surrounding the cartilage of the earlobe (pinna), ear canal, or both. It may be caused by injury, burns, insect bites, ear piercing, or a boil on the ear. The common bacterial causative agent is Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Symptoms include redness, pain, fever, swelling of the earlobe and pus accumulation between the cartilage and the layer of connective tissue around it.

diseases.label: factor X deficiency
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that is characterized by the partial or complete absence of factor X activity in the blood.

diseases.label: essential thrombocythemia
diseases.definition: A myeloproliferative neoplasm that is characterized by sustained thrombocytosis in the blood, increased numbers of large, mature megakaryocytes in the bone marrow, and episodes of thrombosis and/or hemorrhage and that results_in the overproduction of platelets.

diseases.label: myeloproliferative neoplasm
diseases.definition: A myeloid neoplasm that is characterized by a group of slow growing blood cancers in which large numbers of abnormal red blood cells, white blood cells, or platelets grow and spread in the bone marrow and the peripheral blood.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant neoplasm of lymphatic and hemopoietic tissue
thrombocytosis
diseases.definition: A blood platelet disease that is characterized by the presence of high platelet counts in the blood.

diseases.label: factor XI deficiency
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that is characterized by deficiency of factor XI clotting factor and mild prolonged bleeding, especially of mucosal sites following trauma, and has_material_basis_in homozygous, compound heterozygous, or heterozygous mutation of the coagulation factor XI gene of chromosome 4q35.2.

diseases.label: factor XII deficiency
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that is characterized by prolonged PTT time without clinical symptoms, and has_material_basis_in a mutation in the F12 gene on chromosome 5q33.

diseases.label: obsolete partial epilepsy with impairment of consciousness
focal epilepsy
diseases.definition: An epilepsy syndrome that is characterized by seizures that are preceded by an isolated disturbance of a cerebral function and arise from an epileptic focus, a small portion of the brain that serves as the irritant driving the epileptic response.

diseases.label: prothrombin deficiency
diseases.definition: A thrombophilia that is characterized by bleeding symptoms due to low levels of circulating prothrombin, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the gene encoding coagulation factor II, also known as prothrombin, on chromosome 11p11.

diseases.label: congenital afibrinogenemia
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that is characterized by an impaired blood clotting resulting from a lack deficiency of a the fibrinogen protein (coagulation factor I).

diseases.label: transient cerebral ischemia
diseases.definition: A brain ischemia that is characterized by ischemia of brief duration and without resultant tissue death.

diseases.label: spondylosis
diseases.definition: A bone structure disease that involves degeneration between vertebra located_in vertebral column.

diseases.label: syndrome
diseases.definition: A disease characterized by a group of signs and symptoms that occur together and characterize a particular abnormality.

diseases.label: cervix disease
diseases.definition: An uterine disease that is located_in the cervix.

diseases.label: osteochondrodysplasia
diseases.definition: A bone development disease that results_in defective development of cartilage or bone.

diseases.label: ankylosis
diseases.definition: An arthropathy where there is a stiffness of a joint, the result of injury or disease. The rigidity may be complete or partial and may be due to inflammation of the tendinous or muscular structures outside the joint or of the tissues of the joint itself.

diseases.label: obsolete oropharyngeal candidiasis
diseases.definition: A candidiasis that involves fungal infection of the oropharynx in immunocompromised patients caused by Candida species resulting in formation of white plaques on the buccal mucosa, tongue, gums, palate, or pharynx. The symptoms include burning or dryness of the mouth, loss of taste, and pain on swallowing.

diseases.label: vulvovaginal candidiasis
diseases.definition: A candidiasis that involves fungal infection of the vaginal mucous membranes in women caused by Candida albicans. The symptoms include intense vulval pruritus, burning, erythema and dyspareunia associated with a creamy white, curd-like discharge.

diseases.label: vulvovaginitis
diseases.definition: A female reproductive system disease that is characterized by inflammation of the vagina and vulva.

diseases.label: pharyngitis
diseases.definition: An upper respiratory tract disease involving inflammation of the throat or pharynx resulting from bacterial, viral, fungal infections or irritants like pollutants or chemical substances and smoking. The infection is often referred to as sore throat. The symptoms include pain during swallowing, enlarged tonsils coated with a white discharge, runny nose, cough and slight fever.

diseases.label: gonadal disease
diseases.definition: An endocrine system disease that is located_in the gonads.

diseases.label: hidradenitis suppurativa
diseases.definition: A hidradenitis that is characterized by chronic inflammation of the apocrine sweat glands, has_symptom painful nodules, abscesses, sinus tract formation, scarring, erythema, pruritis, and pain, and has_material_basis_in chronic inflammation of the apocrine sweat glands leading to recurrent folliculitis and an accompanying immune response that worsens inflammation.

diseases.label: hidradenitis
diseases.definition: A sweat gland disease that is characterized by inflammation of the apocrine sweat glands and has_symptom erythema, edema, papules, plaques, pruritis, and pain.

diseases.label: female reproductive system disease
diseases.definition: A reproductive system disease that impairs the ability to reproduce and is located in the uterus, vagina, cervix, ovaries or fallopian tubes.

diseases.label: leptospirosis
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that involves systemic infection, has_material_basis_in Leptospira, which is transmitted by contact with water, food, or soil containing urine from the infected animals. The infection has symptom jaundice, has symptom chills, has symptom fever, has symptom muscle pain, and has symptom hepatomegaly.

diseases.label: lateral sclerosis
diseases.definition: A motor neuron disease characterized by painless but progressive weakness and stiffness of the muscles of the legs.

diseases.label: spondylolysis
diseases.definition: A bone structure disease that involves a defect located_in lumbar vertebral column.

diseases.label: stereotypic movement disorder
diseases.definition: A specific developmental disorder that is characterized by repeated, rhythmic, purposeless movements or activities such as head banging, nail biting, or body rocking.

diseases.label: motor neuron disease
diseases.definition: A neurodegenerative disease that is located_in the motor neurons.

diseases.label: nocardiosis
diseases.definition: An opportunistic bacterial infectious disease that results_in disseminated infection in immunocompromised hosts, has_material_basis_in Nocardia asteroides. The infection has_symptom pneumonia, has_symptom cellulitis, has_symptom lesions in the brain or meninges, and has_symptom ascending regional lymphadenopathy.

diseases.label: malt worker's lung
diseases.definition: An extrinsic allergic alveolitis which is caused by inhalation of fungal spores of Aspergillus clavatus and Aspergillus fumigatus from moldy barley.

diseases.label: brain ischemia
diseases.definition: An ischemia that is characterized by insufficient blood flow to the brain to meet metabolic demand.

diseases.label: obstructive lung disease
diseases.definition: A lung disease that is characterized by narrowing of pulmonary airways.

diseases.label: obsolete coxsackie meningitis
diseases.definition: An Enterovirus infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in meningeal cluster, has_material_basis_in Human enterovirus B, which is transmitted_by ingestion of food contaminated with feces, transmitted_by contact with pharyngeal secretions, or transmitted_by droplet spread of oronasal secretions. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom chills, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom headache, and has_symptom neck pain.

diseases.label: gastroenteritis
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system infectious disease that involves inflammation of the lining of the stomach and small and large intestines, which is caused by viruses, bacteria, or parasites. Chemicals and drugs also cause gastroenteritis. The symptoms include diarrhea, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, cramps, and discomfort in the abdomen.

diseases.label: viral gastritis
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system infectious disease that involves inflammation of the stomach lining caused by viruses. The symptoms include abdominal pain, indigestion, ulcer formation, abdominal bloating, nausea and vomiting.

diseases.label: obsolete astrovirus gastroenteritis
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in stomach and located_in intestine, has_material_basis_in Human astrovirus, which is transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food. The infection has_symptom watery diarrhea, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom vomiting, and has_symptom fever.

diseases.label: obsolete Rotavirus gastroenteritis
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in stomach and located_in intestine, has_material_basis_in Rotavirus, which is transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food or water, or transmitted_by fomites. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom diarrhea, and has_symptom abdominal pain.

diseases.label: obsolete metastatic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that is able to grow at sites distant from the primary site of origin.

diseases.label: mandibular cancer
diseases.definition: A jaw cancer and mandibular disease that affects your lower jawbone.

diseases.label: Crouzon syndrome
diseases.definition: A craniosynostosis that involves premature fusion of certain skull bones. This early fusion prevents the skull from growing normally and affects the shape of the head and face. The disease is associated with mutations in the FGFR2 gene.

diseases.label: colon adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A colon carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: craniosynostosis
diseases.definition: A synostosis that results_in premature fusion located_in skull.

diseases.label: plasma protein metabolism disease
diseases.definition: An inherited metabolic disorder that involves plasma protein metabolism malfunction.

diseases.label: arteriosclerosis
diseases.definition: An artery disease that is characterized by a thickening and hardening of arterial walls in the arteries.

diseases.label: colonic benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: An intestinal benign neoplasm that is located_in the colon.

diseases.label: hemochromatosis
diseases.definition: A metal metabolism disorder characterized by the accumulation of iron in various organs of the body.

diseases.label: myelophthisic anemia
diseases.definition: An aplastic anemia that is characterized by displacement of hemopoietic bone-marrow tissue either by fibrosis, tumors or granulomas.

diseases.label: anemia
diseases.definition: A hematopoietic system disease that is characterized by a decrease in the normal number of red blood cells.

diseases.label: macrocytic anemia
diseases.definition: An anemia that is characterized by the production of abnormally large red blood cells and mean corpuscular volume (MCV) (more than 100 fL).

diseases.label: post-thrombotic syndrome
diseases.definition: A venous insufficiency that is characterized by aching pain, heaviness, swelling, cramps, itching, or tingling in the affected limb and is a chronic complication of deep venous thrombosis.

diseases.label: West Nile encephalitis
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results in inflammation located in brain, has_material_basis_in West Nile virus, which is transmitted_by Culex, Aedes, or Anopheles species of mosquitoes. The infection has_symptom high fever, has_symptom headache, has_symptom neck stiffness, has_symptom stupor, has_symptom disorientation, has_symptom coma, has_symptom tremors, has_symptom convulsions, has_symptom muscle weakness, has_symptom vision loss, has_symptom numbness, and has_symptom paralysis.

diseases.label: West Nile fever
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in West Nile virus, which is transmitted_by Culex and transmitted_by Aedes mosquitoes. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom sore throat, has_symptom headache, has_symptom body ache, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom maculopapular rash and has_symptom vomiting.

diseases.label: gangliosidosis
diseases.definition: A sphingolipidosis that is characterized by the accumulation of lipids known as gangliosides.

diseases.label: obsolete diabetes mellitus insulin dependent type not stated as uncontrolled with renal manifestations
obsolete adhesions and disruptions of iris and ciliary body
hereditary elliptocytosis
diseases.definition: A hematopoietic system disease characterized by oval or elliptical red blood cells, slight or absent hemolysis with little or no anemia; splenomegaly is often present.

diseases.label: multiple sclerosis
diseases.definition: A demyelinating disease that involves damage to the fatty myelin sheaths around the axons of the brain and spinal cord resulting in demyelination and scarring.

diseases.label: relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis
diseases.definition: A multiple sclerosis that is characterized by relapse (attacks of symptom flare-ups) followed by remission (periods of recovery). Symptoms may vary from mild to severe, and relapses and remissions may last for days or months. More than 80 percent of people who have MS begin with relapsing-remitting cycles.

diseases.label: obsolete Vibrio cholerae O1 biovar El Tor cholera
diseases.definition: A cholera that involves infection of the intestine caused by Vibrio cholerae serogroup O1 biovar El Tor.

diseases.label: kernicterus
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by hyperbilirubinemia-induced brain dysfunction.

diseases.label: neonatal jaundice
diseases.definition: A pigmentation disease characterized by a high level of bilirubin in the blood, causing a yellowing of the skin and other tissues of a newborn infant.

diseases.label: Wernicke encephalopathy
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by the presence of neurological symptoms of ophthalmoplegia, ataxia, and confusion caused by biochemical lesions of the central nervous system after exhaustion of B-vitamin reserves, in particular thiamine (vitamin B1).

diseases.label: ovarian cancer
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ cancer that is located_in the ovary.

diseases.label: clitoris cancer
diseases.definition: A vulva cancer that is located_in the clitoris.

diseases.label: rhinosporidiosis
diseases.definition: A parasitic Ichthyosporea infectious disease that is a chronic granulomatous infection of the mucous membranes caused by the parasite Rhinosporidium seeberi, which manifests as vascular friable polyps that arise from the nasal mucosa or external structures of the eye. Disease of the skin, mouth, upper airways, ear, genitals, and rectum has also been observed.

diseases.label: obsolete skin tumor of neural origin
obsolete epithelioid and spindle cell nevus
gangliocytoma
diseases.definition: A central nervous system benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in mature neurons, and is classified by the absence of neoplastic glial cells.

diseases.label: glomus tumor
diseases.definition: A hemangiopericytic tumor that is a mesenchymal neoplasm composed of cells that closely resemble the modified smooth muscle cells of the normal glomus body.

diseases.label: glomangioma
diseases.definition: A benign perivascular tumor that is a morphologic variant of the glomus tumor characterized by the presence of dilated veins, surrounded by small clusters of glomus cells. Glomangiomas are most often present in patients with multiple lesions.

diseases.label: frontal sinus squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that is located_in the frontal sinus.

diseases.label: acromegaly
diseases.definition: A disease of metabolism that has_material_basis_in excessive growth hormone production which results_in enlargement located_in limb.

diseases.label: protein S deficiency
diseases.definition: A thrombophilia that is characterized by increased risk of developing abnormal blood clots.

diseases.label: thrombophilia
diseases.definition: A blood coagulation disease that is characterized by an increased tendency to form clots.

diseases.label: angular blepharoconjunctivitis
diseases.definition: A blepharoconjunctivitis that is characterized by fissuring, scaling, maceration and erythema of the lateral or medial canthal area.

diseases.label: blepharoconjunctivitis
diseases.definition: A blepharitis that is characterized by the dual combination of conjunctivitis with blepharitis.

diseases.label: psychotic disorder
diseases.definition: A cognitive disorder that involves abnormal thinking and perceptions resulting in a disconnection with reality.

diseases.label: opportunistic mycosis
diseases.definition: A systemic mycosis that results_in fungal infection located_in human body of immunocompromised individuals, has_material_basis_in Fungi. The organisms invade via the respiratory tract, alimentary tract, or intravascular devices.

diseases.label: hereditary spastic paraplegia
diseases.definition: A paraplegia that is characterized by progressive stiffness and contraction (spasticity) in the lower limbs.

diseases.label: motor peripheral neuropathy
diseases.definition: A neuropathy that is characterized by inflammation or degeneration of the peripheral motor nerves.

diseases.label: central nervous system origin vertigo
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by vertigo caused by hemorrhagic insult, ischemic insult or mass lesion of the cerebellum, the vestibular nuclei, and the brainstem, has_symptom dizziness, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom vomiting and has_symptom difficulty walking.

diseases.label: trachea leiomyoma
diseases.definition: A respiratory system benign neoplasm that derives_from smooth muscle cells and is located_in the trachea.

diseases.label: sensory peripheral neuropathy
diseases.definition: A neuropathy that involves damage to nerves of the peripheral nervous system.

diseases.label: angiodysplasia
diseases.definition: A vascular disease that is characterized as a small vascular malformation of the gut.

diseases.label: obsolete AIDS-related vulvovaginal candidiasis
diseases.definition: A vulvovaginal candidiasis that involves fungal infection of the vaginal mucous membranes by Candida albicans in AIDS patients.

diseases.label: Takayasu's arteritis
diseases.definition: A vasculitis that involves inflammation of the aorta that carries blood from the heart to the rest of the body.

diseases.label: Kluver-Bucy syndrome
diseases.definition: An impulse control disorder that involves abnormalities in memory, social and sexual functioning and idiosyncratic behaviors resulting from damage from trauma or infection to both temporal lobes causing individuals to put objects in their mouths and engage in inappropriate sexual behavior.

diseases.label: nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by multiple early-onset basal cell carcinoma, multiple jaw keratocysts and skeletal abnormalities.

diseases.label: basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A skin carcinoma affecting basal cells.

diseases.label: alcoholic psychosis
diseases.definition: An alcohol-induced mental disorder involving prominent hallucinations and delusions occurring during or shortly after acute alcohol intoxication or withdrawal.

diseases.label: obsolete abnormal glucose tolerance in mother complicating pregnancy childbirth and/or puerperium
prostate adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A prostate carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: nephrosis
diseases.definition: A proteinuria that is characterized by the leaking of blood protein into the urine, swelling or edema, and degenerative lesions without inflammation.

diseases.label: obsolete myeloid metaplasia
diseases.definition: A myeloma and spenic disease that is located_in the bone marrow that results_in the marrow being replaced by fibrous (scar) tissue and has_symptom abdominal fullness related to an enlarged spleen, has_symptom bone pain, has_symptom bruising, has_symptom easy bleeding, has_symptom fatigue, has_symptom increased susceptibility to infection, has_symptom pallor, has_symtom shortness of breath while doing physical work.

diseases.label: hematologic cancer
diseases.definition: An organ system cancer located in the hematological system that is characterized by uncontrolled cellular proliferation in blood, bone marrow and lymph nodes.

diseases.label: inflammatory and toxic neuropathy
diseases.definition: A neuropathy that is caused by drug ingestion, drug or chemical abuse, or industrial chemical exposure from the workplace or the environment.

diseases.label: Landau-Kleffner syndrome
diseases.definition: A childhood electroclinical syndrome that is characterized by the loss of language comprehension (auditory verbal agnosia) and verbal expression (aphasia) in association with severely abnormal electroencephalographic (EEG) findings during sleep and clinical seizures in most patients.

diseases.label: extratemporal epilepsy
diseases.definition: An epilepsy syndrome that is located_in an area of the brain other than the temporal lobe.

diseases.label: reflex epilepsy
diseases.definition: A variable age at onset electroclinical syndrome that is consistently induced by identifiable and objective-specific triggers, which may be an afferent stimulus or by the patient's own activity.

diseases.label: hemangioma
diseases.definition: A cardiovascular organ benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in endothelial cells that line blood vessels and is characterized by increased number of normal or abnormal vessels filled with blood.

diseases.label: relapsing polychondritis

diseases.label: Bloom syndrome

diseases.label: hemopneumothorax

diseases.label: hepatic vascular disease

diseases.label: dyskeratosis congenita

diseases.label: epidermolysis bullosa
diseases.definition: A vesiculobullous skin disease that is characterized by formation of blisters with only minor skin trauma, which can cause widespread wounds, dehydration, electrolyte abnormalities, and severe infection, frequently develops_from mutations in connective tissue elements, including genes encoding keratin, collagen, and laminin.

diseases.label: vesiculobullous skin disease
diseases.definition: A bullous skin disease that is characterized by fluid filled blisters.

diseases.label: Rothmund-Thomson syndrome
diseases.definition: A skin disease characterized by poikiloderma, congenital bone defects, and an increased risk of osteosarcoma in childhood and skin cancer later in life that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the DNA helicase gene RECQL4 on chromosome 8q24.

diseases.label: Hajdu-Cheney syndrome
diseases.definition: A bone disease characterized by short stature, coarse and dysmorphic facies, bowing of the long bones, and vertebral anomalies that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the NOTCH2 gene on chromosome 1p12.

diseases.label: pseudoxanthoma elasticum
diseases.definition: A connective tissue disease that is characterized by the accumulation of deposits of calcium and other minerals in elastic fibers, which are a component of connective tissue, this can result in changes in the skin, eyes, cardiovascular system and gastrointestinal system.

diseases.label: Gilbert syndrome
diseases.definition: A bilirubin metabolic disorder that involves elevated levels of unconjugated bilirubin as bilirubin is not being conjugated as a result of reduced glucuronyltransferase activity.

diseases.label: bilirubin metabolic disorder
diseases.definition: An inherited metabolic disorder that involves elevated levels of bilirubin resulting from disruption of bilirubin metabolism.

diseases.label: auditory system disease
diseases.definition: A sensory system disease that is characterized by auditory dysfunction located_in the auditory system.

diseases.label: narcissistic personality disorder
diseases.definition: A personality disorder that involves an excessive preoccupation with issues of personal adequacy, power, prestige and vanity.

diseases.label: glycogen storage disease V
diseases.definition: A glycogen storage disease that is characterized by onset of exercise intolerance and muscle cramps in childhood or adolescence and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the PYGM gene, which encodes muscle glycogen phosphorylase, on chromosome 11q13.

diseases.label: glycogen storage disease
diseases.definition: A glycogen metabolism disorder that has_material_basis_in enzymes deficiencies necessary in the processing of glycogen synthesis or breakdown within muscles, liver, and other cell types.

diseases.label: glycogen storage disease III
diseases.definition: A glycogen storage disease that is characterized by an accumulation of abnormal glycogen with short outer chains and that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the AGL gene, which encodes the glycogen debrancher enzyme, on chromosome 1p21.

diseases.label: glycogen storage disease Ia
diseases.definition: A glycogen storage disease I that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the G6PC gene, which encodes glucose-6-phosphatase (G6Pase), on chromosome 17q21.

diseases.label: glycogen storage disease IV
diseases.definition: A glycogen storage disease that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the GBE1 gene, which encodes the glycogen branching enzyme, on chromosome 3p12.

diseases.label: glycogen storage disease VIII
diseases.definition: A glycogen storage disease that is characterized hepatomegaly, increased liver glycogen, and decreased leukocyte phosphorylase and results from the lack of expression of phosphorylase-b-kinase activity.

diseases.label: glycogen storage disease II
diseases.definition: A glycogen storage disease that has_material_basis_in deficiency of the lysosomal acid alpha-glucosidase enzyme resulting in damage to muscle and nerve cells due to an accumulation of glycogen in the lysosome.

diseases.label: obsolete nervous system lysosomal storage disease
glycogen storage disease VI

diseases.label: Mycobacterium avium complex disease

The bacteria cause disseminated infection in HIV infected people, while pulmonary disease in immunocompetent persons.

diseases.label: bone carcinoma

diseases.label: ethmoid sinus squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that is located_in the ethmoid sinus.

diseases.definition: An ethmoid sinus cancer that derives from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.definition: A tic disorder that consists of multiple motor and/or phonic tics with duration of at least 4 weeks, but less than 12 months.

diseases.label: obsolete atopic dermatitis and related conditions
irritant dermatitis
diseases.definition: A contact dermatitis that is characterized by a cutaneous inflammatory reaction to repeated contact with an irritant substance, friction, liquid, or adverse temperature that interacts with the skin and often has_symptom erythema, edema, scaling, pain, pruritis, or burning sensation.

diseases.label: long bone adamantinoma
diseases.definition: An adamantinoma that is located_in the long bones and results_in focal epithelial differentiation.

diseases.label: adamantinoma
diseases.definition: A bone cancer that is located_in almost exclusively in the long bones.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant neoplasm of short bones of upper limb

diseases.label: Dandy-Walker syndrome

diseases.label: obsolete Ciliophora infectious disease

diseases.definition: A parasitic infectious disease that is caused by parasitic protozoa which are microorganisms classified as unicellular eukaryotes.

diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves infection of the small intestine of humans, dogs and cats by the nematode Necator americanus causing abdominal pain, diarrhea, cramps, weight loss and anemia. diseases.label: obsolete hookworm infectious disease

diseases.label: idiopathic interstitial pneumonia

diseases.label: endocrine system disease
diseases.definition: A disease of anatomical entity that is located_in endocrine glands which secretes a type of hormone directly into the bloodstream to regulate the body.

diseases.definition: A idiopathic interstitial pneumonia which develops suddenly and is severe. Initially, the lung shows edema, hyaline membranes, and interstitial acute inflammation. Later, it develops loose organizing fibrosis, mostly within alveolar septa and type II pneumocyte hyperplasia. Fever, cough, and difficulty breathing develop over 1 to 2 weeks, typically progressing to acute respiratory failure.

diseases.label: nonspecific interstitial pneumonia
diseases.definition: An idiopathic interstitial pneumonia that occurs mainly in women, people who do not smoke, and people younger than 50 years with no known cause or risk factors. Lung biopsies may show predominantly interstitial inflammation or fibrosis or a combination of inflammation and fibrosis. A dry cough and shortness of breath develop over 6 to 18 months. Low-grade fever and a feeling of illness (malaise) may occur.

diseases.definition: A lung disease that is defined as a recurrent or chronic collapse of the right middle lobe, right upper lobe or lingula of the lung. diseases.label: bruxism

diseases.definition: A larynx cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from embryonic mesoderm.

diseases.label: endometriosis of uterus

diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection, located_in lungs or located_in kidney, has_material_basis_in Hantavirus, which is transmitted_by rodents. The infection has_symptom renal failure, has_symptom hemorrhagic manifestations, and has_symptom pulmonary edema.

diseases.label: obsolete Cysts of iris, ciliary body and anterior chamber
prostatic adenoma
diseases.definition: A male reproductive organ benign neoplasm that derives_from glandular epithelial cells and that is located_in the prostate.

diseases.label: prostate leiomyoma
diseases.definition: A male reproductive organ benign neoplasm that derives_from smooth muscle cells and that is located_in the prostate.

diseases.label: endometriosis
diseases.definition: A female reproductive system disease characterized by the growth of endometrial tissue outside the uterine body.

diseases.label: thyroid adenoma
diseases.definition: An endocrine organ benign neoplasm that is located_in the thyroid and derives_from glandular epithelial cells.

diseases.label: exocervical carcinoma
diseases.definition: A cervix carcinoma that is located_in the exocervix.

diseases.label: immune system disease
diseases.definition: A disease of anatomical entity that is located_in the immune system.

diseases.label: obsolete paraproteinemia
diseases.definition: A hypersensitivity reaction type IV disease that results from the presence of excessive amounts of a single monoclonal gammaglobulin in the blood.

diseases.label: glomerulonephritis
diseases.definition: A nephritis that causes inflammation of the glomeruli located_in kidney.

diseases.label: Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by large cutaneous hemangiomata with hypertrophy of the related bones and soft tissues.

diseases.label: Newcastle disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in birds and humans, has_material_basis_in Avian orthoavulavirus 1, which is transmitted_by contact with feces and urine of an infected bird, or transmitted_by fomites. diseases.label: obsolete Avulavirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Paramyxoviridae infectious disease that results_in infection in birds and rarely humans, has_material_basis_in Avulavirus, which is transmitted_by direct contact with droppings and secretions from the nose, mouth, and eyes.

diseases.label: Chediak-Higashi syndrome

diseases.label: obsolete Parvoviridae infectious disease

diseases.label: obsolete Human herpesvirus 8 infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Herpesviridae infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Human herpesvirus 8.

diseases.label: Epstein-Barr virus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that has_material_basis_in Human gammaherpesvirus 4.

diseases.label: obsolete Herpesviridae infectious disease

diseases.label: obsolete Poxviridae infectious disease
diseases.definition: A dsDNA virus infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Poxviridae viruses.

diseases.label: severe acute respiratory syndrome
diseases.definition: A Coronavirus infectious disease that results_in infection located_in respiratory tract, has_material_basis_in SARS coronavirus (SARS-CoV), which is transmitted_by droplet spread of respiratory secretions, transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food, or transmitted_by fomites. diseases.label: obsolete coronavirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Coronaviridae infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in coronaviruses, which are transmitted_by droplet spread of respiratory secretions or transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food.

diseases.label: obsolete Yellow fever virus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Flavivirus infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Yellow fever virus, which is transmitted_by mosquito bites. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom severe headache, has_symptom back pain, has_symptom muscle ache, has_symptom nausea, and has_symptom weakness.

diseases.label: obsolete Coronaviridae infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Nidovirales infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Coronaviridae viruses, which is transmitted_by droplet spread of respiratory secretions or transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food.

diseases.label: obsolete Nidovirales infectious disease
diseases.definition: A (+)ssRNA virus infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Nidovirales viruses.

diseases.label: eye carcinoma
diseases.definition: An ocular cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells, derives_from epithelial cells and arises_from the tissues that cover structures located_in the eye.

diseases.label: obsolete Orbivirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Reoviridae infectious disease that results_in infection in vertebrates, has_material_basis_in Orbivirus, which is transmitted_by mosquitoes, transmitted_by midges, transmitted_by gnats, transmitted_by sandflies, and transmitted_by ticks.

diseases.label: inner ear disease
diseases.definition: An auditory system disease that is located in the part of the ear that contains organs of the senses of hearing and equilibrium.

diseases.label: pulmonary tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A tuberculosis that is a contagious disease located_in lungs. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom cough, has_symptom difficulty in breathing, has_symptom inflammatory infiltrations, has_symptom formation of tubercles, has_symptom caseation, has_symptom pleural effusion, and has_symptom fibrosis.

diseases.label: hyperimmunoglobulin syndrome
diseases.definition: A B cell deficiency that is characterized by relative predominance of certain immunoglobulin subtypes and deficiencies of others.

diseases.label: photosensitive trichothiodystrophy
diseases.definition: A trichothiodystrophy characterized by skin that is extremely sensitive to ultraviolet (UV) rays from sunlight.

diseases.label: obsolete DNA repair deficiency
diseases.definition: A monogenic disease that results from a reduced functionality of DNA repair.

diseases.label: Cockayne syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by an abnormally small head size (microcephaly), a failure to gain weight and grow at the expected rate (failure to thrive) leading to very short stature, and delayed development.

diseases.label: kidney cortex necrosis
diseases.definition: A kidney cortex disease that is characterized by death of the tissue in the outer part of the kidney that results from blockage of the small arteries that supply blood to the cortex and that causes acute kidney injury.

diseases.label: primary hyperoxaluria
diseases.definition: A carbohydrate metabolic disorder characterized by impaired glyoxylate metabolism resulting in accumulation of oxalate throughout the body typically manifesting as kidney and bladder stones.

diseases.label: carbohydrate metabolic disorder
diseases.definition: An inherited metabolic disorder that affect the catabolism and anabolism of carbohydrates.

diseases.label: lacrimal gland adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A lacrimal gland carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: obsolete chronic rejection of renal transplant
IgA glomerulonephritis
diseases.definition: A glomerulonephritis characterized by build up of IgA antibody in the glomerulus.

diseases.label: familial Mediterranean fever
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease characterized by recurrent episodes of fever and acute inflammation of the membranes lining the abdomen, joints and lungs; that has_material_basis_in mutations in the MEFV gene, which encodes the protein pyrin.

diseases.label: antiphospholipid syndrome
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is characterized by recurrent venous or arterial thrombosis and/or fetal losses associated with characteristic elevated levels of antibodies directed against membrane anionic phospholipids (anticardiolipin).

diseases.label: obsolete Atypical small acinar proliferation of the prostate gland
adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells, derives_from epithelial cells, which originate in glandular tissue.

diseases.label: obsolete tumor of specialized prostatic stroma
germ cell cancer
diseases.definition: A cell type cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from germ cells.

diseases.label: obsolete ovarian mixed germ cell-sex cord neoplasm
Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor
diseases.definition: A sex cord-gonadal stromal tumor characterized by variable proportions of Sertoli cells, Leydig cells, primitive gonadal stroma and/or heterologous elements located_in the ovaries and testicles.

diseases.label: testicular cancer
diseases.definition: A male reproductive system cancer that is located_in the testicles.

diseases.label: granulosa cell tumor
diseases.definition: A sex cord-gonadal stromal tumor that has_material_basis_in granulosa cells and arises from the sex cord stroma.

diseases.label: obsolete disease by environmental exposure
diseases.definition: A disease that has an etiology of chemical exposure or exposure to other environmental factors excluding infectious agents.

diseases.label: female reproductive endometrioid cancer
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ cancer that is characterized by a resemblance to endometrium.

diseases.label: ovary neuroendocrine neoplasm
diseases.definition: An ovarian cancer that has_material_basis_in nuroendocrine cells.

diseases.label: nipple benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A breast benign neoplasm that is located_in the nipple.

diseases.label: breast myoepithelial neoplasm
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that arises from myoepithelial cells, which are a normal constituent of the salivary acini and ducts and are found between the epithelial cells and the basement membrane.

diseases.label: breast ductal carcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast carcinoma that derives_from the lining of milk ducts.

diseases.label: invasive ductal carcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast ductal carcinoma that is characterized by infiltration into the fibrous or fatty tissue of the breast outside of the duct where it originated.

diseases.label: breast neuroendocrine neoplasm
diseases.definition: A breast benign neoplasm that forms from cells that release hormones into the blood in response to a signal from the nervous system.

diseases.label: lobular neoplasia
diseases.definition: A breast carcinoma in situ that is characterized by abnormal cells are found in the lobules (glands that make milk) of the breast.

diseases.label: breast granular cell tumor
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that is believed to arises_from Schwann cells.

diseases.label: Li-Fraumeni syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by autosomal dominant inheritance of increased risk of developing several types of cancer, including breast cancer, osteosarcomata and soft tissue sarcomata.

diseases.label: intraductal breast benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A breast benign neoplasm that is located_in the breast ducts.

diseases.label: breast malignant phyllodes tumor
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that is characterized by a prominent infiltrative border, unequivocal sarcomatous areas, and stromal overgrowth and arises_from the stroma, lined by an epithelial and myoepithelial bilayer, forming a leaflike structure. They tend to grow rapidly and present in middle-aged women (40s-50s).

diseases.label: breast sarcoma
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from mesenchymal cells.

diseases.label: substance abuse
diseases.definition: A substance-related disorder that involves a maladaptive pattern of substance use leading to significant impairment in functioning.

diseases.label: obsolete Complication of labor and/or delivery
acinar cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells, derives_from spindle cells and/or derives_from giant cells.

diseases.label: substance-related disorder
diseases.definition: A disease of mental health involving the abuse or dependence on a substance that is ingested in order to produce a high, alter one's senses, or otherwise affect functioning.

diseases.label: mucinous adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, which produce mucin.

diseases.label: cecum adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A cecum carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: allergic contact dermatitis
diseases.definition: A contact dermatitis that is an allergic skin reaction to foreign chemical or substances leading to red, itchy, weepy reaction where the skin has come into contact with a substance that the immune system recognizes as foreign.

diseases.label: food allergy
diseases.definition: A hypersensitivity reaction type I disease that is an abnormal response to a food, triggered by the body's immune system.

diseases.label: Wissler-Fanconi syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by true sepsis, acute rheumatic fever, rheumatoid arthritis, and adult onset Still’s disease.

diseases.label: Churg-Strauss syndrome
diseases.definition: A vasculitits that is systemic vasculitis realized as blood vessel inflammation and has_symptom asthma along with hay fever, rash and gastrointestinal bleeding.

diseases.label: carcinoma
diseases.definition: A cell type cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: Balkan nephropathy
diseases.definition: An interstitial nephritis endemic to the regions along the Danube river, in the modern countries of Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Romania and Bulgaria.

diseases.label: paratyphoid fever
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that results_in infection located_in intestine, has_material_basis_in Salmonella enterica subsp enterica serovar Paratyphi A, B or C, which are transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom headache, has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom malaise, has_symptom anorexia, has_symptom constipation, has_symptom rosy spots on the central body, has_symptom non productive cough (in early stage of illness), has_symptom bradycardia, and has_symptom hepatosplenomegaly.

diseases.label: obsolete Paramyxoviridae infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Mononegavirales infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Paramyxoviridae viruses.

diseases.label: glioblastoma
diseases.definition: A malignant astrocytoma characterized by the presence of small areas of necrotizing tissue that is surrounded by anaplastic cells as well as the presence of hyperplastic blood vessels, and that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from multiple cell types including astrocytes and oligondroctyes.

diseases.label: malignant astrocytoma
diseases.definition: A malignant glioma that is has_material_basis_in astrocyte cells, a type of star-shaped glial cell, located in the brain and spinal cord.

diseases.label: high grade glioma
diseases.definition: A cell type cancer that has_material_basis_in glial cells and is located in brain or located in spine.

diseases.label: gliosarcoma
diseases.definition: A gliomablastoma that is characterized by a biphasic tissue pattern with alternating areas displaying glial and mesenchymal differentiation.

diseases.label: brain glioblastoma multiforme
diseases.definition: A brain glioma that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from glial cells, has_symptom seizure, headaches, nausea and vomiting, memory loss, changes to personality, mood or concentration; and localized neurological problems.

diseases.label: giant cell glioblastoma
diseases.definition: A glioblastoma that is characterized by a prevalence of bizarre, multinucleated giant cells.

diseases.label: adult astrocytic tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant astrocytoma that occurs during adulthood.

diseases.label: anaplastic astrocytoma
diseases.definition: A malignant astrocytoma that is characterized by cells with regular, round to oval nuclei.

diseases.label: interstitial lung disease
diseases.definition: A lung disease that is characterized by inflammation and altered lung interstitium compromising pulmonary function and often has_symptom shortness of breath, dyspnea, and/or cough.

diseases.label: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
diseases.definition: An obstructive lung disease that is a chronic and progressive disorder of small airways in the lungs and that is characterized by irreversible airflow obstruction, typically identified by reductions in quantitative spirometric indices, induced forced expiratory volume at 1 second (FEV1) and the ratio of FEV1 to forced vital capacity (less than 0.7 is diagnostic of COPD). Lung volume is increased and pulmonary hypertension may occur. The pathologic changes result in the disruption of the airflow in the bronchial airways. Signs and symptoms include shortness of breath, wheezing, productive cough and chest tightness. COPD is a consequence (an end result) of chronic bronchitis, emphysema or both.

diseases.label: Acinetobacter infectious disease
diseases.definition: An opportunistic bacterial infectious disease that has_material_basis_in Acinetobacter.

diseases.label: nervous system cancer
diseases.definition: An organ system cancer located_in the nervous system that affects the central or peripheral nervous system.

diseases.label: germ cell and embryonal cancer
diseases.definition: A germ cell cancer that is derives_from a mixture of germs cells and embryonal cells.

diseases.label: obsolete stenosis and insufficiency of lacrimal passage
small cell sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma characterized by the presence of small round or elongated malignant cells with a small amount of cytoplasm.

diseases.label: thoracic outlet syndrome
diseases.definition: A vascular disease that is characterized by compression at the superior thoracic outlet[1] resulting from excess pressure placed on a neurovascular bundle passing between the anterior scalene and middle scalene muscles.

diseases.label: obsolete Nematoda infectious disease
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves infection by parasitic roundworms including ascarids, filarids, hookworms, pinworms, and whipworms.

diseases.label: toxascariasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves parasitic infection of dogs, cats and foxes with Toxascaris leonina causing damage to the lining of the intestine. The symptoms include diarrhea, vomiting and loss of appetite.

diseases.label: ascaridiasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves infection of the intestine of humans and birds with nematodes of the genus Ascaridia.

diseases.label: idiopathic CD4-positive T-lymphocytopenia
diseases.definition: A lymphopenia that is caused by a reduction of CD4+ T lymphocytes.

diseases.label: papillary cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A cystadenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, with cysts and papillary endophytic projections.

diseases.label: cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, in which cystic accumulations of retained secretions are formed.

diseases.label: papillary adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, which form complex papillary structures and exhibit compressive, destructive growth that replaces the normal tissue.

diseases.label: papillary carcinoma
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that is derives_from epithelial cells with finger like projections.

diseases.label: serous cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A cystadenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue forming serous lesions.

diseases.label: obsolete urinary tract transitional cell cancer
hepatobiliary benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system benign neoplasm located_in the hepatobiliary system.

diseases.label: hepatobiliary disease
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system disease that is located_in the liver and/or biliary tract.

diseases.label: gastrointestinal system cancer
diseases.definition: An organ system cancer located_in gastrointestinal tract that is manifested in organs of the gastrointestinal system.

diseases.label: tenosynovitis of foot and ankle
diseases.definition: A tenosynovitis that is located in the foot and ankle.

diseases.label: gallbladder papillomatosis
diseases.definition: A gallbladder benign neoplasm composed of epithelial tissue on papillae of vascularized connective tissue.

diseases.label: gallbladder cancer
diseases.definition: A biliary tract cancer that is located_in the gallbladder.

diseases.label: multiple endocrine neoplasia
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by tumors in at least two endocrine glands.

diseases.label: proctitis
diseases.definition: A rectal disease that involves inflammation of the rectal mucosa, which results from infection, inflammatory bowel disease, or radiation. Sexually transmitted pathogens (Neisseria gonorrhoeae, Chlamydia trachomatis, herpes simplex virus 1 and 2, Treponema pallidum) and enteric pathogens (Campylobacter, Shigella, Salmonella) are involved in the disease. Symptoms are rectal discomfort and bleeding.

diseases.label: anus disease
diseases.definition: A rectal disease located_in the anus.

diseases.label: porphyria cutanea tarda
diseases.definition: An acute porphyria characterized by painful, blistering skin lesions that develop on sun-exposed skin.

diseases.label: acute porphyria
diseases.definition: A porphyria that has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom neuropathy, has_symptom autonomic instability and has_symptom psychosis.

diseases.label: acanthosis nigricans
diseases.definition: A pigmentation disease characterized by velvety, darkening of the skin usually in intertriginous areas.

diseases.label: scleredema adultorum
diseases.definition: A skin disease that is characterized by induration of the skin, especially of the neck and upper trunk, has_symptom skin hardening or stiffening, and is associated with infections (especially streptococcal), hematologic malignancies, diabetes, and adverse drug reactions.

diseases.label: mucinoses
diseases.definition: A connective tissue disease characterized by accumulation of glycosaminoglycan located_in the dermal tissue.

diseases.label: cutis laxa
diseases.definition: A skin disease characterized by loose, hanging, wrinkled skin lacking in elasticity.

diseases.label: hyperlipoproteinemia type III
diseases.definition: A familial hyperlipidemia that has_material_basis_in by homozygous, compound heterozygous, or heterozygous mutation in the APOE gene on chromosome 19q13.

diseases.label: lipid metabolism disorder
diseases.definition: An inherited metabolic disorder that involves the creation and degradation of lipids.

diseases.label: skin squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A skin carcinoma that has_material_basis_in squamous cells.

diseases.label: hypomelanosis of Ito
diseases.definition: A skin disease that is characterized by distinctive skin changes, in which areas of the body lack skin color (hypopigmentation).

diseases.label: malignant spindle cell melanoma
diseases.definition: A melanoma that is composed of spindled neoplastic cells arranged in sheets and fascicles.

diseases.label: obsolete spindle cell cancer
diseases.definition: A sarcoma that is located_in the skin or located_in tissues that line or cover internal organs and that contains long spindle-shaped cells.

diseases.label: squamous cell neoplasm
diseases.definition: A cell type benign neoplasm composed_of epithelial cells located_in the ectodermal or endodermal cells linking body cavities.

diseases.label: fallopian tube serous papilloma
diseases.definition: A fallopian tube benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in the serosa and is characterized by exophytic growth.

diseases.label: skin papilloma
diseases.definition: A skin benign neoplasm that is composed of epithelial cells and a fibrous stalk.

diseases.label: spinal cord glioma
diseases.definition: A spinal cancer that is located in the spinal cord and has_material_basis_in glial cells.

diseases.label: brain oligodendroglioma
diseases.definition: A brain glioma that has_material_basis_in oligodendrocytes.

diseases.label: nemaline myopathy
diseases.definition: A congenital myopathy characterized by generally non-progressive muscle weakness of varying severity and problems with the tone and contraction of skeletal muscles. The muscle cells contain abnormal clumps of threadlike material called nemaline bodies.

diseases.label: neurilemmoma
diseases.definition: A neuroma that is characterized as a benign nerve sheath tumor that is composed of Schwann cells.

diseases.label: peripheral nerve sheath neoplasm
diseases.definition: A peripheral nervous system neoplasm that is located in the connective tissue surrounding nerves.

diseases.label: cellular schwannoma
diseases.definition: A neurilemmoma with a predominantly cellular growth but no Verocay bodies.

diseases.label: schwannoma of twelfth cranial nerve
diseases.definition: A neurilemmoma that is located_in the 12th cranial nerve.

diseases.label: cerebellopontine angle tumor
diseases.definition: A brain stem cancer that is characterized by neoplasms in the fossa located_in cerebellopontine angle.

diseases.label: neurilemmoma of the fifth cranial nerve
schwannomatosis
diseases.definition: A RASopathy characterized by the development of schwannomas or hybrid nerve sheath tumors.

diseases.label: junctional epidermolysis bullosa
diseases.definition: An epidermolysis bullosa that is characterized by recurrent blistering located in the lamina lucida of the basement membrane secondary to minor trauma, which can cause limited wounds, dehydration, electrolyte abnormalities, severe infection, among other issues, and has_material_basis_in mutation in genes related to laminin 332, which strengthens the skin.

diseases.label: tropical spastic paraparesis
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results in inflammation located in spinal cord, has_material_basis_in Human T-lymphotropic virus 1, which is transmitted by sexual contact, and transmitted by breast feeding. The infection has symptom spastic weakness of both legs, has symptom muscle stiffness, has symptom sensory disturbance, and has symptom spasms.

diseases.label: Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease
diseases.definition: A hypomyelinating leukodystrophy characterized by impaired myelin formation, nystagmus, spastic quadriplegia, ataxia, and developmental delay that has_material_basis_in mutation in the PLP1 gene on chromosome Xq22.

diseases.label: lysosomal storage disease
diseases.definition: An inherited metabolic disorder that involve an abnormal accumulation of substances inside the lysosome resulting from defects in lysosomal function.

diseases.label: obsolete hereditary central nervous system demyelinating disease
demyelinating disease
diseases.definition: A central nervous system disease that is characterized by damage to the myelin sheath present around nerve axons.

diseases.label: obsolete infectious bovine rhinotracheitis
diseases.definition: A Varicellovirus infectious disease that results_in infection in cattle, located_in upper respiratory tract, and located_in genital tract, has_material_basis_in Bovine herpesvirus 1, has_symptom nasal discharge, has_symptom fever, has_symptom abortion, and has_symptom conjunctivitis.

diseases.label: obsolete small intestinal delta cell somatostatin producing tumor
myelitis
diseases.definition: A spinal cord disease that is characterized by inflammation of the white matter or gray matter of the spinal cord.

diseases.label: obsolete Human T-lymphotropic virus 1 infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results in increased proliferation of affected CD4 lymphocytes, has_material_basis_in Human T-lymphotropic virus 1, which is transmitted_by sexual contact, transmitted_by contaminated needles used by intravenous-drug users, and transmitted_by breast feeding. The person infected with HTLV-1 eventually develop an often rapidly fatal leukemia, while others will develop a debilitative myelopathy, uveitis, infectious dermatitis, or another inflammatory disorder.

diseases.label: central nervous system lymphoma
diseases.definition: A hematologic cancer that has_material_basis_in lymphoma located_in central nervous system.

diseases.label: aspiration pneumonitis
diseases.definition: A pneumonia that is defined as an acute lung injury after the inhalation of foreign material such as regurgitated acidic gastric contents, petroleum products and laxative oils. This syndrome occurs in patients who have a marked disturbance of consciousness such as that resulting from a drug overdose, seizures, a massive cerebrovascular accident, or the use of anesthesia. Aspiration of gastric contents results in a chemical burn of the tracheobronchial tree and pulmonary parenchyma, causing an intense parenchymal inflammatory reaction. The disease has_symptom non-productive cough, has_symptom tachypnea, has_symptom bronchospasm, has_symptom bloody sputum, has_symptom frothy sputum, or has_symptom respiratory distress, 2-5 hrs after aspiration.

diseases.label: lipid pneumonia
diseases.definition: An aspiration pneumonitis resulting from the aspiration of lipids. It is the result of a foreign body-type reaction to the presence of lipid material within the lung parenchyma. It is caused by inhalation of nasal drops with oil base or cosmetic oil and aspiration of mineral oil when used as a laxative agent.

diseases.label: embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A rhabdomyosarcoma wherein the mesenchymally-derived malignant cells resemble the primitive developing skeletal muscle of the embryo; it occurs most often in the head and neck area or in the genital or urinary organs.

diseases.label: rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A skeletal muscle cancer that arise from skeletal muscle progenitors.

diseases.label: prostate embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A prostate rhabdomyosarcoma that is most common in children and that is characterized by a high degree of malignancy, both local rapid growth with formation of large pelvic masses, often leading to renal failure due to urethral obstruction, and systemic spread, commonly to the lungs, liver and bone.

diseases.label: prostate rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A rhabdomyosarcoma and sarcoma of prostate that is located_in the prostate.

diseases.label: bile duct rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A rhabdomyosarcoma and sarcoma of bile duct that is located_in the bile duct.

diseases.label: orbit embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: An orbit rhabdomyosarcoma that is characterized by elongated to round spindle cells with features of skeletal muscle in different stages of embryogenesis with a highly eosiniphilic cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei.

diseases.label: orbit rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: An orbit sarcoma that is that arises from primitive pleuripotential mesenchymal cells that possess the ability to differentiate into striated muscle, most often in young children.

diseases.label: ischemia
diseases.definition: A vascular disease that is characterized by a restriction in blood supply to tissues.

diseases.label: spindle cell rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A rhabdomyosarcoma that is characterized by the presence of whorls of spindle cells forming a storiform pattern. In children it usually arises in the paratesticular region. In adults it usually arises from the deep soft tissues in the head and neck.

diseases.label: hyper IgE recurrent infection syndrome 1
diseases.definition: A hyper IgE syndrome that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the STAT3 gene on chromosome 17q21.

diseases.label: phagocyte bactericidal dysfunction
diseases.definition: A primary immunodeficiency disease where phagocytes have a diminished ability to fight bacterial infection.

diseases.label: piebaldism
diseases.definition: An integumentary system disease characterized by congenital absence of melanocytes in areas of the skin and hair that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the KIT gene on chromosome 4q12.

diseases.label: subacute leukemia
diseases.definition: A leukemia that is in between acute and chronic leukemia and is characterized by a moderate duration or severity.

diseases.label: chronic granulomatous disease
diseases.definition: A phagocyte bactericidal dysfunction characterized by an inability to resist repeated infectious diseases and a tendency to develop chronic inflammation. Life-threatening recurrent fungal and bacterial infections affecting the skin, lungs, liver, lymph nodes, and bones may occur along with swollen areas of inflamed tissues known as granulomas that can be widely distributed.

diseases.label: mucinous ovarian cystadenoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian cystadenoma that is characterized by the presence of mucin.

diseases.label: ovarian cystadenoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in glandular epithelial tissue in which cystic accumulations of retained secretions are formed.

diseases.label: proliferative type fibrocystic change of breast
diseases.definition: A breast fibrocystic disease that is characterized by the presence of epithelial cell hyperplasia and the absence of epithelial atypia.

diseases.label: thymoma
diseases.definition: A thymus cancer that derives_from epithelial cells located_in the thymus. The tumor cells in a thymoma look similar to the normal cells of the thymus, grow slowly, and rarely spread beyond the thymus.

diseases.label: thymus cancer
diseases.definition: An immune system cancer located_in the thymus.

diseases.label: thymoma type B
diseases.definition: A thymoma that is an epithelial neoplasm arising from the thymus. It may be associated with myasthenia gravis, pure red cell aplasia, and hypogammaglobulinemia.

diseases.label: thymic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A thymus cancer that derives_from epithelial cells. The tumor cells in a thymic carcinoma look very different from the normal cells of the thymus, grow more quickly, and have usually spread to other parts of the body when the cancer is found.

diseases.label: mpox
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results in infection of primates, rodents and humans, located in skin, has_material_basis_in Monkeypox virus, which is transmitted by contact with the animal's blood, body fluids, rash, or with the body fluids of a sick person, transmitted by fomites, and transmitted by respiratory droplets. The infection has symptom fever, has symptom muscle ache, has symptom headache, and has symptom lymphadenopathy.

diseases.label: obsolete lumpy skin disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection located_in skin and located_in mucous membrane of cattle, has_material_basis_in Lumpy skin disease virus, which results_in_formation_of nodules on the skin particularly on the head, neck, udder, genitalia, perineum and legs, has_symptom fever, and has_symptom lymphadenopathy.

diseases.label: obsolete fowlpox
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease results_in infection located_in skin, or located_in mucous membranes of the mouth, oesophagus, larynx or trachea of birds, has_material_basis_in Fowlpox virus, has_symptom lesions on the skin, has_symptom diphtheritic lesions in the upper parts of the digestive and respiratory tracts.

diseases.label: obsolete infectious ectromelia
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection located in skin of mice, has_material_basis_in Ectromelia virus. The infection has_symptom swelling of the feet, has_symptom gangrene, and has_symptom lesions on the skin.

diseases.label: obsolete infectious myxomatosis
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection located_in eyes or located_in upper respiratory tract of domestic rabbits, has_material_basis_in Myxoma virus, which is transmitted_by mosquitos, transmitted_by biting flies or transmitted_by direct contact. The infection has_symptom conjunctivitis with a milky discharge from the inflamed eye and has_symptom breathing difficulties.

diseases.label: vaccinia
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection, located_in skin, has_material_basis_in Vaccinia virus, which is used as a live vaccine against smallpox. The virus is transmitted_by contact with the vaccination site before it has healed, or transmitted_by fomites that have been contaminated with live virus from the vaccination site. The infection has_symptom rash, has_symptom fever, and has_symptom body aches.

diseases.label: gonadoblastoma
diseases.definition: A cell type benign neoplasm that is composed_of a mixture of gonadal elements, such as large primordial germ cells, immature Sertoli cells or granulosa cells of the sex cord, and gonadal stromal cells (which comprises the granulosa, theca, and fibrocyte cells).

diseases.label: chordoma
diseases.definition: A notochordal cancer that derives_from cellular remnants of the notochord.

diseases.label: notochordal cancer
diseases.definition: An embryonal cancer and bone cancer and mesenchymal cell neoplasm that is located_in the notochord.

diseases.label: germinoma
diseases.definition: A germ cell cancer that lacks histologic differentiation. It usually refers to a tumor in the brain.

diseases.label: teratocarcinoma
