diseases.definition: A mixed germ cell tumor that is a mixture of teratoma with embryonal carcinoma, or with choriocarcinoma, or with both.

diseases.label: mixed germ cell cancer
diseases.definition: A germ cell cancer that occurs in many forms.

diseases.label: teratoma
diseases.definition: A germ cell and embryonal cancer that is an encapsulated tumor with tissue or organ components resembling normal derivatives of all three germ layers.

diseases.label: embryonal carcinoma
diseases.definition: An embryonal cancer that is a type of germ cell tumour that is located_in the ovaries or located_in the testes.

diseases.label: neurodermatitis
diseases.definition: A dermatitis that is characterized by chronic itching or scaling.

diseases.label: central nervous system disease
diseases.definition: A nervous system disease that affects either the spinal cord (myelopathy) or brain (encephalopathy) of the central nervous system.

diseases.label: atopic dermatitis
diseases.definition: An allergic contact dermatitis that is a chronically relapsing inflammatory allergic response located_in the skin that causes itching and flaking.

diseases.label: bipolar disorder
diseases.definition: A mood disorder that involves alternating periods of mania and depression.

diseases.label: angiomyolipoma
diseases.definition: A cell type benign neoplasm that is primarily located in the kidneys but may be found in the lungs, liver or other organs and is derived from perivascular epithelioid cells.

diseases.label: lipoma
diseases.definition: A cell type benign neoplasm that is composed of lipocytes.

diseases.label: lymphangioleiomyomatosis
diseases.definition: A lung disease that is characterized by progressive cystic destruction of the lung and lymphatic abnormalities, frequently associated with renal angiomyolipomas.

diseases.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
diseases.definition: A motor neuron disease that is characterized by muscle spasticity, rapidly progressive weakness due to muscle atrophy, difficulty in speaking, swallowing, and breathing.

diseases.label: Tay-Sachs disease
diseases.definition: A GM2 gangliosidosis that is characterized onset in infancy of developmental retardation, followed by paralysis, dementia and blindness, with death in the second or third year of life and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the alpha subunit of the hexosaminidase A gene (HEXA) on chromosome 15q23.

diseases.label: GM2 gangliosidosis
diseases.definition: A gangliosidosis that is characterized by excessive accumulation of ganglioside GM2 and related glycolipids in the lysosomes.

diseases.label: GM1 gangliosidosis
diseases.definition: A gangliosidosis that is characterized by progressive destruction of nerve cells in the brain and spinal cord and that has_material_basis_in mutations in the gene encoding beta-galactosidase-1 (GLB1) resulting in build up of GM1 ganglioside.

diseases.label: Sandhoff disease
diseases.definition: A GM2 gangliosidosis that is characterized by an accumulation of GM2 gangliosides, particularly in neurons, and that has_material_basis_in mutation in the beta subunit of hexosaminidase (HEXB) on chromosome 5q13.

diseases.label: mood disorder
diseases.definition: A cognitive disorder that involves a disturbance in mood as the predominant underlying feature.

diseases.label: temporal lobe epilepsy
diseases.definition: A focal epilepsy that is characterized by recurrent, unprovoked focal seizures that originate in the temporal lobe of the brain and last about one or two minutes.

diseases.label: benign epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes
diseases.definition: A childhood electroclinical syndrome characterized by partial seizures involving the rolandic area of the brain and electroencephalographic centrotemporal sharp waves.

diseases.label: obsolete chronic factitious illness with physical symptoms
frontal lobe epilepsy
diseases.definition: A focal epilepsy that is characterized by recurring seizures that affect one hemisphere of the brain.

diseases.label: haemonchiasis
diseases.definition: A trichostrongyloidiasis that involves parasitic infection of the ruminant abomasum by nematodes of the genus Haemonchus resulting in anemia, dehydration, diarrhea and accumulation of fluid in the abdomen, gut wall, thoracic cavity and submandibular tissue.

diseases.label: histrionic personality disorder
diseases.definition: A personality disorder that is characterized by a pattern of excessive emotionality and attention-seeking, including an excessive need for approval and inappropriately seductive behavior, usually beginning in early adulthood.

diseases.label: osteitis fibrosa
diseases.definition: A bone resorption disease that has_material_basis_in hyperparathyroidism which results_in hyperactivity in osteoclasts, deformity, and loss of mass located_in bone.

diseases.label: bone inflammation disease
diseases.definition: A bone disease that results_in inflammation of the located_in bone.

diseases.label: glycoproteinosis
diseases.definition: A mucolipidosis that is characterized by a deficiency of the enzyme alpha-N -acetyl neuraminidase (sialidase).

diseases.label: xanthomatosis
diseases.definition: A lipid storage disease that is characterized by the desposition of yellowish cholesterol-rich material in tendons or other body parts.

diseases.label: osteosarcoma
diseases.definition: A bone sarcoma that is located_in bone that has_material_basis_in cells of mesenchymal origin. It usually involves bones and less frequently extraosseous sites. It often involves the long bones (particularly distal femur, proximal tibia, and proximal humerus).

diseases.label: mesenchymal cell neoplasm
diseases.definition: A cell type cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives from embryonic connective tissue that is capable of developing into connective tissue, such as bone, and cartilage, the lymphatic system, and the circulatory system.

diseases.label: fibrosarcoma of bone
diseases.definition: A bone sarcoma characterized by a herringbone or fascicular disposition of atypical, monomorphic fibroblasts and is always negative for any specific marker.

diseases.label: fibrosarcoma
diseases.definition: A connective tissue cancer that has_material_basis_in fibrous connective tissue and characterized by the presence of immature proliferating fibroblasts or undifferentiated anaplastic spindle cells in a storiform pattern.

diseases.label: localized osteosarcoma
diseases.definition: An osteosarcoma that is confined to a specific site without evidence of spread to other anatomic sites.

diseases.label: extraosseous osteosarcoma
diseases.definition: An osteosarcoma arising from the soft tissue.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant extraskeletal cartilaginous and osseous tumor
Ewing sarcoma of bone
diseases.definition: A peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor that is located_in bone.

diseases.label: Ewing sarcoma
diseases.definition: A connective tissue cancer that has_material_basis_in neural crest cells derives_from undeveloped, undifferentiated neuroectoderm.

diseases.label: chondrosarcoma
diseases.definition: A bone sarcoma that has_material_basis_in cells derived from transformed cells that produce cartilage.

diseases.label: bone osteosarcoma
diseases.definition: An osteosarcoma that is an usually aggressive malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the bone. It may arise de novo or from a pre-existing lesion of the bone. Pain and a palpable mass are the most frequent clinical sign and symptom. It may spread to other anatomic sites, particularly the lungs.

diseases.label: obsolete cranial nerve neoplasm
diseases.definition: A central nervous system cancer develops from schwann cells located_in cranial nerves, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells.

diseases.label: liposarcoma
diseases.definition: A connective tissue cancer that arises in fat cells in deep soft tissue retroperitoneum and the extremities.

diseases.label: bacterial vaginosis
diseases.definition: A vaginitis that is characterized by a grayish vaginal discharge usually of foul odor and the presence of Gardnerella vaginalis.

diseases.label: periodontal disease
diseases.definition: A mouth disease that is relating to or affecting the structures surrounding and supporting the teeth.

diseases.label: Papillon-Lefevre disease
diseases.definition: An ectodermal dysplasia that is characterized by palmoplantar keratoderma associated with early-onset periodontitis and has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the cathepsin C gene on chromosome 11q14.

diseases.label: accessory nerve disease
diseases.definition: A glossopharyngeal nerve disease that is characterized by involvement of the accessory nerve (eleventh cranial nerve).

diseases.label: palmoplantar keratosis
diseases.definition: A keratosis characterized by abnormal thickening of the palms and the soles.

diseases.label: coronary artery disease
diseases.definition: An artery disease that is characterized by plaque building up along the inner walls of the arteries of the heart resulting in a narrowing of the arteries and a reduced blood supply to the cardiac muscles.

diseases.label: inappropriate ADH syndrome
diseases.definition: A pituitary gland disease resulting from excessive production of antidiuretic hormone (ADH).

diseases.label: obsolete ectopic hormone secretion syndrome associated with neoplasia
histiocytosis
diseases.definition: A lymphatic system disease that is characterized by an excessive number of histiocytes.

diseases.label: peripheral vascular disease
diseases.definition: A vascular disease that is characterized by obstruction of larger arteries not within the coronary, aortic arch vasculature, or brain.

diseases.label: obsolete infectious canine hepatitis
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that involves necrosis of the liver caused by Canine adenovirus 1 in dogs, wolves, coyotes and bears. The symptoms include fever, leukopenia, apathy, anorexia, conjunctivitis, serous discharge from the eyes and nose, petechiae of the oral mucosa, subcutaneous edema of the head, neck and trunk, hematomas in the mouth, jaundice, and hepatic encephalopathy.

diseases.label: alpha-mannosidosis
diseases.definition: A lysosomal storage disease that has_material_basis_in deficiency of the alpha-D-manosidase enzyme resulting in the impairment of cell function from a build up of complex sugars derived from glycoproteins in the lysosome.

diseases.label: glossopharyngeal nerve disease
diseases.definition: A cranial nerve disease that is located_in the ninth cranial nerve or its nuclei in the medulla.

diseases.label: vestibular disease
diseases.definition: An inner ear disease that is located in the vestibular system.

diseases.label: inclusion body myositis
diseases.definition: A myositis that is characterized by late onset of skeletal muscle inflammation, weakness, and atrophy with cytoplasmic granules and vacuoles in the muscle.

diseases.label: cerebritis
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by inflammation of the brain tissue occurring as a result of an underlying condition.

diseases.label: viral laryngitis
diseases.definition: A acute laryngitis which is caused by viral infection.

diseases.label: laryngitis
diseases.definition: A laryngeal disease involving an inflammation of the larynx leading to hoarse voice or a complete loss of voice due to irritation of the vocal cords caused by viral, bacterial or fungal infection, inflammation due to overuse of the vocal cords and excessive coughing, smoking, or alcohol consumption.

diseases.label: obsolete disease of biological process
diseases.definition: A disease that involves any biological process (GO:0008150) specifically pertinent to the functioning of integrated living units: cells, tissues, organs, and organisms.

diseases.label: mammary Paget's disease
diseases.definition: A breast adenocarcinoma that has_material_basis_in epidermal Paget cells, which are malignant glandular epithelial cells with abundant and clear cytoplasm, usually containing mucin, and pleomorphic and hyperchromatic nucleus.

diseases.label: anus adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An anal carcinoma that originating in the cortex of the adrenal gland and derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: penis carcinoma
diseases.definition: A penile cancer that is located_in the skin or tissues of the penis.

diseases.label: uterine disease
diseases.definition: A female reproductive system disease that is located_in the uterus.

diseases.label: cutaneous Paget's disease
diseases.definition: A skin carcinoma that is characterized by infiltration of the skin by neoplastic large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and large nuclei with prominent nucleoli.

diseases.label: skin carcinoma
diseases.definition: A skin cancer that is located_in tissues of the skin and develops from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: brain infarction
diseases.definition: A cerebrovascular disease that is characterized by tissue necrosis located_in the brain, resulting from inadequate blood flow through the brain.

diseases.label: cervix erosion
diseases.definition: A cervix disease that is characterized by the presence of enodcervical columnar epithelium on the ectocervix.

diseases.label: invasive lobular carcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast lobular carcinoma that is characterized by infiltration into the tissue of the breast outside of the lobule where it originated.

diseases.label: breast adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast carcinoma that originates in the milk ducts and/or lobules (glandular tissue) of the breast.

diseases.label: breast carcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: breast disease
diseases.definition: A disease of anatomical entity that is located_in the breast.

diseases.label: obsolete hamartoma of central nervous system
uveal cancer
diseases.definition: An ocular cancer that is located_in the uvea, which are the pigmented layers of the eye consisting of the iris, ciliary body, and choroid. The uvea is the most common location of intraocular malignancy in adults and may commonly be caused by a subtype of cancer that arises from melanocytes.

diseases.label: blepharochalasis
diseases.definition: An eyelid disease that is characterized by exacerbations and remissions of eyelid edema, which results in a stretching and subsequent atrophy of the eyelid tissue, leading to the formation of redundant folds over the lid margins.

diseases.label: uveal disease
diseases.definition: An eye disease affecting the uvea, which are the pigmented layers of the eye consisting of the iris, ciliary body, and choroid.

diseases.label: septicemic plague
diseases.definition: A plague that results_in infection located_in vasculature where bacterial endotoxins cause coagulation, which leads to formation of tiny clots throughout the body. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom chills, has_symptom prostration, has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom shock and has_symptom bleeding into skin and other organs.

diseases.label: plague
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that results_in infection, located_in lymph node, located_in vasculature or located_in lungs, has_material_basis_in Yersinia pestis, which is transmitted_by oriental rat flea (Xenopsylla cheopis) infected by feeding on rodents and other mammals, transmitted_by air, transmitted_by direct contact or transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated undercooked food.

diseases.label: obsolete Oxyurida infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Chromadorea infectious disease that involves infection by parasitic nematodes of the order Oxyurida.

diseases.label: cellulitis
diseases.definition: A skin disease where there is a diffuse infection of connective tissue with severe inflammation of dermal and subcutaneous layers of the skin. Cellulitis can be caused by normal skin flora or by exogenous bacteria, and often occurs where the skin has previously been broken: cracks in the skin, cuts, blisters, burns, insect bites, surgical wounds, or sites of intravenous catheter insertion.

diseases.label: Noonan syndrome
diseases.definition: A RASopathy that is characterized by mildly unusual facial features, short stature, heart defects, bleeding problems, skeletal malformations, and many other signs and symptoms.

diseases.label: Turner syndrome
diseases.definition: A gonadal dysgenesis that is characterized by short stature and early loss of ovarian function resulting from ovarian hypofunction or premature ovarian failure and has_material_basis_in one missing or structurally altered X chromosome.

diseases.label: mixed connective tissue disease
diseases.definition: A collagen disease that is considered an overlap of three diseases, systemic lupus erythematosus, scleroderma, and polymyositis with very high titers of circulating antinuclear antibody to a ribonucleoprotein antigen.

diseases.label: signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, which have signet ring appearance.

diseases.label: bile duct signet ring cell carcinoma
extrahepatic bile duct adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An extrahepatic bile duct carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A pancreatic adenocarcinoma that derives_from pancreatic duct cells.

diseases.label: gallbladder adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A gallbladder carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: ampulla of Vater adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An ampulla of Vater carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: breast signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast adenocarcinoma that is characterized by the presence of numerous cells containing intracellular mucin, without large amounts of extracellular mucins.

diseases.label: dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
diseases.definition: A fibrosarcoma that is located_in the dermis laryer of the skin and that begins as a hard nodule and grows slowly.

diseases.label: obsolete childhood soft tissue sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma that affects children and is located_in the soft tissues of the body.

diseases.label: lateral medullary syndrome
diseases.definition: A brain stem infarction that is characterized by hoarseness, dizziness, nausea, located_in the lateral part of the medulla oblongata that develops from a blockage in the posterior inferior cerebellar artery or one of its branches or of the vertebral artery, has_symptom vertigo, has_symptom ipsilateral cerebellar signs, has_symptom contralateral sensory deficits of limbs and torso, has_symptom ipsilateral sensory deficits of face, has_symptom laryngeal, pharyngeal, and palatal hemiparalysis, has_symptom ipsilateral Horner's syndrome.

diseases.label: brain stem infarction
diseases.definition: A brain infarction that is characterized by stroke of the brain stem that develops from blockage or narrowing in the arteries located_in the brainstem, has_material_basis_in damage to the cranial nerve nuclei and long tracts, has_symptom vertigo, has_symptom imbalance, has_symptom decreased level of arousal.

diseases.label: cerebral infarction
diseases.definition: A cerebrovascular disease that is characterized by an area of necrotic tissue in the brain resulting from a blockage or narrowing in the arteries supplying blood and oxygen to the brain.

diseases.label: congenital myopathy 1A
diseases.definition: A congenital myopathy that is characterized by muscle weakness primarily affecting the proximal muscles of the lower limbs beginning in infancy or early childhood, although later onset of symptoms has been reported and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the ryanodine receptor-1 gene (RYR1) on chromosome 19q13. Heterozygous mutation in the RYR1 gene also causes susceptibility to malignant hyperthermia-1 (MHS1), patients with CMYP1A are at risk for MHS. Biallelic mutations in the RYR1 gene cause autosomal recessive CMYP1B, which shows overlapping features, but is typically more severe.

diseases.label: obsolete peste des petits ruminants infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in ruminants, has_material_basis_in Peste-des-petits-ruminants virus, which is transmitted_by contact with oronasal and ocular secretions, urine, and feces. The infection results_in_formation_of lesions on the gums, lips and palate.

diseases.label: obsolete Morbillivirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Paramyxoviridae infectious disease that results_in infection in dogs, seals, cattle and humans, has_material_basis_in Morbillivirus.

diseases.label: Lafora disease
diseases.definition: A progressive myoclonus epilepsy characterized by myoclonus and/or generalized seizures, visual hallucinations, and progressive neurological decline with onset between 8 and 18 years of age that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in either NHLRC1 on chromosome 6p22.3 or EPM2A on chromosome 6q24.3.

diseases.label: Unverricht-Lundborg syndrome
diseases.definition: A progressive myoclonus epilepsy characterized by onset between 6 and 13 years of age of action- and stimulus-sensitive myoclonus, tonic-clonic seizures with ataxia, and a mild cognitive decline.

diseases.label: choroid plexus cancer
diseases.definition: A cerebral ventricle cancer that is located_in the plexus located_in the ventricles of the brain.

diseases.label: cerebral ventricle cancer
diseases.definition: A cerebrum cancer that is located_in the cerebral ventricles.

diseases.label: mast-cell sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma that has_material_basis_in mast cells.

diseases.label: superior mesenteric artery syndrome
diseases.definition: A duodenal obstruction resulting from compression of the duodenum between the aorta and the superior mesenteric artery.

diseases.label: pseudomyxoma peritonei
diseases.definition: An appendix cancer that is characterized by progressive accumulation of mucus-secreting tumor cells within the abdomen and pelvis.

diseases.label: obsolete intrathoracic lymph node mast cell malignancy
meningioma
diseases.definition: A central nervous system cancer that are manifested in the central nervous system and arise from the arachnoid cap cells of the arachnoid villi in the meninges.

diseases.label: obsolete viral hemorrhagic septicemia
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in fish, has_material_basis_in Viral hemorrhagic septicemia virus, which is transmitted_by contact with the contaminated water, or transmitted_by direct contact. The infection has_symptom hemorrhages in the internal organs, skin, and muscle, has_symptom bulging eyes, and has_symptom bloated abdomens.

diseases.label: obsolete upper limb lymph node mast cell malignancy
liver cancer
diseases.definition: A hepatobiliary system cancer that is located_in the liver.

diseases.label: Sertoli cell tumor
diseases.definition: A sex cord-gonadal stromal tumor characterized by excessive proliferation of Sertoli cells.

diseases.label: ovarian gonadoblastoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian benign neoplasm that is has_material_basis_in a mixture of gonadal elements.

diseases.label: obsolete testicular mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal neoplasm
obsolete Puerperal pyrexia of unknown origin
pancreatic ductal carcinoma
diseases.definition: A pancreatic carcinoma located_in the pancreatic duct.

diseases.label: obsolete Poor Prognosis metastatic Gestational Trophoblastic tumor
choriocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A placenta cancer that has_material_basis_in trophoblastic cells.

diseases.label: placental site trophoblastic tumor
diseases.definition: A choriocarcinoma that is characterized by low beta-hCG levels and arises from neoplastic transformation of intermediate trophoblastic cells.

diseases.label: obsolete Good Prognosis metastatic Gestational Trophoblastic tumor
toxic encephalopathy
diseases.definition: A nervous system disease that results from exposure to neurotoxicants and is characterized by an altered mental status, memory loss, and visual problems.

diseases.label: mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A cystadenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, with a capsulated structure and mucus-producing cells.

diseases.label: ovarian mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian cystadenocarcinoma that is characterized by the presence of mucin.

diseases.label: ovarian cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovary adenocarcinoma that is characterized by the presence of cysts or cystic spaces.

diseases.label: ovarian mucinous adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovary adenocarcinoma that is characterized by the presence of mucin.

diseases.label: appendix adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An appendix carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: breast mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast mucinous carcinoma that is characterized by both intracellular and extracellular mucin and cystic spaces are lined by tall columnar cells that contain profuse extracellular mucin.

diseases.label: cervix endometriosis
diseases.definition: A cervix disease that is characterized by the growth endometrial tissue that is located on the cervix.

diseases.label: breast mucinous carcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast adenocarcinoma in which at least one half of the tumor volume is extracellular mucin throughout.

diseases.label: Canavan disease
diseases.definition: A leukodystrophy characterized by onset in early infancy, atonia of neck muscles, hypotonia, hyperextension of legs and flexion of arms, blindness, severe mental defect, megalocephaly, and death by 18 months on the average that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in ASPA gene encoding aspartoacylase on chromosome 17p13.

diseases.label: Kallmann syndrome
diseases.definition: A hypogonadotropic hypogonadism with a defective sense of smell (anosmia or hyposmia).

diseases.label: infiltrating angiolipoma
diseases.definition: An angiolipoma that is characterized by prominent vascularity that invades the surrounding deep tissue.

diseases.label: angiolipoma
diseases.definition: A lipoma that is a painful subcutaneous nodule, having all other features of a typical lipoma.

diseases.label: central nervous system cancer
diseases.definition: A nervous system cancer that is located_in the central nervous system.

diseases.label: obsolete central nervous system neuroepithelial neoplasm
aortic aneurysm
diseases.definition: An aortic disease that is characterized by an enlargement (dilation) of the aorta to greater than 1.5 times normal size.

diseases.label: uterine cancer
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ cancer that is located_in the uterus.

diseases.label: beta-mannosidosis
diseases.definition: A lysosomal storage disease that has_material_basis_in deficiency of the beta-A-manosidase enzyme resulting in the disruption of N-linked glycoprotein oligosaccharide catabolism.

diseases.label: congenital myasthenic syndrome
diseases.definition: A neuromuscular junction disease that is characterized by weakness and easy fatiguability resulting from a genetic defect at the junction where the nerve stimulates muscle activity that result in muscle weakness and may affect nerve cells (presynaptic), muscle cells (postsynaptic) or the space between nerve and muscle cells (synaptic).

diseases.label: central nervous system teratoma
diseases.definition: A teratoma that is located_in the central nervous system.

diseases.label: pyruvate decarboxylase deficiency
diseases.definition: A carbohydrate metabolic disorder characterized by the buildup of lactic acid in the body and a variety of neurological problems and caused by a deficiency of one of the three enzymes in the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex.

diseases.label: bladder disease
diseases.definition: A urinary system disease that is located_in the bladder.

diseases.label: lactic acidosis
diseases.definition: A metabolic acidosis characterized by buildup of lactate.

diseases.label: pyruvate carboxylase deficiency disease
diseases.definition: A carbohydrate metabolic disorder that is characterized by deficiency of pyruvate carboxylase causing decreased utilization of carbohydrates and toxic accumulation of lactic acid, possibly has_symptom periodic lactate elevations, gastrointestinal upset, neonatal onset of metabolic acidosis, failure to thrive, developmental delay, seizures, death, and has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the PC gene, which encodes pyruvate carboxylase, a critical protein in the citric acid cycle and in gluconeogenesis.

diseases.label: Leigh disease
diseases.definition: A cytochrome-c oxidase deficiency disease characterized by progressive loss of mental and movement abilities. Symptoms usually begin between ages of three months and two years and include loss of appetite, vomiting, irritability and seizure activity.

diseases.label: sialuria
diseases.definition: A lysosomal storage disease characterized by increased sialic acid in the urine.

diseases.label: wheat allergy
diseases.definition: A food allergy that develops_from exposure to and particularly consumption of wheat, and has_symptom that are both gastrointestinal and nongastrointestinal in nature, such as diarrhea, mouth and throat irritation, headache, hives, skin rashes, and anaphylaxis.

diseases.label: mast cell neoplasm
diseases.definition: A hematologic cancer that has_material_basis_in mast cells.

diseases.label: solitary mastocytoma of the skin
diseases.definition: A mast cell neoplasm that is characterized by collections of mast cells with a single or multiple (usually five or fewer individual) orange-brown to red-brown plaques or nodules ranging from 0.5 to 3.5 cm in diameter.

diseases.label: obsolete Cardiovirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Picornaviridae infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Cardiovirus.

diseases.label: obsolete Picornaviridae infectious disease
diseases.definition: A (+)ssRNA virus infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Picornaviridae viruses.

diseases.label: olfactory nerve disease
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by nerve injury located_in olfactory nerve, occurring as a result of normal aging, trauma, mass lesion or other insult, and has_symptom impaired sense of smell, has_symptom anosmia or loss of smell.

diseases.label: rhabdoid cancer
diseases.definition: A childhood kidney neoplasm that is located_in the kidney, liver, muscle, heart, lung, soft tissues, skin and central nervous system.

diseases.label: kidney rhabdoid cancer
diseases.definition: A embryonal cancer that is located in the kidney.

diseases.label: pulmonary plasma cell granuloma
diseases.definition: A lung disease that is characterized by an inflammatory lesion that is composed of plasma cells and fibrous tissue.

diseases.label: cerebrum cancer
diseases.definition: A supratentorial cancer that is located_in the cerebrum.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant neoplasm of lip, oral cavity and pharynx
MELAS syndrome
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial encephalomyopathy that is characterized by mitochondrial myopathy, encephalopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes, has_symptom myalgia, motor weakness, headaches, seizures, and stroke-like episodes with acute hemiparesis and severe headaches, and develops_from mutation in mitochondrial genes including MT-TL1, which encodes tRNA proteins.

diseases.label: brachial plexus neuritis
diseases.definition: A brachial plexus neuropathy that affects the chest, shoulder, arm and hand.

diseases.label: brachial plexus neuropathy
diseases.definition: A peripheral nervous system disease that is characterized by damage to nerves in the upper shoulder of the brachial plexus, an area where nerves from the spinal cord branch into the arm nerves.

diseases.label: anal colloid adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An anus carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin located_in the anal colloid.

diseases.label: anal canal adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An anal canal cancer that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: acute sanguinous otitis media
diseases.definition: A acute transudative otitis media which involves bloody effusion.

diseases.label: acute transudative otitis media
diseases.definition: A non-suppurative otitis media and eustachian tube disorder with a sudden onset and a short course.

diseases.label: uterine ligament mucinous adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A uterine ligament adenocarcinoma that produces mucin.

diseases.label: skin disease
diseases.definition: An integumentary system disease that is located_in skin.

diseases.label: uterine ligament adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A uterine ligament cancer that is characterized as a mixture of carcinoma and sarcoma and has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue and has_material_basis_in connective tissue.

diseases.label: cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A cervical adenocarcinoma that derives_from mucin producing epithelial cells.

diseases.label: cervical adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A cervix carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: prostate colloid adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A prostate adenocarcinoma that produces mucin and is characterized by non-cystic structure.

diseases.label: fallopian tube mucinous adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A fallopian tube adenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, which produce mucin.

diseases.label: fallopian tube mucinous tumor
diseases.definition: A fallopian tube benign neoplasm that produces mucin.

diseases.label: fallopian tube adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A fallopian tube carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: endometrial mucinous adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An endometrial adenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, which produce mucin.

diseases.label: rectum mucinous adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A rectal adenocarcinoma that produces mucin.

diseases.label: bladder adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A bladder carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: ovary adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: obsolete non-suppurative otitis media and eustachian tube disorder
diseases.definition: A non-suppurative otitis media which involves obstruction of the collecting lymphatic tubules of the middle ear and eustachian tube as they drain to the retropharyngeal lymphatics. Retraction of the tympanic membrane is also observed.

diseases.label: gastric adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A stomach carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: obsolete Arterivirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Arteriviridae infectious disease that results_in infection in animals, has_material_basis_in Arterivirus.

diseases.label: acute allergic sanguinous otitis media
diseases.definition: A acute sanguinous otitis media caused by an allergen.

diseases.label: obsolete Respirovirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Paramyxoviridae infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Respirovirus, which is transmitted_by contact with the respiratory secretions of an infected person.

diseases.label: obsolete pneumonic pasteurellosis
diseases.definition: A Pasteurella infectious disease that involves infection by the bacterium Mannheimia haemolytica and less frequently by Pasteurella multocida and Histophilus somni. After stress or viral infection, the replication rate of M. haemolytica in the upper respiratory tract increases rapidly, followed by inhalation and colonization of the lungs due to suppression of the host's defense mechanism. The bacterium produces exotoxin called leukotxin which interacts with the host's defense mechanism resulting in tissue damage with charactersistic necrosis, thrombosis, and exudation and the development of pneumonia.

diseases.label: obsolete bovine respiratory disease complex
diseases.definition: A pneumonia which has a multifactorial etiology and develops as a result of complex interactions between environmental factors, host factors, and pathogens leading to pulmonary lesions caused by various micro organisms ( essentially viruses and bacteria). Environmental factors (eg, weaning, transport, commingling, crowding, and inadequate ventilation) serve as stressors that adversely affect the immune and nonimmune defense mechanisms of the host. In addition, certain environmental factors (eg, crowding and inadequate ventilation) can enhance the transmission of infectious agents among animals.

diseases.label: theileriasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic protozoa infectious disease that involves infection of humans and cattle caused by a genus of parasitic protozoa Theileria, which is transmitted by ixodid ticks.

diseases.label: verrucous carcinoma
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that is a diffuse, papillary, non metastasizing, well differentiated, malignant neoplasm of epidermis or oral epithelium.

diseases.label: obsolete human papillomavirus related squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A human papillomavirus related carcinoma that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in human papillomavirus (types 16, or 18), which cause malignant tumors in squamous epithelium in genital and periungual areas.

diseases.label: nutrition disease
diseases.definition: An acquired metabolic disease that is characterized by an insufficient intake of food or of certain nutrients, by an inability of the body to absorb and use nutrients, or by overconsumption of certain foods.

diseases.label: vulva verrucous carcinoma
diseases.definition: A vulva squamous cell carcinoma that is characterized as locally invasive, with warty-appearing, highly differentiated, and variably keratinized lesions.

diseases.label: bladder squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A carcinoma of bladder that is manifested in squamous cells of the bladder.

diseases.label: cervical verrucous carcinoma
diseases.definition: A cervical squamous cell carcinoma that is characterized by a hyperkeratotic, undulating, warty surface and invades the underlying stroma in the form of bulbous epithelial pegs with a pushing border, broad papillae that lack fibrovascular cores and the absence of koilocytosis. It shows no more than minimal nuclear atypia and does not exhibit infiltrative growth.

diseases.label: cervical squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A cervix carcinoma that has_material_basis_in squamous cells of the cervix.

diseases.label: esophagus squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: An esophageal carcinoma that derives_from epithelial squamous cells located_in the esophagus.

diseases.label: urethra squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A cancer of urethra that shows squamous cell differentiation.

diseases.label: Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by oculocutaneous albinism, bleeding problems due to platelet storage pool defect, visual impairment and lysosomal accumulation of ceroid lipofuscin.

diseases.label: antithrombin III deficiency
diseases.definition: A thrombophilia that is characterized by the tendency to form clots in the veins.

diseases.label: protein C deficiency
diseases.definition: A thrombophilia that is characterized by recurrent venous thrombosis and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the PROC gene on chromosome 2q14.

diseases.label: cytochrome-c oxidase deficiency disease
diseases.definition: A mitochondrial metabolism disease that is characterized by deficiency of cytochrome c oxidase, myopathy, hepatomegaly, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, lactic acidosis, and Leigh syndrome, and is caused by mutations related to oxidative phosphorylation.

diseases.label: Denys-Drash syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by the association of diffuse mesangial sclerosis (DMS), male pseudohermaphroditism with a 46,XY karyotype, and nephroblastoma that derives_from an abnormality in the WT1 gene (Wilms' tumor suppressor gene).

diseases.label: leukorrhea
diseases.definition: A vaginal discharge that is characterized by a whitish or yellow color.

diseases.label: vaginal discharge
diseases.definition: A vaginal disease that is characterized by the presence of discharge.

diseases.label: pulmonary fibrosis
diseases.definition: An interstitial lung disease that is characterized by destruction, scarring, and thickening of the interstitial lung tissues and progressive pulmonary function loss in a restrictive pattern, has_symptom progressive shortness of breath, fatigue, and chronic cough, possibly has_material_basis_in exposure to certain chemicals, autoimmune conditions, and radiation. It can be caused by inhaling hazardous chemicals, certain diseases, medication and genetics or unknown causes.

diseases.label: chordoid glioma
diseases.definition: A high grade glioma that is characterized by the presence of epithelioid cells which express GFAP, and mucinous stroma which contains lymphoplasmacytic infiltrates.

diseases.label: anovulation
diseases.definition: An ovarian disease that is characterized by the absence of ovulation.

diseases.label: Coffin-Lowry syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by skeletal malformations, growth retardation, hearing deficit, paroxysmal movement disorders, and cognitive impairment in affected males and some carrier females, and has_material_basis_in mutation in the RSK2 gene on chromosome Xp22.

diseases.label: external ear disease
diseases.definition: An auditory system disease that is located_in the external ear.

diseases.label: pleural empyema
diseases.definition: A soft tissue infectious disease that involves accumulation of pus in the pleural cavity as a result of infection within the lung (pneumonia) or a lung abscess spreading into the space. The symptoms include cough, fever, chest pain, sweating and shortness of breath.

diseases.label: obsolete feline panleukopenia
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in ulceration located_in intestinal epithelium of cats, which has_material_basis_in Feline panleukopenia virus, transmitted_by contact with an infected cat's bodily fluids, feces, or fleas. The infection has_symptom bloody diarrhea, has_symptom dehydration, has_symptom anemia, and has_symptom vomiting.

diseases.label: obsolete avian leukosis
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in birds, has_material_basis_in Avian leukosis virus, which causes wide range of tumors.

diseases.label: Crigler-Najjar syndrome
diseases.definition: A bilirubin metabolic disorder that involves a build up of bilirubin as bilirubin is not being broken down as a result of a lack or deficiency of the enzyme uridine diphosphate glycosyltransferase (UGT).

diseases.label: arthropathy
diseases.definition: A bone disease that is located_in the joint.

diseases.label: soft tissue chondroma
diseases.definition: A connective tissue benign neoplasm arising from the extraskeletal soft tissues near tendons and joints. It is a well circumscribed tumor characterized by the presence of chondrocytes, a lobulated hyaline cartilage growth pattern, and in some cases calcification.

diseases.label: cranial nerve palsy
diseases.definition: A cranial nerve disease that is characterized by complete or partial weakness or paralysis of the areas served by the affected nerve.

diseases.label: photoallergic dermatitis
diseases.definition: An allergic contact dermatitis that is characterized by a delayed-type hypersensitivity cutaneous reaction in response to a photoantigen applied to the skin in individuals previously sensitized to the same substance, and has_symptom erythematous papules, vesicles, or eczema.

diseases.label: toxicodendron dermatitis
diseases.definition: An allergic contact dermatitis that has_allergic_trigger members of the toxicodendron family, including urushiol producing poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac, has_symptom pruritic erythematous rash with papules, vesicles, and plaques, and has_material_basis_in a type IV hypersensitivity reaction.

diseases.label: congenital diaphragmatic hernia
diseases.definition: A diaphragm disease characterized by the lack of development of all or part of the diaphragm, which results in an abnormal opening that allows the stomach and intestines to move into the chest cavity and crowd the heart and lungs.

diseases.label: pituitary adenoma
diseases.definition: A pituitary gland benign neoplasm that derives_from glandular epithelial cells.

diseases.label: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome
diseases.definition: An intestinal disease characterized by melanocytic macules of the lips, buccal mucosa, and digits; multiple gastrointestinal hamartomatous polyps; and an increased risk of various neoplasms that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the serine/threonine kinase STK11 gene on chromosome 19p13.

diseases.label: male reproductive organ cancer
diseases.definition: A reproductive organ cancer that is manifested in the male genital system. This includes organs such as the penis and scrotum.

diseases.label: large cell medulloblastoma
diseases.definition: A medulloblastoma that is characterized by cells that are larger than would be normally expected.

diseases.label: obsolete region 17p13 allelic loss associated medulloblastoma
adult central nervous system embryonal tumor
diseases.definition: A central nervous system embryonal tumor that occurs in adults.

diseases.label: obsolete nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome associated medulloblastoma
childhood central nervous system embryonal tumor
diseases.definition: A central nervous system embryonal tumor that occurs in childhood.

diseases.label: desmoplastic/nodular medulloblastoma
diseases.definition: A medulloblastoma that is characterized by the presence of nodular, collagenous areas which do not contain reticulin, surrounded by hypercellular areas which contain an intercellular reticulin fiber network.

diseases.label: thrombophlebitis
diseases.definition: A phlebitis that results from a blood clot in the vessel.

diseases.label: Lynch syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by an increased risk for colon cancer and cancers of the endometrium, ovary, stomach, small intestine, hepatobiliary tract, urinary tract, brain, and skin and has_material_basis_in mutation of mismatch repair genes that increases the risk of many types of cancers.

diseases.label: placental insufficiency
diseases.definition: A placenta disease that is characterized by insufficient blood flow to the placenta during pregnancy.

diseases.label: insulinoma
diseases.definition: A pancreatic cystadenoma that is characterized by the overproduction of insulin.

diseases.label: hidradenoma
diseases.definition: A sweat gland benign neoplasm that is located_in an apical sweat gland.

diseases.label: vulvitis
diseases.definition: A vulvar disease that is characterized by inflammation of the vulva.

diseases.label: obsolete pseudorabies
diseases.definition: A Varicellovirus infectious disease that results_in infection located_in peripheral nervous system in swine, cattle, sheep, dogs and raccoons, has_material_basis_in Suid herpesvirus 1 and has_symptom abortion, has_symptom coughing, has_symptom sneezing, has_symptom fever, has_symptom constipation, has_symptom depression, has_symptom seizures, has_symptom ataxia, has_symptom circling, has_symptom excess salivation in piglets, and has_symptom intense itching in cattle.

diseases.label: bronchus carcinoma
diseases.definition: A bronchus cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

diseases.label: lung carcinoma
diseases.definition: A lung cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells and is located_in the lungs and has_symptom cough and has_symptom chest discomfort or pain and has_symptom weight loss and has_symptom hemoptysis.

diseases.label: lung squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A non-small cell lung carcinoma that has_material_basis_in the squamous cell.

diseases.label: lung non-small cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A lung carcinoma that is characterized as any type of epithelial lung cancer other than small cell lung carcinoma.

diseases.label: lung adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A lung non-small cell carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: progeria
diseases.definition: A progeroid syndrome characterized by extreme short stature, low body weight, early loss of hair, lipodystrophy, scleroderma, decreased joint mobility, osteolysis, and facial features that resemble aged persons that has_material_basis_in mutation in the LMNA gene on chromosome 1q22.

diseases.label: otitis interna
diseases.definition: An inner ear disease which involves inflammation of the inner ear.

diseases.label: Arenaviridae infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in rodents and humans, has_material_basis_in Arenaviridae viruses.

diseases.label: adrenocortical carcinoma
diseases.definition: An adrenal cortex cancer that forms in the outer layer of tissue of the adrenal gland and that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: adrenal carcinoma
diseases.definition: An adrenal cancer that is located_in the cortex (steroid hormone-producing tissue) of the adrenal gland and that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: adrenal cortex disease
diseases.definition: An adrenal gland disease that is located_in the adrenal cortex.

diseases.label: adrenal gland cancer
diseases.definition: An endocrine gland cancer located_in the adrenal glands which are located above the kidneys.

diseases.label: adrenal cortical adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An adrenocortical carcinoma that originates in the cortex of the adrenal gland and derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: Loeffler endocarditis
diseases.definition: A restrictive cardiomyopathy that affects the endocardium and occurs with white blood cell proliferation, specifically of eosinophils.

diseases.label: follicular thyroid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A differentiated thyroid gland carcinoma that has_material_basis_in follicular cells.

diseases.label: thyroid gland carcinoma
diseases.definition: A thyroid gland cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

diseases.label: papillary thyroid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A differentiated thyroid gland carcinoma that is characterized by the small mushroom shape of the tumor which has a stem attached to the epithelial layer and arises from the follicular cells of the thyroid gland.

diseases.label: restrictive cardiomyopathy
diseases.definition: An intrinsic cardiomyopathy characterized by impaired ventricular filling, with normal or decreased diastolic volume of either or both ventricles typically resulting from increased stiffness of the myocardium.

diseases.label: medullary thyroid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A thyroid gland carcinoma that has_material_basis_in parafollicular cells.

diseases.label: extrinsic cardiomyopathy
diseases.definition: A cardiomyopathy that is characterized by the pathology occurring outside of the myocardium.

diseases.label: pantothenate kinase-associated neurodegeneration
diseases.definition: A neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation that has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance of mutation in the PANK2 gene on chromosome 20p13.

diseases.label: Meige syndrome
diseases.definition: A cranio-facial dystonia that is accompanied by blepharospasm.

diseases.label: oesophagostomiasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves infection of the intestine in goats, pigs and humans by the nematode Oesophagostomum bifurcum. The symptoms are a low-grade fever, tenderness in the lower-right quadrant and painless cutaneous masses in the lower abdominal region. Rarely, Oesophagostomum spp will perforate the bowel wall, causing purulent peritonitis or migrate to the skin, producing cutaneous nodules.

diseases.label: obsolete Strongylus equinus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves infection of the intestine in horses by the nematode Strongylus equinus.

diseases.label: ostertagiasis
diseases.definition: A trichostrongyloidiasis that involves parasitic infection of the ruminant gastrointestinal tract by nematodes of the genus Ostertagia.

diseases.label: tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that is located_in lungs, located_in lymph nodes, located_in pericardium, located_in brain, located_in pleura or located_in gastrointestinal tract, has_material_basis_in Mycobacterium tuberculosis, which is transmitted_by droplets released into the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes.

diseases.label: urinary system cancer
diseases.definition: An organ system cancer that is located_in the kidneys, ureteres, bladder or urethra.

diseases.label: obsolete urinary tract infiltrating transitional cell carcinoma
Bartholin's gland transitional cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A Bartholin's gland carcinoma that derives_from transitional epithelial cells.

diseases.label: Bartholin's gland carcinoma
diseases.definition: A vulva carcinoma that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells and is located_in Bartholin's gland.

diseases.label: disease
diseases.definition: A disease is a disposition (i) to undergo pathological processes that (ii) exists in an organism because of one or more disorders in that organism.

diseases.label: ovary transitional cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian epithelial cancer that derives_from epithelial transitional cells.

diseases.label: ovarian carcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue and is located_in the ovary.

diseases.label: endometrial transitional cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: An endometrial carcinoma that derives_from transitional epithelial cells.

diseases.label: bladder urothelial carcinoma
diseases.definition: A bladder carcinoma that has_material_basis_in transitional cells located_in the lining of the bladder.

diseases.label: bladder carcinoma
diseases.definition: A urinary bladder cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: fallopian tube transitional cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A fallopian tube carcinoma that derives_from epithelial transitional cells.

diseases.label: obsolete renal pelvis and ureter transitional cell cancer
multidrug-resistant tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A tuberculosis that is resistant to isoniazid and rifampicin, the two most powerful first-line anti-TB drugs.

diseases.label: obsolete renal pelvis and ureter cancer
prostate transitional cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A prostate carcinoma that derives_from transitional epithelial cells.

diseases.label: papillary transitional carcinoma
diseases.definition: A transitional cell carcinoma that has several papillary fronds with central fibrovascular core lined by transitional type epithelium.

diseases.label: urethra transitional cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: An urethra cancer that is characterized by cancer cells forming in the renal pelvis and ureter.

diseases.label: sarcomatoid transitional cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A transitional cell carcinoma that has sarcoma-like components arising from the malignant transitional epithelium.

diseases.label: sarcomatoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of spindle cells and anaplastic morphologic features.

diseases.label: oral tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal tuberculosis that involves formation of painful ulcerative mucosal lesions located in tongue, located in palate, located in maxilla or located in mandible.

diseases.label: ureterocele
diseases.definition: A ureteral disease that is characterized_as a congenital anomaly in which the distal end of the ureter swells as it enters the bladder.

diseases.label: scirrhous adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that results in a hard structure owing to the formation of dense connective tissue in the stroma.

diseases.label: angioma serpiginosum
diseases.definition: A skin hemangioma that is characterized by the presence of small red dots that cluster together to form a linear or snake-like array or ring-shaped pattern located_in the blood vessels of the skin.

diseases.label: gastritis
diseases.definition: A stomach disease that is an inflammation of the lining of the stomach.

diseases.label: mouth disease
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system disease that is located_in the mouth.

diseases.label: bacterial gastritis
diseases.definition: A gastritis that involves inflammation of the stomach lining caused by bacteria. The disease has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom indigestion, has_symptom ulcer formation, has_symptom abdominal bloating, has_symptom nausea and has_symptom vomiting.

diseases.label: fungal gastritis
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system infectious disease that involves inflammation of the stomach lining caused by fungal infection in immunocompromised patients.

diseases.label: obsolete Helicobacter pylori gastritis
diseases.definition: A commensal Helicobacter infectious disease that involves inflammation of the stomach lining caused by Helicobacter pylori, which contributes to ulcer formation by increasing acid production, interfering with the normal defenses against stomach acid, and producing toxins. The symptoms include indigestion and pain or discomfort in the upper abdomen.

diseases.label: gastrointestinal tuberculosis
diseases.definition: An abdominal tuberculosis that results_in infection located_in gastrointestinal tract. The infection has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom weight loss, has_symptom fever, has_symptom anorexia, has_symptom constipation, has_symptom nausea, and has_symptom vomiting.

diseases.label: muscle cancer
diseases.definition: A musculoskeletal system cancer that is located_in muscle.

diseases.label: liver rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A rhabdomyosarcoma and sarcoma of liver that are located_in the liver.

diseases.label: mediastinum rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A rhabdomyosarcoma that is located_in the mediastinum and affects children and adolescents.

diseases.label: mediastinum sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma and malignant mediastinal mesenchymnal tumor that is located_in the mediastinum.

diseases.label: rectum rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A rectum sarcoma that is located_in the rectum in which the cancer cells are thought to arise from skeletal muscle progenitors.

diseases.label: prostate sarcoma
diseases.definition: A prostate cancer that is located_in the prostate.

diseases.label: gallbladder rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A gallbladder sarcoma that is located_in the gallbladder that has_material_basis_in cells that normally develop into skeletal (voluntary) muscles.

diseases.label: gallbladder sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma that is located_in the gallbladder.

diseases.label: ovary rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: An ovary sarcoma that arises from skeletal muscle progenitors.

diseases.label: breast rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A breast sarcoma that arises from skeletal muscle cells.

diseases.label: testis rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A testis sarcoma that arises from mesenchymal cells and is located_in the testis.

diseases.label: testis sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma and malignant neoplasm of testis that is located_in the testis.

diseases.label: bile duct sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma and malignant tumor of extrahepatic bile duct that is located_in the bile duct.

diseases.label: anus rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: A rhabdomyosarcoma and sarcoma of the anus that is located_in the anus.

diseases.label: anus sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma and malignant neoplasm of anus that is located_in the anus.

diseases.label: hepatic tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal tuberculosis that involves infection located_in liver, which results in the formation of tuberculous granulomas. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom anorexia, has_symptom weight loss, has_symptom abdominal pain and has_symptom jaundice.

diseases.label: duodenum disease
diseases.definition: An intestinal disease that is located_in the duodenum.

diseases.label: pancreatic adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A pancreatic carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: obsolete pleomorphic adenoma of the breast
obsolete metastasizing mixed tumor of salivary gland
tricuspid valve stenosis
diseases.definition: A tricuspid valve disease that is characterized by the narrowing of the orifice of the tricuspid valve of the heart. This causes increased resistance to blood flow through the valve.

diseases.label: heart valve disease
diseases.definition: A heart disease involving one or more of the four valves of the heart (the aortic and mitral valves on the left and the pulmonary and tricuspid valves on the right).

diseases.label: tricuspid valve insufficiency
diseases.definition: A tricuspid valve disease that is characterized by failure of the heart's tricuspid valve to close properly during systole. As a result, with each heart beat, blood is pumped out from the right side of the heart in the opposite direction to normal.

diseases.label: trophoblastic neoplasm
diseases.definition: A germ cell and embryonal cancer that derives_from trophoblastic tissue.

diseases.label: testicular germ cell tumor non-seminomatous
diseases.definition: A testicular germ cell cancer characterized by the absence of a seminomatous component.

diseases.label: obsolete Torovirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Coronaviridae infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Torovirus, which is transmitted_by ingestion of food contaminated with feces.

diseases.label: agnosia
diseases.definition: A communication disorder that is a loss of ability to recognize objects, persons, sounds, shapes, or smells while the specific sense is not defective nor is there any significant memory loss.

diseases.label: obsolete Caliciviridae infectious disease
diseases.definition: A (+)ssRNA virus infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Caliciviridae viruses.

diseases.label: obsolete vesicular exanthema of swine
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in_formation_of vesicles located_in epithelium of the snout, lips, nostrils, tongue, feet and mammary glands of swine, has_material_basis_in Vesicular exanthema of swine virus, which is transmitted_by direct contact.

diseases.label: obsolete rinderpest
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in cattle, has_material_basis_in Rinderpest virus, which is transmitted_by direct contact with an infected animal, or transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated water. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom nasal and eye discharge, and results_in_formation_of erosions in the mouth, the lining of the nose and the genital tract.

diseases.label: obsolete canine distemper
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection located_in respiratory system, located_in gastrointestinal system, and located_in nervous system of dogs, foxes, wolves, coyotes, raccoons, skunks, and ferrets, has_material_basis_in Canine distemper virus, which is transmitted_by droplet spread of respiratory secretions from an infected animal. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom nasal discharge, has_symptom coughing, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom seizures, and has_symptom twitching.

diseases.label: tick infestation
diseases.definition: A parasitic ectoparasitic infectious disease that involves parasitic infestation of blood feeding ticks of the families Ixodidae and Argasidae on animals and humans. Ticks are vectors of a number diseases, including Lyme disease, Q fever, Colorado tick fever, tularemia, tick-borne relapsing fever, babesiosis, ehrlichiosis and tick-borne meningoencephalitis, as well as anaplasmosis in cattle and canine jaundice.

diseases.label: parasitic ectoparasitic infectious disease
diseases.definition: A parasitic infectious disease that is caused by organisms that live primarily on the surface of the host.

diseases.label: cervical adenosarcoma
diseases.definition: A cervical carcinosarcoma that is located_in the cervix.

diseases.label: cervical carcinosarcoma
diseases.definition: A cervical cancer that has_material_basis_in carcinomatous (epithelial tissue) and sarcomatous (connective tissue) components.

diseases.label: uterine corpus adenosarcoma
diseases.definition: An adenosarcoma and malignant uterine body mixed neoplasm that derives_from the glands that line the uterus.

diseases.label: uterine body mixed cancer
diseases.definition: A uterine corpus cancer that has_material_basis_in more than one type of cell.

diseases.label: ovarian mesodermal adenosarcoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian carcinosarcoma that derives_from simultaneously or consecutively in mesodermal tissue and glandular epithelium.

diseases.label: vaginal adenosarcoma
diseases.definition: A vaginal carcinosarcoma derives_from the glands that line the uterus.

diseases.label: obsolete West Nile virus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Flavivirus infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in West Nile virus, which is transmitted_by Culex mosquitoes. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom headache, has_symptom body aches, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom swollen lymph glands, or has_symptom skin rash on the chest, stomach and back.

diseases.label: nail disease
diseases.definition: An integumentary system disease that is located_in nail.

diseases.label: obsolete avian tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A tuberculosis that is a chronic and progressive wasting and weakness caused by infection of companion, captive exotic, wild and domestic birds with Mycobacterium avium complex (serotypes 1, 2 and 3) and M. genavense.

diseases.label: erythrasma
diseases.definition: A pyoderma that is characterized by brown, scaly skin patches that are generalized or iterdigital (between the toes or fingers) and is caused by infection with corynebacterium minutissimum.

diseases.label: common bile duct disease
diseases.definition: A bile duct disease that is located_in the common bile duct.

diseases.label: bile duct disease
diseases.definition: A biliary tract disease located_in one or more bile ducts.

diseases.label: biliary dyskinesia
diseases.definition: A gallbladder disease characterized by altered tonus of the sphincter of Oddi, disturbance in the coordination of contraction of the biliary ducts, and/or reduction in the speed of emptying of the biliary tree.

diseases.label: intraorbital meningioma
diseases.definition: A meningioma by site and orbital neoplasm that is located_in the area around the eye sockets of the skull and results_in pressure in the eyes, giving a bulging appearance.

diseases.label: orbital cancer
diseases.definition: A bone cancer that is located_in the area behind the eye and derives_from the orbit or secondarily derives_from an adjacent source (eyelid, paranasal sinus, or intracranial compartment). It results_in the eye pushing forward causing a bulging of the eye called proptosis.

diseases.label: skull base chordoma
diseases.definition: A chordoma that is located_in the skull base.

diseases.label: chondroid chordoma
diseases.definition: A chordoma that histologically derives_from chordoma, derives_from chondroma, and derives_from chondrosarcoma.

diseases.label: spinal chordoma
diseases.definition: A chordoma that derives_from the spine.

diseases.label: dentinogenesis imperfecta
diseases.definition: A tooth disease characterized by discolored, opalescent teeth that has_material_basis_in mutation in the DSPP gene on chromosome 4q22.

diseases.label: primary syphilis
diseases.definition: A syphilis that is the first stage of syphilis, marked by the development of a chancre, which is characterized by mononuclear leukocytic infiltration, macrophages, and lymphocytes.

diseases.label: secondary syphilis
diseases.definition: A syphilis that is characterized as the second stage of syphilis which appears from 2 to 6 months after primary infection, and is marked by lesions especially in the skin but also in organs and tissues, and that lasts from 3 to 12 weeks.

diseases.label: skin cancer
diseases.definition: An integumentary system cancer located_in the skin that is the uncontrolled growth of abnormal skin cells.

diseases.label: cerebral neuroblastoma
diseases.definition: A brain cancer that is characterized by small, round and blue cells with rosette patterns on histology, that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells and derives_from precursor cells called blast cells.

diseases.label: syphilis
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that is a sexually transmitted systemic disease, has_material_basis_in Treponema pallidum subsp pallidum, which is transmitted_by sexual contact, transmitted_by blood product transfusion, transmitted_by congenital method from mother to fetus or transmitted_by contact with infectious lesions. If left untreated, produces chancres, rashes, and systemic lesions in a clinical course with three stages continued over many years.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease
diseases.definition: An immune system disease that is an overactive immune response of the body against substances and tissues normally present in the body resulting from an abnormal functioning of the immune system that results in the production of antibodies or T cell directed against the host tissues.

diseases.label: systemic scleroderma
diseases.definition: A scleroderma that is characterized by fibrosis (or hardening) of the skin and major organs, as well as vascular alterations, and autoantibodies.

diseases.label: articulation disorder
diseases.definition: A speech disorder that involves mispronouncing speech sounds by omitting, distorting, substituting, or adding sounds which can make speech difficult to understand.

diseases.label: echolalia
diseases.definition: A speech disorder that involves the automatic repetition of vocalizations made by another person.

diseases.label: mutism
diseases.definition: A speech disorder that involves a complete inability to speak.

diseases.label: scleroderma
diseases.definition: A rheumatic disease that involves the abnormal growth of connective tissue, which supports the skin and internal organs.

diseases.label: glucose metabolism disease
diseases.definition: A carbohydrate metabolic disorder that is characterized by blood glucose levels which cannot be maintained within the normal range.

diseases.label: femoral neuropathy
diseases.definition: A mononeuropathy that is characterized by a loss of movement or sensation in parts of the legs due to damage to the femoral nerve.

diseases.label: hypertrichosis
diseases.definition: A hair disease characterized by hair growth that is abnormal in quantity or location.

diseases.label: brain stem glioma
diseases.definition: A brain stem cancer that is characterized by mass lesion of the brainstem, associated cranial nerve nuclei and long tracts, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells, derives_from glial cells.

diseases.label: childhood brain stem neoplasm
diseases.definition: A brain stem cancer characterized by mass lesion of the brainstem in childhood, associated cranial nerve nuclei and long tracts, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells.

diseases.label: childhood infratentorial neoplasm
diseases.definition: A brain stem cancer in the infratentorial region of the brain in childhood, characterized by mass lesion of the brainstem, associated cranial nerve nuclei and long tracts, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells.

diseases.label: hair disease
diseases.definition: An integumentary system disease that is located_in hair.

diseases.label: posterior fossa meningioma
diseases.definition: A meningioma that affects the posterior cranial fossa.

diseases.label: malignant ovarian Brenner tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant ovarian surface epithelial-stromal neoplasm that has_material_basis_in the surface epithelium of the ovary.

diseases.label: congenital structural myopathy
diseases.definition: A myopathy that is characterized by hypotonia, muscle weakness, and delayed development of motor skills.

diseases.label: pyoderma
diseases.definition: A dermatitis that is characterized by a pyogenic infection causing the formation of pus.

diseases.label: obsolete adult soft tissue sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma that affects adults and is located_in the muscle, located_in fat, located_in fibrous tissue, located_in blood vessels, or located_in other supporting tissue of the body.

diseases.label: endometrial stromal sarcoma
diseases.definition: An endometrial stromal tumor that has_material_basis_in connective tissue.

diseases.label: uterine corpus endometrial stromal sarcoma
diseases.definition: A uterine corpus sarcoma that has_material_basis_in the connective tissue of the uterine lining.

diseases.label: myopathy
diseases.definition: A muscular disease in which the muscle fibers do not function resulting in muscular weakness.

diseases.label: extraosseous Ewing sarcoma
diseases.definition: A Ewing sarcoma that is morphologically indistinguishable from skeletal Ewing sarcoma but is located in extraosseous locations.

diseases.label: clear cell sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma that is characterized by solid nests and fascicles of tumor cells with clear cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli. It presents as a slow growing mass that especially affects tendons and aponeuroses and it is deeply situated.

diseases.label: spindle cell sarcoma
diseases.definition: A sarcoma that results_in cells that are spindle-shaped. They are usually resistant to radiation therapy.

diseases.label: carcinosarcoma
diseases.definition: A mixed cell type cancer that has_material_basis_in carcinomatous (epithelial tissue) and sarcomatous (connective tissue) components.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant soft tissue neoplasm of central nervous system
alveolar soft part sarcoma
diseases.definition: A soft tissue cancer that is a slow growing tumor of an unknown origin that effects children and effects young adults.

diseases.label: pulmonary immaturity
diseases.definition: A lung disease that is characterized by pulmonary collapse, accompanied by hypoventilation which can affect a lobe, segment, or all of the lung, resulting in a decrease in the ventilation/perfusion ratio.

diseases.label: kidney sarcoma
diseases.definition: A kidney cancer that is located in the kidney's connective tissue.

diseases.label: obsolete extraskeletal cartilaginous and osseous tumor
Gerstmann-Straussler-Scheinker syndrome
diseases.definition: A prion disease characterized by adult onset of memory loss, dementia, ataxia, and pathologic deposition of amyloid-like plaques in the brain.

diseases.label: obsolete certain conditions originating in the perinatal period
conjunctival disease
diseases.definition: An eye disease affecting the conjunctiva, which is the mucous membrane surrounding the eye and interior of the eyelids.

diseases.label: Alexander disease
diseases.definition: A leukodystrophy that is characterized by the destruction of white matter and the formation of Rosenthal fibers consisting of abnormal clumps of protein that accumulate in astrocytes.

diseases.label: melorheostosis
diseases.definition: An osteosclerosis that has_material_basis_in a mutation of the LEMD3 gene which results_in a hyperdense bony cortex.

diseases.label: osteosclerosis
diseases.definition: A bone remodeling disease that results_in abnormal elevated bone density or mass.

diseases.label: Caffey disease
diseases.definition: A bone inflammation disease that causes bone changes, soft tissue swelling and irritability in infants. The disease has been associated with COL1A1 gene. It has symptom soft-tissue swelling, has symptom bone lesions, and has symptom irritability.

diseases.label: Weissenbacher-Zweymuller syndrome
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that results_in shortened long bones and distinct facial abnormalities.

diseases.label: angiomyoma
diseases.definition: A leiomyoma that is located_in the blood vessels.

diseases.label: akinetic mutism
diseases.definition: A brain disease characterized by marked reduction of nearly all motor functions including facial expressions, gestures and speech output, but with some degree of alertness.

diseases.label: encephalitozoonosis
diseases.definition: A microsporidiosis that is a zoonotic infectious disease results_in disseminated fungal infection in dogs, cats, hamsters, guinea pigs, rats, mice and humans, has_material_basis_in Encephalitozoon cuniculi, has_material_basis_in Encephalitozoon intestinalis or has_material_basis_in Encephalitozoon hellem.

diseases.label: microsporidiosis
diseases.definition: An opportunistic mycosis that results_in systemic fungal infection in immunocompromised people, has_material_basis_in Microsporidia phylum members.

diseases.label: obsolete bovine hemorrhagic syndrome
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in cattle, has_material_basis_in Bovine viral diarrhea virus 2, which is transmitted_by ingestion of infected food, or transmitted_by nasal secretions. The infection has_symptom low grade fever, has_symptom bloody diarrhea, and has_symptom bleeding in the eyes.

diseases.label: obsolete Pestivirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in mammals, has_material_basis_in Pestivirus, which is transmitted_by contact with nasal secretions of an infected animal. The infection has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom respiratory problems, and has_symptom bleeding disorder.

diseases.label: penis basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma that is located_in the penis.

diseases.label: infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A variant of basal cell carcinoma characterized by follicular differentiation.

diseases.label: nodular basal cell carcinoma
