diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma characterized by elevated, pearl shaped nodules with telengactisae on the surface and periphery.

diseases.label: metatypical basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma characterized by intermediate typology between basal cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma.

diseases.label: pigmented basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma characterized by brown or black pigmentation.

diseases.label: anal margin basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma that is located_in the anal margin.

diseases.label: anal margin carcinoma
diseases.definition: An anal carcinoma that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells and is located_in the anal margin (where the canal meets the outside skin at the anus).

diseases.label: obsolete complications of pregnancy, childbirth and the puerperium
skin nasal cell carcinoma with sebaceous differentiation
diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma that is characterized by sebaceous differentiation and located in the skin.

diseases.label: external ear carcinoma
diseases.definition: An external ear cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: micronodular basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma characterized by solid tumor nodules.

diseases.label: gynatresia
diseases.definition: A female reproductive system disease that is characterized by the occlusion of some part of the female genital tract, especially occlusion of the vagina.

diseases.label: adenoid basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of thin strands of basaloid cells forming a reticulate pattern.

diseases.label: follicular basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma that is characterized by follicular differentiation.

diseases.label: scimitar syndrome
diseases.definition: A congenital heart disease that is characterized by partial or entire anomalous curved venous drainage of the right lung to the inferior vena cava, association with variable right lung and pulmonary artery hypoplasia, dextraposition of the heart and an anomalous systemic blood supply to the ipsilateral lung.

diseases.label: infiltrative basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma that is characterized by the formation of thin, small clusters in an infiltrative growth pattern.

diseases.label: vulva basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A vulva carcinoma that has_material_basis_in basal cells.

diseases.label: cystic basal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A nodular basal cell carcinoma that is characterized by a homogenous blue/black area.

diseases.label: bone giant cell tumor
diseases.definition: A benign giant cell tumor that results_in the presence of multinucleated giant cells.

diseases.label: radiculopathy
diseases.definition: A peripheral nervous system disease that is characterized by the pinching of a nerve root in the spine and has symptoms of pain, weakness, numbness and tingling.

diseases.label: polyradiculopathy
diseases.definition: A radiculopathy that is present in more than one nerve.

diseases.label: polyradiculoneuropathy
diseases.definition: A peripheral nervous system disease that is characterized by the co-occurance of polyneuropahty and polyradicuopathy and is located in both the spinal nerve roots and the peripheral nerves.

diseases.label: epidermolysis bullosa acquisita
diseases.definition: An acquired epidermolysis bullosa that is characterized by formation of recurrent blisters secondary to minor trauma in the skin and mucosa, and has_material_basis_in the development of autoantibodies to type VII collagen.

diseases.label: obsolete visna
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection located_in brain in sheep and goats, has_material_basis_in Visna/Maedi virus, which is transmitted_by droplet spread of oronasal secretion, and transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated water, milk or colostrum. The infection has_symptom hindlimb weakness, has_symptom head tilt, has_symptom ataxia, has_symptom incoordination, has_symptom muscle tremors, has_symptom paresis, and has_symptom paraplegia.

diseases.label: non-gestational choriocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A choriocarcicoma that develops in the absence of a preceding gestational event.

diseases.label: Ebola hemorrhagic fever
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that is a hemorrhagic fever, has_material_basis_in Zaire ebolavirus, has_material_basis_in Sudan ebolavirus, has_material_basis_in Cote d'Ivoire ebolavirus, or has_material_basis_in Bundibugyo ebolavirus, which are transmitted_by contact with the body fluids of an infected animal or person, transmitted by contaminated fomites, or transmitted by infected medical equipment. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom headache, has_symptom joint pain, has_symptom muscle aches, has_symptom sore throat, has_symptom weakness, has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom stomach pain, has_symptom rash, has_symptom red eyes, has_symptom hiccups, and has_symptom internal and external bleeding.

diseases.label: obsolete Filoviridae infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Mononegavirales infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Filoviridae viruses.

diseases.label: Marburg hemorrhagic fever
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that is a hemorrhagic fever, has_material_basis_in Orthomarburgvirus marburgense, which is transmitted_by contact with the body fluids of an infected person. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom chills, has_symptom headache, has_symptom myalgia, has_symptom maculopapular rash on the trunk, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom chest pain, has_symptom sore throat, has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom diarrhea, and has_symptom bleeding.

diseases.label: Erdheim-Chester disease
diseases.definition: A non-Langerhans-cell histiocytosis that is characterized by the proliferation in the tissues of lipid-laden macrophages and the presence of multinucleated giant cells. It results in sclerosis of the long bones and failure of the affected organs.

diseases.label: obsolete Intraventricular hemorrhage from any perinatal cause
non-Langerhans-cell histiocytosis
diseases.definition: A histiocytosis that is characterized by the accumulation of histiocytes that do not meet the phenotypic criteria for the diagnosis of Langerhans cells.

diseases.label: burning mouth syndrome
diseases.definition: A mouth disease that is characterized by long-lasting burning sensations of the mouth.

diseases.label: parovarian cyst
diseases.definition: A female reproductive system disease that is characterized by epithelium-lined fluid-filled cysts in the adnexa adjacent to the fallopian tube and ovary.

diseases.label: tinea favosa
diseases.definition: A tinea capitis that results_in fungal infection located_in scalp, located_in glabrous skin or located_in nail, has_material_basis_in Ascomycota fungi that belong to a group called dermatophytes and results_in_formation_of scutula, yellowish cup-shaped crusts of dense masses of mycelium and epithelial debris, which develop at the surface of a hair follicle with the shaft in the center of the raised lesion. Removal of these crusts reveals an oozing, moist, red base. Later, atrophy of the skin occurs leaving a cicatricial alopecia and scarring.

diseases.label: tinea capitis
diseases.definition: A dermatophytosis that results_in contagious fungal infection located_in scalp, located_in hair of head, located_in eyebrow or located_in eyelash, has_material_basis_in Ascomycota fungi that belong to a group called dermatophytes and has_symptom itching of the scalp, has_symptom pus filled lesions on the scalp, and has_symptom patches of hair loss, sometimes with a 'black dot' pattern.

diseases.label: obsolete complications occurring mainly in the course of labor and delivery
obsolete malignant neoplasm of thymus, heart and mediastinum
ciliary body disease
diseases.definition: An iris disease that is located_in the ciliary body.

diseases.label: cervical cancer
diseases.definition: A female reproductive organ cancer that is located_in the cervix.

diseases.label: malignant breast melanoma
diseases.definition: A breast cancer that arises_from melanocytes.

diseases.label: apparent mineralocorticoid excess syndrome
diseases.definition: A steroid inherited metabolic disorder characterized by decreased conversion of biologically active cortisol to inactive cortisone resulting in low aldosterone levels, metabolic alkalosis, hypernatremia, hypokalemia and early-onset severe hypertension that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the HSD11B2 gene on chromosome 16.

diseases.label: myasthenia gravis
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease of the nervous system that has_material_basis_in antibodies to acetylcholine receptors at the neuromuscular junction, has_symptom ptosis, has_symptom diplopia, has_symptom dysphagia, has_symptom dysarthria, has_symptom muscle weakness and has_symptom shortness of breath.

diseases.label: Schnitzler syndrome
diseases.definition: A hypersensitivity reaction type IV disease that is characterized by chronic urticarial rash and monoclonal IgM gammopathy, has_symptom rash, intermittent fever, arthralgia, and lymphadenopathy.

diseases.label: Silo filler's disease
diseases.definition: A lung disease that is characterized by inhalation of nitrogen oxides from exposure to silage gas in recently filled silos resulting in sudden death, pulmonary edema, and/or bronchiolitis obliterans.

diseases.label: milk allergy
diseases.definition: A food allergy that results in adverse immune reaction to one or more of the proteins in cow's milk and/or the milk of other animals, which are normally harmless to the non-allergic individual.

diseases.label: egg allergy
diseases.definition: A food allergy that is an allergy or hypersensitivity to dietary substances from the yolk or whites of eggs, causing an overreaction of the immune system which may lead to severe physical symptoms.

diseases.label: peanut allergy
diseases.definition: A legume allergy that is an allergy or hypersensitivity to dietary substances from peanuts causing an overreaction of the immune system which in a small percentage of people may lead to severe physical symptoms.

diseases.label: nut allergy
diseases.definition: A food allergy that develops_from exposure to and particularly consumption of nuts, and has_symptom asthma, skin rashes, throat and eye irritation, and anaphylaxis.

diseases.label: autoimmune disease of the nervous system
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease affecting the nervous system.

diseases.label: orbit alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: An orbit rhabdomyosarcoma that is characterized by ill-defined aggregates of poorly differentiated malignant cells that are loosely arranged and separated into irregular ovoid spaces by thin fibrovascular septa in an alveolar pattern which is absent in the solid form.

diseases.label: papillary squamous carcinoma
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that has papillae, which are characterized either by narrow fibrovascular cores that superficially resemble papillary carcinoma of the urinary tract or by broad cores that contain edematous fibrous stroma with prominent capillaries and stromal inflammation.

diseases.label: obsolete recurrent peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor
neuromuscular junction disease
diseases.definition: A neuromuscular disease that is characterized by the disfunction of conduction through the neuromuscular junction.

diseases.label: obsolete Henipavirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Paramyxoviridae infectious disease that results_in infection in domestic animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Henipavirus, which is transmitted_by direct contact with the urine, feces, and nasal secretions of an infected animal.

diseases.label: neuromuscular disease
diseases.definition: A neuropathy that affect the nerves that control the voluntary muscles.

diseases.label: phototoxic dermatitis
diseases.definition: An irritant dermatitis that is caused or precipitated by exposure to ultraviolet sunlight, or by mediating phototoxic or photoallergic material in response to ultraviolet sunlight.

diseases.label: obsolete contact dermatitis due to arnica
hepatitis E
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in liver, has_material_basis_in Hepatitis E virus, which is transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom fatigue, has_symptom loss of appetite, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom clay-colored bowel movements, has_symptom dark urine, has_symptom joint pain, and has_symptom jaundice.

diseases.label: obsolete Astroviridae infectious disease
diseases.definition: A (+)ssRNA virus infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Astroviridae viruses.

diseases.label: cervix melanoma
diseases.definition: A cervical cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from melanocytes.

diseases.label: sea-blue histiocytosis
diseases.definition: A sphingolipidosis characterized by dysfunctional metabolism of sphingolipids.

diseases.label: juvenile xanthogranuloma
diseases.definition: A non-Langerhans-cell histiocytosis is characterized as a benign skin lump or bump caused by a collection of cells called histiocytes. These may be red, orange or tan at first, but over time may become more yellow in color. These bumps usually appear on the head, neck and trunk.

diseases.label: dyslexia
diseases.definition: A reading disorder resulting from a developmental reading disability involving the inability to process graphic symbols resulting in impairment of reading ability.

diseases.label: central nervous system germ cell tumor
diseases.definition: A central nervous system cancer that is characterized by tumors near the pineal gland, the pituitary gland and the tissue just above it, develops from mismigrational pluripotent embryonic cells that remain in the brain after birth, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from germ cells.

diseases.label: seminoma
diseases.definition: A germinoma that has_material_basis_in cells that make sperm and eggs.

diseases.label: dysgerminoma
diseases.definition: A germ cell cancer that derives_from cells that give rise to egg cells.

diseases.label: cervical alveolar soft part sarcoma
diseases.definition: An alveolar soft part sarcoma and cervical soft tissue tumor and malignant neoplasm of cervix uteri that is located_in the cervix.

diseases.label: macular degeneration
diseases.definition: A retinal degeneration characterized by gradual deterioration of light-sensing cells in the tissues at the back of the eye and has_symptom vision loss.

diseases.label: renal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A renal carcinoma that has_material_basis_in the lining of the proximal convoluted renal tubule of the kidney.

diseases.label: renal carcinoma
diseases.definition: A kidney cancer that derives_from the lining of the proximal convoluted tubule (the very small tubes in the kidney that filter the blood and remove waste products).

diseases.label: primary hyperaldosteronism
diseases.definition: An adrenal gland hyperfunction disease that results in the overproduction of aldosterone by the adrenal glands.

diseases.label: multilocular clear cell renal cell carcinoma
collecting duct carcinoma
diseases.definition: A renal cell carcinoma that begins in distal collecting ducts of the kidney with a tubulopapillary morphology and intracytoplasmic mucicarminophilic material.

diseases.label: papillary renal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A renal cell carcinoma that is characterized by the development of multiple, bilateral papillary renal tumors.

diseases.label: clear cell renal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A renal cell carcinoma that has_material_basis_in cells that appear very pale or clear when examined under microscope.

diseases.label: clear cell adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells which have clear cytoplasm.

diseases.label: chromophobe renal cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A renal cell carcinoma that has_material_basis_in chromophobe cell that appear pale when viewed under microscope, but that are larger and display different features than clear cells.

diseases.label: mucinous tubular and spindle renal cell carcinoma
achondroplasia
diseases.definition: An osteochondrodysplasia that is characterized by short stature caused by rhizomelic shortening of the limbs, characteristic facies with frontal bossing and midface hypoplasia, exaggerated lumbar lordosis, limitation of elbow extension, genu varum, and trident hand and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the fibroblast growth factor receptor-3 gene (FGFR3) on chromosome 4p16.3. Achondroplasia results in dwarfism due to the abnormal ossification of cartilage in the long bone.

diseases.label: allergic rhinitis
diseases.definition: A rhinitis that is an allergic inflammation and irritation of the nasal airways involving sneezing, runny nose, nasal congestion, itching and tearing of the eyes caused by exposure to an allergen such as pollen, dust, mold, animal dander and droppings of cockroaches or house dust mites.

diseases.label: rhinitis
diseases.definition: A upper respiratory infectious disease which involves irritation and inflammation of the mucous membrane of the nose due to viruses, bacteria or irritants. The inflammation results in generation of excessive amounts of mucus leading to runny nose, as well as nasal congestion and post-nasal drip.

diseases.label: malignant peritoneal solitary fibrous tumor
diseases.definition: A peritoneum cancer that is characterized by the presence of prominent hemangiopericytoma-like vessels and that arises from the peritoneum.

diseases.label: persian gulf syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome affecting returning military veterans and civilian workers of the Gulf War.

diseases.label: avian influenza
diseases.definition: An influenza that results in infection located in respiratory tract of humans, domestic and wild birds, has_material_basis_in Influenza A virus, which is transmitted by contact with infected poultry. Five strains of avian influenza A viruses (H5N1, H7N3, H7N2, H7N7 and H9N2) are known to cause human infections. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom cough, has_symptom sore throat, has_symptom muscle aches, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom neurologic changes, has_symptom pneumonia, and has_symptom acute respiratory distress.

diseases.label: obsolete Orthomyxoviridae infectious disease
diseases.definition: A (-)ssRNA virus infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Orthomyxoviridae family viruses, which are transmitted_by droplet spread of respiratory secretions or transmitted_by contaminated fomites.

diseases.label: obsolete metastatic malignant neoplasm to the cervix
myotonic disease
diseases.definition: A muscular dystrophy that is characterized by progressive muscle wasting and weakness.

diseases.label: orofaciodigital syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by malformations of the face, oral cavity, and digits.

diseases.label: central nervous system angiosarcoma
diseases.definition: A central nervous system sarcoma that is located_in the inner lining of blood vessels.

diseases.label: childhood angiosarcoma
diseases.definition: An angiosarcoma that affects children.

diseases.label: aorta angiosarcoma
diseases.definition: An angiosarcoma that is located_in the aorta.

diseases.label: breast angiosarcoma
diseases.definition: An angiosarcoma and sarcoma of breast and vascular neoplasm of breast that is located_in the cells that line the blood vessels within the breast or underarm area.

diseases.label: gallbladder angiosarcoma
diseases.definition: An angiosarcoma and gallbladder sarcoma that is located_in the gallbladder.

diseases.label: thyroid angiosarcoma
diseases.definition: A thyroid sarcoma and angiosarcoma that results_in a high prevalence of iodine-deficient goiter.

diseases.label: thyroid sarcoma
diseases.definition: A thyroid gland cancer that is located_in the supporting cells of the thyroid.

diseases.label: skin angiosarcoma
diseases.definition: An angiosarcoma and hemangioma of skin and malignant skin vascular tumor and sarcoma of skin that is located_in the skin and results_in an enlarged bruise (a blue-black nodule) and an unhealed ulceration.

diseases.label: pleomorphic adenoma
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system benign neoplasm that is a located_in the salivary glands.

diseases.label: cervical endometrial stromal sarcoma
diseases.definition: A cervix endometrical stromal tumor that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from embryonic mesoderm.

diseases.label: cervix endometrial stromal tumor
diseases.definition: A cervical cancer that derives_from the fibrous connective tissue of the endometrium.

diseases.label: prostate angiosarcoma
diseases.definition: An angiosarcoma and sarcoma of prostate that is located_in the prostate.

diseases.label: mediastinum angiosarcoma
diseases.definition: An angiosarcoma and sarcoma of the mediastinum that is located_in the mediastinum.

diseases.label: ovarian angiosarcoma
diseases.definition: An ovary sarcoma that is a malignant vascular tumor that derives_from blood vessels.

diseases.label: mucoepidermoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of cuboidal mucous cells, goblet-like mucous cells, squamoid cells, cystic changes, and a fibrotic stromal formation.

diseases.label: Hallermann-Streiff syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that affects growth, cranial development, hair growth and dental development.

diseases.label: hypotrichosis
diseases.definition: A hair disease that is characterized by sparse hair on the scalp resulting from abnormal hair follicle development and has_material_basis_in mutations in proteins involved in hair growth, division or proliferation of cells within hair follicles.

diseases.label: dysgraphia
diseases.definition: A writing disorder that involves a deficiency in the ability to write where the writing is distorted or incorrect, spelling difficulty, poor handwriting or trouble putting thoughts on paper.

diseases.label: nominal aphasia
diseases.definition: An agnosia that involves a severe problem with recalling words or names.

diseases.label: retrograde amnesia
diseases.definition: An amnestic disorder that involves a loss of one's pre-existing memories to conscious recollection.

diseases.label: adult mesenchymal chondrosarcoma
diseases.definition: An adult sarcoma of soft tissue and mesenchymal chondrosarcoma that is located_in the cartilage.

diseases.label: extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma
diseases.definition: A chondrosarcoma that is located_in exclusively soft tissue and that is characterized by the presence of chondroblast-like cells in a myxoid stroma and a multinodular growth pattern.

diseases.label: large cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that is composed of large, monotonous rounded or overtly polygonal-shaped cells with abundant cytoplasm.

diseases.label: ovarian large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovarian carcinoma that is characterized by large pleiomorphic cells with large round or oval nuclei, presence of mitoses and staining for neuroendocrine (NE) markers and has_material_basis_in neuroendocrine cells.

diseases.label: oral leukoedema
diseases.definition: A mouth disease that is characterized by the presence of filmy opalescence of the mucosa in the early stages to a whitish gray cast with a coarsely wrinkled surface in the later stages, associated with intracellular edema of the spinous or malpighian layer.

diseases.label: ascariasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves infection of the intestine with the nematode Ascaris lumbricoides. Larvae migrating through the lungs cause cough, wheezing and hemoptysis. Bowel or biliary obstruction causes cramping abdominal pain, nausea, and vomiting. Peritonitis, enlargement of the liver or spleen, toxicity and pneumonia are observed when larvae get into the portal circulation.

diseases.label: non specific chronic endometritis
diseases.definition: An endometritis that is present for weeks or more and does not have an identifiable causative organism.

diseases.label: granulomatous endometritis
diseases.definition: An endometritis that is characterized by the presence of granulomas in the uterus.

diseases.label: obsolete Ascaridida infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Chromadorea infectious disease that involves infection of humans and domestic animals by parasitic roundworms with three lips on the anteriour end.

diseases.label: obsolete deletion of short arm of chromosome 1 (1p) associated meningioma
obsolete deletion of chromosome 22 associated meningioma
obsolete central nervous system adult tumor
obsolete deletion of chromosome 3p associated meningioma
epidermolytic hyperkeratosis
diseases.definition: An ichthyosis that is characterized by generalized erythema, skin blisters and skin fragility, manifested at birth.

diseases.label: bile duct cancer
diseases.definition: A biliary tract cancer that is located_in the bile duct.

diseases.label: biliary tract cancer
diseases.definition: A hepatobiliary system cancer that results_in malignant growth located_in the gallbladder or located_in the bile duct.

diseases.label: intestinal benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal system benign neoplasm that is located_in the intestine.

diseases.label: obsolete bovine atypical interstitial pneumonia
diseases.definition: A bovine respiratory disease complex defined as an acute, noncontagious respiratory distress caused 5-10days after change to a better, often lush, pasture. Metabolites of the naturally occurring amino acid L-tryptophan probably are responsible for the disease. Severely affected cattle show extensive respiratory distress with mouth breathing, extension of the tongue, and drooling. There is extensive edema and emphysema, often with the formation of large air-filled bullae in interlobular and subpleural regions of the lung.

diseases.label: maxillary cancer
diseases.definition: A jaw cancer that effects the maxilla or upper jaw.

diseases.label: obsolete cancer by anatomical entity
diseases.definition: A cancer that affects an anatomical entity.

diseases.label: holoprosencephaly
diseases.definition: A congenital nervous system abnormality characterized by failed or incomplete separation of the forebrain early in gestation; it is accompanied by a spectrum of characteristic craniofacial anomalies.

diseases.label: Ollier disease
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by an asymmetric distribution of cartilagenous tumors, which may lead to skeletal deformities and limb-length discrepancy. This condition primarily affects the long bones and cartilage of the joints of the arms and legs, specifically the area where the shaft and head of a long bone meet.

diseases.label: obsolete porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection causing reproductive failure of sows and respiratory problems of piglets and growing pigs, has_material_basis_in Porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus, which is transmitted_by contact with feces, urine and semen of infected pigs, and transmitted_by fomites. The infection has_symptom stillborn piglets, has_symptom mummified fetuses, has_symptom premature farrowings, has_symptom weak-born pigs, and has_symptom pneumonia.

diseases.label: obsolete inverted papilloma of paranasal sinus
epidermolysis bullosa simplex
diseases.definition: An epidermolysis bullosa that is characterized by recurrent blistering at the level of the epidermis secondary to minor trauma, which can cause limited wounds, dehydration, electrolyte abnormalities, severe infection, among other issues, and has_material_basis_in mutation in the KRT5, KRT14, or PLEC genes, which encode keratin and plectin proteins that provide resilience in skin.

diseases.label: trilateral retinoblastoma
diseases.definition: A retinoblastoma that refers to bilateral retinoblastoma associated with an intracranial primitive neuroectodermal tumor located_in the pineal or suprasellar region.

diseases.label: bilateral retinoblastoma
diseases.definition: A retinoblastoma that develops in both eyes.

diseases.label: unilateral retinoblastoma
diseases.definition: A retinoblastoma that effects only one eye.

diseases.label: intraocular retinoblastoma
diseases.definition: A retinoblastoma that is located_in the eye and has not spread to other parts of the body.

diseases.label: extraocular retinoblastoma
diseases.definition: A retinoblastoma that has spread from the soft tissues surrounding the eye or to the optic nerve beyond the margin of resection to other parts of the body.

diseases.label: multiple chemical sensitivity
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is an adverse physical reaction to low levels of many common chemicals.

diseases.label: thalamic disease
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by Dejerine-Roussy syndrome that develops from thalamic injury.

diseases.label: kyphosis
diseases.definition: A bone structure disease that has_material_basis_in an abnormal curvature located_in vertebral column.

diseases.label: congenital kyphosis
diseases.definition: A kyphosis that results_in abnormal formation located_in body of vertebra.

diseases.label: androgen insensitivity syndrome
diseases.definition: A disorder of sexual development that is characterized by the inability of the cell to respond to androgens in individuals with a karyotype of 46,XY resulting in female physical traits but male genetic makeup.

diseases.label: keratitis
diseases.definition: A corneal disease that is characterized by inflammation of the cornea.

diseases.label: thymus mucoepidermoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in the thymus.

diseases.label: breast mucoepidermoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast metaplastic carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of four cell types (basaloid, intermediate, epidermoid, and mucinous) in varying proportions.

diseases.label: breast metaplastic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast carcinoma that represents a mixed group of malignant neoplasms characterized by the histologic presence of two or more cellular types.

diseases.label: bile duct mucoepidermoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in a bile duct.

diseases.label: extrahepatic bile duct carcinoma
diseases.definition: A cholangiocarcinoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts.

diseases.label: lacrimal gland mucoepidermoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in the lacrimal gland.

diseases.label: thyroid gland mucoepidermoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A thyroid gland carcinoma that is composed of groups of squamoid and mucous cells, surrounded by fibrous tissue.

diseases.label: laryngeal mucoepidermoid carcinoma
diseases.definition: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in the larynx.

diseases.label: malignant mediastinal neurogenic neoplasm
diseases.definition: A mediastinal cancer that has_material_basis_in neural cells.

diseases.label: endophthalmitis
diseases.definition: A globe disease that is characterized by inflammation of the inside of the eye.

diseases.label: infratentorial cancer
diseases.definition: A brain cancer that is located_in the infratentorial region.

diseases.label: extragonadal germ cell cancer
diseases.definition: A germ cell cancer that derives_from germ cells that are found in areas of the body other than the ovary or testicle. The tumors originate in the sperm forming cells in the testicles or egg producing cells in the ovary.

diseases.label: bone giant cell sarcoma
diseases.definition: A malignant giant cell tumor that is composed_of multinucleated giant cells.

diseases.label: intracranial hypotension
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by low pressure inside the skull, and thus in the brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid; may occur as a result of an occult or iatrogenically caused leak of CSF into another body cavity; may result in the downward displacement of the cerebellar tonsils through the foramen magnum or Chiari malformation; has_symptom orthostatic headache; other symptoms are related to compression of cranial nerves due to brain sagging.

diseases.label: brain edema
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by excess accumulation of fluid in the intracellular and/or extracellular spaces of the brain, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom blurred vision, has_symptom seizure, has_symptom coma.

diseases.label: vasomotor rhinitis
diseases.definition: A rhinitis which involves a hypersensitive reaction to various potentially irritating stimuli such as changes in weather, temperature, or barometric pressure, chemical irritants such as smoke, ozone, pollution, perfumes, and aerosol sprays, psychological stress and emotional shocks, medications, alcohol, and spicy food.

diseases.label: atrophic rhinitis
diseases.definition: A rhinitis which involves inflammation of the nose characterized by atrophy of nasal mucosa including the glands, turbinate bones, and the nerve elements supplying the nose that is caused by heredity factors, endocrine imbalance, nutritional deficiency, bacterial infection and autoimmune issues.

diseases.label: somatoform disorder
diseases.definition: A disease of mental health that involves physical symptoms suggesting a physical illness where the biological or medical cause of the symptoms is indeterminate.

diseases.label: obsolete Iris or ciliary body disorder
testicular Brenner tumor
diseases.definition: A testicular cancer that has_material_basis_in the surface epithelium of the testis and is characterized by the presence of cysts lined by transitional cells and solid nests of transitional cells in a spindle cell stroma.

diseases.label: obsolete mixed embryonal carcinoma and teratoma of the testis
mixed testicular germ cell tumor
diseases.definition: A mixed germ cell cancer that is located_in the testis.

diseases.label: placenta accreta
diseases.definition: A placenta disease that is characterized by an abnormally deep attachment of the placenta, through the endometrium and into the myometrium.

diseases.label: obsolete Dictyocaulus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A trichostrongyloidiasis that involves parasitic infection of the bronchial tree of horses, sheep, goats, deer, and cattle by nematodes of the genus Dictyocaulus.

diseases.label: testicular sex cord-stromal neoplasm
diseases.definition: A sex cord-gonadal stromal tumor that is located_in the testis.

diseases.label: breast hemangioma
diseases.definition: A breast benign neoplasm that is characterized by a collection of excess blood vessels.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant catarrh
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in cattle and other ruminants, has_material_basis_in Macavirus and has_symptom fever, has_symptom bilateral corneal opacity, and has_symptom oculonasal discharge.

diseases.label: vasculogenic impotence
diseases.definition: An impotence that is characterized by an inability to achieve and maintain an erection due to defects in the arterial blood flow to the penis or a defect in venous occlusive function allowing blood drainage from the erectile tissue.

diseases.label: pulmonary blastoma
diseases.definition: A lung cancer that has_material_basis_in tissues of the lung and has_material_basis_in pleural tissues. It is most commonly effects children.

diseases.label: embryoma
diseases.definition: A carcinosarcoma and embryonal cancer that is located_in embryonic tissue and results_in a mass of rapidly growing cells.

diseases.label: pleuropulmonary blastoma
diseases.definition: A pulmonary blastoma that derives_from the lung or pleural cavity.

diseases.label: obsolete mesoblastic nephroma
diseases.definition: A kidney cancer that is found in the kidney and is usually found before birth by ultrasound or within the first 3 months of life.

diseases.label: congenital mesoblastic nephroma
diseases.definition: A kidney cancer that is characterized by the presence of fibroblastic cells.

diseases.label: obsolete feline acquired immunodeficiency syndrome
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in domesticated housecats, has_material_basis_in Feline immunodeficiency virus, which is transmitted_by contact with the infected cat's saliva during deep bite wounds, and transmitted_by congenital method. The virus attacks the immune system infecting CD4+ and CD8+ T lymphocytes, B lymphocytes, and macrophages. Some of the symptoms are loss of weight, malaise, pyrexia, anemia, gastroenteritis, gingivitis, stomatitis, diarrhea, infections of the skin, eyes, urinary tract, respiratory tract, and diseases of the nervous system.

diseases.label: anti-basement membrane glomerulonephritis
diseases.definition: A Goodpasture syndrome that is characterized by damage to only kidney capillaries.

diseases.label: obsolete primitive neuroectodermal tumor with Leptomeningeal Spread
obsolete embryonal Tumor with Multilayered Rosettes, C19MC-Altered
GM2 gangliosidosis, AB variant
diseases.definition: A GM2 gangliosidosis that is characterized by normal hexosaminidase A (HEXA) and hexosaminidase B (HEXB) but the inability to form a functional GM2 activator complex.

diseases.label: male reproductive system disease
diseases.definition: A reproductive system disease that affects male reproductive organs.

diseases.label: movement disease
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by a clinical syndrome of either hyperkinetic movement or hyperkinetic movement unrelated to weakness or spasticity.

diseases.label: obsolete border disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in sheep and goats, has_material_basis_in Border disease virus, which is transmitted_by congenital method. The infection has_symptom abortion, has_symptom stillbirth, has_symptom hairy fleece in lambs, and has_symptom abnormal body conformation.

diseases.label: obsolete swine vesicular disease
diseases.definition: An Enterovirus infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Swine vesicular disease virus, which is transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food, or transmitted_by contact with an infected animal. The infection results_in_formation_of vesicles in the mouth, snout and feet, and has_symptom lameness.

diseases.label: obsolete Enterovirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Enterovirus, which is transmitted_by direct contact with secretions from an infected person, transmitted_by fomites, transmitted_by droplet spread of oronasal secretions from an infected person, or transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food.

diseases.label: obsolete enzootic porcine encephalomyelitis
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in brain and located_in spinal cord of pigs, has_material_basis_in Porcine teschovirus, which is transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food, and transmitted_by contaminated fomites. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom anorexia, has_symptom depression, has_symptom incoordination, has_symptom paralysis, has_symptom muscle tremors, has_symptom stiffness, has_symptom nystagmus, has_symptom seizures, and has_symptom loss of the voice.

diseases.label: obsolete central nervous system hereditary degenerative disease
cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis
diseases.definition: A xanthomatosis that is characterized by a deficiency in the production of the bile acid, chenodeoxycholic acid that has_material_basis_in autosomal recessive inheritance and results in cholestanol deposition in the brain and other tissues and with elevated levels of cholesterol in plasma.

diseases.label: adult brain stem glioma
diseases.definition: A brain stem cancer that is characterized by mass lesion of the brainstem in adulthood, associated cranial nerve nuclei and long tracts, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells and derives_from glial cells.

diseases.label: ganglioneuroma
diseases.definition: An autonomic nervous system benign neoplasm that is characterized by the presence of mature ganglion cells and a mature Schwannian stroma and arises from the sympathetic trunk in the mediastinum.

diseases.label: obsolete lung occult non-small cell carcinoma
adenosquamous lung carcinoma
diseases.definition: An adenosquamous carcinoma located_in lung that derives_from lung tissue composed of at least 10% by volume each of squamous cell carcinoma (SqCC) and adenocarcinoma (AdC) cells.

diseases.label: adenosquamous carcinoma
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that contains squamous cells and gland-like cells.

diseases.label: obsolete non small cell lung cancer recurrent
Gorham's disease
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by bone loss (osteolysis) which is often associated with swelling or abnormal blood vessel growth (angiomatous proliferation). Bone loss can occur in just one bone or spread to soft tissue and adjacent bones.

diseases.label: myoepithelial carcinoma
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that derives_from myoepithelial cells.

diseases.label: sebaceous carcinoma
diseases.definition: A skin cancer that arises from the sebaceous glands.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant tumor of epidermal appendage
pilomyxoid astrocytoma
diseases.definition: A pilocytic astrocytoma that is characterized by a monomorphic architectural pattern, usually associated with the absence of Rosenthal fibers and eosinophilic granular bodies.

diseases.label: pilocytic astrocytoma
diseases.definition: A childhood low-grade glioma that is characterized by cells that look like fibers when viewed under a microscope and is located_in the brain.

diseases.label: pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma
diseases.definition: A low grade glioma that is characterized by pleomorphic and lipidized cells expressing GFAP often surrounded by a reticulin network and eosinophilic granular bodies.

diseases.label: diffuse astrocytoma
diseases.definition: A low grade glioma that is characterized by diffuse infiltration of neighboring central nervous system structures.

diseases.label: brain stem astrocytic neoplasm
diseases.definition: A brain stem glioma that is characterized by mass lesion of the brainstem, associated cranial nerve nuclei and long tracts, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from astrocytes.

diseases.label: obsolete Rubella virus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Rubella virus, which is transmitted_by direct contact with the infected person through coughing and sneezing, and transmitted_by congenital method.

diseases.label: obsolete Togaviridae infectious disease
diseases.definition: A (+)ssRNA virus infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Togaviridae viruses.

diseases.label: salivary gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A salivary gland carcinoma that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests or cords of epithelial cells surround and/or infiltrate ducts or glandular structures within the affected organ. These structures are typically filled with a mucous-like material or contain abnormal fibrous membranes.

diseases.label: cervical adenoid cystic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A cervix carcinoma that is characterized by its resemblance to adenoid cystic carcinoma of the salivary glands. It shows pseudoglandular, cribriform-like and tubular patterns containing basement membrane-like material. Cytologically, the nuclei are angulated and hyperchromatic, without prominent nucleoli.

diseases.label: anterior horn cell disease
diseases.definition: A motor neuron disease that is characterized by lower motor neuron signs of wasting, weakness, and loss of reflexes and that is located in the anterior horn of the spinal cord that contains the motor neurons responsible for body muscles.

diseases.label: trachea carcinoma
diseases.definition: A tracheal cancer that effects the airway that leads from the larynx to the bronchi.

diseases.label: breast adenoid cystic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of a dual cell population of luminal and basaloid cells arranged in specific growth patterns.

diseases.label: esophageal adenoid cystic carcinoma
diseases.definition: An esophageal carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of the salivary gland.

diseases.label: Bartholin's gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A Bartholin's gland carcinoma that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests and columns of cells of bland appearance are arranged concentrically around glandlike spaces filled with eosinophilic periodic acid-Schiff-positive diastase-resistant material.

diseases.label: kidney clear cell sarcoma
diseases.definition: A kidney sarcoma that has_material_basis_in clear cells that are characterized as cells that look clear when viewed under a microscope.

diseases.label: obsolete pediatric soft part clear cell sarcoma
Colorado tick fever
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Colorado tick fever virus, which is transmitted_by rocky mountain wood tick, Dermacentor andersoni. The infection has_symptom fever for 2-3 days, followed by an afebrile period of similar duration and then another 2-3 days of fever, has_symptom headache, has_symptom myalgia, and has_symptom fatigue.

diseases.label: obsolete Rotavirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A Reoviridae infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in stomach and located_in intestine, has_material_basis_in Rotavirus, which is transmitted_by ingestion of contaminated food or water, or transmitted_by fomites. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom diarrhea, and has_symptom abdominal pain.

diseases.label: lymph node tuberculosis
diseases.definition: An extrapulmonary tuberculosis that is located_in lymph node, and has_symptom lymphadenopathy, has_symptom fever, has_symptom weight loss, has_symptom fatigue, has_symptom night sweats and has_symptom cough.

diseases.label: juvenile myoclonic epilepsy
diseases.definition: A adolescence-adult electroclinical syndrome that is characterized by brief, involuntary twitching of a muscle or a group of muscles (myoclonus) early in the morning with onset between 12 and 18 years.

diseases.label: middle ear adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A middle ear carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: middle ear carcinoma
diseases.definition: A middle ear cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: rete ovarii adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovary adenocarcinoma that arises from the rete ovarii.

diseases.label: rete ovarii benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A female reporoductive organ benign neoplasm that is located_in the rete ovarii.

diseases.label: bile duct adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A bile duct carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: bile duct carcinoma
diseases.definition: A bile duct cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: appendix carcinoma
diseases.definition: An appendix cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: granular cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells, with polygonal accumulation of secondary lysosomes in the cytoplasm.

diseases.label: pancreatic carcinoma
diseases.definition: A pancreas cancer that derives_from epithelial cells located_in the exocrine pancreas.

diseases.label: small intestine adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A small intestine carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: small intestine carcinoma
diseases.definition: A small intestine cancer that develops from epithelial cells and is located_in the small intestine.

diseases.label: anal carcinoma
diseases.definition: A anus cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells and is located_in the anus.

diseases.label: urethra adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An urethra cancer that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: esophagus adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An esophageal carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: villous adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, with villous architecture.

diseases.label: renal pelvis adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A renal pelvis carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: eccrine adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An eccrine sweat gland cancer that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: breast secretory carcinoma
diseases.definition: A breast adenocarcinoma that has_material_basis_in cells with abundant granular or clear vacuolated cytoplasm.

diseases.label: thymus adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A thymic carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: obsolete human papillomavirus related adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A human papillomavirus related carcinoma that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in human papillomaviruses (types 16, 18, 31, 39 or 45), which cause lesions that progress to cancers.

diseases.label: obsolete human papillomavirus related carcinoma
diseases.definition: A papillomavirus infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in human papillomavirus (types 16, 18, 31, 32 or 33), which cause intraepithelial lesions that may progress to carcinomas.

diseases.label: bronchiolo-alveolar adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A lung adenocarcinoma characterized by a predominantly lepidic pattern and 5 mm or less invasion in greatest dimension.

diseases.label: Klatskin's tumor
diseases.definition: An intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma arising near or at the confluence of the right and left hepatic ducts.

diseases.label: intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A cholangiocarcinoma that arises from the intrahepatic bile duct epithelium in any site of the intrahepatic biliary tree.

diseases.label: tubular adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue. The tumor has branched angular tubules embedded in a loose fibrous stroma.

diseases.label: nasal cavity adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A nasal cavity carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: nasal cavity carcinoma
diseases.definition: A nasal cavity cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

diseases.label: ampulla of Vater carcinoma
diseases.definition: An ampulla of Vater cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: apocrine carcinoma
diseases.definition: An apocrine sweat gland cancer that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: ureter adenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: An ureter carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: ureter carcinoma
diseases.definition: An ureter cancer that is located_in the ureter.

diseases.label: obsolete combined hepatocellular carcinoma and cholangiocarcinoma
adenocarcinoma in situ
diseases.definition: An in situ carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

diseases.label: cholangiocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A bile duct adenocarcinoma that has_material_basis_in bile duct epithelial cells.

diseases.label: gallbladder carcinoma
diseases.definition: A gallbladder cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from epithelial cells.

diseases.label: postpoliomyelitis syndrome
diseases.definition: A poliomyelitis that results in atrophy located in muscle, many years after the initial infection, has_material_basis_in Human poliovirus 1, has_material_basis_in Human poliovirus 2, or has_material_basis_in Human poliovirus 3. It is characterized by new weakening in muscles that were previously affected by the polio infection and in muscles that were unaffected. The infection has symptom muscle weakness, has symptom muscle pain, has symptom sleep apnea, and has symptom breathing problems.

obsolete Sezary's disease involving intra-abdominal lymph nodes
gas gangrene
diseases.definition: A commensal bacterial infectious disease that results in infection, located in muscle tissue, has_material_basis_in Clostridium perfringens, which produce gas that becomes trapped in the infected tissue. Gas gangrene usually develops after injuries or surgery. The infection has symptom large blisters, has symptom pain in the infected area, has symptom myonecrosis, has symptom gas production, and has symptom sepsis.

diseases.label: obsolete Sezary's disease involving intrapelvic lymph nodes
achalasia
diseases.definition: An esophageal disease that is characterized by an inability of the esophagus to move food toward the stomach resulting from the lower esophogeal sphincter not fully relaxing during swallowing.

diseases.label: Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by abnormal immune system function and a reduced ability to form blood clots resulting from a decrease in the number and size of blood cell fragments involved in clotting (microthrombocytopenia).

diseases.label: rectum carcinoma in situ
diseases.definition: An in situ carcinoma that is located_in the rectum.

diseases.label: obsolete amebic colitis
diseases.definition: An amebiasis that involves infection of the intestine with the protozoan parasite Entamoeba histolytica trophozoites resulting in intermittent nondysenteric diarrhea with abdominal pain, mucus, flatulence, and weight loss. Chronic infection manifests as tender, palpable masses or annular lesions (amebomas) in the cecum and ascending colon.

diseases.label: amebiasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic protozoa infectious disease that involves infection caused by the amoeba Entamoeba histolytica. Amebic invasion of the intestinal lining causes dysentery, colitis or diarrhea. The infection can also spread through the blood to the liver and, rarely, to the lungs, brain or other organs.

diseases.label: pemphigus
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease of skin and connective tissue that is characterized by blistering of the outer layer of the skin and mucous membranes (mouth, nose, throat, eyes, and genitals), causing lesions and blisters that are easily ruptured.

diseases.label: obsolete Hodgkin's paragranuloma involving lymph nodes of inguinal region and lower limb
obsolete Herpes simplex virus keratitis
diseases.definition: A Simplexvirus infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in cornea of the eye, has_material_basis_in Human herpesvirus 1 or has_material_basis_in Human herpesvirus 2, and has_symptom photophobia, has_symptom blurred vision, has_symptom tearing, has_symptom pain, and has_symptom redness.

diseases.label: obsolete Sezary's disease involving intrathoracic lymph nodes
speech disorder
diseases.definition: A communication disorder that involves difficulty with the act of speech production.

diseases.label: lichen planus
diseases.definition: A lichen disease that is located_in skin, located_in tongue or located_in oral mucosa, which presents itself in the form of papules, lesions or rashes.

diseases.label: obsolete disorder of optic chiasm associated with pituitary neoplasm and disorder
obsolete Burkitt's tumor or lymphoma involving intra-abdominal lymph nodes
Barrett's esophagus
diseases.definition: An esophageal disease characterized by a change of normal esophageal squamous epithelium to a columnar and intestinal-type epithelium.

diseases.label: periodic limb movement disorder
diseases.definition: A sleep disorder that involves involuntary limb movement during sleep.

diseases.label: herpes zoster oticus
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in facial nerve, which leads to paralysis of one side of the face, has_material_basis_in Human herpesvirus 3, which reactivates after appearing as chickenpox in childhood. The infection has_symptom vesicular rash of the ear or mouth, has_symptom tinnitus, has_symptom vertigo, has_symptom otalgia, and has_symptom headache.

diseases.label: pityriasis rubra pilaris
diseases.definition: A skin disease that is characterized by hyperkeratotic follicular papules coalescing into orange-red scaly plaques, islands of sparing, and palmoplantar keratoderma.

diseases.label: obsolete Herpes simplex virus iridocyclitis
diseases.definition: A Simplexvirus infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in iris and located_in ciliary body of the eye, has_material_basis_in Human herpesvirus 1 or has_material_basis_in Human herpesvirus 2, and has_symptom redness, has_symptom photophobia, has_symptom lacrimation, and has_symptom blurred vision.

diseases.label: obsolete Hodgkin's lymphoma, lymphocytic depletion, involving lymph nodes of head, face, and neck
obsolete herpes zoster eyelid dermatitis
diseases.definition: A Varicellovirus infectious disease that results_in infection located_in skin of eyelid, has_material_basis_in Human herpesvirus 3 and has_symptom rash after the reactivation of latent virus years after the primary infection.

diseases.label: central sleep apnea
diseases.definition: A sleep apnea that is characterized by a malfunction of the basic neurological controls for breathing rate and the failure to give the signal to inhale, causing the individual to miss one or more cycles of breathing.

diseases.label: obsolete lymphosarcoma involving lymph nodes of inguinal region and lower limb
obsolete Hodgkin's sarcoma involving intrapelvic lymph nodes
obsolete Hodgkin's lymphoma, mixed cellularity, involving lymph nodes of head, face, and neck
obsolete congenital rubella
diseases.definition: A rubella that results_in infection has_material_basis_in Rubella virus, which is transmitted_by congenital method to the developing fetus of a pregnant woman who has contracted rubella during her first trimester.

diseases.label: pompholyx
diseases.definition: A sweat gland disease that is characterized by recurrent vesicles and bullae that develop particularly upon the lateral palms, soles, and fingers and has_symptom pruritis and cracked skin.

diseases.label: kidney carcinoma in situ
diseases.definition: An in situ carcinoma that is located_in the kidney.

diseases.label: erythromelalgia
diseases.definition: A neuropathy that is characterized by intense, burning pain of affected extremities, severe redness and increased skin temperature.

diseases.label: obsolete reticulosarcoma involving lymph nodes of axilla and upper limb
Alagille syndrome
diseases.definition: A liver disease that is characterized by an accumulation of bile in the liver resulting from a reducted number of liver small bile ducts.

diseases.label: cerebral amyloid angiopathy
diseases.definition: An amyloidosis where amyloid protein progressively deposits in cerebral blood vessel walls with subsequent degenerative vascular changes that usually result in spontaneous cerebral hemorrhage, ischemic lesions and progressive dementia.

diseases.label: Pallister-Hall syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is characterized by hypothalamic hamartoma, pituitary dysfunction, central polydactyly, and visceral malformations and has_material_basis_in autosomal dominant heterozygous mutation in the GLI3 gene on chromosome 7p14.

diseases.label: Beemer-Langer syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that results_in multiple congenital anomalies, including hydrops fetalis, facial and visceral abnormalities, short ribs, and short limbs without polydactyly.

diseases.label: acrocallosal syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is an autosomal recessive disorder, which is characterized by corpus callosum agenesis, polydactyly, multiple dysmorphic features, motor and mental retardation.

diseases.label: amino acid metabolic disorder
diseases.definition: An inherited metabolic disorder that is characterized by impaired synthesis and degradation of amino acids.

diseases.label: mast-cell leukemia
diseases.definition: A leukemia that results_in an overwhelming number of tissue mast cells located_in peripheral blood.

diseases.label: frontotemporal dementia
diseases.definition: A dementia characterized by progressive neuronal loss predominantly involving the frontal and/or temporal lobes of the brain resulting in a gradual and progressive decline in behavior or language.

diseases.label: colorectal cancer
diseases.definition: A large intestine cancer that is located_in the colon and/or located_in the rectum.

diseases.label: Waardenburg syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by varying degrees of deafness, minor defects in structures arising from the neural crest and pigmentation anomalies of the hair, the skin and/or the iris of both eyes.

diseases.label: nasopharynx carcinoma
diseases.definition: A pharynx cancer that is located in the nasopharynx, the uppermost region of the pharynx or throat, where the nasal passages and auditory tubes join the remainder of the upper respiratory tract.

diseases.label: homocystinuria
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that involves an accumulation of homocysteine in the serum and an increased excretion of homocysteine in the urine.

diseases.label: histidine metabolism disease
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that involves deficiency in histidine.

diseases.label: cystinuria
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that involves the formation of cystine stones in the kidneys, ureter, and bladder.

diseases.label: urea cycle disorder
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that involves a deficiency of one of the enzymes in the urea cycle which is responsible for removing ammonia from the blood stream.

diseases.label: glycine encephalopathy
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that involves abnormally high levels of the amino acid glycine in bodily fluids and tissues.

diseases.label: maple syrup urine disease
diseases.definition: An organic acidemia that is caused by a deficiency of decarboxylase leading to high concentrations of valine, leucine, isoleucine, and alloisoleucine in the blood, urine, and cerebrospinal fluid and characterized by an odor of maple syrup to the urine, vomiting, hypertonicity, severe mental retardation, seizures, and eventually death unless the condition is treated with dietary measures.

diseases.label: obsolete metastatic malignant neoplasm to brain
alkaptonuria
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that involves phenylalanine and tyrosine metabolism with the accumulation of homogentisic acid, a toxic tyrosine byproduct.

diseases.label: ornithine carbamoyltransferase deficiency
diseases.definition: An urea cycle disorder that involves a mutated and ineffective form of the enzyme ornithine transcarbamylase.

diseases.label: citrullinemia
diseases.definition: An inherited urea cycle disorder that involves the accumulation of ammonia and other toxic substances in the blood.

diseases.label: hyperlysinemia
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that involves an abnormal increase of lysine in the blood.

diseases.label: tyrosinemia
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that involves impaired break down of the amino acid tyrosine.

diseases.label: hyperargininemia
diseases.definition: An urea cycle disorder that involves arginase deficiency resulting in elevated levels of plasma arginine.

diseases.label: hyperhomocysteinemia
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that involves an abnormally large level of homocysteine in the blood.

diseases.label: carbamoyl phosphate synthetase I deficiency disease
diseases.definition: A urea cycle disorder that involves accumulation of ammonia in the blood.

diseases.label: phenylketonuria
diseases.definition: An amino acid metabolic disorder that is characterized by a mutation in the gene for the hepatic enzyme phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH), rendering it nonfunctional.

diseases.label: ocular hypertension
diseases.definition: An eye disease that is characterized by elevated intraocular pressure in the absence of optic nerve damage or visual field loss.

diseases.label: borderline glaucoma
diseases.definition: A glaucoma characterized by clinical features and risk factors that are associated with high likelihood to developing optic atrophy secondary to glaucoma in the future. These features may include elevated intraocular pressure, retinal nerve fiber layer abnormalities, abnormal anterior chamber angles, and/or a positive family history for glaucoma without any evidence of current optic nerve atrophy.

diseases.label: priapism
diseases.definition: A peripheral vascular disease characterized by blood trapped in the penis that is unable to drain.

diseases.label: cleft lip
diseases.definition: An orofacial cleft that is characterized by a congenital defect in the upper lip where the maxillary prominence fails to merge with the merged medial nasal prominences.

diseases.label: lip disease
diseases.definition: A mouth disease located_in the lip.

diseases.label: language disorder
diseases.definition: A communication disorder that involves the processing of linguistic information.

diseases.label: orbital disease
diseases.definition: An adnexa disease that is located_in the eye socket.

diseases.label: splenic tuberculosis
diseases.definition: An abdominal tuberculosis that results_in formation of granulomas or abscesses located_in spleen.

diseases.label: monieziasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves zoonotic infection caused by Moniezia expansa, the common tapeworm of sheep.

diseases.label: nasal cavity benign neoplasm
diseases.definition: A respiratory system benign neoplasm that arises from the nasal cavity.

diseases.label: chronic ethmoiditis
diseases.definition: A ethmoid sinusitis which lasts for 12 weeks or more.

diseases.label: obsolete glaucoma associated with anomalies of iris
lymphangitis
diseases.definition: A lymphatic system disease that is characterized by inflammation of the lymphatic channels which occurs as a result of infection at a site distal to the channel. It is caused by Streptococcus pyogenes (Group A strep) or Staphylococcus aureus. Lymphangitis is also sometimes called blood poisoning.

diseases.label: obsolete Cestoda infectious disease
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves infection by parasitic flatworms known as tapeworms living in the vertebrate digestive tract.

diseases.label: viral infectious disease
diseases.definition: A disease by infectious agent that results in infection, has_material_basis_in Viruses.

diseases.label: diabetes mellitus
diseases.definition: A glucose metabolism disease that is characterized by chronic hyperglycaemia with disturbances of carbohydrate, fat and protein metabolism resulting from defects in insulin secretion, insulin action, or both.

diseases.label: type 2 diabetes mellitus
diseases.definition: A diabetes mellitus that is characterized by high blood sugar, insulin resistance, and relative lack of insulin.

diseases.label: brain disease
diseases.definition: A central nervous system disease that is located_in the brain.

diseases.label: intrinsic asthma
diseases.definition: A chronic asthma that is triggered by factors not attributable to allergies.

diseases.label: status asthmaticus
diseases.definition: An acute asthma that is characterized by an acute episode with a progressive severity that is poorly responsive to standard therapeutic measures, regardless of disease severity or phenotypic variant.

diseases.label: obsolete DNA virus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in DNA viruses, which have DNA as their genetic material and replicate using a DNA-dependent DNA polymerase.

diseases.label: obsolete exophthalmos
diseases.definition: An eye disease that is characterized by a bulging of the eye anteriorly out of the orbit.

diseases.label: postural kyphosis
diseases.definition: A kyphosis that has_material_basis_in slouching which results_in stretching of spinal ligament and abnormal formation located_in vertebra.

diseases.label: Fuchs' heterochromic uveitis
diseases.definition: A syndrome that is a chronic unilateral (or rarely bilateral) iridocyclitis appearing with the triad of heterochromia, predisposition to cataracts and glaucoma, and keratitic percipitates on the posterior corneal surface.

diseases.label: obsolete pigment dispersion syndrome of iris
tracheitis
diseases.definition: A tracheal disease which involves bacterial infection of the trachea often caused by Staphylococcus aureus and streptococci that follows a recent viral upper respiratory infection. The symptoms include barking croup cough, loud squeaking noise while breathing, scratchy feeling in the throat, high fever, and production of large amounts of pus-filled secretions.

diseases.label: croup
diseases.definition: A respiratory system infectious disease that involves inflammation, edema, and subsequent obstruction of the larynx, trachea, and bronchi. The disease is caused by viruses, bacteria, allergies and inhaled irritants. It is marked by episodes of difficult breathing and hoarse metallic cough in infants and young children. Croup is caused by parainfluenza virus (types 1 and 2), Influenza A and B viruses, Measles virus, adenovirus, respiratory syncytial virus, Staphylococcus and Streptococcus.

diseases.label: acute laryngitis
diseases.definition: A laryngitis which lasts less than a few days.

diseases.label: epiglottitis
diseases.definition: An upper respiratory tract disease which involves inflammation of the epiglottis due to infection. Haemophilus influenzae type B is the most common bacterial causative agent, although some cases are attributable to Streptococcus pneumoniae or Streptococcus pyogenes. The infection can cause the epiglottis to either obstruct or completely close off the windpipe. Epiglottitis typically affects children, and is associated with fever, difficulty in swallowing, drooling, hoarseness of voice, and stridor.

diseases.label: hypopituitarism
diseases.definition: A pituitary gland disease characterized by the decreased secretion of one or more of the eight hormones normally produced by the pituitary gland.

diseases.label: diabetes insipidus
diseases.definition: A kidney disease that is characterized by polydipsia and polyuria with a dilute urine having a specific gravity less than 1.010, hypernatremia, and dehydration.

diseases.label: panhypopituitarism
diseases.definition: A hypopituitarism characterized by deficiency in growth hormone and at least one other pituitary hormone.

diseases.label: obsolete Congenital abnormalities of uterus complicating pregnancy, childbirth, or the puerperium
obsolete abnormality of organs and soft tissues of pelvis complicating pregnancy, childbirth, or the puerperium
allergic asthma
diseases.definition: An extrinsic asthma that is characterized by symptoms that are triggered by an allergic reaction caused by inhaled allergens such as dust mite allergen, pet dander, pollen and mold. The disease has_symptom coughing, has_symptom wheezing, has_symptom shortness of breath or has_symptom rapid breathing, and has_symptom chest tightness.

diseases.label: blepharitis
diseases.definition: An eyelid disease that is characterized by often chronic inflammation of the eyelid, generally the part where eyelashes grow.

diseases.label: obsolete tuberculous bronchiectasis
diseases.definition: A pulmonary tuberculosis characterized by bronchial compression and obstruction as a result of enlarged lymph nodes of the primary complex or by infiltration of the wall of the bronchi by caseous lymph nodes.

diseases.label: intracranial hypertension
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized by high pressure inside the skull, the brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid, has_symptom headache, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom altered mental status, has_symptom papilledema.

diseases.label: renal glycosuria
diseases.definition: A renal tubular transport disease characterized by decreased renal tubular resorption of glucose from the urine in the absence of hyperglycemia and other signs of tubular dysfunction.

diseases.label: cervical Mullerian papilloma
diseases.definition: A cervical benign neoplasm that is a polypoid lesion of the superficial cervix or vagina of young girls to adult women and is characterized by papillary stalks covered by mucinous epithelium with focal squamous metaplasia, highly cellular fibrous tissue, no atypia, and minimal mitotic activity.

diseases.label: cervix squamous papilloma
diseases.definition: A cervical benign neoplasm that is a polypoid lesion characterized by a single papillary frond with a central fibrovascular core and mature squamous epithelium.

diseases.label: cholangitis
diseases.definition: A bile duct disease that is an inflammation of the bile duct.

diseases.label: obsolete infectious disease of the breast and nipple associated with childbirth
steatotic liver disease
diseases.definition: A lipid storage disease characterized by the accumulation of large vacuoles of triglyceride fat in at least 5% of hepatocytes.

diseases.label: lipid storage disease
diseases.definition: A lysosomal storage disease that involves the accumulation of harmful amounts of lipids (fats) in some of the body's cells and tissues.

diseases.label: dientamoebiasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic protozoa infectious disease that involves infection of the large intestine by a protozoan parasite Dientamoeba fragilis. The symptoms include diarrhea, stomach pain and cramping, loss of appetite and weight, nausea, and fatigue.

diseases.label: uterine corpus cancer
diseases.definition: A uterine cancer that is located_in the uterine corpus.

diseases.label: cholesteatoma of external ear
diseases.definition: A cholesteatoma which involves invasion of the squamous tissue into a localized area of bony erosion of the ear canal. It may develop spontaneously or as a consequence of infection, trauma or surgery.

diseases.label: otitis externa
diseases.definition: An external ear disease that involves inflammation of the outer ear and ear canal. It can be caused by active bacterial or fungal infections.

diseases.label: nail-patella syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by nail dysplasia and absent or hypoplastic patellae that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the LMX1B gene on chromosome 9q33.3.

diseases.label: bacterial meningitis
diseases.definition: A meningitis that has_material_basis_in a bacterial infection.

diseases.label: meningitis
diseases.definition: A central nervous system disease that is characterized by an inflammation of the pia-arachnoid meninges. It can be caused by growth of bacteria, fungi, or parasites within the subarachnoid space or by the growth of bacteria or viruses within the meningeal or ependymal cells.

diseases.label: pulmonary embolism
diseases.definition: An artery disease characterized by a blockage of the main artery of the lung or one of its branches by a substance that has travelled from elsewhere in the body, e.g. a blood clot.

diseases.label: postpartum depression
diseases.definition: An endogenous depression that involves intense, sustained and sometimes disabling depression experienced by women after giving birth.

diseases.label: Meckel's diverticulum
diseases.definition: A physical disorder that is characterized by a congenital abnormality characterized by the outpouching or sac formation in the ileum.

diseases.label: pulmonary eosinophilia
diseases.definition: A hypereosinophilic syndrome characterized by the accumulation of eosinophils in the lungs.

diseases.label: leukocyte disease
diseases.definition: A hematopoietic system disease that is located_in white blood cells.

diseases.label: chronic eosinophilic pneumonia
diseases.definition: An eosinophilic pneumonia which slowly progresses over weeks to months. Life-threatening shortness of breath can develop if the condition is not treated. Individuals are often diagnosed with asthma before the advent of this disease.

diseases.label: Loeffler syndrome
diseases.definition: An eosinophilic pneumonia described as a form of pulmonary eosinophilia characterized as a mild pneumonitis marked by transitory pulmonary infiltration and eosinophilia and usually considered to be an allergic reaction. It can occur in response to a parasitic infection.

diseases.label: benign mammary dysplasia
diseases.definition: A breast benign neoplasm that encompasses a range of conditions in which there is marked change in the breast tissue.

diseases.label: cannabis abuse
diseases.definition: A substance abuse that involves the recurring use of cannabis despite negative consequences.

diseases.label: acute ethmoiditis
diseases.definition: A ethmoid sinusitis which lasts for less than 4 weeks.

diseases.label: ethmoid sinusitis
diseases.definition: A sinusitis which involves infection of ethmoid sinuses that causes pain or pressure behind and between the eyes, tearing, and headache over the forehead.

diseases.label: plasma cell leukemia
diseases.definition: A plasma cell neoplasm that is characterized by the presence of a circulating clonal plasma cell count that exceeds 2x10^9/L or is 20% of the leukocyte differential count.

diseases.label: obsolete multiple myeloma and immunoproliferative neoplasm
obsolete abortion complicated by renal failure
Laron syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by marked short stature with normal or high serum growth hormone and low serum insulin-like growth factor-1 levels that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in GHR on chromosome 5p13-p12.

diseases.label: obsolete acute renal failure with lesion of renal medullary necrosis
obsolete Rhesus isoimmunisation affecting management of mother
latent syphilis
diseases.definition: A syphilis that is characterized as having serologic proof of infection without signs or symptoms of disease.
