diseases.label: tuberculous pneumothorax
diseases.definition: A pneumothorax in which air enters into the pleural cavity.

diseases.label: obsolete Arenavirus hemorrhagic fever
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that involves fever and bleeding disorder caused by Arenavirus.

diseases.label: Lassa fever
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Mammarenavirus lassaense, which is transmitted_by multimammate rat of the genus Mastomys. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom retrosternal pain, has_symptom sore throat, has_symptom back pain, has_symptom cough, has_symptom abdominal pain, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom conjunctivitis, has_symptom facial swelling, has_symptom proteinuria (protein in the urine), and has_symptom mucosal bleeding.

diseases.label: multiple myeloma
diseases.definition: A myeloid neoplasm that is located_in the plasma cells in bone marrow.

diseases.label: indolent plasma cell myeloma
diseases.definition: A multiple myeloma that is characterized by M protein in serum and/or urine and evidence of organ damage related the plasma cell neoplasm.

diseases.label: smoldering myeloma
diseases.definition: A multiple myeloma that is a slow growing type of myeloma in which abnormal plasma cells results_in too much of a single type of monoclonal antibody.

diseases.label: adrenal gland disease
diseases.definition: An endocrine system disease that is located_in the adrenal gland.

diseases.label: primary ciliary dyskinesia
diseases.definition: A ciliopathy that is characterized by impaired function of the cilia lining the respiratory tract (lower and upper, sinuses, Eustachian tube, middle ear) and fallopian tube.

diseases.label: bronchiectasis
diseases.definition: A bronchial disease that is a chronic inflammatory condition of one or more bronchi or bronchioles marked by dilatation and loss of elasticity of the walls resulting from damage to the airway wall leading to the formation of small sacs on the bronchial wall and impairment of cilia mobility in the lung. Inflammation of the bronchial wall increases mucus secretion which serves as a breeding ground for bacteria. Bronchiectasis is caused by repeated respiratory infections, immune deficiency disorders, hereditary disorders (cystic fibrosis or primary ciliary dyskinesia), mechanical factors (inhaled object or a lung tumor) or inhaling toxic substances.

diseases.label: neonatal candidiasis
diseases.definition: A candidiasis that involves fungal infection in neonates caused by Candida species. Low birthweight and age, prolonged intravascular catheterization and the use of antibiotic drugs are the principle predisposing conditions for systemic candidiasis in neonates.

diseases.label: Venezuelan equine encephalitis
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in brain of horses and humans, has_material_basis_in Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus, which is transmitted_by Culex mosquitoes. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom chills, has_symptom malaise, has_symptom severe headache, has_symptom photophobia, and has_symptom myalgia in the legs and lumbosacral region.

diseases.label: obsolete equine encephalitis
diseases.definition: An Alphavirus infectious disease that results_in inflammation located_in brain of horses and humans, has_material_basis_in Eastern equine encephalitis virus, has_material_basis_in Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus, or has_material_basis_in Western equine encephalomyelitis virus, which are transmitted_by moquito bite. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom headache, and has_symptom malaise.

diseases.label: encephalitis
diseases.definition: A brain disease that is characterized as an acute inflammation of the brain with flu-like symptoms.

diseases.label: lower urinary tract calculus
diseases.definition: A urinary system disease that is located_in the lower urinary tract and is characterized by the formation of a stone.

diseases.label: Krukenberg carcinoma
diseases.definition: An ovary epithelial cancer that is a metastatic signet-ring cell carcinoma, which spreads to the ovary from gastric tissue.

diseases.label: fasciitis
diseases.definition: A connective tissue disease characterized by inflammation located in the fascia.

diseases.label: staphyloenterotoxemia
diseases.definition: A primary bacterial infectious disease that results_in infection located_in intestine caused by eating food contaminated with enterotoxins produced by bacteria, has_material_basis_in Staphylococcus aureus. The infection has_symptom diarrhea, has_symptom vomiting, has_symptom nausea, has_symptom cramps, and has_symptom weakness.

diseases.label: vesicoureteral reflux
diseases.definition: A ureteral disease characterized by backward flow of urine from the urinary bladder into the ureter.

diseases.label: episodic ataxia
diseases.definition: A hereditary ataxia characterized by sporadic bouts of ataxia with or without continuous muscle movement.

diseases.label: Pelger-Huet anomaly
diseases.definition: A hematopoietic system disease characterized by white blood cells with unusually shaped nuclei that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in LBR on chromosome 1q42.12.

diseases.label: stomatitis
diseases.definition: A mouth disease that is characterized by inflammation of the mouth and lips.

diseases.label: sarcocystosis
diseases.definition: A coccidiosis that involves infection of the intestine and muscles of humans and animals caused by an intracellular protozoan parasite of genus Sarcocystis. The symptoms include mild fever, diarrhea, chills, vomiting, muscle swelling, erythema, muscle tenderness,cough, arthralgia, transient pruritic rashes, headache, malaise and lymphadenopathy.

diseases.label: babesiosis
diseases.definition: A parasitic protozoa infectious disease that has_symptom mild fevers and has_symptom anemia described as malaria-like symptoms caused by a protozoan of genus Babesia, which reproduce in red blood cells and cause hemolytic anemia. They are transmitted by Ixodid ticks or by blood transfusion. Babesiosis is a zoonotic disease.

diseases.label: congenital nystagmus
diseases.definition: A pathologic nystagmus, present at birth, characterized by involuntary, rhythmic eye movements; oscillations are usually horizontal in direction.

diseases.label: obsolete Pre-eclampsia or eclampsia superimposed on pre-existing hypertension
obsolete hypertension complicating pregnancy, childbirth and the puerperium
oral mucosa leukoplakia
diseases.definition: A mouth disease that is characterized by a white patch or plaque that develops in the oral cavity and is strongly associated with smoking.

diseases.label: aphthous stomatitis
diseases.definition: A stomatitis characterized by the repeated formation of benign and non-contagious mouth ulcers.

diseases.label: placental abruption
diseases.definition: A placenta disease that is characterized by separation of the placental lining from the uterus of the mother.

diseases.label: senile cataract
diseases.definition: A cataract that is characterized by thickening and loss of transparency of the lens with age progression, caused by a multifactorial etiology related to aging.

diseases.label: pulmonary emphysema
diseases.definition: A chronic obstructive pulmonary disease that is characterized by permanent enlargement of air spaces distal to the terminal bronchioles and the destruction of the alveolar walls.

diseases.label: obsolete cervical incompetence complicating pregnancy, childbirth, or the puerperium
cervical incompetence
diseases.definition: A cervix disease that is characterized by the beginning of dilation and effacement of a pregnant woman's cervix before her pregnancy has reached term.

diseases.label: yellow fever
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results in infection, has_material_basis_in Yellow fever virus, which is transmitted by Aedes, transmitted by Haemagogus, or transmitted by Sabethes species of mosquitoes. The infection has symptom fever, has symptom muscle pain, has symptom backache, has symptom headache, has symptom shivers, has symptom loss of appetite, has symptom jaundice, and has symptom bleeding from the mouth, nose, eyes or stomach leading to vomitus containing blood.

diseases.label: toxic myocarditis
diseases.definition: An acute myocarditis that is characterized by an underlying toxin insult to the myocardium that induces acute inflammation.

diseases.label: ophthalmia neonatorum
diseases.definition: A bacterial conjuctivitis that is characterized by pain and tenderness in the eyeball and conjuctival discharge.

diseases.label: tenosynovitis
diseases.definition: An arthropathy that is characterized as an inflammation of the lining of the sheath that surrounds a tendon.

diseases.label: neovascular inflammatory vitreoretinopathy
diseases.definition: A retinal and vitreous disease characterized by ocular inflammation, vascular dropout, large spots of hyperpigmentation, neovascularization of the peripheral and posterior retina, vitreous hemorrhage, and retinal detachment that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the CAPN5 gene on chromosome 11q13.5.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant neoplasm of cerebrum except lobes and ventricles
vitreous disease
diseases.definition: An eye and adnexa disease that is located in the vitreous of the eye.

diseases.label: vitreous abscess
diseases.definition: A vitreous disease that is characterized by an abscess located_in the vitreous of the eye.

diseases.label: renal tuberculosis
diseases.definition: An urogenital tuberculosis that results_in formation of granulomas located_in kidney.

diseases.label: acute allergic mucoid otitis media
diseases.definition: A blue drum syndrome caused by an allergen.

diseases.label: blue drum syndrome
diseases.definition: A acute transudative otitis media involving thick, viscid and mucuslike fluid effusion due to which the drum appears blue in color.

diseases.label: eustachian tube disease
diseases.definition: A non-suppurative otitis media and eustachian tube disorder in which the tube is either too narrow or too wide. It can also be caused by nasal inflammation which leads to inflammatory swelling and obstruction of the eustachian tube, which, in turn, leads to increased negative pressure in the middle ear and improper ventilation.

diseases.label: upper respiratory tract disease
diseases.definition: A respiratory system disease which involves the upper respiratory tract.

diseases.label: postcholecystectomy syndrome
diseases.definition: A biliary tract disease characterized by the continuation or development of new gastrointestinal symptoms after cholecystectomy.

diseases.label: biliary tract disease
diseases.definition: A hepatobiliary disease that is located_in the biliary tract.

diseases.label: pelvic varices
diseases.definition: A varicose veins that is located_in the pelvis.

diseases.label: type 1 diabetes mellitus
diseases.definition: A diabetes mellitus that is characterized by destruction of pancreatic beta cells resulting in absent or extremely low insulin production.

diseases.label: hemorrhoid
diseases.definition: A pelvic varices that is characterized by swollen, inflamed veins around the anus or lower rectum.

diseases.label: internal hemorrhoid
diseases.definition: A hemorrhoid that is located_in the rectum.

diseases.label: obsolete arthropathy associated with dermatological disorder
emphysematous cholecystitis
diseases.definition: A cholecystitis consisting of an inflammation of the gallbladder characterized by air-filled expansions in interstitial or subcutaneous tissues, where gallbladder wall necrosis causes gas formation in the lumen or wall.

diseases.label: xanthogranulomatous cholecystitis
diseases.definition: A cholecystitis characterized by nodules containing lipid-laden macrophages.

diseases.label: obsolete Retracted nipple associated with childbirth
obsolete hematological disease of fetus and newborn
female breast upper-outer quadrant cancer
diseases.definition: A female breast cancer that is located_in the upper-outer quadrant of the breast.

diseases.label: irritable bowel syndrome
diseases.definition: An intestinal disease that is characterized by chronic abdominal pain, discomfort, bloating, and alteration of bowel habits in the absence of any detectable organic cause.

diseases.label: trichinosis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves parasitic infection of animals and humans by Trichinella spiralis, Trichinella nativa or Trichinella britovi. Intestinal invasion causes diarrhea, abdominal pain and vomiting. Larval migration into muscle tissues can cause periorbital and facial edema, conjunctivitis, fever, myalgias, splinter hemorrhages, rashes, and blood eosinophilia. Myocarditis, central nervous system involvement, and pneumonitis can also occur.

diseases.label: bulbar polio
diseases.definition: A paralytic poliomyelitis that results in destruction located in motor neurons of brainstem, has_material_basis_in Human poliovirus 1, has_material_basis_in Human poliovirus 2, or has_material_basis_in Human poliovirus 3, which are transmitted by ingestion of food or water contaminated with feces, or transmitted by direct contact with the oral secretions. The infection has symptom difficulty breathing, has symptom difficulty speaking, has symptom difficulty swallowing, and has symptom difficulty chewing.

diseases.label: obsolete Foreign body granuloma of muscle
toxocariasis
diseases.definition: A parasitic helminthiasis infectious disease that involves zoonotic infection of humans by the larvae of Toxocara canis or Toxocara cati. The larvae invade multiple tissues like liver, heart, lungs, brain, muscle and eyes causing various symptoms including fever, anorexia, weight loss, cough, wheezing, rashes, hepatosplenomegaly, hypereosinophilia and ophthalmologic lesions.

diseases.label: tuberculous peritonitis
diseases.definition: A gastrointestinal tuberculosis that results_in inflammation located_in peritoneum, which results in formation of tubercles. The infection has_symptom abdominal discomfort, has_symptom pain, has_symptom distention from gas or fluid, has_symptom digestive disturbances and has_symptom emaciation.

diseases.label: obsolete pneumococcal peritonitis
diseases.definition: A pneumococcal infectious disease that involves inflammation of the peritoneum caused by streptococcal infection. The symptoms include diarrhea, fever, fasciitis and influenza-like syndrome.

diseases.label: Goodpasture syndrome
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease that is characterized by antibody attack of the basement membrane in lungs and kidneys, leading to bleeding from the lungs and kidney failure.

diseases.label: hypersensitivity vasculitis
diseases.definition: A hypersensitivity reaction type III disease that is characterized by inflammation and injury to blood vessels and has_symptom purpura, telangiectasia, blistering, urticaria, and ulcers.

diseases.label: polyarteritis nodosa
diseases.definition: A vasculitis that is characterized by necrotizing inflammation of medium or small arteries.

diseases.label: obsolete Recent retinal detachment, total or subtotal
obsolete partial recent retinal detachment with giant tear
obsolete disorganized type schizophrenia subchronic state with acute exacerbation
obsolete Partial recent retinal detachment with retinal dialysis
obsolete total or subtotal old retinal detachment
neonatal abstinence syndrome
diseases.definition: A withdrawal disorder that is characterized by a group of problems that occur in a newborn who was exposed to addictive illegal or prescription drugs while in the mother's womb or postnatally following the discontinuance of drug treatment.

diseases.label: obsolete drug abstinence syndrome or symptom
hyperopia
diseases.definition: A refractive error that is characterized by rays of light entering the eye parallel to the optic axis are brought to a focus behind the retina, as a result of the eyeball being too short from front to back.

diseases.label: esotropia
diseases.definition: A strabismus that is characterized the eye which turns inward toward the nose.

diseases.label: peripheral vertigo
diseases.definition: A vestibular disease that is characterized by a sensation of motion or spinning that is often described as dizziness due to a problem in the part of the inner ear that controls balance.

diseases.label: Meniere's disease
diseases.definition: A vestibular disease characterized by vertigo, low-pitched tinnitus and hearing loss.

diseases.label: obsolete disorganized type schizophrenia subchronic state
congenital syphilis
diseases.definition: A syphilis that results_in a multisystem infection in the fetus via the placenta.

diseases.label: interstitial keratitis
diseases.definition: A connective tissue disease characterized by corneal scarring that develops from non-suppurative inflammation located_in the corneal stroma, has_symptom visual acuity loss, has_symptom pain, and has_symptom lacrimation.

diseases.label: alopecia areata
diseases.definition: An autoimmune disease resulting in the loss of hair on the scalp and elsewhere on the body initially causing bald spots.

diseases.label: miliary tuberculosis
diseases.definition: An extrapulmonary tuberculosis that results in formation of tiny lesions in all the organs.

diseases.label: hereditary fructose intolerance syndrome
diseases.definition: A carbohydrate metabolic disorder characterized by recurrent vomiting, abdominal pain, and hypoglycemia that may be fatal after introduction of fructose or sucrose to the diet that has_material_basis_in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the aldolase B gene (ALDOB) on chromosome 9q31.

diseases.label: alopecia
diseases.definition: A hypotrichosis that is characterized by a loss of hair from the head or body.

diseases.label: galactosemia
diseases.definition: A carbohydrate metabolic disorder that involves a defect in galactose metabolism resulting in toxic levels of galactose 1-phosphate in various tissues.

diseases.label: obsolete Excessive vomiting starting after 22 completed weeks of gestation
mitral valve prolapse
diseases.definition: A mitral valve disease where one or both of the cusps of the mitral valve bulge or collapse backward in the left atrium during systole.

diseases.label: cardiovascular syphilis
diseases.definition: A tertiary syphilis that is manifested as aneurysm formation in the ascending aorta, caused by chronic inflammatory destruction of the vasa vasorum, insufficiency of the aortic valve, or narrowing of the coronary arteries.

diseases.label: Becker muscular dystrophy
diseases.definition: A muscular dystrophy that involves slowly worsening muscle weakness of the legs and pelvis, and has_material_basis_in X-linked recessive inheritance of mutation in the dystrophin gene on chromosome Xp21.

diseases.label: muscular dystrophy
diseases.definition: A myopathy is characterized by progressive skeletal muscle weakness degeneration.

diseases.label: obsolete alternating esotropia with A pattern
obsolete alternating esotropia with V pattern
obsolete glaucoma associated with tumors or cysts
congenital heart block
diseases.definition: An atrioventricular block characterized by the presence of conduction system disease of any form, which is diagnosed on or before 28 days of life.

diseases.label: meibomian cyst
diseases.definition: A blepharitis that is characterized as a cyst in the eyelid that is caused by inflammation of a blocked meibomian gland, usually on the upper eyelid.

diseases.label: hordeolum
diseases.definition: An eyelid disease that is characterized by an infection of the sebaceous glands at the base of the eyelashes. Styes are generally caused by a Staphylococcus aureus bacterial infection.

diseases.label: central corneal ulcer
diseases.definition: A corneal ulcer that is characterized by ulceration and opacification of the central cornea and is caused by minor trauma and subsequent infection by bacterial or mycotic organisms.

diseases.label: obsolete malignant neoplasm of ribs, sternum and clavicle
obsolete secondary malignant neoplasm to the chest wall
obsolete malignant neoplasm of thoracic esophagus
Omsk hemorrhagic fever
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that is a hemorrhagic fever, has_material_basis_in Omsk hemorrhagic fever virus, which is transmitted_by Dermacentor and transmitted_by Ixodes species of ticks. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom chills, has_symptom headache, has_symptom pain in lower and upper extremities, has_symptom stiff neck, has_symptom papulovesicular rash on the soft palate, has_symptom cervical lymphadenopathy, has_symptom conjunctival suffusion, has_symptom blood in the urine, and has_symptom blood in the sputum.

diseases.label: developmental coordination disorder
diseases.definition: A specific developmental disorder that involves disordered motor skills where coordinated muscle movement is impaired.

diseases.label: obsolete Flavivirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection in animals and humans, has_material_basis_in Flavivirus, which causes encephalitis or hemorrhagic fever in humans and transmitted_by arthropod vectors or transmitted_by contact with infected animal carcasses.

diseases.label: Waterhouse-Friderichsen syndrome
diseases.definition: An adrenal gland disease that is characterized by failure of the adrenal gland due to bleeding into the gland.

diseases.label: chronic inflammation of lacrimal passage
diseases.definition: A lacrimal apparatus disease that is characterized by longstanding inflammation of the lacrimal passage, and has_symptom pain, increased or decreased tearing, and swelling between the eye and nose.

diseases.label: dacryocystitis
diseases.definition: An acute inflammation of lacrimal passage that is characterized by inflammation of the lacrimal sac, has_symptom conjunctivitis and has_symptom purulent discharge.

diseases.label: obsolete Congenital or acquired abnormality of vulva complicating pregnancy, childbirth, or the puerperium
steroid-induced glaucoma
diseases.definition: A glaucoma characterized by elevated intraocular pressure secondary to chronic corticosteroid use, which leads to glaucomatous optic nerve atrophy and progressive vision loss and has_symptom progressive decreased vision, visual field defects, and decreased peripheral vision. Steroid-induced glaucoma is caused by chronic corticosteroid use.

diseases.label: acute lymphoblastic leukemia
diseases.definition: A acute leukemia that is characterized by over production of lymphoblasts.

diseases.label: acute biphenotypic leukemia
diseases.definition: An acute leukemia that is characterized by the occurrence of more than one type of leukemia at the same time resulting from either the occurrence of blasts which coexpress myeloid and T or B lineage antigens or concurrent B and T lineage antigens.

diseases.label: hypoplastic left heart syndrome
diseases.definition: A congenital heart disease characterized by abnormal development of the left-sided structures of the heart.

diseases.label: periostitis
diseases.definition: A connective tissue disease characterized by inflammation located_in the periosteum of the bone.

diseases.label: hemometra
diseases.definition: A uterine disease that is characterized by the presence of blood in the uterine cavity.

diseases.label: toxoplasmosis
diseases.definition: A coccidiosis that has_material_basis_in protozoan Toxoplasma gondii. The parasite effects most genera of warm-blooded animals, including humans, but the primary host is the felid (cat) family. Animals are infected by eating infected meat, by ingestion of feces of a cat that has itself recently been infected, or transmission_by mother to fetus. The symptoms include bilateral, nontender cervical or axillary lymphadenopathy, fever, malaise, myalgia, hepatosplenomegaly, anemia and leukopenia.

diseases.label: carotenemia
diseases.definition: An acquired metabolic disease that is characterized by yellow-orange skin pigmentation due to high levels of carotene in blood.

diseases.label: uterine inversion
diseases.definition: A uterine disease that is characterized by the uterine cavity turning inside out as a complication of childbirth.

diseases.label: obesity
diseases.definition: An overnutrition that is characterized by excess body fat, traditionally defined as an elevated ratio of weight to height (specifically 30 kilograms per meter squared), has_material_basis_in a multifactorial etiology related to excess nutrition intake, decreased caloric utilization, and genetic susceptibility, and possibly medications and certain disorders of metabolism, endocrine function, and mental illness.

diseases.label: hypervitaminosis D
diseases.definition: An overnutrition that is characterized by elevated vitamin D, which can subsequently cause high levels of calcium, has_symptom myalgia, fatigue, irritability, nausea, dehydration, polyuria, and nephrocalcinosis, and possibly has_material_basis_in excess intake of vitamin D.

diseases.label: hypervitaminosis A
diseases.definition: An overnutrition that is characterized by excess vitamin A, has_symptom hepatomegaly, anorexia, fever, alopecia, and arthralgia, and has_material_basis_in excessive intake of vitaimin A, and/or derangement of vitamin A metabolism.

diseases.label: substance dependence
diseases.definition: A substance-related disorder that involves the continued use of alcohol or other drugs despite problems related to use of the substance.

diseases.label: drug dependence
diseases.definition: A substance dependence that involves the continued use of drugs despite problems related to use of the substance.

diseases.label: cocaine dependence
diseases.definition: A drug dependence that is a psychological dependency on the regular use of cocaine.

diseases.label: heroin dependence
diseases.definition: An opiate dependence that involves the continued use of heroin despite problems related to use of the substance.

diseases.label: hallucinogen dependence
diseases.definition: A drug dependence that involves the continued use of hallucinogenic drugs despite problems related to use of the substance.

diseases.label: eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome
diseases.definition: A hypereosinophilic syndrome that is characterized by subacute onset of myalgias and peripheral eosinophilia, followed by chronic neuropathy and skin induration.

diseases.label: orbit lymphoma
diseases.definition: An orbital cancer that has_material_basis_in some lymphocyte.

diseases.label: orbit sarcoma
diseases.definition: An orbital cancer that has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derived from embryonic mesoderm.

diseases.label: tertiary neurosyphilis
diseases.definition: A tertiary syphilis that results in infection located in brain or located in spinal cord.

diseases.label: hypereosinophilic syndrome
diseases.definition: A leukocyte disease that is characterized by high numbers of eosinophils which over time enter various tissues, eventually damaging organs.

diseases.label: hypoglycemia
diseases.definition: A glucose metabolism disease that is characterized by abnormally low levels of blood glucose.

diseases.label: obsolete endocrine and metabolic disturbances specific to the fetus and newborn
peripartum cardiomyopathy
diseases.definition: A dilated cardiomyopathy that is characterized by a weakness of the heart muscle that begins sometime during the final month of pregnancy through about five months after delivery.

symptoms.label: cellulitis
symptoms.definition: Cellulitis is a musculoskeletal system symptom characterized as a diffuse and especially subcutaneous inflammation of connective tissue.

symptoms.label: ataxia
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by an inability to coordinate voluntary muscular movements that is symptomatic of some nervous disorders.

symptoms.label: backache
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by occurring in the lower back.

symptoms.label: bleeding
symptoms.definition: A general symptom that is characterized as an act, instance, or result of being bled or the process by which something is bled: as a the escape of blood from vessels.

symptoms.label: blister
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a fluid-filled elevation of the epidermis.

symptoms.label: blurred vision
symptoms.definition: A vision symptom that is characterized by a decreased clarity or sharpness in vision, which can be caused by eye conditions myopia or hyperopia.

symptoms.label: confusion
symptoms.definition: A balance symptom that is characterized by a disturbance of consciousness characterized by inability to engage in orderly thought or by lack of power to distinguish, choose, or act decisively.

symptoms.label: dehydration
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by an abnormal depletion of body fluids.

symptoms.label: delirium
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a mental disturbance characterized by confusion, disordered speech, and hallucinations.

symptoms.label: depression
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a chronic feeling of emptiness, sadness, or inability to feel pleasure that may appear to happen for no clear reason.  Additionally one may experience feelings of hopelessness, pessimism, irritability, frustration, or restlessness, guilt, worthlessness and thoughts of death or suicide.

symptoms.label: disorientation
symptoms.definition: A confusion that is characterized by an usually transient state of confusion especially as to time, place, or identity; often as a result of disease or drugs.

symptoms.label: drowsiness
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a feeling of being more sleepy than normal during the day. People who are drowsy may fall asleep in when they do not want to or at times which can lead to safety concerns.

symptoms.label: dry cough
symptoms.definition: A cough that is characterized by a lack of accompanied phlegm production.

symptoms.label: paralysis
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by a complete or partial loss of function especially when involving the power of motion or of sensation in any part of the body.

symptoms.label: dyspneic enteritis
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by being short or breath or out of air (dyspnea), with inflammation of the small intestine (enteritis).

symptoms.label: enteritis
symptoms.definition: Enteritis is a digestive system symptom involving the inflammation of the small intestines and especially of the human ileum.

symptoms.label: hematuria
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by the presence of blood or blood cells in the urine.

symptoms.label: hemorrhage
symptoms.definition: A cardiovascular system symptom that is characterized by an acute loss of blood from a damaged blood vessel.

symptoms.label: obsolete hyperkeratotic plaques of surface of foot
hyperpigmentation
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an excess pigmentation in a bodily part or tissue, as the skin.

symptoms.label: inflammation
symptoms.definition: Inflammation is a general symptom where there is a local response to cellular injury that is marked by capillary dilatation, leukocytic infiltration, redness, heat, pain, swelling, and often loss of function and that serves as a mechanism initiating the elimination of noxious agents and of damaged tissue.

symptoms.label: joint pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a pain situated, or occurring, in or around a joint.

symptoms.label: lethargy
symptoms.definition: A fatigue that is characterized by abnormal drowsiness.

symptoms.label: coordination symptom
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by the harmonious functioning of interrelated organs and body parts; in particular the working together of muscle groups in the execution of complicated movements.

symptoms.label: meningoencephalitis
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by an inflammation of the brain and meninges.

symptoms.label: encephalitis
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by inflammation of the brain tissue, which is typically caused by a viral infection, but it may also be caused by bacterial or parasitic infections, cancer, or certain drugs or toxins.

symptoms.label: mild encephalitis
symptoms.definition: An encephalitis that is not intense (not severe).

symptoms.label: skin lesion
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an abnormal change in structure of the skin that is especially circumscribed and well defined due to injury or disease.

symptoms.label: nephritis
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by the acute or chronic inflammation of the kidney affecting the structure (as of the glomerulus or parenchyma) and caused by infection, a degenerative process, or vascular disease.

symptoms.label: pain
symptoms.definition: A sensation perception that is characterized by an unpleasant sensation that usually indicates the body is threatened or damaged. The sensation may be sharp or dull, short-lived or chronic, intermittent or continual, confined to one area or spread over the entire body.

symptoms.label: peritonitis
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an inflammation of the peritoneum.

symptoms.label: pleural effusion
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an exudation of fluid from the blood or lymph into a pleural cavity.

symptoms.label: prostration
symptoms.definition: Prostration is a general symptom characterized by complete physical or mental exhaustion.

symptoms.label: rales
symptoms.definition: An abnormal chest sound that is characterized by the clicking, rattling, or crackling noises heard on auscultation of (listening to) the lung with a stethoscope during inhalation. The sounds are caused by the 'popping open' of small airways and alveoli collapsed by fluid, exudate, or lack of aeration during expiration. The word 'rales' derives from the French word rale meaning 'rattle'. Rales can be heard in patients with pneumonia, atelectasis, pulmonary fibrosis, acute bronchitis, or bronchiectasis. Pulmonary edema secondary to left-sided congestive heart failure can also cause rales.

symptoms.label: severe joint pain
symptoms.definition: A joint pain that is characterized by a pain situated, or occurring, in or around a joint that is intense (severe).

symptoms.label: necrosis
symptoms.definition: Necrosis is a general symptom where death of a portion of tissue differentially affected by local injury (as loss of blood supply, corrosion, burning, or the local lesion of a disease).

symptoms.label: skin ulcer
symptoms.definition: A skin lesion that is characterized by a break in skin with loss of surface tissue, disintegration and necrosis of epithelial tissue, and often pus.

symptoms.label: sneezing
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by a sudden violent spasmodic audible expiration of breath through the nose and mouth especially as a reflex act following irritation of the nasal mucous membrane.

symptoms.label: spasticity
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by an abnormal increase in muscle tone or stiffness of muscle, which might interfere with movement, speech, or be associated with discomfort or pain.

symptoms.label: obsolete bronchopneumonia
symptoms.definition: A pneumonia that is characterized by acute inflammation of the bronchi, accompanied by inflamed patches in the nearby lobules of the lungs

symptoms.label: obsolete sudden onset of severe chills
thirst
symptoms.definition: Thirst is a general symptom characterized by a sensation of dryness in the mouth and throat associated with a desire for liquids.

symptoms.label: tremor
symptoms.definition: Tremor is a generial symptom characterized by a trembling or shaking usually from physical weakness, emotional stress, or disease.

symptoms.label: incoordination
symptoms.definition: A coordination symptom that is characterized by a loss of complicated body movements, which may be caused by disease, injury, or toxins.

symptoms.label: obsolete vesicular lesions on lip border
wasting
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by the unintended loss of weight and lean body tissue characteristic of many diseases (as cancer, tuberculosis, and AIDS).

symptoms.label: weight loss
symptoms.definition: A weight symptom that is characterized by a reduction of the total body mass, by a mean loss of fluid, body fat (adipose tissue), or lean mass (namely bone mineral deposits, muscle, tendon, and other connective tissue). Weight loss can either occur unintentionally because of malnourishment or an underlying disease.

symptoms.label: weariness
symptoms.definition: A fatigue that is characterized by a feeling of exhaustion in strength, endurance, and vigor.

symptoms.label: exhaustion
symptoms.definition: A fatigue that is characterized by a feeling of weariness (bodily or mental) or feeling of weakness.  Exhaustion is a shorter-lived form of fatigue that can be experienced emotionally, mentally, and physically.

symptoms.label: tiredness
symptoms.definition: A fatigue that is characterized by a feeling of a lessened capacity for work and reduced efficiency of accomplishment, usually accompanied by a sense of weariness and fatigue.

symptoms.label: abortion
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by the expulsion of a fetus at any time before completion of pregnancy and is often due to infection.

symptoms.label: miscarriage
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by the spontaneous expulsion of a human fetus before it is viable and especially between the 12th and 28th weeks of gestation.

symptoms.label: spontaneous abortion
symptoms.definition: An abortion that is characterized by the natural occurring expulsion of a nonviable fetus.

symptoms.label: acute meningoencephalitis
symptoms.definition: A meningoencephalitis that is characterized by a severe and sudden onset.

symptoms.label: afebrile
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by the state of being free from fever.

symptoms.label: agraphia
symptoms.definition: An aphasia that is characterized by a pathological loss of the ability to write.

symptoms.label: anomia
symptoms.definition: An aphasia that is characterized by a severe problem with recalling words or names.

symptoms.label: inability to comprehend speech
symptoms.definition: An aphasia that is characterized by a loss of ability to comprehend speech.

symptoms.label: inability to speak
symptoms.definition: An aphasia that is characterized by a loss of ability to speak.

symptoms.label: inability to form words
symptoms.definition: An aphasia that is characterized by a loss of ability to form words.

symptoms.label: poor enunciation
symptoms.definition: An aphasia that is characterized by a loss of ability to properly enunciate words.

symptoms.label: receptive aphasia
symptoms.definition: An inability to comprehend speech that is characterized by an inability to understand spoken, written, or tactile speech symbols that results from damage (as by a brain lesion) to an area of the brain (as Wernicke's area) concerned with language.

symptoms.label: atrial fibrillation
symptoms.definition: A cardiac fibrillation consisting of a very rapid uncoordinated contractions of the atria of the heart resulting in a lack of synchronism between heartbeat and pulse beat.

symptoms.label: bradycardia
symptoms.definition: Bradycardia is a cardiovascular system symptom consisting of a relatively slow heart action whether physiological or pathological.

symptoms.label: bronchiolitis
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by an inflammation of the bronchioles.

symptoms.label: colic
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by the condition marked by recurrent episodes of prolonged and uncontrollable crying and irritability in an otherwise healthy infant that is of unknown cause and usually subsides after three to four months of age.

symptoms.label: colicky pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by an attack of acute abdominal pain localized in a hollow organ or part (as the small intestine, ureter, or bile duct) and often caused by spasm, obstruction, or twisting.

symptoms.label: congestion
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by an excessive accumulation especially of blood or mucus.

symptoms.label: cough with bloody sputum
symptoms.definition: A cough that is characterized by production and expectoration (bringing up) of sputum that is bright red or pink and frothy.

symptoms.label: cyclic fever
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by occurring during periodic episodes.

symptoms.label: decreased appetite
symptoms.definition: An alteration of appetite that is characterized by a reduced desire to eat.

symptoms.label: increased appetite
symptoms.definition: An alteration of appetite that is characterized by an desire to eat, an excess desire for food.

symptoms.label: proprioception symptom
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by one's body’s ability to sense movement, action, and location and results from sensory receptors in one's nervous system and body (muscles, joints, and tendons).

symptoms.label: decreased conscious proprioception
symptoms.definition: A proprioception symptom that is characterized by a decreased ability of an organism to consciously process the reception of stimuli produced within the organism.

symptoms.label: dermal abscess
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a pus-filled pocket in the skin, similar to a pimple, but larger and deeper.  The pocket is filled with bacteria, white blood cells, and dead skin and typcally result from the bacteria Staphylococcus aureus prentrating the skin through a cut or hair follicle.

symptoms.label: diffuse rash
symptoms.definition: A rash characterized by large patches of red skin, without overlying changes in the epidermis.

symptoms.label: dry hacking cough
symptoms.definition: A dry cough that is characterized by a rough and loud sound.

symptoms.label: epididymitis
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by an inflammation of the epididymis.

symptoms.label: epididymorchitis
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by inflammation of the epididymis and/or testicle (testis).

symptoms.label: extreme exhaustion
symptoms.definition: An exhaustion that is characterized by exceeding the ordinary, usual, or expected.

symptoms.label: extreme fatigue
symptoms.definition: A fatigue that is characterized by exceeding the ordinary, usual, or expected.

symptoms.label: flaccid paralysis
symptoms.definition: A paralysis that is charicterized by a lack of muscle tone in the affected muscles and in which tendon reflexes are decreased or absent.

symptoms.label: arrhythmia
symptoms.definition: Arrhythmia is a cardiovascular system symptom consisting of an alteration in rhythm of the heartbeat either in time or force.

symptoms.label: eczema
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an inflammatory condition of the skin with redness, itching, and oozing vesicular lesions, which become scaly, crusted, or hardened.

symptoms.label: belching
symptoms.definition: Belching is a digestive system symptom involving the sudden expulsion of gas from the stomach through the mouth.

symptoms.label: hemiparesis
symptoms.definition: A paralysis that is characterized by a weakness or the inability to move on one side of the body.

symptoms.label: hepatic abscess
symptoms.definition: hepatic abscess is a liver symptom characterized by a pus-filled mass in the liver that can develop from injury to the liver or an intraabdominal infection disseminated from the portal circulation.

symptoms.label: hyperemia
symptoms.definition: Hyperemia is a hemic system symptom consisting of an excess of blood in a body part as from an increased flow of blood due to vasodilation.

symptoms.label: hyperesthesia
symptoms.definition: A sensation perception that is characterized by an increased sensitivity to stimulation.

symptoms.label: hypothermia
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a subnormal temperature of the body, as defined by a temperature under 36.6 degrees Celcius (97.8 degrees Fahrenheit).

symptoms.label: impaired coordination
symptoms.definition: A coordination symptom that is characterized by weakened or imperfect body complicated  movement, which may be caused by disease, injury, or toxins.

symptoms.label: inability to feed
symptoms.definition: A feeding difficulties and mismanagement that is characterized by a lack of feeding capacity.

symptoms.label: loss of appetite
symptoms.definition: An alteration of appetite that is characterized by a loss of desire to eat, i.e. no desire to eat.

symptoms.label: loss of balance
symptoms.definition: A  balance symptom that is characterized by an inability to stay upright and move confidently.  Loss of balance may be due to problems in the inner ear, the brain, or the heart. Aging, infections, head injury, certain medicines, and problems with blood circulation may also cause balance problems.

symptoms.label: low birth weight
symptoms.definition: A weight symptom that is characterized by an infant weighing 5.5 pounds (2500 grams) or less at birth.  Low birth weight may occur with premature birth, or due to smoking cigarettes, secondhand tobacco smoke exposure, drinking alcohol, and taking certain drugs during pregnancy.

symptoms.label: melena
symptoms.definition: A feces and droppings symptom that is characterized by the passage of dark tarry stools containing decomposing blood that is usually an indication of bleeding in the upper part of the alimentary canal and especially the esophagus, stomach, and duodenum.

symptoms.label: bronchitis
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by an acute or chronic inflammation of the bronchial tubes.

symptoms.label: tetanic convulsion
symptoms.definition: A convulsion that is characterized by a tonic spasm (prolonged contraction of the muscles), without loss of consciousness and often associated with hypocalcemia.

symptoms.label: mild tetanic convulsion
symptoms.definition: A tetanic convulsion that is not intense (not severe).

symptoms.label: muscle ache
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a continuous or prolonged dull pain.

symptoms.label: limb edema
symptoms.definition: An adema that is characterized by an abnormal excess accumulation of serous fluid in connective tissue of the limbs.

symptoms.label: painful lymph glands
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a pain situated, or occurring, in the lymph gland (lymph node). Pain is often associated with swelling of the gland, which is a sign that one's body is fighting an infection.

symptoms.label: palpebral edema
symptoms.definition: An adema that is characterized by an abnormal excess accumulation of serous fluid in connective tissue of the eyelids.

symptoms.label: panting respiration
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by short, shallow, and rapid breathing.

symptoms.label: papule
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a small solid usually conical elevation of the skin caused by inflammation, accumulated secretion, or hypertrophy of tissue elements.

symptoms.label: paraplegia
symptoms.definition: A paralysis that is characterized by a complete, or partial, loss of function of the lower half of the body with involvement of both legs that is usually due to injury or disease of the spinal cord in the thoracic or lumbar region.

symptoms.label: obsolete partial paralysis of the limbs
phlegm
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by a viscid mucus secreted in abnormal quantity in the respiratory passages.

symptoms.label: pneumonitis
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by an inflammation of lung tissue. Pneumonia is one type of pneumonitis caused by an infection. Many other factors can cause pneumonitis, including breathing in animal dander, inhaling small food particles 'down the wrong pipe' and receiving radiation therapy to your chest.

symptoms.label: poor feeding
symptoms.definition: A feeding difficulties and mismanagement that is characterized by an infant with little interest in feeding and it can also refer to an infant who is not feeding enough to receive the necessary nutrition required for adequate growth.

symptoms.label: premature labor
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by labor occurring before 37 full weeks of pregnancy.

symptoms.label: emaciation
symptoms.definition: A wasting that is characterized by the state of being extremely thin as a result of an absence of body fat and very week as a result of muscle wasting; usually because of illness or extreme hunger.

symptoms.label: progressive emaciation
symptoms.definition: An emaciation that is characterized by an increase in scope or severity with time.

symptoms.label: prostatic abscess
symptoms.definition: A prostate symptom that is characterized by a localized collection of purulent fluid within the prostate, often forming as a complication of acute bacterial prostatitis.

symptoms.label: prostatic infection
symptoms.definition: A prostate symptom that is characterized by inflammation of the prostate and surrounding area.

symptoms.label: proteinuria
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom characterized by the presence of excess protein in the urine.

symptoms.label: proximal paralysis of arm and leg
ptosis
symptoms.definition: Ptosis is a general symptom characterized by a sagging or prolapse of an organ or part.

symptoms.label: renal abscess
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by a pocket (a walled-off cavity) of pus that develops in the kidney tissue. It results from the migration of bacteria from another infection site on the body to the kidneys.

symptoms.label: respiratory paralysis
symptoms.definition: A paralysis that is characterized by a complete or severe weakness of the muscles of respiration.

symptoms.label: rhinorrhea
symptoms.definition: A nose symptom that is characterized by an excessive secretion of mucous through the nose.

symptoms.label: scrotal abscess
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by an abscess that is either superficial or intrascrotal.  Superficial scrotal abscess may occur from an infected hair follicle, infection of a scrotal laceration, or minor scrotal surgery.  Intrascrotal abscess most commonly arises from bacterial epididymitis, but may also be related to tuberculous infection of the epididymis, a testicular abscess that ruptures through the tunica albuginea, or drainage of appendicitis into scrotum through a patent processus vaginalis or as a result of extravasation of infected urine from the urethra in patients with a urethral stricture and neurogenic bladder using an external collection device.

symptoms.label: obsolete mastitis
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an inflammation of the mammary gland or udder and usually caused by infection.

symptoms.label: obsolete severe mastitis
symptoms.definition: A mastitis that is characterized by an increased intensity or severity of the condition.

symptoms.label: severe myalgia
symptoms.definition: A muscle pain that is characterized by being severe in nature.  Myalgia may be acute in nature, stemming from overuse of a muscle group or viral infection.  It may also be chronic and caused by  metabolic myopathy, some nutritional deficiencies, and chronic fatigue syndrome.

symptoms.label: stupor
symptoms.definition: An alteration of consciousness that is characterized by a lack of critical mental function and a level of consciousness, in which an affected person is almost entirely unresponsive and responds only to intense stimuli such as pain.

symptoms.label: vaginal discharge
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by fluid made by glands inside the vagina and cervix carrying away dead cells and bacteria. While it is normal for odor and color to vary, vaginal itching or burning may be indicative of an infection.

symptoms.label: vertigo
symptoms.definition: A dizziness that is characterized by a specific type of dizziness, a major symptom of a balance disorder. It is the sensation of spinning or swaying while the body is stationary with respect to the surroundings.

symptoms.label: cachexia
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by a general physical wasting and malnutrition usually associated with chronic disease.

symptoms.label: weight gain
symptoms.definition: A weight symptom that is characterized by an increase in body weight. This can involve an increase in muscle mass, fat deposits, excess fluids such as water or other factors.

symptoms.label: vaginismus
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by a painful spasmodic contraction of the vagina.

symptoms.label: bruise
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an injury transmitted through unbroken skin to underlying tissue causing rupture of small blood vessels and escape of blood into the tissue with resulting discoloration.

symptoms.label: syncope
symptoms.definition: An alteration of consciousness that is characterized by a loss of consciousness resulting from insufficient blood flow to the brain.

symptoms.label: cataplexy
symptoms.definition: Cataplexy is a muscle symptom characterized by a sudden loss of muscle control with retention of clear consciousness that follows a strong emotional stimulus (as elation, surprise, or anger) and is a characteristic symptom of narcolepsy.

symptoms.label: hyperthermia
symptoms.definition: A high fever that is characterized by an exceptionally high fever especially when induced artificially for therapeutic purposes.

symptoms.label: anxiety
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a painful or apprehensive uneasiness of mind usually over an impending or anticipated ill.

symptoms.label: catatonia
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a marked psychomotor disturbance that may involve stupor or mutism, negativism, rigidity, purposeless excitement, echolalia, echopraxia, and inappropriate or bizarre posturing and is associated with various medical conditions (as schizophrenia and mood disorders).

symptoms.label: dysarthria
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a difficulty in articulating words due to disease of the central nervous system.

symptoms.label: bloating
symptoms.definition: Bloating is a digestive system symptom involving the accumulation of gas in the digestive tract and resulting in abdominal distension.

symptoms.label: hematochezia
symptoms.definition: hematochezia is a feces and droppings symptom characterized by the passage of fresh blood per anus, usually in or with stools.

symptoms.label: dyspepsia
symptoms.definition: Dyspepsia is a digestive system symptom referred to as indigestion resulting from an impairment to digestion caused by ulcer, gall bladder disease or inflamed colon. Related symptoms include weakness, loss of appetite, and depression.

symptoms.label: pyrosis
symptoms.definition: From synonym: Heartburn is a pain characterized by a painful burning feeling in your chest or throat that happens when stomach acid backs up into your esophagus.

symptoms.label: claudication
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a leg pain in the calf, or thigh, which is caused by inadequate blood flow to the leg muscles and is brought on by leg exercise such as walking.

symptoms.label: obsolete impotence
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by an abnormal physical or psychological state of a male characterized by inability to copulate because of failure to have, or maintain, an erection.

symptoms.label: hypoventilation
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by a deficient ventilation of the lungs that results in reduction in the oxygen content or increase in the carbon dioxide content of the blood or both.

symptoms.label: bradypnea
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by abnormally slow breathing.

symptoms.label: pleuritic chest pain
symptoms.definition: A chest pain that is characterized by an inflammation of the pleural cavity with a sharp pain resulting from the exansion of the lungs as the inflammed pleural layers rub against each other.

symptoms.label: sputum
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by matter discharged from the air passages in diseases of the lungs, bronchi, or upper respiratory tract that contains mucus and often pus, blood, fibrin, or bacterial products.

symptoms.label: itching
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an uneasy irritating sensation in the upper surface of the skin usually held to result from mild stimulation of pain receptors.

symptoms.label: anasarca
symptoms.definition: Anasarca is a edema characterized as generalized edema with accumulation of serum in the connective tissue.

symptoms.label: urticaria
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by raised red skin wheals (welts) commonly caused by an allergic reaction with wheals that may vary in size from about 5 mm (0.2 inches) in diameter to the size of a dinner plate that are described as severely itchy a stingnig or burning sensation, and having a pale border.

symptoms.label: paresthesia
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a sensation of pricking, tingling, or creeping on the skin having no objective cause and usually associated with injury or irritation of a sensory nerve or nerve root.

symptoms.label: abnormal vaginal bleeding
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by bleeding from the uterus that is longer than usual or that occurs at an irregular time. Bleeding may be heavier or lighter than usual and occur often or randomly.

symptoms.label: toothache
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a pain in, or about, a tooth or teeth.

symptoms.label: obsolete heartburn
symptoms.definition: Heartburn is a pain characterized by a painful burning feeling in your chest or throat that happens when stomach acid backs up into your esophagus.

symptoms.label: hair loss
symptoms.definition: A hair symptom that is characterized by the stopping of hair growth (regeneration), which may be a result of hereditary hair loss, immune system overreacts, drugs and treatments, harsh hair-care products, and other factors.

symptoms.label: elbow pain
symptoms.definition: A joint pain that is characterized by a pain situated, or occurring, in or around the elbow.

symptoms.label: knee pain
symptoms.definition: A joint pain that is characterized by a pain situated, or occurring, in or around the knee.

symptoms.label: shoulder pain
symptoms.definition: A joint pain that is characterized by a pain situated, or occurring, in or around the shoulder.

symptoms.label: obsolete faint
symptoms.definition: Faint is a alteration of consciousness characterized by a loss of consciousness because of a temporary decrease in the blood supply to the brain.

symptoms.label: bloody sputum
symptoms.definition: A sputum that is characterized by blood or bloody mucus discharged from the air passages caused by common forms of infection in the lungs and airways, such as acute bronchitis or pneumonia. Bloody sputum can also come from cancer of the lung.

symptoms.label: epistaxis
symptoms.definition: A nose symptom that involves a is loss of blood from the tissue lining the nose.

symptoms.label: shock
symptoms.definition: A cardiovascular system symptom that is characterized as a state of profound depression of the vital processes of the body that is characterized by pallor, rapid but weak pulse, rapid and shallow respiration, reduced total blood volume, and low blood pressure and that is caused usually by severe especially crushing injuries, hemorrhage, burns, or major surgery.

symptoms.label: abnormal weight gain
symptoms.definition: A weight gain that is characterized as deviating from what is normal or usual, typically in a way that is undesirable or worrying.

symptoms.label: left upper quadrant abdominal pain
symptoms.definition: An abdominal pain that is characterized by occurring in the left upper quadrant abdominal pain of the abdomen that can be caused by a stomach ulcer, acute gastritis, a viral infection, or indigestion, or may be an issue with one's lungs.

symptoms.label: abdominal pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by occurring in the abdomen, i.e. between the chest and groin.

symptoms.label: nausea
symptoms.definition: Nausea is a digestive system symptom characterized by an uneasy or unsettled feeling in the stomach together with an urge to vomit.

symptoms.label: symptom
symptoms.definition: A symptom is a perceived change in function, sensation, loss, disturbance or appearance reported by a patient indicative of a disease.

symptoms.label: lack of expected normal physiological development in childhood
failure to thrive
symptoms.definition: A lack of expected normal physiological development in childhood that is characterized by a decelerated or arrested physical growth (height and weight measurements fall below the third or fifth percentile, or a downward change in growth across two major growth percentiles) and is associated with abnormal growth and development.

symptoms.label: delayed milestones
symptoms.definition: A lack of expected normal physiological development in childhood that is characterized by a failure for a child to reach a significant stage at the predicted age and may include walking or talking.

symptoms.label: early satiety
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by a feeling of being full after a few bites of food, or before you finish a normal-sized meal.

symptoms.label: obsolete abnormal loss of weight and underweight
underweight
symptoms.definition: A weight symptom that is characterized by weighing less than the normal amount for one's age, height, and build.

symptoms.label: abnormality of gait
symptoms.definition: Abnormality of gait is a nervous system and musculoskeletal system symptom characterized by a difficulty in the manner of walking or moving on foot.

symptoms.label: persistent vegetative state
symptoms.definition: An alteration of consciousness that is characterized by an individual with severe brain damage being in a state of partial arousal rather than true awareness. After four weeks in a vegetative state, the patient is classified as being in a persistent vegetative state. After three months in the US and six months in the UK, the diagnosis is classified as a permanent vegetative state after a non-traumatic brain injury, or, one year after a traumatic injury.

symptoms.label: alteration of consciousness
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by any condition which is significantly different from a normal waking state.

symptoms.label: dysuria
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by the difficult, or painful, discharge of urine.

symptoms.label: rash
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an eruption on the body typically with little or no elevation above the surface.

symptoms.label: skin and integumentary tissue symptom
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by the outer layer of the skin starting to replace itself. Often, this happens when skin is damaged, either by disease or injury.

symptoms.label: urinary incontinence
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by the an inability of the body to control the evacuative functions.

symptoms.label: renal colic
symptoms.definition: A colic that is characterized by a severe pain produced by the passage of a calculus from the kidney through the ureter.

symptoms.label: urethral discharge
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by abnormal purulent or mucoid secretions from the penis or, rarely, the female urethra.

symptoms.label: mixed incontinence (female) (male)
symptoms.definition: A urinary incontinence that is characterized by urine leakage when you sneeze, cough, laugh, do jarring exercise, or lift something heavy. It is typically a combination of stress and urge incontinence.

symptoms.label: adult failure to thrive
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by a physical decline in health seen in older adults – typically those with multiple chronic medical conditions – resulting in decreased appetite and poor nutrition, weight loss, inactivity, often accompanied by dehydration, depression, decreasing functional ability, and impaired immune function.

symptoms.label: headache
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a pain in the head.

symptoms.label: throat pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a painful throat due to inflammation of the fauces and pharynx.

symptoms.label: aphasia
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by a loss or impairment of the power to use or comprehend words usually resulting from brain damage.

symptoms.label: pallor
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a deficiency of color especially of the face.

symptoms.label: flushing
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a markedly red flush in a persons face and often other areas of the skin, from various physiological conditions. Flushing is generally distinguished, despite a close physiological relation between them, from blushing, which is milder, generally restricted to the face or cheeks, and generally assumed to reflect embarrassment. Flushing is also a cardinal symptom of carcinoid syndrome the syndrome that results from hormones (often serotonin or histamine) being secreted into systemic circulation.

symptoms.label: male stress incontinence
symptoms.definition: A stress incontinence that is characterized by a compromised external urinary sphincter muscle resulting from surgical or radiotherapeutic manipulation.

symptoms.label: stridor
symptoms.definition: An abnormal chest sound that is characterized by a harsh vibrating sound heard during respiration in cases of obstruction of the air passages.

symptoms.label: hiccough
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by a spasmodic inhalation with closure of the glottis accompanied by a peculiar sound.

symptoms.label: hemoptysis
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by an expectoration of blood from some part of the respiratory tract.

symptoms.label: generalized abdominal pain
symptoms.definition: An abdominal pain that is characterized by being diffuse or widespread and affecting or involving all of the abdomen.

symptoms.label: anorexia
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by a loss of appetite especially when prolonged.

symptoms.label: polyphagia
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by an excessive appetite or eating.

symptoms.label: transient alteration of awareness
symptoms.definition: An alteration of consciousness that is characterized by a brief (transient) episode of losing normal awareness or behavior.

symptoms.label: ascites
symptoms.definition: An abdominal symptom consisting of an abnormal accumulation of serous fluid in the spaces between tissues and organs in the cavity of the abdomen.

symptoms.label: tachycardia
symptoms.definition: Tachycardia is a cardiovascular system symptom consisting of a relatively rapid heart action whether physiological (as after exercise) or pathological.

symptoms.label: palpitation
symptoms.definition: Palpitation is a cardiovascykar system symptom characterized by an abnormal awareness of the beating of the heart,whether it is too slow, too fast, irregular, or at its normal frequency when excited by violent exertion, strong emotion, or disease.

symptoms.label: urge incontinence
symptoms.definition: A urinary incontinence that is characterized by an involuntary leakage of urine from the bladder when a sudden strong need to urinate is felt, even when the bladder isn't full.

symptoms.label: post-void dribbling
symptoms.definition: A urinary incontinence that is characterized by urine remaining in the urethra after voiding the bladder that slowly leaks out after urination.

symptoms.label: spontaneous ecchymoses
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by the spontaneous escape of blood into the tissues from ruptured blood vessels marked by a livid black-and-blue or purple spot or area.

symptoms.label: cyanosis
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a bluish or purplish discoloration (as of skin) due to deficient oxygenation of the blood.

symptoms.label: edema
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an abnormal excess accumulation of serous fluid in connective tissue or in a serous cavity.

symptoms.label: jaundice
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a yellowish pigmentation of the skin, tissues, and certain body fluids is caused by the deposition of bile pigments that follows interference with normal production and discharge of bile (as in certain liver diseases) or excessive breakdown of red blood cells (as after internal hemorrhage or in various hemolytic states).

symptoms.label: painful respiration
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by a feeling of discomfort when breathing in or out.  The pain may be the result of infection, musculoskeletal injury, and heart problems.

symptoms.label: epigastric abdominal pain
symptoms.definition: An abdominal pain that is characterized by occurring in the epigastrium, i.e. the upper part of the abdomen below the rib cage.

symptoms.label: memory loss
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by an unusual forgetfulness. One may not be able to remember new events, recall one or more memories of the past, or both.  Memory loss may be for a short time and then resolve (transient), or it may not go away and get worse over time.

symptoms.label: transient paralysis of limb
symptoms.definition: A paralysis that is characterized by a loss of some, or all, muscle control in a limb, and which lasts for only a short time (i.e. is temporary).

symptoms.label: disturbances of sensation of smell and taste
meningismus
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by a state of meningeal irritation with symptoms suggesting meningitis that often occurs at the onset of acute febrile diseases especially in children.

symptoms.label: urinary retention
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by an inability to empty the bladder completely during the process of voiding (urination).

symptoms.label: incomplete bladder emptying
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by a bladder that is not empty.

symptoms.label: polydipsia
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by an excessive or abnormal thirst.

symptoms.label: urinary frequency
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by the need to urinate many times during the day, at night, or both but in normal or less-than-normal volumes.  Frequency may be accompanied by a sensation of an urgent need to void (urgency of urination).

symptoms.label: nocturia
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by urination at night especially when excessive.

symptoms.label: polyuria
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by the excessive secretion of urine.

symptoms.label: short stature
symptoms.definition: A lack of expected normal physiological development in childhood that is characterized by an individual's height being in the 3rd percentile for the mean height of a given age, sex, and population group.

symptoms.label: oliguria
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by the reduced excretion of urine.

symptoms.label: diarrhea
symptoms.definition: Diarrhea is a feces and droppng symptom involving the abnormally frequent intestinal evacuations with more or less fluid stools.

symptoms.label: insomnia
symptoms.definition: Insomnia is a sleep disturbance characterized by prolonged and usually abnormal inability to obtain adequate sleep.

symptoms.label: splitting of urinary stream
symptoms.definition: A urinary stream symptom that is characterized by a split in the urine flow resulting in it streaming in two directions.

symptoms.label: sleep apnea
symptoms.definition: An apnea that is characterized by brief periods of recurrent cessation of breathing during sleep that is caused especially by obstruction of the airway or a disturbance in the brain's respiratory center and is associated especially with excessive daytime sleepiness.

symptoms.label: hypersomnia
symptoms.definition: Hypersomnia is a sleep disturbance characterized by sleeping for excessive periods at intervals with intervening periods of normal duration of sleeping and waking.

symptoms.label: overflow incontinence
symptoms.definition: A urinary incontinence that is characterized by a bladder that does not empty completely, resulting in a bladder that is too full, which leads to overflow and unexpected leaking.

symptoms.label: abnormal chest sound
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by a sound of breathing that is not similar to that of the sound of moving air and may include: rhonchi (a low-pitched breath sound), crackles (a high-pitched breath sound), wheezing (a high-pitched whistling sound caused by narrowing of the bronchial tubes), and stridor (a harsh, vibratory sound caused by narrowing of the upper airway).

symptoms.label: extravasation of urine
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by an injury of the urethra in its bulbous or membranous portion, which leads to a collection of urine in other cavities, such as the perineal space, the scrotum, the penis and the connective tissue of the anterior abdominal wall.

symptoms.label: slowing of urinary stream
symptoms.definition: A urinary stream symptom that is characterized by a slow or weak stream of urine.

symptoms.label: urinary urgency
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by a strong and immediate need to urinate due to an increase in pressure in the bladder, resulting in difficulty to hold in the urine. This can occur regardless of whether the bladder is full.

symptoms.label: abnormal involuntary movement
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by an inability to control bodily movement and may be a symptom of cerebrovascular diseases, dyskinesia, tremor, chorea, dystonia and myoclonus.

symptoms.label: febrile convulsion
symptoms.definition: A convulsion that is characterized by occurring in young children between six months and five years of age and which is triggered by fever.

symptoms.label: convulsion
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by an abnormal violent and involuntary contraction or series of contractions of the muscles.

symptoms.label: respiratory abnormality
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by a respiration that is not normal and may include, but is not limited to: apnea, eupnea, orthopnea, dyspnea hyperpnea, hyperventilation, hypoventilation, tachypnea, Kussmaul respiration, Cheyne-Stokes respiration, sighing respiration, Biot respiration, apneustic breathing, central neurogenic hyperventilation, and central neurogenic hypoventilation.

symptoms.label: cheyne-stokes respiration
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by a specific form of periodic breathing (waxing and waning amplitude of flow or tidal volume) characterized by a crescendo-decrescendo pattern of respiration between central apneas or central hypopneas.

symptoms.label: apnea
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by transient cessation of respiration whether normal (as in hibernating animals) or abnormal (as that caused by certain drugs).

symptoms.label: hyperventilation
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by excessive ventilation characterized by excessive rate and depth of respiration leading to abnormal loss of carbon dioxide from the blood.

symptoms.label: orthopnea
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by a difficulty in breathing that occurs when lying down and is relieved upon changing to an upright position (as in congestive heart failure).

symptoms.label: tachypnea
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by an increased rate of respiration and shallow breathing.

symptoms.label: wheezing
symptoms.definition: An abnormal chest sound that is characterized by breathing with difficulty usually with a whistling sound.

symptoms.label: coma
symptoms.definition: An alteration of consciousness that is characterized by a deep state of prolonged unconsciousness in which a person cannot be awakened, fails to respond normally to painful stimuli, light, or sound, lacks a normal wake-sleep cycle and does not initiate voluntary actions.

symptoms.label: nocturnal enuresis
symptoms.definition: A urinary incontinence that is characterized by involuntary urination at night in children five years of age or older.

symptoms.label: hallucination
