symptoms.definition: Hallucination is a general symptom where there is a perception of something (as a visual image or a sound) with no external cause usually arising from a disorder of the nervous system (as in delirium tremens or in functional psychosis without known neurological disease) or in response to drugs (as LSD).

symptoms.label: syncope and collapse
symptoms.definition: An alteration of consciousness that is characterized by a loss of consciousness resulting from insufficient blood flow to the brain and limb weakness progressing to collapse.

symptoms.label: generalized hyperhidrosis
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by excessive sweating, i.e. the production of more sweat than is required to regulate body temperature.  Generalized hyperhidrosis is caused by non-thermoregulatory stimuli and affects the entire body.

symptoms.label: dizziness
symptoms.definition: A  balance symptom that is characterized by a sensation of unsteadiness accompanied by a feeling of movement within the head.

symptoms.label: fever
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a rise of body temperature above the normal, whether as a natural response (as to infection) or artificially induced for therapeutic reasons.

symptoms.label: cough
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by an explosive expulsion of air from the lungs acting as a protective mechanism to clear the air passages or as a symptom of pulmonary disturbance.

symptoms.label: left lower quadrant abdominal pain
symptoms.definition: An abdominal pain that is characterized by occurring in the left lower quadrant of the abdomen that is often related to the digestive tract, but can also be related to conditions of the body wall, skin, blood vessels, urinary tract, or reproductive organs.

symptoms.label: alexia
symptoms.definition: An aphasia that is characterized by a loss of ability to read.

symptoms.label: acute renal failure
symptoms.definition: A renal failure that is characterized by a severe and sudden onset of renal failure.

symptoms.label: conscious disturbance
symptoms.definition: An alteration of consciousness that is characterized by a disturbance in sentience (the ability to experience feelings and sensations) or awareness of one's internal and external existence, i.e. inhibited or absent self-awareness.

symptoms.label: exanthema
symptoms.definition: A rash characterized by a widespread skin eruption usually occurring in children that is a symptom of a more general disease.

symptoms.label: hip pain
symptoms.definition: A joint pain that is characterized by a pain situated, or occurring, in or around the hip.

symptoms.label: maculopapular rash
symptoms.definition: A rash characterized by papule(s), which are a raised area of the skin and macule(s), which are a flat red area of the skin.

symptoms.label: papular rash
symptoms.definition: A rash characterized by papule(s), which are a raised area of the skin.

symptoms.label: ankle rash
symptoms.definition: A rash characterized by an inflammatory reaction of the skin on the ankles.

symptoms.label: respiratory failure
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by a difficulty to breathe on one's own and develops when the lungs cannot get enough oxygen into the blood.

symptoms.label: synovitis
symptoms.definition: Synovitis is a joint inflammation characterized by an inflammation of a synovial membrane usually with pain and swelling of the joint.

symptoms.label: tache noire
symptoms.definition: A skin ulcer that is characterized by a a small dark-centered ulcer that appears at the site of a tick bite and is the primary lesion of boutonneuse fever.

symptoms.label: irritability
symptoms.definition: A behavioral symptom that is characterized by a quick excitability to annoyance, impatience, or anger.

symptoms.label: pareses
symptoms.definition: A paralysis that is charachterized by a slight or partial paralysis.

symptoms.label: purpuric rash
symptoms.definition: A rash characterized by a red or purple hued small spots of blood appear on the skin caused by conditions that result in blood leaking into the skin and other body surfaces that does not fade when pressed upon.

symptoms.label: shakes
symptoms.definition: Shakes is a general symptom characterized by a condition of trembling.

symptoms.label: abnormal behavior
symptoms.definition: A behavioral symptom that is characterized by behavior that is atypical or statistically uncommon within a particular culture, or that is maladaptive, or detrimental to an individual, or those around that individual.

symptoms.label: bradykinesia
symptoms.definition: Bradykinesia is a hypokinesia characterized by an extreme slowness in the execution of movements and reflexes.

symptoms.label: acute diarrhea
symptoms.definition: Acute diarrhea is a diarrhea with either or both a rapid onset or a short course.

symptoms.label: acute enteritis
symptoms.definition: Acute enteritis is a enteritis with either or both a rapid onset and a short course which is usually due to bacteria or virus.

symptoms.label: acute mental dysfunction
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by a severe and sudden onset of disturbance in the normal operation of one's cognition, emotional regulation, or behaviour.

symptoms.label: acute dyspnea
symptoms.definition: A dyspnea that is characterized by a severe and sudden onset.

symptoms.label: acute weight loss
symptoms.definition: A weight loss that is characterized by a severe and sudden onset.

symptoms.label: aggressive behavior
symptoms.definition: A behavioral symptom that is characterized by behavior aimed at harming a person, or animal, or damaging physical property.

symptoms.label: altered mental status
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by a host of presentations that include changes in cognition, mood, behavior, and/or level of arousal.

symptoms.label: obsolete tachypnoea
symptoms.definition: Tachypnoea is a respiratory system and chest symptom characterized by an increased rate of respiration.

symptoms.label: chronic cough
symptoms.definition: A cough that is characterized by an explosive expulsion of air from the lungs acting as a protective mechanism to clear the air passages or as a symptom of pulmonary disturbance marked by long duration, by frequent recurrence over a long time, and often by slowly progressing seriousness.

symptoms.label: obsolete chronic fatigue syndrome
symptoms.definition: Chronic fatigue syndrome is a fatigue characterized by a disorder of uncertain cause that is characterized by persistent profound fatigue usually accompanied by impairment in short-term memory or concentration, sore throat, tender lymph nodes, muscle or joint pain, and headache unrelated to any preexisting medical condition and that typically has an onset at about 30 years of age.

symptoms.label: circling movement
symptoms.definition: An abnormal involuntary movement that is characterized by an inability to walk in a straight line.

symptoms.label: decreased milk production
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by a decrease in the production of milk in breastfeeding mothers.

symptoms.label: decreased sucking
symptoms.definition: A feeding difficulties and mismanagement that is characterized by a decrease in muscle coordination to form a suck response so that the child can ingest milk.

symptoms.label: distended loops of intestines on rectal
expressive aphasia
symptoms.definition: An aphasia that is characterized by damage to, or a developmental issues in, the anterior regions of the brain, including (but not limited to) the left inferior frontal region known as Broca's area. Sufferers of this form of aphasia exhibit the common problem of agrammatism. For them, speech is difficult to initiate, non-fluent, labored, and halting.

symptoms.label: infertility
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized the biological inability of a man or a woman to contribute to conception; or, the state of a woman who is unable to carry a pregnancy to full term.

symptoms.label: skin desquamation
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by the peeling off of skin in the form of scales.

symptoms.label: loss of consciousness
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a state in which an individual lacks normal awareness of self and the surrounding environment and one's ability to remain awake, aware, and oriented is impaired.

symptoms.label: memory impairment
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a diminished or reduced ability to remember things such as dates and names, and increased forgetfulness.

symptoms.label: pulmonary consolidation
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by a region of normally compressible lung tissue that has filled with liquid instead of air.

symptoms.label: rapid respiration
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by an increased breathing rate, with more than 20 breaths per minute in an adult, while in children, the number of breaths per minute can be a higher resting rate than seen in adults.

symptoms.label: renal failure
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by a loss of excretory function in one or both kidneys, leading to retention of nitrogenous waste products from the blood.

symptoms.label: obsolete stroke
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by a sudden diminution or loss of consciousness, sensation, and voluntary motion caused by rupture or obstruction (as by a clot) of a blood vessel of the brain.

symptoms.label: obsolete suppurative pneumonia
symptoms.definition: A pneumonia that is characterized by the formation of pus and destruction of pulmonary tissue; abscess formation may occur.

symptoms.label: respiratory tract mucosa ulcer
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by an ulceration (dying and sloughing) of the bronchial or bronchiolar epithelium, exposing the underlying basement membrane.

symptoms.label: bronchopulmonary bleeding
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by bleeding (hemorrhage) in either or both the bronchi and the lungs.

symptoms.label: gum bleeding
symptoms.definition: Gum bleeding is a mouth symptom characterized by a copious discharge of blood from the blood vessels of the mucosal tissue that lies over the alveolar bone.

symptoms.label: enanthem
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an eruption on a mucous surface.

symptoms.label: facial edema
symptoms.definition: An adema that is characterized by an abnormal excess accumulation of serous fluid in connective tissue of the face.

symptoms.label: menorrhagia
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized an abnormally profuse menstrual flow.

symptoms.label: parotid pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a pain situated, or occurring, in the parotid gland, which is a salivary gland located in front of the ears. (Additional salivary glands include the submandibular and sublingual glands.) Pain is attributed to swelling of the gland.

symptoms.label: petechiae
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a minute reddish or purplish spot containing blood that appears in skin or mucous membrane as a result of localized hemorrhage.

symptoms.label: retrobulbar pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a pain situated, or occurring, behind the eyeball.

symptoms.label: testicular pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a pain in, or about, a testis (testicle) or testes. Testicular pain can be caused by nerve damage, sexually transmitted infections, gangrene, swelling, hernia, kidney stones, inflammation, enlarged veins, fluid in the testicle, or a severe condition known as testicular torsion.

symptoms.label: dysfunctions associated with arousal from sleep
chronic enteritis
symptoms.definition: Chronic enteritis is a enteritis with slow progress, long duration, or frequent recurrence which can be due to Crohn's disease, giardiasis, tuberculosis, coeliac disease, or rarely due to Whipple's disease.

symptoms.label: sinus bradycardia
symptoms.definition: Sinus bradycardia is a bradycardia where the sinus rhythm is abnormally slow bradycardia consisting of a sinus rhythm at a rate lower than 60 beats per minute.

symptoms.label: junctional tachycardia
symptoms.definition: Junctional tachycardia is a tachycardia associated with the generation of impulses in a locus in the region of the atrioventricular node.

symptoms.label: paroxysmal tachycardia
symptoms.definition: Paroxysmal tachycardia is a tachycardia that begins and ends abruptly and that is initiated by a premature supraventricular beat originating in the atrium or in the atrioventricular node or bundle of His or by a premature ventricular beat.

symptoms.label: sinus tachycardia
symptoms.definition: Sinus tachycardia is a tachychardia characterized by an abnormally rapid sinus rhythm specifically a sinus rhythm at a rate greater than 100 beats per minute.

symptoms.label: ventricular tachycardia
symptoms.definition: A tachycardia that is associated with the generation of improper electrical impulses within the ventricles, characterized by an electrocardiogram showing a rate of greater than 120 BPM and three or more wide QRS complexes in a row.

symptoms.label: sore eyes
symptoms.definition: Sore eyes is a eye symptom characterized by an inflammation of the thin covering of the eyeball and the inner eyelid brought about by a viral infection which may be highly contagious.

symptoms.label: neck pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by an unpleasant sensation localized in the neck that usually indicates the body is threatened or damaged. The sensation may be sharp or dull, short-lived or chronic, intermittent or continual.

symptoms.label: phantom pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a painful sensation that is perceived to originate in the amputated portion of the extremety. Patients may have localized pain that originates in the stump.

symptoms.label: nociceptive pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by originating from other than the peripheral and central nervous systems, and which is caused by activation of nociceptive fibers.

symptoms.label: neuropathic pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by being experienced by cancer patients and which is caused by radiotherapy or chemotherapy damage to nerves, when cancer invades or compresses nerves, or when, during cancer treatment. This type of pain is typically described as burning, electrical, or strange feeling.

symptoms.label: visceral pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by originating from organ tissues of the thorax, abdomen, or pelvis.  It characterizes as deep, vague, and difficult to locate pain, that radiates away from the affected organ.

symptoms.label: hypoesthesia
symptoms.definition: A sensation perception that is characterized by a reduced sense of touch or sensation, or a partial loss of sensitivity to sensory stimuli.

symptoms.label: hypoalgesia
symptoms.definition: A sensation perception that is characterized by a diminished sensitivity to painful stimulation.

symptoms.label: hyperalgesia
symptoms.definition: A sensation perception that is characterized by an increased response to a painful stimulus.

symptoms.label: chronic pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by ranging from mild to severe and which continues beyond the expected healing phase.

symptoms.label: breakthrough pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by occurring with movement and is not controlled by a scheduled pain medication regimen, such that the pain breaks through the current regimen. This is usually referred to in the context of a short and long acting opioid, the short acting opioid being used to treat the breakthrough pain.

symptoms.label: acute pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by being severe but lasting a relatively short time.

symptoms.label: allodynia
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a painful sensation with a normal, non-painful stimulation.

symptoms.label: reactive hyperemia
symptoms.definition: Reactive hyperemia is a hyperemia occurring due to the dilation of arteriolar smooth muscle to increase blood flow in response to a profound increase in blood flow to an organ after being occluded. There will be a shortage of oxygen and a build-up of metabolic waste.

symptoms.label: active hyperemia
symptoms.definition: Active hyperemia is a hyperemia occurring due to the dilation of arteriolar smooth muscle to increase blood flow in response to an increase in metabolism.

symptoms.label: functional hyperemia
symptoms.definition: Functional hyperemia is a hyperemia occurring due to an increase in blood flow to a tissue due to the presence of metabolites and a change in general conditions.

symptoms.label: face hyperemia
symptoms.definition: Hyperemia of the face is a head symptom consisting of an excess of blood in the tissues of the face as from an increased flow of blood due to vasodilation.

symptoms.label: hyperemia of the neck
symptoms.definition: Hyperemia of the neck is a neck symptom consisting of an excess of blood in the tissues of the neck as from an increased flow of blood due to vasodilation.

symptoms.label: chest hyperemia
symptoms.definition: Hyperemia of the chest is a cardiovascular system symptom consisting of an excess of blood in the tissues of the chest as from an increased flow of blood due to vasodilation.

symptoms.label: spastic paralysis
symptoms.definition: A paralysis that is characterized by a tonic spasm of the affected muscles and with increased tendon reflexes.

symptoms.label: motor paralysis
symptoms.definition: A paralysis that is characterized by a complete or partial loss of function the voluntary muscles.

symptoms.label: stillbirth
symptoms.definition: A reproductive system symptom that is characterized by the birth of a dead fetus; in which  a fetus that has died in the uterus, or during labor, or delivery, exits a woman's body.

symptoms.label: congested sclera
symptoms.definition: Congested sclera is a hyperemia characterized as the congestion of the vessels of the outer layer of the eye containing collagen and elastic fibers.

symptoms.label: gross hematuria
symptoms.definition: A hematuria that is characterized by the production of a visible redness in the urine.

symptoms.label: anuria
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by the absence of, or by defective, urine excretion.

symptoms.label: stress incontinence
symptoms.definition: A urinary incontinence that is characterized by an involuntary leakage of urine from the bladder accompanying physical activity (as in laughing, coughing, sneezing, or physical exercise) which places increased pressure on the abdomen.

symptoms.label: hypermenorrhea
symptoms.definition: A menorrhagia that is characterized by an abnormally profuse or prolonged menstrual flow.

symptoms.label: metrorrhagia
symptoms.definition: A menorrhagia that is characterized by an irregular uterine bleeding, especially between menstrual periods.

symptoms.label: subjective vertigo
symptoms.definition: A vertigo that is characterized by a sensation that one's body is revolving in space.

symptoms.label: objective vertigo
symptoms.definition: A vertigo that is characterized by a sensation that the external world is revolving.

symptoms.label: hypokinesia
symptoms.definition: Hypokinesia is a musculoskeletal system  symptom characterized by the slow or diminished movement of body musculature. It may be associated with basal ganglia diseases; mental disorders; prolonged inactivity due to illness; experimental protocols used to evaluate the physiologic effects of immobility; and other conditions.

symptoms.label: rigidity hypokinesia
symptoms.definition: Rigidity hypokinesia a type of hypokinesia described as the increase in muscle tension when moved by an outside force.

symptoms.label: postural instability hypokinesia
symptoms.definition: Postural instability hypokinesia is a hypokinesia described as a loss of ability to maintain an upright posture.

symptoms.label: freezing hypokinesia
symptoms.definition: Freezing hypokinesia is a hypkinesia where a person can not move their muscles how they want them to.

symptoms.label: referred pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by pain which is subjectively localized in one region although it is due to irritation in another region.

symptoms.label: facial tremor
symptoms.definition: Facial tremor is a head symptom characterized by a trembling or shaking of the muscles of the face usually from physical weakness, emotional stress, or disease, may be emphasized by the firm closure of the eyes, elevation of the eyebrows, or drawing down and outward of the corners of the mouth.

symptoms.label: cervical edema
symptoms.definition: Cervical edema is a neck symptom characterized by an abnormal excess accumulation of serous fluid in the soft tissue of the cervical area.

symptoms.label: gastrointestinal bleeding
symptoms.definition: A digestive system symptom characterized by bleeding from one or more of the areas of the digestive or gastrointestinal (GI) tract that includes the espophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intestine or colon, rectum and anus.

symptoms.label: breathing problems
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by a shortness of breath, a hard or uncomfortable intake of air, or the feeling that you're not getting enough air.

symptoms.label: nasal congestion
symptoms.definition: A congestion that is characterized by a blockage of the nasal passages, usually due to the membranes lining the nose becoming swollen from inflamed blood vessels.

symptoms.label: icteric eyes
symptoms.definition: Icteric eyes is a eye symptom characterized by yellowed eyes due to bile or bilirubin accumulation.

symptoms.label: icteric mucous membrane
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by yellowed mucous membranes due to bile or bilirubin accumulation.

symptoms.label: icteric skin
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by yellowed skin due to bile or bilirubin accumulation.

symptoms.label: otitis
symptoms.definition: Otitis is a ear symptom characterized as a general term for inflammation or infection of the ear, in both humans and other animals.

symptoms.label: hematoma
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a mass of usually clotted blood that forms in a tissue, organ, or body space as a result of a broken blood vessel generally the result of hemorrhage, or more specifically, internal bleeding.

symptoms.label: lameness
symptoms.definition: Lameness is a musculoskeletal system symptom where a person is physically disabled as the result of having a body part and especially a limb so disabled as to impair freedom of movement.

symptoms.label: pericardial effusion
symptoms.definition: Pericardial effusion is a cardiovascular system symptom where there is an abnormal accumulation of fluid in the pericardial cavity.

symptoms.label: transient fever
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by a rise of body temperature above the normal that is sustained for only a short period of time.

symptoms.label: low-grade fever
symptoms.definition: A mild fever that is characterized by a fever that does not exceed 38.5 degrees Celsius (101.3 degrees Fahrenheit).

symptoms.label: prolonged fever
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by as  persisting over a prolonged period of time.

symptoms.label: mild fever
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by being mild in form.

symptoms.label: high fever
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by an elevated temperature.

symptoms.label: very high fever
symptoms.definition: A high fever that is characterized by extremely high temperatures.

symptoms.label: hyperpyrexia
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by an extreme elevation of body temperature greater than, or equal to, 41.5 degrees Celsius (106.7 degrees Fahrenheit).

symptoms.label: Pel-Epstein fever
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by association with Hodgkin's lymphoma, where the fever alternates weekly from high to low.

symptoms.label: continuous fever
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by a temperature remaining above normal throughout the day and which does not fluctuate more than 1 degree Celsius in 24 hours.

symptoms.label: remittent fever
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by a fever where the temperature remains above normal throughout the day and fluctuates more than 1 degree Celsius in 24 hours.

symptoms.label: relapsing fever
symptoms.definition: A fever that is characterized by  body temperature periodically rising and falling.

symptoms.label: sensation perception
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by interpretation of the information perceived by sensory receptors.

symptoms.label: hypotensive
symptoms.definition: A low blood pressure characterized by or due to abnormally low blood pressure, especially in the arteries of the systemic circulation.

symptoms.label: cold clammy skin
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by cold, moist and sticky skin.

symptoms.label: anaphylactic shock
symptoms.definition: An acute allergic reaction to an antigen to which the body has become hypersensitive.

symptoms.label: exophthalmos
symptoms.definition: An abnormal protrusion or displacement of an eye or other body part.

symptoms.label: ventricular bradycardia
symptoms.definition: A bradycardia associated with the generation of impules in the ventricles when impules from the atria fail to reach them, characterized by an electrocardiogram showing a heart rate below 50 BPM and a broad QRS complex.

symptoms.label: cardiac fibrillation
symptoms.definition: An arrhythmia characterized by rapid, irregular, and unsynchronized contraction of muscle fibers within the heart.

symptoms.label: ventricular fibrillation
symptoms.definition: A cardiac fibrillation associated with quivering of the lower chambers of the heart, preventing blood from being pumped and causing cardiac arrest.

symptoms.label: allergic reaction
symptoms.definition: An immune system symptom that is characterized by sensitivities to substances called allergens.

symptoms.label: vomiting
symptoms.definition: Vomiting is a digestive system symptom characterized by throwing up the stomach contents.

symptoms.label: hematemesis
symptoms.definition: A vomiting where there is vomiting of blood.

symptoms.label: pulmonary edema
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by an abnormal accumulation of fluid in the lungs.

symptoms.label: diaphoresis
symptoms.definition: A sweat that is characterized by excessive sweating commonly associated with shock and other medical emergency conditions.

symptoms.label: dyspnea
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by difficult or labored respiration.

symptoms.label: hemorrhagic mediastinitis
symptoms.definition: A respiratory abnormality that is characterized by inflammation of the mediastinum (the chest cavity, which contains the heart, the thymus gland, some lymph nodes, and parts of the esophagus, aorta, thyroid, and parathyroid glands) as the result of bleeding.

symptoms.label: eschar
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a scab formed especially after a burn.

symptoms.label: boil
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a localized swelling and inflammation of the skin resulting from usually bacterial infection of a hair follicle and adjacent tissue, having a hard central core, and forming pus.

symptoms.label: muscle pain
symptoms.definition: A pain that is characterized by a pain in one or more muscles.

symptoms.label: pustule
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by a small circumscribed elevation of the skin containing pus and having an inflamed base.

symptoms.label: obsolete pneumonia
symptoms.definition: A pneumonitis that is characterized by an inflammatory illness of the lung resulting from a variety of causes including infection with bacteria, viruses, fungi, or parasites, and chemical or physical injury to the lungs. Its cause may also be officially described as idiopathic, that is, unknown, when infectious causes have been excluded.

symptoms.label: arthritis
symptoms.definition: Arthritis is a musculoskeletal system symptom characterized as an inflammation of joints due to infectious, metabolic, or constitutional causes.

symptoms.label: spondylitis
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by an inflammation of the vertebrae.

symptoms.label: meningitis
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by an inflammation of the meninges and especially of the pia mater and the arachnoid.

symptoms.label: sweaty
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by the excretion of moisture in visible quantities through the opening of the sweat glands.

symptoms.label: malaise
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by an indefinite feeling of debility or lack of health, often indicative of or accompanying the onset of an illness.

symptoms.label: fatigue
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a weariness or exhaustion from labor, exertion, or stress.

symptoms.label: necrotic lesion
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by regions of cell death to living tissue in an organ, which has suffered damage through injury or disease, such as a wound, ulcer, abscess, or tumor.

symptoms.label: lightheadedness
symptoms.definition: A  balance symptom that is characterized by a condition of being dizzy or on the verge of fainting, particularly when one arises to a standing position. Lightheadedness is a predictable consequence of any medication tending to lower blood pressure.

symptoms.label: constipation
symptoms.definition: Constipation is a feces and droppings symptom involving the abnormally delayed or infrequent passage of dry hardened feces. Constipation may be categorized into three subtypes: normal-transit, slow-transit, and pelvic floor dysfunction.

symptoms.label: behavioral symptom
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by an involvement, or relation to, or emphasizes behavior.

symptoms.label: hyperactivity
symptoms.definition: A behavioral symptom that is characterized by an increase in movement, impulsive actions, a shorter attention span, and being easily distracted.

symptoms.label: limited attention
symptoms.definition: A behavioral symptom that is characterized by a restricted rate of information processing by the brain.

symptoms.label: communication difficulty
symptoms.definition: A behavioral symptom that is characterized by speech, language and communication needs or communication disabilities.

symptoms.label: obsessive interests
symptoms.definition: A behavioral symptom that is characterized by obsessive and highly-focused interests.

symptoms.label: repetitive behavior
symptoms.definition: A behavioral symptom that is characterized by an unusual repetitive motor movements or manipulation of objects.

symptoms.label: intracranial hemorrhage
symptoms.definition: A hemorrhage that is characterized by any bleeding occurring within the skull.

symptoms.label: intracerebral hemorrhage
symptoms.definition: A hemorrhage that is characterized by bleeding within the brain tissue itself.

symptoms.label: subdural hemorrhage
symptoms.definition: A hemorrhage that is characterized by bleeding that occurs within the skull of head but outside the actual brain tissue.

symptoms.label: airway stenosis
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by a narrowing in the airway that obstructs the passage of air into the lungs.  Examples include tracheal and laryngotracheal stenosis.

symptoms.label: apthous ulcer
symptoms.definition: A skin ulcer that is characterized by a small recurrent, painful, round or ovoid ulcers with well-defined erythematous margins, like a halo, and a central yellow or gray floor found in the soft tissue of the oral cavity.

symptoms.label: ageusia
symptoms.definition: A disturbances of sensation of smell and taste that is characterized by a complete loss of taste function of the tongue.

symptoms.label: agitation
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by a feeling of irritability or severe restlessness.

symptoms.label: barking croup cough
symptoms.definition: A cough that is characterized by a tight, low-pitched, and barky (like a barking seal) cough.

symptoms.label: abnormal weight loss
symptoms.definition: A weight loss that is characterized as deviating from what is normal or usual, typically in a way that is undesirable or worrying.

symptoms.label: chronic weight loss
symptoms.definition: A weight loss that is characterized by conditions that last 1 year or more and require ongoing medical attention, or limit activities of daily living, or both.

symptoms.label: acute weight gain
symptoms.definition: A weight gain that is characterized by a severe and sudden onset.

symptoms.label: chronic weight gain
symptoms.definition: A weight gain that is characterized by conditions that last 1 year or more and require ongoing medical attention, or limit activities of daily living, or both.

symptoms.label: overweight
symptoms.definition: A weight symptom that is characterized by being too heavy for one’s height. Excess body weight can come from fat, muscle, bone, and/or water retention. Being overweight does not always mean being obese.

symptoms.label: postnasal drainage
symptoms.definition: A nose symptom that is characterized by an an excessive secretion of mucous down the back of the throat.

symptoms.label: bone conduction hyperacusis
symptoms.definition: An ear symptom - need proper definition - placeholder for xref.

symptoms.label: bronchospasm
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by constriction of the air passages of the lung (as in asthma) by spasmodic contraction of the bronchial muscles.

symptoms.label: caseation
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by necrosis of tissue with conversion of damaged tissue into a soft cheesy substance.

symptoms.label: wet cough
symptoms.definition: A cough that is characterized by a production and expectoration (bringing up) of mucus (phlegm) or sputum.

symptoms.label: concentration difficulty
symptoms.definition: An alteration of consciousness that is characterized by a decreased ability to focus one's thoughts on something. Concentration difficulties can be related to difficulty staying awake, impulsiveness, intrusive thoughts or concerns, overactivity, or inattention. They can be caused by medical, cognitive or psychological problems, or, may be related to sleep disorders, medications, alcohol, or drugs.

symptoms.label: patches of hair loss with a black dot pattern
symptoms.definition: A hair symptom that is characterized by patchy hair loss and the presence of comedo-like cadaver hairs, which appear as black dots.

symptoms.label: chest discomfort
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by pain, pressure, tightness, or other discomfort originating in or radiating to the chest, which constitutes an important indicator of potentially serious cardiac or cardiovascular disorders.

symptoms.label: chest tightness
symptoms.definition: A chest discomfort that is characterized by any type of pain or discomfort between your upper belly and lower neck.

symptoms.label: paroxysmal cough
symptoms.definition: A cough that is characterized by a persistent cough with sudden onset due to difficulty expelling thick mucus from the tracheobronchial tree. This type of cough is associated with diseases such as Pertussis (Whooping Cough).

symptoms.label: conjunctival congestion
symptoms.definition: An eye symptom that is characterized by (need def conjunctival congestion - placeholder for xref).

symptoms.label: conjunctival suffusion
symptoms.definition: An eye symptom that is characterized by (need def conjunctival suffusion - placeholder for xref).

symptoms.label: contracture
symptoms.definition: A musculoskeletal system symptom that is characterized by a permanent tightening of the muscles, tendons, skin, and nearby tissues that causes the joints to shorten and become very stiff.

symptoms.label: corkscrew hair
symptoms.definition: A hair symptom that is characterized by coiled “corkscrew” hairs on the surface of the arms, legs and chest, which can occur as a result low level of ascorbic acid (vitamin C).

symptoms.label: corneal scarring
symptoms.definition: A cornea symptom that is characterized by scarring (an opacity or irregularity in the cornea) of the cornea, from trauma; abrasion; bacterial, fungal, viral, or parasitic infection; or disease, and can result in impaired vision, or even blindness.

symptoms.label: dark urine
symptoms.definition: A urinary system symptom that is characterized by an elevation in the concentration of the the pigments from foods, dyes, and medications in urine. The dilution of these pigment is dependent on the amount of water intake and severe dehydration can lead to a dark color.

symptoms.label: hair shedding
symptoms.definition: A hair symptom that is characterized by significant falling out of hair, which may be a result of stress, high fever, and other factors.

symptoms.label: balance symptom
symptoms.definition: A neurological and physiological symptom that is characterized by any of the following: dizziness or vertigo (a spinning sensation); falling or feeling as if you are going to fall; staggering when walking; lightheadedness, faintness, or a floating sensation; and confusion or disorientation.

symptoms.label: feeding problem
symptoms.definition: A feeding difficulties and mismanagement that is characterized by delays and/or disorders in the development of eating and drinking skills including disordered placement of food in the mouth, difficulty in appropriately manipulating food when it is in the mouth, difficulty chewing, and/or difficulty swallowing.

symptoms.label: descending muscle paralysis
symptoms.definition: A paralysis that is characterized by a loss of motor function in one or more muscles, which can also be accompanied by a loss of feeling (sensory loss). Descending paralysis contrasts with ascending paralysis in that descending paralysis presents in the upper limbs before the lower limbs. Descending paralysis occurs in conditions such as botulism.

symptoms.label: delayed psychomotor development
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by the delay in development child's cognitive, emotional, motor, and social capacities from the beginning of life throughout fetal and neonatal periods, infancy, childhood, and adolescence.

symptoms.label: decreased tearing
symptoms.definition: An eye symptom that is characterized by a reduction in the saline fluid secreted by the lacrimal gland.

symptoms.label: decreased metabolism
symptoms.definition: A nutrition, metabolism, and development symptom that is characterized by a reduction in the chemical reactions catalyzed by enzymes, which keep us alive. Metabolism allows organisms to grow, reproduce, maintain their structures, and respond to their environments and can be divided into catabolism (breaking down of organic matter) and anabolism (building of molecules).

symptoms.label: hand weakness
symptoms.definition: A muscle weakness that is characterized by a reduction in muscle strength, which may be the result of a variety of conditions, such as carpal tunnel syndrome, arthritis, peripheral neuropathy, tendon damage, and ganglion cysts.

symptoms.label: mammary gland inflammation
symptoms.definition: A skin and integumentary tissue symptom that is characterized by an inflammation of the mammary gland or udder and usually caused by infection.

symptoms.label: severe mammary gland inflammation
symptoms.definition: A mammary gland inflammation that is characterized by an increased intensity or severity of the condition.

symptoms.label: cerebrovascular accident
symptoms.definition: A nervous system symptom that is characterized by a loss of blood flow to part of the brain, which damages brain tissue. Cerebrovascular accidents are caused by blood clots and broken blood vessels in the brain.

symptoms.label: bronchiole inflammation
symptoms.definition: A respiratory system and chest symptom that is characterized by acute inflammation of the bronchi, accompanied by inflamed patches in the nearby lobules of the lungs.

symptoms.label: outlet dysfunction constipation
symptoms.definition: A constipation that is characterized by difficulty passing bowel movements after they reach the rectum. One experiences difficulty evacuating the stool and often has to strain or press the fingers into the vagina or in front of or into the rectum to help remove the stool. Outlet dysfunction can be caused by inappropriate or abnormal muscle contraction of the pelvic floor (called pelvic floor dyssynergia or dyssynergic defecation) which can respond to biofeedback. It may also be due to a rectocele or other structural changes in the pelvic floor that will require medical or at times, surgical treatment.

symptoms.label: soft tissue necrosis
symptoms.definition: A musculoskeletal system symptom that is characterized by necrosis (i.e. tissue death) of soft tissue, including muscle, fat, blood vessels, nerves, tendons, and tissues that surround the bones and joints.
